```php
        Actor $actor,
        ?BookingRules $rules = null,
        ?BookingData $data = null,
        ?CarbonImmutable $now = null,
    ): void {
        ($rules ?? $this->rules())->assertBookable(
            $profile,
            $session,
            $data ?? new BookingData(PaymentType::Umum),
            $actor,
            $now ?? CarbonImmutable::now(),
        );
    }

    private function assertRejected(string $code, callable $call): BookingException
    {
        try {
            $call();
        } catch (BookingException $e) {
            $this->assertSame($code, $e->errorCode, 'Kode galat: '.$e->getMessage());

            return $e;
        }

        $this->fail("Seharusnya ditolak dengan {$code}, tetapi diterima.");
    }

    private function assertAccepted(callable $call): void
    {
        $call();

        $this->addToAssertionCount(1);
    }

    /**
     * Sesi dengan satu kondisi yang membuat F.5 #1 gagal; `$condition` = nilai dari `unavailableConditions()`.
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     */
    private function unavailableSession(string $condition, array $overrides = []): PracticeSession
    {
        $clinic = Clinic::factory()->create([
            'is_active' => $condition !== 'clinic_inactive',
            'is_bookable' => $condition !== 'clinic_not_bookable',
        ]);

        $doctorFactory = match ($condition) {
            'doctor_inactive' => Doctor::factory()->inactive(),
            'doctor_archived' => Doctor::factory()->archived(),
            default => Doctor::factory(),
        };
        $doctor = $doctorFactory->create(['clinic_id' => $clinic->id]);

        $sessionFactory = match ($condition) {
            'closed' => PracticeSession::factory()->closed(),
            'needs_review' => PracticeSession::factory()->needsReview(['source' => PracticeSession::SOURCE_MANUAL_TIME]),
            'cancelled' => PracticeSession::factory()->cancelled(),
            default => PracticeSession::factory(),
        };

        return $sessionFactory->manual()->create(array_merge($this->sessionAttributes($overrides), [
            'doctor_id' => $doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $clinic->id,
        ]));
    }

    /**
     * Pendaftaran aktif pasien pada tiga sesi berbeda tanggal (6, 7, 8 Oktober; status pending, confirmed,
     * checked_in) sehingga hitungan "aktif mendatang" = 3 tanpa saling bertabrakan.
     *
     * @return list<PracticeSession>
     */
    private function bookThreeUpcoming(PatientProfile $profile): array
    {
        $sessions = [];

        foreach ([['2026-10-06', AppointmentStatus::Pending], ['2026-10-07', AppointmentStatus::Confirmed], ['2026-10-08', AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn]] as [$date, $status]) {
            $session = $this->makeSession(['session_date' => $date]);
            $this->bookAppointment($session, $status, ['patient_profile_id' => $profile->id]);
            $sessions[] = $session;
        }

        return $sessions;
    }

    #[DataProvider('windowDates')]
    public function test_bkg_06_the_default_thirty_day_window_has_exact_edges(string $date, bool $accepted): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $session = $this->makeSession(['session_date' => $date, 'start_time' => '20:00:00', 'end_time' => '22:00:00']);
        $call = fn () => $this->check($user->patientProfile, $session, Actor::patient($user), now: $this->at('2026-10-05 10:00:00'));

        if ($accepted) {

        $this->assertSame('Pendaftaran hanya dapat dilakukan untuk tanggal mulai hari ini sampai 30 hari ke depan.', $e->getMessage());
        $this->assertSame($session->id, $e->context['practice_session_id']);

    {

        $actor = Actor::patient($user);

        $this->assertAccepted(fn () => $this->check($user->patientProfile, $later, $actor, now: $this->at('2026-10-05 10:00:00')));
        $this->assertAccepted(fn () => $this->check($user->patientProfile, $later, $actor, now: $this->at('2026-10-05 12:59:59')));
        $this->assertRejected('CUTOFF_PASSED', fn () => $this->check($user->patientProfile, $later, $actor, now: $this->at('2026-10-05 13:00:00')));

        $officer = $this->officer();
        $this->assertAccepted(fn () => $this->check($user->patientProfile, $later, $officer, now: $this->at('2026-10-05 16:59:59')));
        $this->assertRejected('CUTOFF_PASSED', fn () => $this->check($user->patientProfile, $later, $officer, now: $this->at('2026-10-05 17:00:00')));
    }

    /** @return array<string, array{string, string, bool}> */
    public static function overlapCases(): array
    {
        // Pendaftaran yang sudah ada: 09.00-12.00 pada 7 Oktober 2026. Kolom: mulai, selesai, bertabrakan?
        return [
            'beririsan di akhir (11.00-13.00)' => ['11:00:00', '13:00:00', true],
            'berimpit tepat di batas akhir (12.00-14.00)' => ['12:00:00', '14:00:00', false],
            'berimpit tepat di batas awal (07.00-09.00)' => ['07:00:00', '09:00:00', false],
            'beririsan di awal (08.00-10.00)' => ['08:00:00', '10:00:00', true],
            'berada di dalam (09.30-10.30)' => ['09:30:00', '10:30:00', true],
            'melingkupi (08.00-13.00)' => ['08:00:00', '13:00:00', true],
            'jam sama persis (09.00-12.00)' => ['09:00:00', '12:00:00', true],
            'satu detik sebelum batas akhir' => ['11:59:59', '14:00:00', true],
            'satu detik sesudah batas akhir' => ['12:00:01', '14:00:00', false],
            'jauh sesudahnya' => ['14:00:00', '16:00:00', false],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('overlapCases')]
    public function test_bkg_03_overlap_is_strict_and_spans_doctors(string $start, string $end, bool $overlaps): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $profile = $user->patientProfile;
        $existing = $this->makeSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-07']);
        $booked = $this->bookAppointment($existing, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, ['patient_profile_id' => $profile->id]);
        $target = $this->makeSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-07', 'start_time' => $start, 'end_time' => $end]);
        $call = fn () => $this->check($profile, $target, Actor::patient($user), now: $this->at('2026-10-05 10:00:00'));

        $this->assertNotSame($existing->doctor_id, $target->doctor_id, 'Benturan berlaku lintas dokter.');

        if (! $overlaps) {
            $this->assertAccepted($call);

            return;
        }

        $e = $this->assertRejected('OVERLAPPING_BOOKING', $call);
        $this->assertSame($booked->booking_code, $e->context['appointment_code']);
        $this->assertSame($target->id, $e->context['practice_session_id']);
    }

    {

        $profile = $user->patientProfile;

    public function test_bkg_09_insurance_needs_an_existing_active_partner(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $profile = $user->patientProfile;
        $session = $this->makeSession();
        $active = InsurancePartner::factory()->create();
        $inactive = InsurancePartner::factory()->inactive()->create();
        $now = $this->at('2026-10-05 10:00:00');
        $actor = Actor::patient($user);

        $this->assertAccepted(fn () => $this->check($profile, $session, $actor, data: new BookingData(PaymentType::Asuransi, null, $active->id), now: $now));
        $this->assertAccepted(fn () => $this->check($profile, $session, $actor, data: new BookingData(PaymentType::Asuransi, 'POL/2026-001', $active->id), now: $now));
        $this->assertAccepted(fn () => $this->check($profile, $session, $actor, data: new BookingData(PaymentType::Asuransi, str_repeat('A', 30), $active->id), now: $now));

        $rejected = [
            'mitra nonaktif' => new BookingData(PaymentType::Asuransi, null, $inactive->id),
            'mitra tidak ada' => new BookingData(PaymentType::Asuransi, null, 999999),
            'polis 31 karakter' => new BookingData(PaymentType::Asuransi, str_repeat('A', 31), $active->id),
            'polis berspasi' => new BookingData(PaymentType::Asuransi, 'POL 001', $active->id),
            'polis berisi karakter terlarang' => new BookingData(PaymentType::Asuransi, 'POL#001', $active->id),
            'polis dengan newline di akhir' => new BookingData(PaymentType::Asuransi, "POL-001\n", $active->id),
        ];

        foreach ($rejected as $label => $data) {
            $e = $this->assertRejected('INVALID_PAYMENT', fn () => $this->check($profile, $session, $actor, data: $data, now: $now));
            $this->assertSame('INVALID_PAYMENT', $e->errorCode, $label);
        }
    }

    /** @return array<string, array{string, string, bool, bool}> */
    public static function agreementCases(): array
    {
        // Kolom: jenis sesi, jam "sekarang" pada 6 Oktober 2026, dapat dipesan online?, dapat dipesan di loket?
        return [

            'tersedia, satu detik sebelum cutoff' => ['normal', '07:59:59', true, true],

            'sudah mulai tetapi belum berakhir' => ['normal', '11:59:59', false, true],
            'tepat berakhir' => ['normal', '12:00:00', false, false],
            'penuh' => ['full', '07:00:00', false, false],
            'tepat pada batas jendela 30 hari' => ['day_30', '07:00:00', true, true],
            'melewati batas jendela 30 hari' => ['day_31', '07:00:00', false, false],
            'ditutup petugas' => ['closed', '07:00:00', false, false],
            'dibatalkan' => ['cancelled', '07:00:00', false, false],
            'menunggu tinjauan' => ['needs_review', '07:00:00', false, false],
            'dokter nonaktif' => ['doctor_inactive', '07:00:00', false, false],
            'dokter diarsipkan' => ['doctor_archived', '07:00:00', false, false],
            'poliklinik nonaktif' => ['clinic_inactive', '07:00:00', false, false],

        ];

    #[DataProvider('agreementCases')]
    public function test_k3_assert_bookable_agrees_with_the_availability_query_for_available_sessions(string $kind, string $time, bool $online, bool $counter): void
    {
        $now = $this->at('2026-10-06 '.$time);
        $session = match ($kind) {
            'normal' => $this->makeSession(),
            'full' => $this->makeSession(['quota' => 2, 'booked_count' => 2, 'last_queue_number' => 2]),
            'day_30' => $this->makeSession(['session_date' => '2026-11-05']),
            'day_31' => $this->makeSession(['session_date' => '2026-11-06']),
            default => $this->unavailableSession($kind),
        };
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $profile = $user->patientProfile;

        $availability = $this->app->make(DoctorAvailabilityQuery::class);
        $onlinePasses = $this->passes(fn () => $this->check($profile, $session, Actor::patient($user), now: $now));
        $counterPasses = $this->passes(fn () => $this->check($profile, $session, $this->officer(), now: $now));

        $this->assertSame($online, $availability->forSession($session, false, $now)->isBookableOnline);
        $this->assertSame($counter, $availability->forSession($session, true, $now)->isBookableCounter);
        $this->assertSame($online, $onlinePasses, 'assertBookable online harus sepakat dengan isBookableOnline.');
        $this->assertSame($counter, $counterPasses, 'assertBookable loket harus sepakat dengan isBookableCounter.');
    }

    // --- F6-R12: hanya baca; muat relasi tanpa lazy load ---

    public function test_f6_r12_assert_bookable_reads_only_and_takes_no_locks(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $profile = $user->patientProfile;
        $partner = InsurancePartner::factory()->create();
        $this->bookAppointment($this->makeSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-07']), AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, ['patient_profile_id' => $profile->id]);
        $session = $this->makeSession();
        $appointmentsBefore = Appointment::query()->count();
        $counterBefore = [$session->fresh()->booked_count, $session->fresh()->last_queue_number];

        DB::flushQueryLog();
        DB::enableQueryLog();

        $this->check($profile, $session, Actor::patient($user), data: new BookingData(PaymentType::Asuransi, 'POL/2026-001', $partner->id), now: $this->at('2026-10-05 10:00:00'));

        $queries = array_column(DB::getQueryLog(), 'query');
        DB::disableQueryLog();

        $this->assertGreaterThanOrEqual(4, count($queries), 'Aturan #5-#8 masing-masing menjalankan satu kueri.');

        foreach ($queries as $sql) {
            $this->assertDoesNotMatchRegularExpression('/\bfor update\b|^\s*(insert|update|delete)\b/i', $sql, 'assertBookable tidak boleh mengunci atau menulis: '.$sql);
        }

        $this->assertSame($appointmentsBefore, Appointment::query()->count());
        $this->assertSame($counterBefore, [$session->fresh()->booked_count, $session->fresh()->last_queue_number]);
    }

    public function test_a_session_from_a_collection_is_checked_without_a_lazy_loading_violation(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $a = $this->makeSession();
        $b = $this->makeSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-07']);
        $loaded = PracticeSession::query()->whereKey([$a->id, $b->id])->orderBy('id')->get();

        $this->assertFalse($loaded->first()->relationLoaded('doctor'));

        $this->assertAccepted(fn () => $this->check($user->patientProfile, $loaded->first(), Actor::patient($user), now: $this->at('2026-10-05 10:00:00')));

        $this->assertTrue($loaded->first()->relationLoaded('doctor'));
        $this->assertTrue($loaded->first()->relationLoaded('clinic'));
    }

    // --- pembantu bersama ---

    private function passes(callable $call): bool
    {
        try {
            $call();
        } catch (BookingException) {
            return false;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```php
use App\Enums\BookingChannel;
use App\Enums\DoctorStatus;
use App\Enums\PaymentType;
use App\Enums\SessionStatus;
use App\Exceptions\BookingException;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\InsurancePartner;
use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Services\Settings\SettingsService;
use App\Support\Actor;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;

/**
 * Snapshot pengaturan `booking.*` (11 §6.1), dibaca sekali per operasi, beserta aturan F.5 #1-#8
 * (`assertBookable()`, F6-R11). Aturan hanya MEMBACA: pemanggil (`BookingService::book()`) yang mengunci profil
```

```php
            autoConfirm: $settings->bool('booking.auto_confirm', false),
```

```php
    /**
     * Aturan F.5 #1-#8 menurut urutan 00 F.5; yang pertama gagal dilempar sebagai BookingException (kode,
     * pesan Indonesia, konteks `practice_session_id` serta `appointment_code` untuk DUPLICATE/OVERLAPPING).
     * Kanal dari `$actor`: staf = loket (#3 memakai akhir sesi, #7 dilewati), selain itu online. Profil
     * dianggap sudah valid dan aktif (diperiksa middleware, Policy, dan `book()`). `booked_count` dibaca dari
     * instans `$session` yang dioper (pemanggil menjamin kesegarannya).
     *
     * @throws BookingException
     */
    public function assertBookable(PatientProfile $profile, PracticeSession $session, BookingData $data, Actor $actor, CarbonImmutable $now): void
    {
        $counter = $actor->channel() === BookingChannel::Loket;
        $session->loadMissing(['doctor', 'clinic']);

        $this->assertSessionAvailable($session);
        $this->assertInsideWindow($session, $now);
        $this->assertBeforeCutoff($session, $now, $counter);
        $this->assertHasQuota($session);
        $this->assertNoDuplicate($profile, $session, $counter);
        $this->assertNoOverlap($profile, $session, $counter);

        if (! $counter) {
            $this->assertBelowActiveLimit($profile, $session, $now);
        }

        $this->assertValidPayment($session, $data);
    }

    /** #1: sesi `open`, dokter `active`, poliklinik `is_active` dan `is_bookable`. */
    private function assertSessionAvailable(PracticeSession $session): void
    {
        $available = $session->status === SessionStatus::Open
            && $session->doctor->status === DoctorStatus::Active
            && $session->clinic->is_active
            && $session->clinic->is_bookable;

        if (! $available) {
            throw BookingException::make(BookingException::SESSION_UNAVAILABLE, [], $this->context($session));
        }
    }

    /** #2: hari ini <= `session_date` <= hari ini + `windowDays` (hari ke-N masih diterima). */
    private function assertInsideWindow(PracticeSession $session, CarbonImmutable $now): void
    {
        $today = $now->setTimezone((string) config('app.timezone'))->startOfDay();
        $date = $session->session_date->toDateString();

        if ($date < $today->toDateString() || $date > $today->addDays($this->windowDays)->toDateString()) {
            throw BookingException::make(BookingException::OUTSIDE_WINDOW, ['days' => $this->windowDays], $this->context($session));
        }
    }

    /** #3: online `now >= start - onlineCutoffMinutes`; loket `now >= end`. */
    private function assertBeforeCutoff(PracticeSession $session, CarbonImmutable $now, bool $counter): void
    {
        if ($counter) {
            if ($now->greaterThanOrEqualTo($session->ends_at)) {
                throw BookingException::makeVariant(BookingException::CUTOFF_PASSED, 'CUTOFF_PASSED_COUNTER', [], $this->context($session));
            }

            return;
        }

        if ($now->greaterThanOrEqualTo($session->starts_at->subMinutes($this->onlineCutoffMinutes))) {
            throw BookingException::make(BookingException::CUTOFF_PASSED, ['minutes' => $this->onlineCutoffMinutes], $this->context($session));
        }
    }

    /** #4: `booked_count < quota`. */
    private function assertHasQuota(PracticeSession $session): void
    {
        if ((int) $session->booked_count >= (int) $session->quota) {
            throw BookingException::make(BookingException::QUOTA_FULL, [], $this->context($session));
        }
    }

    /** #5: tidak ada pendaftaran aktif pasien pada sesi yang sama. */
    private function assertNoDuplicate(PatientProfile $profile, PracticeSession $session, bool $counter): void
    {
        $code = Appointment::query()
            ->forPatient($profile)
            ->active()
            ->where('appointments.practice_session_id', $session->getKey())
            ->value('appointments.booking_code');

        if ($code !== null) {
            throw BookingException::make(
                BookingException::DUPLICATE_BOOKING,
                ['subjek' => $this->subject($counter)],
                $this->context($session, ['appointment_code' => (string) $code]),
            );
        }
    }

    /** #6: tidak ada pendaftaran aktif pasien pada tanggal sama di sesi lain berjam beririsan (`start1 < end2 AND start2 < end1`). */
    private function assertNoOverlap(PatientProfile $profile, PracticeSession $session, bool $counter): void
    {
        $start = $session->starts_at->format('H:i:s');
        $end = $session->ends_at->format('H:i:s');

        $other = Appointment::query()
            ->forPatient($profile)
            ->active()
            ->where('appointments.session_date', $session->session_date->toDateString())
            ->where('appointments.practice_session_id', '!=', $session->getKey())
            ->whereHas('practiceSession', fn (Builder $existing): Builder => $existing
                ->where('practice_sessions.start_time', '<', $end)
                ->where('practice_sessions.end_time', '>', $start))
            ->with(['practiceSession', 'doctor'])
            ->orderBy('appointments.id')
            ->first();

        if ($other !== null) {
            throw BookingException::make(
                BookingException::OVERLAPPING_BOOKING,
                [
                    'subjek' => $this->subject($counter),
                    'doctor' => $other->doctor->display_name,
                    'start' => $other->practiceSession->starts_at->format('H.i'),
                    'end' => $other->practiceSession->ends_at->format('H.i'),
                ],
                $this->context($session, ['appointment_code' => $other->booking_code]),
            );
        }
    }

    /** #7 (online saja): jumlah pendaftaran aktif mendatang pasien < `maxActivePerPatient`. */
    private function assertBelowActiveLimit(PatientProfile $profile, PracticeSession $session, CarbonImmutable $now): void
    {
        $count = Appointment::query()->forPatient($profile)->upcomingActive($now)->count();

        if ($count >= $this->maxActivePerPatient) {
            throw BookingException::make(
                BookingException::ACTIVE_LIMIT_REACHED,
                ['subjek' => $this->subject(false), 'max' => $this->maxActivePerPatient],
                $this->context($session),
            );
        }
    }

    /** #8: bpjs = 13 digit tanpa mitra; asuransi = mitra aktif (+ polis opsional); umum = tanpa referensi dan mitra. */
    private function assertValidPayment(PracticeSession $session, BookingData $data): void
    {
        $reference = $data->paymentReference;
        $partnerId = $data->insurancePartnerId;

        $valid = match ($data->paymentType) {
            PaymentType::Bpjs => $partnerId === null
                && $reference !== null
                && preg_match('/\A[0-9]{13}\z/', $reference) === 1,
            PaymentType::Asuransi => $partnerId !== null
                && ($reference === null || preg_match('/\A[A-Za-z0-9\/-]{1,30}\z/', $reference) === 1)
                && InsurancePartner::query()->whereKey($partnerId)->where('is_active', true)->exists(),
            PaymentType::Umum => $reference === null && $partnerId === null,
        };

        if (! $valid) {
            throw BookingException::make(BookingException::INVALID_PAYMENT, [], $this->context($session));
        }
    }

    /** "Anda" (online) atau "pasien ini" (loket) untuk `:subjek`/`:Subjek`. */
    private function subject(bool $counter): string
    {
        return $counter ? 'pasien ini' : 'Anda';
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $extra
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function context(PracticeSession $session, array $extra = []): array
    {
        return ['practice_session_id' => $session->getKey()] + $extra;
    }
}
```

1. **Kontrak untuk T4 (`book()`/`precheck()`).** `assertBookable()` membaca `booked_count`/`quota`/`status` dari instans sesi yang dioper dan memuat `doctor`/`clinic` lewat `loadMissing()`. `book()` HARUS mengoper baris sesi hasil `whereKey(...)->lockForUpdate()` (sesudah kunci profil), dan `precheck()` sesi hasil muat biasa; jangan mengoper instans lama dari form. `$now` = `CarbonImmutable::now()` yang sama untuk seluruh pemeriksaan satu permintaan. Kueri #5-#7 adalah SELECT biasa dan baru benar di `book()` bila dijalankan setelah kunci profil (kerangka A "Konkurensi").
2. **Kontrak untuk T7 (`BookingRedirect`).** Semua `BookingException` dari aturan memuat `context['practice_session_id']`; `DUPLICATE_BOOKING` memuat `context['appointment_code']` (kode pendaftaran milik pasien yang SAMA, aman untuk `show`); `OVERLAPPING_BOOKING` memuat `appointment_code` pendaftaran yang bertabrakan (tidak dipakai untuk redirect; kerangka F6-R10 mengarahkannya ke langkah 3).
3. **Perilaku di luar kerangka yang ditambahkan tugas ini (semua masih di dalam `INVALID_PAYMENT` F.5 #8):** `bpjs` dengan `insurance_partner_id` terisi ditolak; `asuransi` dengan nomor polis tidak cocok `/\A[A-Za-z0-9\/-]{1,30}\z/` ditolak; `umum` dengan referensi atau mitra ditolak (digest-rules §3 baris #8 dan F6-R21). `BookingData::fromValidated()` (T1) sengaja meneruskan isian yang tidak sesuai jenis pembayaran agar #8 bisa menolaknya; Form Request (T8) sudah menolaknya lebih dulu dengan pesan per field.
4. **Kesetaraan dengan `DoctorAvailabilityQuery` dijamin hanya oleh tes `test_k3_*` (15 kasus).** Bila fase lain mengubah `classify()` (mis. urutan label atau cutoff), tes ini harus ikut diperbarui; urutan kode F.5 (#3 sebelum #4) sengaja berbeda dari urutan label (penuh sebelum cutoff), sesuai konflik K-3.
5. **`SettingsBookingRulesTest`:** tes asli yang dibalik diganti namanya (`..._with_the_assert_bookable_rule_method`) dan satu tes tanda tangan baru (`test_assert_bookable_has_the_f6_r11_signature`) mengunci nama dan tipe parameter; mengubah signature `assertBookable()` di tugas lain wajib mengubah tes itu dan kerangka D.

### Task 3: Notifikasi pendaftaran (`AppointmentNotifier`, `AppointmentStatusChangedNotification`, `AppointmentScheduleChangedNotification`)

**Files:**
- Create: `app/Notifications/AppointmentStatusChangedNotification.php`

- Create: `app/Services/Booking/AppointmentNotifier.php`
- Create (pembantu tes): `tests/Support/RegistersAppointmentRoutes.php`
- Test (baru): `tests/Feature/Booking/AppointmentNotificationsTest.php`
- Tidak diubah: `lang/id.json` (terjemahan footer surel sudah ada sejak fase 5; seluruh teks notifikasi ditulis langsung di kelas, lihat Catatan teknis 6), `lang/id/booking.php` (milik Task 1), `AppServiceProvider`, seluruh migration, enum, izin, `PatientWelcomeNotification`.

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - Task 1: `Appointment::queueLabel()` (accessor `queue_label`, wajib `clinic` termuat), `Appointment::factory()` (dipakai lewat `InteractsWithSchedules::bookAppointment()`), `PatientProfile::user()` (sudah ada, fase 5), `Doctor::display_name`, `PracticeSession::time_range`, `Clinic::name`.
  - Fase 3-5 (sudah ada): `Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules` (`createSession()`, `bookAppointment()`), `Tests\Support\InteractsWithPatients` (`createPatient()`), `Database\Seeders\SettingsSeeder` (kunci `contact.phone` dan `contact.whatsapp`), `SettingsService::string()` dan `whatsappUrl()`, `App\Enums\AppointmentStatus`.
  - Route `patient.appointments.show` (dibuat Task 8): untuk Task 3 dan 4 tes memasang route pengganti lewat `RegistersAppointmentRoutes`.
- Produces:
  - `App\Notifications\AppointmentStatusChangedNotification` (`final`; konstruktor `(Appointment $appointment, ?AppointmentStatus $from, AppointmentStatus $to, ?string $reason = null)`; `via()`, `toArray()`, `toMail()`). Satu kelas untuk pendaftaran dibuat (`$from` NULL) dan setiap transisi.
  - `App\Notifications\AppointmentScheduleChangedNotification` (`final`; konstruktor `(Appointment $appointment, string $oldRange, string $newRange)`; `via()`, `toArray()`, `toMail()`). Pemicu produksi (resolusi `apply`) = fase 7.
  - `App\Services\Booking\AppointmentNotifier` (`final`; `statusChanged(Appointment, ?AppointmentStatus $from, AppointmentStatus $to, ?string $reason = null): void`, `scheduleChanged(Appointment, string $oldRange, string $newRange): void`). Dipakai Task 4 (`BookingService`) dan Task 5 (`AppointmentStatusService`) dengan SATU panggilan di dalam closure transaksi; pembungkus `DB::afterCommit` dan `try/catch` ada di dalam notifier (pemanggil tidak membungkus lagi).
  - `Tests\Support\RegistersAppointmentRoutes::ensureAppointmentShowRoute(): void` (dipakai ulang Task 4 dan 5).

**Test IDs:** NTF-01, NTF-02, NTF-03 (sisi notifier), NTF-07 (kanal per status K-13 = b, termasuk `AppointmentScheduleChangedNotification`; resolusi `apply` = fase 7 sehingga kelasnya diuji langsung), Review Focus 5 (tanpa BPJS/polis/keluhan/alamat/telepon), F-SYS-19, F-PAS-10 (sisi kelas), F6-R14, Review Focus 1 (sebagian: notifikasi hanya sesudah commit dan tidak terkirim bila rollback).

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
1. **Kapan callback `DB::afterCommit` jalan.** `Illuminate\Database\DatabaseTransactionsManager::addCallback()` (vendor/laravel/framework/src/Illuminate/Database) menaruh callback pada transaksi tertunda TERAKHIR; bila tidak ada transaksi, callback langsung dijalankan. Di bawah `RefreshDatabase`, `Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\DatabaseTransactionsManager` melewati transaksi pembungkus tes (`callbackApplicableTransactions()` = `pendingTransactions->skip(count($connectionsTransacting))`) dan `afterCommitCallbacksShouldBeExecuted($level)` = `$level === 1`: callback dari `DB::transaction()` di dalam tes jalan tepat ketika transaksi aplikasi itu commit dan level kembali ke 1 (itu sebabnya tes memakai `DB::transactionLevel()` awal sebagai pembanding, pola fase 5). `rollback()` pada savepoint membuang callback transaksi yang dibatalkan (`pendingTransactions->reject(level > newLevel)`), sehingga notifikasi dari savepoint yang di-rollback tidak pernah terkirim.
2. **Kanal dan urutan.** `NotificationSender::sendNow()` memanggil `via()` lalu mengirim berurutan per kanal; event `NotificationSending` dikirim per kanal dan pengecualian dari listener merambat ke pemanggil `notify()`. Karena `via()` selalu menaruh `database` sebelum `mail`, kegagalan surel tidak membatalkan baris `notifications` (dikunci tes `test_a_mail_failure_is_reported_and_the_database_notification_is_kept`). Kegagalan dipaksa lewat listener `NotificationSending` + `Exceptions::fake()` (pola `PatientRegistrationServiceTest`), bukan mock.
3. **`via()` memakai status TUJUAN** (`$to`) dan status ASAL (`$from`) hanya untuk pengecualian R-b, bukan `$appointment->status`: kelas dibuat pada saat status instance Eloquent mungkin belum/sudah diubah dan konstruktor sudah membawa `$to` secara eksplisit. K-13 = (b): `database` untuk semua status, `mail` hanya `confirmed` dan `cancelled` (pembuatan loket `confirmed` pada profil berakun otomatis ikut mengirim surel; koreksi check-in `checked_in -> confirmed` dikecualikan lewat `$from === CheckedIn` (R-b, 06 §18): hanya `database`, tanpa surel; dikunci `test_a_check_in_correction_uses_database_only_but_other_confirmations_also_mail`).
4. **Mode ketat.** `Model::shouldBeStrict()` melarang lazy loading hanya pada model dari koleksi berisi lebih dari satu baris (`Eloquent\Builder::hydrate` memberi `preventsLazyLoading` bila `count($items) > 1`). Notifier memuat `patientProfile.user`, `doctor`, `clinic`, `practiceSession` dengan `loadMissing()` di dalam callback sesudah commit, sehingga aman untuk appointment yang berasal dari koleksi (dikunci tes `test_relations_are_loaded_by_the_notifier_so_strict_mode_never_blocks_a_collection_member`). Kelas notifikasi mengandalkan relasi itu sudah termuat (docblock menyatakannya).
5. **Penerima.** Hanya `patientProfile->user` (akun pasien). Profil walk-in tanpa akun: tidak ada notifikasi dan tidak ada galat (NTF-03). Akun nonaktif tetap menerima (tidak ada aturan sebaliknya di spesifikasi).
6. **Teks dan sumbernya.** Judul/isi/surel status-changed TIDAK ditetapkan lengkap oleh blueprint: 11 §10.1 hanya menetapkan subjek surel `Status pendaftaran {booking_code}: {label status}`, baris surel (salam, kode booking, dokter, poliklinik, tanggal dan jam, nomor antrean, status baru, alasan bila dibatalkan), tombol "Lihat Pendaftaran", dan catatan surel otomatis; 06 §18 menetapkan "memuat alasan" untuk pembatalan; 07 W-10 memberi contoh banner jadwal ("Jadwal kunjungan berubah", "Jam praktik dr. Sinta M. pada Rab, 7 Okt kini 10.00-14.00 (sebelumnya 09.00-13.00)"). Selebihnya kalimat Indonesia berikut DITETAPKAN penulis rencana ini (tercatat di Catatan penulis) dan dikunci tes:
   - Judul: `pending` "Pendaftaran diterima"; `confirmed` "Pendaftaran dikonfirmasi"; `checked_in` "Check-in berhasil"; `completed` "Kunjungan selesai"; `cancelled` "Pendaftaran dibatalkan"; `no_show` "Ditandai tidak hadir"; `checked_in -> confirmed` "Check-in dikoreksi"; perubahan jadwal "Jadwal kunjungan berubah".
   - Isi memakai `visit` = "{dokter} di {poliklinik} pada {Kamis, 8 Oktober 2026} pukul {08.00–12.00} WIB" (tanggal `translatedFormat('l, j F Y')`, jam `PracticeSession::time_range`), mis. pending: "Pendaftaran {kode} untuk {visit} telah diterima dan menunggu konfirmasi petugas. Nomor antrean Anda {ANK-001}."; alasan (bila diberikan) ditambahkan "Alasan: {alasan}." (titik ditambahkan bila belum ada tanda baca akhir).
   - Teks tidak memuat nomor BPJS/polis, keluhan, alamat, telepon, ataupun tanggal lahir; nama pasien hanya muncul pada salam surel.
7. **Perubahan jadwal.** `toArray()` memuat `appointment_id`, `booking_code`, `old_range`, `new_range` (11 §10.1) PLUS `title` dan `body` (F6-R14): dashboard Task 11 menampilkan keduanya tanpa membentuk kalimat sendiri. Kontak rumah sakit pada surel dibaca dari `SettingsService` saat surel dibuat (`contact.phone`, `whatsappUrl()`); baris kontak dilewati bila pengaturan kosong.
8. **Route `patient.appointments.show`.** `toMail()` memanggil `route('patient.appointments.show', $appointment)` langsung (route baru ada di Task 8; pengikatan `{appointment:booking_code}` membuat `route()` menyisipkan kode booking). Sebelum Task 8 hanya tes yang memicu surel, dan tes memasang route pengganti lewat `RegistersAppointmentRoutes` (pola route `login` pengganti fase 5; tidak melakukan apa pun begitu route sebenarnya ada). Bila di produksi `toMail()` gagal, notifier menangkap dan melaporkannya tanpa membatalkan apa pun.
9. **Tidak `ShouldQueue`.** Sesuai F6-R14 dan D-149 (antrean notifikasi dirancang fase 7); `QUEUE_CONNECTION=sync`, jadi `notify()` langsung mengirim di dalam callback `afterCommit`.
10. **DB pengembangan.** Implementer tidak menjalankan `migrate`/`db:seed` pada `unpam_hospital`; tes memakai `unpam_hospital_test` dan `SettingsSeeder` per tes.
11. Jumlah tes baru 41 (provider: `via` 7, notifier per status 6, judul 7).

- [ ] **Step 2: Buat pembantu tes route pengganti (tool Write) `tests/Support/RegistersAppointmentRoutes.php`**

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Support;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;

/**
 * Memasang route pengganti `patient.appointments.show` bila route sebenarnya belum ada (dibuat fase 6 Task 8),
 * supaya tombol "Lihat Pendaftaran" pada surel dan tautan notifikasi dapat dibangun di tes Task 3 dan 4
 * (pola fase 5: route `login` pengganti). Setelah route sebenarnya ada, pembantu ini tidak melakukan apa pun.
 * Route pengganti memakai pengikatan `booking_code` seperti route sebenarnya, jadi `route('...show', $appointment)`
 * menghasilkan kode booking pada URL.
 */
trait RegistersAppointmentRoutes
{
    protected function ensureAppointmentShowRoute(): void
    {
        if (Route::has('patient.appointments.show')) {
            return;
        }

        Route::middleware('web')
            ->get('/_uji/pendaftaran/{appointment:booking_code}', fn () => 'detail')
            ->name('patient.appointments.show');

        Route::getRoutes()->refreshNameLookups();
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Booking;

use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Enums\PaymentType;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\AppointmentScheduleChangedNotification;
use App\Notifications\AppointmentStatusChangedNotification;
use App\Services\Booking\AppointmentNotifier;
use Database\Seeders\SettingsSeeder;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldQueue;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Notifications\Events\NotificationSending;
use Illuminate\Notifications\Messages\MailMessage;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Event;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Exceptions;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use RuntimeException;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithPatients;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\Support\RegistersAppointmentRoutes;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * F6-R14, F-SYS-19, F-PAS-10. NTF-01 (satu notifikasi `database`, tanpa data sensitif), NTF-02 (surel `confirmed` dan
 * `cancelled`), NTF-03 (profil walk-in tanpa akun), NTF-07 (kanal per status menurut K-13 = b, termasuk
 * `AppointmentScheduleChangedNotification`), Review Focus 5 (tanpa BPJS/polis/keluhan/alamat/telepon), dan
 * pola fase 5 (kegagalan kirim dilaporkan tanpa melempar; kirim sesudah commit; tidak terkirim bila rollback).
 */
class AppointmentNotificationsTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithPatients;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use RefreshDatabase;
    use RegistersAppointmentRoutes;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-08 09:30:00');
        app()->setLocale('id');
        $this->seed(SettingsSeeder::class);
        $this->ensureAppointmentShowRoute();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ pembantu

    private function notifier(): AppointmentNotifier
    {
        return $this->app->make(AppointmentNotifier::class);
    }

    /**
     * Appointment pada sesi besok 08.00-12.00 (kuota 5) milik profil `$owner`, dengan relasi yang dibutuhkan
     * notifikasi sudah dimuat.
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     */
    private function appointmentFor(User|PatientProfile $owner, AppointmentStatus $status = AppointmentStatus::Pending, array $overrides = []): Appointment
    {
        $profile = $owner instanceof User ? $owner->patientProfile : $owner;
        $session = $this->createSession(['doctor_schedule_id' => null, 'quota' => 5]);

        $appointment = $this->bookAppointment($session, $status, ['patient_profile_id' => $profile->id] + $overrides);

        return $this->loaded($appointment);
    }

    private function loaded(Appointment $appointment): Appointment
    {
        return Appointment::query()
            ->with(['doctor', 'clinic', 'practiceSession', 'patientProfile.user'])
            ->findOrFail($appointment->id);
    }

    private function dateLabel(Appointment $appointment): string
    {
        return $appointment->session_date->translatedFormat('l, j F Y');
    }

    private function visit(Appointment $appointment): string
    {
        return $appointment->doctor->display_name.' di '.$appointment->clinic->name
            .' pada '.$this->dateLabel($appointment).' pukul '.$appointment->practiceSession->time_range.' WIB';
    }

    private function mailLines(MailMessage $mail): string
    {
        return implode("\n", array_map('strval', array_merge($mail->introLines, $mail->outroLines)));
    }

    private function sentMailCount(): int
    {
        return count(app('mailer')->getSymfonyTransport()->messages());
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ kanal per status (NTF-07, K-13 = b)

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{0: AppointmentStatus, 1: list<string>}>
     */
    public static function channelsPerStatus(): array
    {
        return [
            'pending' => [AppointmentStatus::Pending, ['database']],
            'confirmed' => [AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, ['database', 'mail']],
            'checked_in' => [AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, ['database']],
            'completed' => [AppointmentStatus::Completed, ['database']],
            'cancelled' => [AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, ['database', 'mail']],
            'no_show' => [AppointmentStatus::NoShow, ['database']],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @param  list<string>  $channels
     */
    #[DataProvider('channelsPerStatus')]
    public function test_via_follows_the_target_status_for_every_status(AppointmentStatus $to, array $channels): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();

        // via() hanya memakai status tujuan, bukan status yang tersimpan pada appointment.
        $notification = new AppointmentStatusChangedNotification(new Appointment, AppointmentStatus::Pending, $to);

        $this->assertSame($channels, $notification->via($user));
    }

    public function test_a_check_in_correction_uses_database_only_but_other_confirmations_also_mail(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $make = fn (?AppointmentStatus $from, AppointmentStatus $to) => (new AppointmentStatusChangedNotification(new Appointment, $from, $to))->via($user);

        $this->assertSame(['database'], $make(AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed));
        $this->assertSame(['database', 'mail'], $make(AppointmentStatus::Pending, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed));
        $this->assertSame(['database', 'mail'], $make(null, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed));
        $this->assertSame(['database', 'mail'], $make(AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled));
    }

    public function test_schedule_changed_notification_always_uses_database_and_mail(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();

        $notification = new AppointmentScheduleChangedNotification(new Appointment, '09.00–13.00', '10.00–14.00');

        $this->assertSame(['database', 'mail'], $notification->via($user));
    }

    public function test_the_notification_classes_are_synchronous(): void
    {
        $appointment = new Appointment;

        $this->assertNotInstanceOf(ShouldQueue::class, new AppointmentStatusChangedNotification($appointment, null, AppointmentStatus::Pending));
        $this->assertNotInstanceOf(ShouldQueue::class, new AppointmentScheduleChangedNotification($appointment, '09.00–13.00', '10.00–14.00'));
    }

    /**
     * @param  list<string>  $channels
     */
    #[DataProvider('channelsPerStatus')]
    public function test_the_notifier_sends_each_status_through_the_k13_channels(AppointmentStatus $to, array $channels): void
    {
        Notification::fake();
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $appointment = $this->appointmentFor($user, $to);
        $from = $to === AppointmentStatus::Pending ? null : AppointmentStatus::Pending;

        $this->notifier()->statusChanged($appointment, $from, $to);

        Notification::assertSentToTimes($user, AppointmentStatusChangedNotification::class, 1);
        Notification::assertSentTo(
            $user,
            AppointmentStatusChangedNotification::class,
            fn (AppointmentStatusChangedNotification $notification, array $sentChannels): bool => $sentChannels === $channels
                && $notification->to === $to
                && $notification->from === $from,
        );
    }

    {

        $appointment = $this->appointmentFor($user, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);

        $this->notifier()->scheduleChanged($appointment, '09.00–13.00', '10.00–14.00');

        Notification::assertSentToTimes($user, AppointmentScheduleChangedNotification::class, 1);
        Notification::assertSentTo(
            $user,
            AppointmentScheduleChangedNotification::class,
            fn (AppointmentScheduleChangedNotification $notification, array $channels): bool => $channels === ['database', 'mail']
                && $notification->oldRange === '09.00–13.00'
                && $notification->newRange === '10.00–14.00',
        );
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ NTF-01: baris database

    public function test_a_status_change_stores_one_unread_database_notification_with_the_agreed_shape(): void
    {

        $appointment = $this->appointmentFor($user, AppointmentStatus::Pending);

    /**

    #[DataProvider('titles')]
    public function test_the_title_describes_the_transition(AppointmentStatus $to, ?AppointmentStatus $from, string $title): void

        $without = new AppointmentStatusChangedNotification($appointment, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled);

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ sesudah commit / rollback

    public function test_the_notification_is_sent_only_after_the_transaction_commits(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $appointment = $this->appointmentFor($user, AppointmentStatus::Pending);
        $baseLevel = DB::transactionLevel();
        $levels = [];
        Event::listen(NotificationSending::class, function () use (&$levels): void {
            $levels[] = DB::transactionLevel();
        });

        DB::transaction(function () use ($appointment, $user, &$levels): void {
            $this->notifier()->statusChanged($appointment, null, AppointmentStatus::Pending);

            $this->assertSame([], $levels, 'Belum ada pengiriman di dalam transaksi.');
            $this->assertSame(0, $user->notifications()->count());
        });

        $this->assertSame([$baseLevel], $levels, 'Tepat satu pengiriman (kanal database), di luar transaksi pendaftaran.');
        $this->assertSame(1, $user->notifications()->count());
    }

    public function test_nothing_is_sent_when_the_transaction_is_rolled_back(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $appointment = $this->appointmentFor($user, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);

        try {
            DB::transaction(function () use ($appointment): void {
                $this->notifier()->statusChanged($appointment, AppointmentStatus::Pending, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);

                throw new RuntimeException('Transaksi dibatalkan.');
            });
            $this->fail('Pengecualian transaksi seharusnya dilempar.');
        } catch (RuntimeException $e) {
            $this->assertSame('Transaksi dibatalkan.', $e->getMessage());
        }

        $this->assertSame(0, DB::table('notifications')->count());
        $this->assertSame(0, $this->sentMailCount());
    }

    public function test_a_notification_inside_a_rolled_back_nested_transaction_is_discarded_but_the_outer_one_is_sent(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $first = $this->appointmentFor($user, AppointmentStatus::Pending);
        $second = $this->appointmentFor($user, AppointmentStatus::Pending);

        DB::transaction(function () use ($first, $second): void {
            $this->notifier()->statusChanged($first, null, AppointmentStatus::Pending);

            try {
                DB::transaction(function () use ($second): void {
                    $this->notifier()->statusChanged($second, null, AppointmentStatus::Pending);

                    throw new RuntimeException('Savepoint dibatalkan.');
                });
            } catch (RuntimeException) {
                // Diharapkan: hanya savepoint bagian dalam yang dibatalkan.
            }
        });

        $stored = $user->notifications()->get();
        $this->assertCount(1, $stored);
        $this->assertSame($first->booking_code, $stored->first()->data['booking_code']);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ kegagalan kirim

    public function test_a_notification_failure_is_reported_and_does_not_undo_the_committed_work(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $appointment = $this->appointmentFor($user, AppointmentStatus::Pending);
        Event::listen(NotificationSending::class, function (): void {
            throw new RuntimeException('Kanal notifikasi gagal.');
        });
        Exceptions::fake();

        DB::transaction(function () use ($appointment): void {
            Appointment::query()->whereKey($appointment->id)->update(['complaint' => 'Tetap tersimpan']);

            $this->notifier()->statusChanged($appointment, null, AppointmentStatus::Pending);
        });

        $this->assertSame('Tetap tersimpan', Appointment::query()->whereKey($appointment->id)->value('complaint'));
        $this->assertSame(0, $user->notifications()->count());
        Exceptions::assertReportedCount(1);
        Exceptions::assertReported(fn (RuntimeException $e): bool => $e->getMessage() === 'Kanal notifikasi gagal.');
    }

    public function test_a_mail_failure_is_reported_and_the_database_notification_is_kept(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $appointment = $this->appointmentFor($user, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        Event::listen(NotificationSending::class, function (NotificationSending $event): void {
            if ($event->channel === 'mail') {
                throw new RuntimeException('Surel gagal dikirim.');
            }
        });
        Exceptions::fake();

        $this->notifier()->statusChanged($appointment, AppointmentStatus::Pending, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);

        $this->assertSame(1, $user->notifications()->count(), 'Kanal database dikirim lebih dulu dan tetap tersimpan.');
        $this->assertSame(0, $this->sentMailCount());
        Exceptions::assertReportedCount(1);
        Exceptions::assertReported(fn (RuntimeException $e): bool => $e->getMessage() === 'Surel gagal dikirim.');
    }

    public function test_relations_are_loaded_by_the_notifier_so_strict_mode_never_blocks_a_collection_member(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $first = $this->appointmentFor($user, AppointmentStatus::Pending);
        $second = $this->appointmentFor($user, AppointmentStatus::Pending);
        Exceptions::fake();

        // Koleksi berisi lebih dari satu model: lazy loading dilarang mode ketat, jadi relasi harus dimuat eksplisit.
        $bare = Appointment::query()->whereIn('id', [$first->id, $second->id])->get();
        $this->assertCount(2, $bare);

        foreach ($bare as $appointment) {
            $this->notifier()->statusChanged($appointment, null, AppointmentStatus::Pending);
        }

        Exceptions::assertNothingReported();
        $this->assertSame(2, $user->notifications()->count());
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ Review Focus 5: tanpa data sensitif

    public function test_no_notification_carries_bpjs_policy_complaint_address_phone_or_birth_date(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient([], [
            'phone' => '081355577788',
            'address' => 'Jl. Rahasia Kenanga No. 99 Tangerang',
            'bpjs_number' => '0009900000077',
        ]);
        $profile = $user->patientProfile;
        $appointment = $this->appointmentFor($user, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, [
            'complaint' => 'Nyeri dada hebat sejak semalam',
            'payment_type' => PaymentType::Bpjs,
            'payment_reference' => '0009900000088',
            'payment_reference_last4' => '0088',
        ]);

        $this->notifier()->statusChanged($appointment, null, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $this->notifier()->statusChanged($appointment, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, 'Berhalangan hadir');
        $this->notifier()->scheduleChanged($appointment, '08.00–12.00', '10.00–14.00');

        $dump = (string) json_encode(DB::table('notifications')->pluck('data')->all());
        foreach ([
            new AppointmentStatusChangedNotification($appointment, null, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed),
            new AppointmentStatusChangedNotification($appointment, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, 'Berhalangan hadir'),
            new AppointmentScheduleChangedNotification($appointment, '08.00–12.00', '10.00–14.00'),
        ] as $notification) {
            $mail = $notification->toMail($user);
            $dump .= "\n".$mail->subject."\n".$this->mailLines($mail)."\n".$mail->render();
        }

        $this->assertSame(3, $user->notifications()->count());

        foreach ([
            '0009900000077',
            '0009900000088',
            'Nyeri dada',
            'Rahasia Kenanga',
            '081355577788',
            $profile->birth_date->toDateString(),
        ] as $forbidden) {
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString($forbidden, $dump, "Notifikasi memuat: {$forbidden}");
        }
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Buat notifikasi perubahan status (tool Write) `app/Notifications/AppointmentStatusChangedNotification.php`**

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Notifications;

use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Notifications\Messages\MailMessage;
use Illuminate\Notifications\Notification;

/**
 * Pemberitahuan perubahan status pendaftaran kepada pasien berakun (F6-R14, 11 §10.1, K-13 = b): kanal `database`
 * untuk setiap status tujuan dan kanal `mail` hanya untuk `confirmed` dan `cancelled`, kecuali koreksi check-in (R-b). Dipakai saat pendaftaran
 * dibuat (`$from` NULL) dan pada setiap transisi. Sinkron (bukan ShouldQueue; antrean dirancang fase 7, D-149).
 * Isi sengaja tanpa nomor BPJS/polis, keluhan, alamat, dan telepon (BR-174, NTF-01). `appointment.doctor`,
 * `.clinic`, dan `.practiceSession` wajib sudah dimuat (AppointmentNotifier memuatnya; mode ketat).
 */
final class AppointmentStatusChangedNotification extends Notification
{
    public function __construct(
        public readonly Appointment $appointment,
        public readonly ?AppointmentStatus $from,
        public readonly AppointmentStatus $to,
        public readonly ?string $reason = null,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    public function via(object $notifiable): array
    {
        return $this->sendsMail() ? ['database', 'mail'] : ['database'];
    }

    /**
     * R-b (06 §18): surel untuk `cancelled` dan `confirmed`, KECUALI koreksi check-in (`checked_in` kembali ke
     * `confirmed`) yang hanya masuk kotak masuk (`database`).
     */
    private function sendsMail(): bool
    {
        if ($this->to === AppointmentStatus::Cancelled) {
            return true;
        }

        return $this->to === AppointmentStatus::Confirmed && $this->from !== AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn;
    }

    /**
     * Isi baris `notifications.data` (11 §10.1).
     *
     * @return array{appointment_id: int, booking_code: string, status: string, title: string, body: string}
     */
    public function toArray(object $notifiable): array
    {
        return [
            'appointment_id' => (int) $this->appointment->id,
            'booking_code' => (string) $this->appointment->booking_code,
            'status' => $this->to->value,
            'title' => $this->title(),
            'body' => $this->body(),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @param  User  $notifiable
     */
    public function toMail(object $notifiable): MailMessage
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointment;

        $mail = (new MailMessage)
            ->subject("Status pendaftaran {$appointment->booking_code}: {$this->to->label()}")
            ->greeting("Halo, {$notifiable->name}!")
            ->line($this->mailIntro())
            ->line("Kode booking: {$appointment->booking_code}")
            ->line("Dokter: {$appointment->doctor->display_name}")
            ->line("Poliklinik: {$appointment->clinic->name}")
            ->line("Jadwal: {$this->dateLabel()}, pukul {$appointment->practiceSession->time_range} WIB")
            ->line("Nomor antrean: {$appointment->queue_label}")
            ->line("Status: {$this->to->label()}");

        $reason = $this->reasonSentence();

        if ($reason !== null) {
            $mail->line($reason);
        }

        return $mail
            ->action('Lihat Pendaftaran', route('patient.appointments.show', $appointment))
            ->line('Surel ini dikirim otomatis. Mohon tidak membalas surel ini.');
    }

    private function isCheckInCorrection(): bool
    {
        return $this->from === AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn && $this->to === AppointmentStatus::Confirmed;
    }

    private function title(): string
    {
        if ($this->isCheckInCorrection()) {
            return 'Check-in dikoreksi';
        }

        return match ($this->to) {
            AppointmentStatus::Pending => 'Pendaftaran diterima',
            AppointmentStatus::Confirmed => 'Pendaftaran dikonfirmasi',
            AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn => 'Check-in berhasil',
            AppointmentStatus::Completed => 'Kunjungan selesai',
            AppointmentStatus::Cancelled => 'Pendaftaran dibatalkan',
            AppointmentStatus::NoShow => 'Ditandai tidak hadir',
        };
    }

    private function body(): string
    {
        $code = $this->appointment->booking_code;
        $queue = $this->appointment->queue_label;
        $visit = $this->visit();

        if ($this->isCheckInCorrection()) {
            $body = "Check-in untuk pendaftaran {$code} ({$visit}) dikoreksi oleh petugas. Status kembali menjadi Dikonfirmasi dan nomor antrean Anda tetap {$queue}.";
        } else {
            $body = match ($this->to) {
                AppointmentStatus::Pending => "Pendaftaran {$code} untuk {$visit} telah diterima dan menunggu konfirmasi petugas. Nomor antrean Anda {$queue}.",
                AppointmentStatus::Confirmed => "Pendaftaran {$code} untuk {$visit} telah dikonfirmasi. Nomor antrean Anda {$queue}.",
                AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn => "Kehadiran Anda untuk pendaftaran {$code} ({$visit}) telah dicatat. Nomor antrean Anda {$queue}.",
                AppointmentStatus::Completed => "Kunjungan untuk pendaftaran {$code} ({$visit}) telah selesai. Terima kasih telah berkunjung.",
                AppointmentStatus::Cancelled => "Pendaftaran {$code} untuk {$visit} telah dibatalkan. Kuota telah dilepas.",
                AppointmentStatus::NoShow => "Pendaftaran {$code} untuk {$visit} tercatat tidak hadir. Hubungi rumah sakit bila Anda merasa hal ini keliru.",
            };
        }

        $reason = $this->reasonSentence();

        return $reason === null ? $body : $body.' '.$reason;
    }

    private function mailIntro(): string
    {
        if ($this->isCheckInCorrection()) {
            return 'Check-in pendaftaran Anda dikoreksi oleh petugas dan status kembali menjadi Dikonfirmasi.';
        }

        return match ($this->to) {
            AppointmentStatus::Confirmed => 'Pendaftaran kunjungan Anda telah dikonfirmasi. Mohon hadir sesuai jadwal dan tunjukkan kode booking di loket pendaftaran.',
            AppointmentStatus::Cancelled => 'Pendaftaran kunjungan Anda telah dibatalkan dan kuota telah dilepas. Anda dapat mendaftar kembali melalui menu Daftar Kunjungan.',
            default => "Status pendaftaran kunjungan Anda berubah menjadi {$this->to->label()}.",
        };
    }

    /** "Alasan: …" (berakhir dengan tanda baca), atau NULL bila alasan kosong. */
    private function reasonSentence(): ?string
    {
        $reason = trim((string) $this->reason);

        if ($reason === '') {
            return null;
        }

        return 'Alasan: '.$reason.(preg_match('/[.!?]$/u', $reason) === 1 ? '' : '.');
    }

    private function visit(): string
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointment;

        return "{$appointment->doctor->display_name} di {$appointment->clinic->name} pada {$this->dateLabel()} pukul {$appointment->practiceSession->time_range} WIB";
    }

    private function dateLabel(): string
    {
        return $this->appointment->session_date->translatedFormat('l, j F Y');
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Notifications;

use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\Settings\SettingsService;
use Illuminate\Notifications\Messages\MailMessage;
use Illuminate\Notifications\Notification;

/**
 * Pemberitahuan perubahan jam praktik sesi kepada pasien berakun (F6-R14, 11 §10.1): kanal `database` dan `mail`.
 * Fase 6 hanya menyediakan kelas ini; pemicunya (resolusi sesi terdampak `apply`, yang mengisi
 * `appointments.schedule_changed_at`) dibangun fase 7. `$oldRange` dan `$newRange` berupa teks jam siap tampil,
 * mis. "09.00–13.00". Sinkron (bukan ShouldQueue). Tanpa nomor BPJS/polis, keluhan, alamat, dan telepon pasien.
 * `appointment.doctor`, `.clinic`, dan `.practiceSession` wajib sudah dimuat.
 */
final class AppointmentScheduleChangedNotification extends Notification
{
    public function __construct(
        public readonly Appointment $appointment,
        public readonly string $oldRange,
        public readonly string $newRange,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    public function via(object $notifiable): array
    {
        return ['database', 'mail'];
    }

    /**
     * @return array{appointment_id: int, booking_code: string, old_range: string, new_range: string, title: string, body: string}
     */
    public function toArray(object $notifiable): array
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointment;

        return [
            'appointment_id' => (int) $appointment->id,
            'booking_code' => (string) $appointment->booking_code,
            'old_range' => $this->oldRange,
            'new_range' => $this->newRange,
            'title' => 'Jadwal kunjungan berubah',
            'body' => "Jam praktik {$appointment->doctor->display_name} pada {$this->dateLabel()} kini {$this->newRange} (sebelumnya {$this->oldRange}). "
                ."Pendaftaran {$appointment->booking_code} tetap berlaku; batalkan atau hubungi rumah sakit bila jadwal baru tidak sesuai.",
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @param  User  $notifiable
     */
    public function toMail(object $notifiable): MailMessage
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointment;

        $mail = (new MailMessage)
            ->subject("Perubahan jadwal praktik pendaftaran {$appointment->booking_code}")
            ->greeting("Halo, {$notifiable->name}!")
            ->line('Jam praktik dokter untuk pendaftaran kunjungan Anda telah berubah.')
            ->line("Kode booking: {$appointment->booking_code}")
            ->line("Dokter: {$appointment->doctor->display_name}")
            ->line("Poliklinik: {$appointment->clinic->name}")
            ->line("Tanggal: {$this->dateLabel()}")
            ->line("Jam praktik semula: {$this->oldRange} WIB")
            ->line("Jam praktik baru: {$this->newRange} WIB")
            ->line("Nomor antrean: {$appointment->queue_label}")
            ->line('Pendaftaran Anda tetap berlaku. Jika jadwal baru tidak sesuai, batalkan pendaftaran atau hubungi rumah sakit.');

        $settings = app(SettingsService::class);
        $phone = trim($settings->string('contact.phone'));
        $whatsapp = $settings->whatsappUrl();

        if ($phone !== '') {
            $mail->line("Telepon rumah sakit: {$phone}");
        }

        if ($whatsapp !== null) {
            $mail->line("WhatsApp: [{$whatsapp}]({$whatsapp})");
        }

        return $mail
            ->action('Lihat Pendaftaran', route('patient.appointments.show', $appointment))
            ->line('Surel ini dikirim otomatis. Mohon tidak membalas surel ini.');
    }

    private function dateLabel(): string
    {
        return $this->appointment->session_date->translatedFormat('l, j F Y');
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 7: Buat `AppointmentNotifier` (tool Write) `app/Services/Booking/AppointmentNotifier.php`**

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Services\Booking;

use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Notifications\AppointmentScheduleChangedNotification;
use App\Notifications\AppointmentStatusChangedNotification;
use Closure;
use Illuminate\Notifications\Notification;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Satu-satunya pintu pengiriman notifikasi pendaftaran (F6-R14, 06 §18). Aturan:
 *  - hanya pasien yang profilnya punya akun (`patient_profiles.user_id`); pasien walk-in tanpa akun tidak
 *    menerima apa pun dan tidak menimbulkan galat;
 *  - pengiriman dijadwalkan `DB::afterCommit` sehingga tidak ada notifikasi/surel dari transaksi yang
 *    di-rollback, dan tidak ada IO surel di dalam transaksi (bila dipanggil di luar transaksi, langsung jalan);
 *  - kegagalan kirim (kanal, surel, relasi) ditangkap dan dilaporkan (`report()`), tidak pernah dilempar ke
 *    pemanggil sehingga tidak membatalkan pendaftaran atau transisi yang sudah ter-commit (06 §18).
 */
final class AppointmentNotifier
{
    /**
     * Pendaftaran dibuat (`$from` NULL) atau status berubah. `$reason` (mis. alasan batal) ikut ke isi
     * notifikasi.
     */
    public function statusChanged(Appointment $appointment, ?AppointmentStatus $from, AppointmentStatus $to, ?string $reason = null): void
    {
        $this->afterCommit(
            $appointment,
            fn (): Notification => new AppointmentStatusChangedNotification($appointment, $from, $to, $reason),
        );
    }

    /**
     * Jam sesi berubah (resolusi `apply`, fase 7). `$oldRange` dan `$newRange` = teks jam, mis. "09.00–13.00".
     */
    public function scheduleChanged(Appointment $appointment, string $oldRange, string $newRange): void
    {
        $this->afterCommit(
            $appointment,
            fn (): Notification => new AppointmentScheduleChangedNotification($appointment, $oldRange, $newRange),
        );
    }

    /**
     * @param  Closure(): Notification  $notification  Dibuat SESUDAH commit, setelah relasi dimuat.
     */
    private function afterCommit(Appointment $appointment, Closure $notification): void
    {
        DB::afterCommit(function () use ($appointment, $notification): void {
            try {
                // Mode ketat melarang lazy loading pada koleksi; muat eksplisit hanya yang belum ada.
                $appointment->loadMissing(['patientProfile.user', 'doctor', 'clinic', 'practiceSession']);

                $recipient = $appointment->patientProfile->user;

                if ($recipient === null) {
                    return;
                }

                $recipient->notify($notification());
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                report($e);
            }
        });
    }
}
```

#### Catatan penulis (konteks untuk implementer dan reviewer)

1. **Teks notifikasi ditetapkan penulis** (judul, isi, kalimat surel; Catatan teknis 6): blueprint tidak membakukannya selain subjek surel dan komponen baris. Pemilik/koordinator dapat mengubahnya di satu tempat per kelas; tes memakai kalimat yang sama sehingga perubahan teks = ubah kelas dan tes bersama. `AppointmentScheduleChangedNotification::toArray()` menambahkan `title` dan `body` di luar daftar 11 §10.1 (F6-R14 sudah menyebutkannya).
2. **Kontrak untuk Task 5 (dan 4):** panggil `AppointmentNotifier::statusChanged($appointment, $from, $to, $reason)` LANGSUNG di dalam closure transaksi, tanpa `DB::afterCommit` tambahan; notifier yang menjadwalkannya. Untuk pembatalan, kirim `$reason` (alasan batal) agar masuk ke isi dan surel; untuk koreksi check-in kirim alasan koreksinya. Instance `$appointment` boleh belum memuat relasi.
3. **K-13 (b) dan loket.** Pembuatan loket (`confirmed`) pada profil berakun mengirim `database` + `mail`; pembuatan online `pending` hanya `database`. Itu konsekuensi harfiah K-13 (b) dan tabel 06 §18; pertanyaan terbuka digest-data §13 butir 1 dijawab dengan itu.
4. **`RegistersAppointmentRoutes`** dibuat di tugas ini (bukan di peta berkas kerangka C.2) karena hanya berupa pembantu tes; Task 4 dan 5 memakainya. Task 8 membuat route sebenarnya sehingga pembantu itu menjadi no-op; tidak perlu dihapus.
5. **Pendekatan kegagalan.** Notifier menelan SEMUA `Throwable` (termasuk kegagalan memuat relasi) dan hanya melaporkannya; tes mengunci bahwa transaksi pemanggil tetap commit dan bahwa kegagalan surel tidak menghapus baris `database`.

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - Task 1: `BookingCodeGenerator::generate()/isValid()/PATTERN`, `BookingData` (konstruktor bernama `paymentType`, `paymentReference`, `insurancePartnerId`, `complaint`, `saveBpjs`; `paymentReferenceLast4()`), `BookingException::make()/profileInactive()` dan 9 konstanta kode, `lang/id/booking.php` (`errors.*`, `errors.PROFILE_INACTIVE` = "Profil pasien tidak aktif atau tidak ditemukan."), `Appointment::queueLabel()` (`queue_label`), `Appointment::maskedPaymentReference()` (`masked_payment_reference`), factory `PracticeSessionFactory` dan `InteractsWithSchedules::bookAppointment()`.
  - Task 2: `BookingRules::assertBookable(PatientProfile, PracticeSession, BookingData, Actor, CarbonImmutable): void` (membaca sesi yang dioper dan `loadMissing(['doctor', 'clinic'])`; `context['practice_session_id']` pada semua kode, `context['appointment_code']` pada `DUPLICATE_BOOKING` dan `OVERLAPPING_BOOKING`; placeholder pesan `subjek`).
  - Task 3: `AppointmentNotifier::statusChanged(Appointment, ?AppointmentStatus, AppointmentStatus, ?string): void` (pembungkus `afterCommit` dan `try/catch` ada di dalamnya) dan `Tests\Support\RegistersAppointmentRoutes`.
  - Fase 1-5 (sudah ada): `AuditLogger::log()`, `SettingsService::bookingRules()`, `Actor`, model `PatientProfile`/`PracticeSession`/`Appointment`/`AppointmentStatusHistory`, `InteractsWithPatients`/`InteractsWithSchedules`/`InteractsWithStaff`, `SettingsSeeder`.
- Produces (persis kerangka D, T4): `App\Services\Booking\BookingService` (`final`; konstruktor `(AuditLogger $audit, SettingsService $settings, AppointmentNotifier $notifier)`):
  - `book(PatientProfile $profile, int $practiceSessionId, BookingData $data, Actor $actor): Appointment`: mengembalikan appointment hasil baca ulang dengan relasi `clinic`, `doctor`, `practiceSession` termuat.
  - `precheck(PatientProfile $profile, PracticeSession $session, BookingData $data, Actor $actor): void`.
  - Konstanta publik `TRANSACTION_ATTEMPTS` (3), `UNIQUE_ROUNDS` (3), `CODE_ATTEMPTS` (5) (dipakai tes Task 4 dan 6).
  - Galat: `BookingException` (9 kode F.5/`SYSTEM_BUSY`), `LogicException` (pelaku `system`), `AuthorizationException` (pasien mendaftarkan profil orang lain).

**Test IDs:** BKG-01, BKG-02, BKG-03, BKG-04, BKG-05, BKG-06, BKG-07 (sisi `book()`), BKG-08, BKG-09, BKG-10, BKG-15, BKG-17, BKG-18 (UNIQUE `active_flag`, UNIQUE `booking_code`, UNIQUE antrean, CHECK `chk_sessions_quota` dari pelanggaran MariaDB nyata), NTF-01 dan NTF-03 (sisi `book()`), SEK-12, VAL-03 (pesan galat), Review Focus 1 (urutan kunci, nomor antrean tidak dipakai ulang, tanpa baris parsial), Review Focus 5 (riwayat dan audit tanpa data sensitif), F6-R12, F6-R13, F6-R35, F-SYS-03, F-SYS-05, F-PAS-05.

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
1. **`DB::transaction($callback, $attempts)`** (`vendor/laravel/framework/src/Illuminate/Database/Concerns/ManagesTransactions.php`). Setiap percobaan: `beginTransaction()` (transaksi nyata di level 0, `SAVEPOINT trans{n}` di level lebih dalam), jalankan closure, commit. Pada pengecualian, `handleTransactionException()`: bila `causedByConcurrencyError($e)` DAN `$this->transactions > 1` (transaksi bersarang), level dikurangi dan dilempar `Illuminate\Database\DeadlockException` (turunan `PDOException`, BUKAN `QueryException`) TANPA pengulangan; selain itu `rollBack()` (ke savepoint bila bersarang) lalu mengulang HANYA bila galat konkurensi dan `$currentAttempt < $attempts`, kalau tidak dilempar ulang apa adanya. Galat bukan konkurensi (1062, CHECK, `BookingException`) tidak pernah diulang oleh Laravel. Kegagalan saat commit juga diulang bila konkurensi (`handleCommitTransactionException`). Akibat: `attempts: 3` hanya bekerja pada transaksi terluar (produksi, tes tanpa `RefreshDatabase`); di bawah `RefreshDatabase` setiap `DB::transaction` adalah savepoint, tidak pernah diulang, dan galat konkurensi muncul sebagai `DeadlockException`. Karena itu `book()` menangkap `QueryException|DeadlockException` dan pengulangan transaksi nyata diuji di Task 6.
2. **Deteksi galat konkurensi.** `causedByConcurrencyError()` bersifat `protected` pada trait `DetectsConcurrencyErrors`, jadi service memakai kontrak `Illuminate\Contracts\Database\ConcurrencyErrorDetector` (di-bind singleton oleh `DatabaseServiceProvider`; implementasi `Illuminate\Database\ConcurrencyErrorDetector`: kode `40001`, atau pesan memuat "Deadlock found when trying to get lock", "Lock wait timeout exceeded; try restarting transaction", dan sejenisnya). Ditambah pemeriksaan eksplisit `errorInfo[1]` 1205/1213 dan `instanceof DeadlockException`.
3. **`UniqueConstraintViolationException`** (`extends QueryException`) dilempar `Connection::runQueryCallback()` bila `isUniqueConstraintError()` benar; `MySqlConnection` (induk `MariaDbConnection`) mengujinya dengan regex `Integrity constraint violation: 1062`. `QueryException::$errorInfo` = `errorInfo` PDO (`[SQLSTATE, errno, pesan driver]`), sedangkan `getMessage()` = pesan driver + " (Connection: ..., SQL: ...)". Nama indeks dibaca dari `errorInfo[2]` (tanpa SQL dan bindings), bentuk MariaDB 10.4: `Duplicate entry '12-1' for key 'appointments_practice_session_id_queue_number_unique'`; MySQL 8 menambah awalan tabel (`for key 'appointments.nama'`), yang dibuang. Bentuk MariaDB sudah dibuktikan `ScheduleSchemaTest` baris 731, 744, 795 (errno 1062 + nama indeks).
4. **CHECK.** MariaDB 10.4: SQLSTATE 23000, errno 4025, pesan "CONSTRAINT `chk_sessions_quota` failed for `db`.`practice_sessions`" (`ScheduleSchemaTest` baris 594-605); MySQL 8: errno 3819, "Check constraint 'chk_sessions_quota' is violated.". Pencocokan memakai nama LENGKAP dengan tanda kutip penutup (backtick atau apostrof) supaya `chk_sessions_quota_range` dan `chk_sessions_queue` tidak ikut cocok; CHECK lain tetap berupa `QueryException` (galat sistem, dikunci tes).
5. **Perilaku savepoint di dalam `RefreshDatabase`.** Galat tingkat pernyataan (1062, 4025) tidak membatalkan transaksi pembungkus tes (`ScheduleSchemaTest` terus berjalan sesudah galat); `rollBack()` ke `trans2` membuang SEMUA tulisan percobaan itu (pencacah sesi, appointment, riwayat, audit, dan baris yang disuntikkan hook tes), sehingga tes dapat menegaskan "tanpa baris parsial" dengan membandingkan hitungan baris dan pencacah sebelum dan sesudah. `Foundation\Testing\DatabaseTransactionsManager` melewati transaksi pembungkus untuk callback `afterCommit` (lihat Task 3, Catatan teknis 1): notifikasi terjadwal dalam percobaan yang di-rollback dibuang, dan yang commit terkirim saat level kembali ke 1.
6. **Pola kunci `ScheduleChangeService`.** `lockFresh()` (baris 672-677) dan `activeAppointmentCount()` (baris 1235-1238) memakai `PracticeSession::query()->whereKey($id)->lockForUpdate()` (kunci via PK) lalu pembacaan terkunci atas appointment sesi itu SETELAH kunci sesi; templat dikunci sebelum sesinya (`deleteTemplate`, baris 148-150). `book()` meniru kunci via PK dan urutan `patient_profiles` -> `practice_sessions` -> INSERT `appointments`. Tidak ada siklus kunci dengan `ScheduleChangeService`: keduanya harus memegang kunci baris sesi sebelum menyentuh `appointments`, dan `ScheduleChangeService` tidak pernah mengunci `patient_profiles`; `book()` tidak mengunci dokter atau templat.
7. **Snapshot REPEATABLE READ dan pengaturan.** SELECT biasa pertama dalam transaksi membuat snapshot; karena itu pernyataan PERTAMA `createInTransaction()` adalah kunci profil dan `booking.*` dibaca (`SettingsService::bookingRules()`) SEBELUM transaksi dibuka (pada `CACHE_STORE=database` pembacaan pengaturan dapat menjadi SELECT di koneksi yang sama). Dikunci tes `test_the_first_statements_are_the_profile_lock_then_the_session_lock_and_nothing_else_is_locked` (menangkap SQL lewat `DB::listen`).
8. **Pencacah sesi lewat `forceFill()->save()`, bukan `increment()`.** `increment()` melewati event model dan mengisi `updated_at` terpisah; `save()` memicu event `updating` PracticeSession, yang dipakai tes sebagai titik suntik pelanggaran nyata (Catatan teknis 11). `booked_count`/`last_queue_number` bukan `$fillable` (mode ketat), jadi `forceFill`.
9. **Kode booking.** `uniqueCode()` memilih kode yang belum ada lewat `exists()` di bawah kunci (maks 5 percobaan; F6-R5). Tabrakan yang lolos tetap ditangkap UNIQUE: 1062 pada `appointments_booking_code_unique` atau `appointments_practice_session_id_queue_number_unique` mengulang transaksi dalam putaran luar baru (kode baru), maksimum 3 putaran (`UNIQUE_ROUNDS`); sesudahnya `report()` + `SYSTEM_BUSY`. Putaran gagal tidak menghabiskan nomor antrean (rollback membatalkan kenaikan `last_queue_number`).
10. **Anti-kirim-ganda bukan di service** (F6-R9: `Cache::lock` di controller Task 8) supaya tes konkurensi Task 6 tetap menguji lapis DB.
11. **Pelanggaran DB nyata, bukan mock.** Tiga hook model per tes dipasang sebelum `book()`: (a) `PracticeSession::updating` menyisipkan, lewat `DB::table('appointments')->insert()`, pendaftaran aktif lain pasien yang sama pada sesi itu TEPAT sebelum UPDATE pencacah, sehingga INSERT service melanggar UNIQUE `appointments_patient_session_active_unique` yang sebenarnya (pemeriksaan F.5 sudah lolos karena baris itu belum ada saat dibaca; ini meniru balapan); (b) `PracticeSession::updating` menulis `booked_count = quota + 1` (dan `last_queue_number` yang sama agar `chk_sessions_queue` tidak ikut gagal) sehingga CHECK `chk_sessions_quota` yang sebenarnya menolak UPDATE; (c) `Appointment::creating` menimpa `booking_code` atau `queue_number` dengan nilai yang sudah ada, sehingga UNIQUE yang sebenarnya menolak INSERT. Hook dipasang pada dispatcher aplikasi per tes (`DatabaseServiceProvider::boot()` memasang dispatcher baru dan `Model::clearBootedModels()` untuk tiap aplikasi tes), jadi tidak bocor ke tes lain.
12. **Mode ketat.** Pemuatan baris memakai `first()` (model tunggal: lazy loading diizinkan, tetapi relasi sesi dimuat eksplisit `load(['clinic', 'doctor'])` setelah kedua kunci). Hasil `book()` memakai `with([...])->findOrFail()`. Appointment dibuat dengan `forceFill()` (kolom `booking_code`, `queue_number`, `status`, `confirmed_at`, `payment_reference_last4` bukan `$fillable`); riwayat lewat `AppointmentStatusHistory::query()->create()` (semua kolomnya `$fillable`).
13. **Pelaku.** `assertActorMayBook()` (tanpa DB; ditambahkan penulis, lihat Catatan penulis 3): pelaku `system` -> `LogicException`; pasien dengan `$profile->user_id` bukan miliknya -> `AuthorizationException`. Kanal, status awal, dan pembuat: `$actor->channel()`; status `confirmed` bila pelaku staf atau `booking.auto_confirm`, selain itu `pending`; `created_by_user_id` hanya untuk staf; alasan riwayat "Konfirmasi otomatis" hanya untuk pasien yang langsung `confirmed`.
14. **Audit.** `appointment.created` dengan `new_values` = `booking_code`, `queue_number`, `status`, `channel`, `payment_type` dan deskripsi "Pendaftaran {kode} dibuat ({label kanal}).": tanpa nama, telepon, nomor BPJS/polis, dan keluhan (redaksi `appointment.*` bawaan `AuditLogger` tetap aktif sebagai pengaman). Bila `save_bpjs` aktif pada pembayaran BPJS, ditulis juga satu audit `patient.updated` (R-a) tanpa nomor BPJS.
15. **DB pengembangan.** Implementer tidak menjalankan `migrate`/`db:seed` pada `unpam_hospital`.
16. Jumlah tes baru ±40 (provider `failureScenarios` 10).

```php
/**

 *
 * Di dalam RefreshDatabase, `DB::transaction` adalah savepoint: deadlock tidak diulang (Laravel melempar
 * DeadlockException) dan tidak ada transaksi terluar. Pengulangan transaksi nyata, SYSTEM_BUSY karena lock wait,

class BookingServiceTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithPatients;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        // Kamis 2026-10-08 09.30; sesi bawaan = besok (Jumat 2026-10-09) 08.00-12.00.
        $this->travelTo('2026-10-08 09:30:00');
        app()->setLocale('id');
        $this->seed(SettingsSeeder::class);
        $this->ensureAppointmentShowRoute();

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ pembantu

    private function service(): BookingService
    {
        return $this->app->make(BookingService::class);
    }

    {
        return new BookingData(PaymentType::Umum);
    }
```
