```php
     * Sesi manual (tanpa templat) kuota 5 dengan dokter dan poliklinik baru.
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     */
    private function makeSession(array $overrides = []): PracticeSession
    {
        return $this->createSession($overrides + ['doctor_schedule_id' => null, 'quota' => 5]);
    }

    private function bookAs(User $user, PracticeSession $session, ?BookingData $data = null): Appointment
    {
        return $this->service()->book($user->patientProfile, $session->id, $data ?? $this->umum(), Actor::patient($user));
    }

    /**
     * Pembatalan langsung di DB (Task 5 belum ada): status final dan `booked_count - 1`; `last_queue_number` tetap.
     */
    private function cancelDirectly(Appointment $appointment): void
    {
        DB::table('appointments')->where('id', $appointment->id)->update([
            'status' => AppointmentStatus::Cancelled->value,
            'cancelled_at' => now(),
            'cancelled_by_type' => ActorType::Patient->value,
            'updated_at' => now(),
        ]);
        DB::table('practice_sessions')->where('id', $appointment->practice_session_id)->decrement('booked_count');
    }

    private function counters(int $sessionId): array

    }

    private function snapshot(int $sessionId): array

                'histories' => DB::table('appointment_status_histories')->count(),
                'audits' => DB::table('audit_logs')->count(),
                'notifications' => DB::table('notifications')->count(),

            'counters' => $this->counters($sessionId),

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ sukses (BKG-01, BKG-15, loket)

    public function test_an_online_booking_creates_a_pending_appointment_with_the_session_columns_copied(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $session = $this->makeSession(['quota' => 3]);

        $appointment = $this->bookAs($user, $session);

        $this->assertTrue(BookingCodeGenerator::isValid($appointment->booking_code));
        $this->assertSame($user->patientProfile->id, $appointment->patient_profile_id);
        $this->assertSame($session->id, $appointment->practice_session_id);
        $this->assertSame($session->doctor_id, $appointment->doctor_id);
        $this->assertSame($session->clinic_id, $appointment->clinic_id);
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-09', $appointment->session_date->toDateString());
        $this->assertSame(1, $appointment->queue_number);
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Pending, $appointment->status);
        $this->assertSame(BookingChannel::Online, $appointment->channel);
        $this->assertSame(PaymentType::Umum, $appointment->payment_type);
        $this->assertSame(1, $appointment->active_flag, 'Kolom generated terisi karena appointment dibaca ulang dari DB.');
        $this->assertNull($appointment->confirmed_at);
        $this->assertNull($appointment->created_by_user_id);
        $this->assertNull($appointment->insurance_partner_id);
        $this->assertNull($appointment->payment_reference);
        $this->assertNull($appointment->payment_reference_last4);

        foreach (['clinic', 'doctor', 'practiceSession'] as $relation) {
            $this->assertTrue($appointment->relationLoaded($relation), "Relasi {$relation} harus sudah dimuat.");
        }

        $this->assertSame($session->clinic->code.'-001', $appointment->queue_label);
        $this->assertSame(['booked_count' => 1, 'last_queue_number' => 1], $this->counters($session->id));
    }

    public function test_the_first_history_row_has_no_from_status_and_records_the_patient_actor(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();

        $appointment = $this->bookAs($user, $this->makeSession());

        $history = AppointmentStatusHistory::query()->where('appointment_id', $appointment->id)->sole();
        $this->assertNull($history->from_status);
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Pending, $history->to_status);
        $this->assertSame(ActorType::Patient, $history->actor_type);
        $this->assertSame($user->id, $history->actor_user_id);
        $this->assertNull($history->reason);
    }

    public function test_auto_confirm_creates_a_confirmed_appointment_with_the_automatic_confirmation_reason(): void
    {
        app(SettingsService::class)->set('booking.auto_confirm', true);
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $session = $this->makeSession();

        $appointment = $this->bookAs($user, $session);

        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $appointment->status);
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-08 09:30:00', $appointment->confirmed_at->toDateTimeString());
        $this->assertSame(BookingChannel::Online, $appointment->channel);

        $history = AppointmentStatusHistory::query()->where('appointment_id', $appointment->id)->sole();
        $this->assertNull($history->from_status);
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $history->to_status);
        $this->assertSame('Konfirmasi otomatis', $history->reason);
        $this->assertSame(['booked_count' => 1, 'last_queue_number' => 1], $this->counters($session->id));
    }

    public function test_a_counter_booking_by_staff_is_confirmed_and_records_the_creator(): void
    {
        $staff = $this->createStaff('registration-officer');
        $walkIn = PatientProfile::factory()->create();
        $session = $this->makeSession();

        $appointment = $this->service()->book($walkIn, $session->id, $this->umum(), Actor::staff($staff));

        $this->assertSame(BookingChannel::Loket, $appointment->channel);
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $appointment->status);
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-08 09:30:00', $appointment->confirmed_at->toDateTimeString());
        $this->assertSame($staff->id, $appointment->created_by_user_id);

        $history = AppointmentStatusHistory::query()->where('appointment_id', $appointment->id)->sole();
        $this->assertSame(ActorType::Staff, $history->actor_type);
        $this->assertSame($staff->id, $history->actor_user_id);
        $this->assertNull($history->reason, 'Alasan "Konfirmasi otomatis" hanya untuk pendaftaran online.');

        $audit = AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'appointment.created')->sole();
        $this->assertSame(ActorType::Staff, $audit->actor_type);
        $this->assertSame($staff->id, $audit->user_id);
        $this->assertSame('loket', $audit->new_values['channel']);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('(Loket)', $audit->description);
    }

    public function test_a_counter_booking_is_accepted_after_the_online_cutoff_while_online_is_not(): void
    {
        $session = $this->makeSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-08', 'start_time' => '10:00:00', 'end_time' => '12:00:00']);
        $staff = $this->createStaff('registration-officer');
        $user = $this->createPatient();

        try {
            $this->bookAs($user, $session);
            $this->fail('Pendaftaran online 30 menit sebelum sesi seharusnya ditolak (batas 60 menit).');
        } catch (BookingException $e) {
            $this->assertSame(BookingException::CUTOFF_PASSED, $e->errorCode);
        }

        $appointment = $this->service()->book($user->patientProfile, $session->id, $this->umum(), Actor::staff($staff));

        $this->assertSame(BookingChannel::Loket, $appointment->channel);
        $this->assertSame(['booked_count' => 1, 'last_queue_number' => 1], $this->counters($session->id));
    }

        $session = $this->makeSession(['doctor_id' => $doctor->id, 'clinic_id' => $clinic->id, 'quota' => 5]);

        $codes = [];
        $labels = [];
        foreach (range(1, 5) as $expectedQueue) {
            $appointment = $this->bookAs($this->createPatient(), $session);
            $this->assertSame($expectedQueue, $appointment->queue_number);
            $codes[] = $appointment->booking_code;
            $labels[] = $appointment->queue_label;
            $this->assertMatchesRegularExpression(BookingCodeGenerator::PATTERN, $appointment->booking_code);
        }

        $this->assertSame(['ANK-001', 'ANK-002', 'ANK-003', 'ANK-004', 'ANK-005'], $labels);
        $this->assertCount(5, array_unique($codes));
        $this->assertSame(['booked_count' => 5, 'last_queue_number' => 5], $this->counters($session->id));

        try {
            $this->bookAs($this->createPatient(), $session);
            $this->fail('Pasien keenam pada kuota 5 seharusnya ditolak.');
        } catch (BookingException $e) {
            $this->assertSame(BookingException::QUOTA_FULL, $e->errorCode);
        }

        $this->assertSame(['booked_count' => 5, 'last_queue_number' => 5], $this->counters($session->id));
    }

    public function test_a_cancelled_queue_number_is_never_reused_and_the_same_patient_can_book_again(): void
    {
        $session = $this->makeSession(['quota' => 3]);
        $userA = $this->createPatient();
        $userB = $this->createPatient();
        $userC = $this->createPatient();

        $first = $this->bookAs($userA, $session);
        $this->bookAs($userB, $session);
        $this->cancelDirectly($first);
        $this->assertSame(['booked_count' => 1, 'last_queue_number' => 2], $this->counters($session->id));

        $third = $this->bookAs($userC, $session);
        $again = $this->bookAs($userA, $session);

        $this->assertSame(3, $third->queue_number, 'Nomor antrean 1 tidak dipakai ulang.');
        $this->assertSame(4, $again->queue_number, 'Pasien yang sama boleh mendaftar lagi sesudah batal, dengan nomor baru.');
        $this->assertSame(['booked_count' => 3, 'last_queue_number' => 4], $this->counters($session->id));
        $this->assertSame([1, 2, 3, 4], Appointment::query()->orderBy('queue_number')->pluck('queue_number')->all());
    }

    public function test_the_bpjs_number_is_stored_encrypted_with_the_last_four_digits(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $data = new BookingData(paymentType: PaymentType::Bpjs, paymentReference: '0009900000011');

        $appointment = $this->bookAs($user, $this->makeSession(), $data);

        $raw = (string) DB::table('appointments')->where('id', $appointment->id)->value('payment_reference');
        $this->assertNotSame('', $raw);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('0009900000011', $raw, 'Nilai mentah di DB harus terenkripsi.');
        $this->assertSame('0009900000011', Crypt::decryptString($raw));
        $this->assertSame('0009900000011', Appointment::query()->findOrFail($appointment->id)->payment_reference);
        $this->assertSame('0011', DB::table('appointments')->where('id', $appointment->id)->value('payment_reference_last4'));
        $this->assertSame('•••••••••0011', $appointment->masked_payment_reference);
        $this->assertSame(PaymentType::Bpjs, $appointment->payment_type);
        $this->assertNull($appointment->insurance_partner_id);
    }

    public function test_save_bpjs_updates_the_profile_number_only_when_requested_for_a_bpjs_booking(): void
    {
        $number = '0009900000011';
        $saver = $this->createPatient();
        $keeper = $this->createPatient();
        $cash = $this->createPatient();

        $this->bookAs($saver, $this->makeSession(), new BookingData(paymentType: PaymentType::Bpjs, paymentReference: $number, saveBpjs: true));
        $this->bookAs($keeper, $this->makeSession(), new BookingData(paymentType: PaymentType::Bpjs, paymentReference: $number, saveBpjs: false));
        $this->bookAs($cash, $this->makeSession(), new BookingData(paymentType: PaymentType::Umum, saveBpjs: true));

        $savedProfile = PatientProfile::query()->findOrFail($saver->patientProfile->id);
        $this->assertSame($number, $savedProfile->bpjs_number);
        $this->assertSame('0011', $savedProfile->bpjs_number_last4);
        $raw = (string) DB::table('patient_profiles')->where('id', $savedProfile->id)->value('bpjs_number');
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString($number, $raw, 'Nomor BPJS profil tersimpan terenkripsi.');

        // R-a: hanya penyimpan BPJS yang menulis audit `patient.updated`; nomor tidak bocor ke audit.
        $audit = AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'patient.updated')->sole();
        $this->assertSame($savedProfile->id, (int) $audit->auditable_id);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString($number, json_encode([$audit->old_values, $audit->new_values, $audit->description]));

        $this->assertNull(PatientProfile::query()->findOrFail($keeper->patientProfile->id)->bpjs_number, 'Tanpa save_bpjs profil tidak berubah.');
        $this->assertNull(PatientProfile::query()->findOrFail($cash->patientProfile->id)->bpjs_number, 'save_bpjs hanya berlaku untuk pembayaran BPJS.');
    }

    public function test_the_audit_row_records_the_creation_without_personal_or_payment_data(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient([], ['phone' => '081355577788', 'address' => 'Jl. Rahasia Kenanga No. 99 Tangerang']);

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ kode F.5 tanpa baris parsial (BKG-02..09)

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{0: string, 1: string}>
     */
    public static function failureScenarios(): array
    {
        return [
            'sesi tidak tersedia (BKG-05)' => ['session_unavailable', BookingException::SESSION_UNAVAILABLE],
            'sesi tidak ditemukan' => ['session_not_found', BookingException::SESSION_UNAVAILABLE],
            'di luar jendela (BKG-06)' => ['outside_window', BookingException::OUTSIDE_WINDOW],
            'lewat batas online (BKG-07)' => ['cutoff_passed', BookingException::CUTOFF_PASSED],
            'kuota penuh (BKG-04)' => ['quota_full', BookingException::QUOTA_FULL],
            'pendaftaran ganda (BKG-02)' => ['duplicate_booking', BookingException::DUPLICATE_BOOKING],
            'jadwal beririsan (BKG-03)' => ['overlapping_booking', BookingException::OVERLAPPING_BOOKING],
            'batas aktif (BKG-08)' => ['active_limit_reached', BookingException::ACTIVE_LIMIT_REACHED],
            'pembayaran tidak valid (BKG-09)' => ['invalid_payment', BookingException::INVALID_PAYMENT],
            'profil tidak aktif' => ['profile_inactive', BookingException::SESSION_UNAVAILABLE],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array{0: PatientProfile, 1: int, 2: BookingData, 3: Actor}
     */
    private function scenario(string $case): array
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $profile = $user->patientProfile;
        $actor = Actor::patient($user);
        $data = $this->umum();

        switch ($case) {
            case 'session_unavailable':
                $sessionId = $this->makeSession(['status' => SessionStatus::Closed])->id;
                break;
            case 'session_not_found':
                $sessionId = 987654;
                break;
            case 'outside_window':
                $sessionId = $this->makeSession(['session_date' => '2026-11-20'])->id;
                break;
            case 'cutoff_passed':
                $sessionId = $this->makeSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-08', 'start_time' => '10:00:00', 'end_time' => '12:00:00'])->id;
                break;
            case 'quota_full':
                $session = $this->makeSession(['quota' => 1]);
                $this->bookAppointment($session);
                $sessionId = $session->id;
                break;
            case 'duplicate_booking':
                $session = $this->makeSession();
                $this->service()->book($profile, $session->id, $data, $actor);
                $sessionId = $session->id;
                break;
            case 'overlapping_booking':
                $first = $this->makeSession(['start_time' => '09:00:00', 'end_time' => '12:00:00']);
                $this->service()->book($profile, $first->id, $data, $actor);
                $sessionId = $this->makeSession(['start_time' => '11:00:00', 'end_time' => '13:00:00'])->id;
                break;
            case 'active_limit_reached':
                foreach (['2026-10-09', '2026-10-10', '2026-10-11'] as $date) {
                    $this->service()->book($profile, $this->makeSession(['session_date' => $date])->id, $data, $actor);
                }
                $sessionId = $this->makeSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-12'])->id;
                break;
            case 'invalid_payment':
                $sessionId = $this->makeSession()->id;
                $data = new BookingData(paymentType: PaymentType::Bpjs, paymentReference: '123456789012');
                break;
            case 'profile_inactive':
                $profile->forceFill(['is_active' => false])->save();
                $sessionId = $this->makeSession()->id;
                break;
            default:
                $this->fail("Skenario tidak dikenal: {$case}");
        }

        return [$profile, $sessionId, $data, $actor];
    }

    #[DataProvider('failureScenarios')]
    public function test_every_f5_failure_has_its_code_and_leaves_no_partial_rows(string $case, string $expectedCode): void
    {
        Notification::fake();
        [$profile, $sessionId, $data, $actor] = $this->scenario($case);
        $before = $this->snapshot($sessionId);

        try {
            $this->service()->book($profile, $sessionId, $data, $actor);
            $this->fail("Pendaftaran skenario {$case} seharusnya ditolak.");
        } catch (BookingException $e) {
            $this->assertSame($expectedCode, $e->errorCode);
            $this->assertNotSame('', $e->getMessage());
        }

        $this->assertSame($before, $this->snapshot($sessionId), 'Tidak boleh ada baris parsial atau perubahan pencacah sesi.');
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ BKG-18: pelanggaran DB nyata dipetakan

    public function test_a_real_active_unique_violation_is_mapped_to_duplicate_booking(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $profile = $user->patientProfile;
        $session = $this->makeSession();
        $before = $this->snapshot($session->id);
        $injected = 0;
        // Sesudah aturan F.5 lolos dan sebelum INSERT, "pendaftaran lain" pasien yang sama pada sesi ini masuk
        // (balapan yang lolos dari pemeriksaan): INSERT kita melanggar UNIQUE `active_flag` yang sebenarnya.
        PracticeSession::updating(function (PracticeSession $locked) use ($profile, &$injected): void {
            if ($injected++ > 0) {
                return;
            }

            DB::table('appointments')->insert([
                'booking_code' => 'UPH-ZZZZ-ZZZZ',
                'patient_profile_id' => $profile->id,
                'practice_session_id' => $locked->id,
                'doctor_id' => $locked->doctor_id,
                'clinic_id' => $locked->clinic_id,
                'session_date' => $locked->session_date->toDateString(),
                'queue_number' => 99,
                'status' => 'pending',
                'channel' => 'online',
                'payment_type' => 'umum',
                'created_at' => now(),
                'updated_at' => now(),
            ]);
        });

        try {
            $this->bookAs($user, $session);
            $this->fail('Pelanggaran UNIQUE aktif seharusnya menjadi BookingException.');
        } catch (BookingException $e) {
            $this->assertSame(BookingException::DUPLICATE_BOOKING, $e->errorCode);
            $this->assertSame(__('booking.errors.DUPLICATE_BOOKING', ['subjek' => 'Anda']), $e->getMessage());
            $previous = $e->getPrevious();
            $this->assertInstanceOf(UniqueConstraintViolationException::class, $previous);
            $this->assertSame(1062, $previous->errorInfo[1]);
            $this->assertStringContainsString('appointments_patient_session_active_unique', (string) $previous->errorInfo[2]);
        }

        $this->assertSame(1, $injected);
        $this->assertSame($before, $this->snapshot($session->id), 'Savepoint dibatalkan: tanpa baris parsial, pencacah sesi kembali.');
    }

    public function test_a_real_quota_check_violation_is_mapped_to_quota_full(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $session = $this->makeSession(['quota' => 5]);
        $before = $this->snapshot($session->id);
        // Pencacah ditulis melewati kuota (booked_count = quota + 1) sehingga CHECK `chk_sessions_quota` yang
        // sebenarnya menolak UPDATE. `last_queue_number` ikut dinaikkan agar `chk_sessions_queue` tidak ikut gagal.
        PracticeSession::updating(function (PracticeSession $locked): void {
            $locked->booked_count = $locked->quota + 1;
            $locked->last_queue_number = $locked->quota + 1;
        });

        try {
            $this->bookAs($user, $session);
            $this->fail('Pelanggaran CHECK kuota seharusnya menjadi BookingException.');
        } catch (BookingException $e) {
            $this->assertSame(BookingException::QUOTA_FULL, $e->errorCode);
            $this->assertSame(__('booking.errors.QUOTA_FULL'), $e->getMessage());
            $previous = $e->getPrevious();
            $this->assertInstanceOf(QueryException::class, $previous);
            $this->assertNotInstanceOf(UniqueConstraintViolationException::class, $previous);
            $this->assertContains($previous->errorInfo[1], [4025, 3819]);
            $this->assertStringContainsString('chk_sessions_quota', (string) $previous->errorInfo[2]);
        }

        $this->assertSame($before, $this->snapshot($session->id));
    }

    public function test_other_check_violations_are_not_mapped_and_surface_as_system_errors(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $session = $this->makeSession();
        $before = $this->snapshot($session->id);
        // `last_queue_number` di bawah `booked_count` melanggar `chk_sessions_queue`, bukan `chk_sessions_quota`.
        PracticeSession::updating(function (PracticeSession $locked): void {
            $locked->last_queue_number = 0;
        });

        try {
            $this->bookAs($user, $session);
            $this->fail('Pelanggaran CHECK selain kuota seharusnya tetap berupa QueryException (galat sistem).');
        } catch (QueryException $e) {
            $this->assertContains($e->errorInfo[1], [4025, 3819]);
            $this->assertStringContainsString('chk_sessions_queue', (string) $e->errorInfo[2]);
        }

        $this->assertSame($before, $this->snapshot($session->id));
    }

    public function test_a_booking_code_collision_is_retried_with_a_new_code_in_a_new_round(): void
    {
        $session = $this->makeSession();
        $existing = $this->bookAppointment($session);
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $calls = 0;
        // Tabrakan UNIQUE `booking_code` yang sebenarnya pada percobaan pertama.
        Appointment::creating(function (Appointment $appointment) use ($existing, &$calls): void {
            if (++$calls === 1) {
                $appointment->booking_code = $existing->booking_code;
            }
        });

        $appointment = $this->bookAs($user, $session);

        $this->assertSame(2, $calls, 'Putaran pertama gagal (1062), putaran kedua berhasil.');
        $this->assertNotSame($existing->booking_code, $appointment->booking_code);
        $this->assertTrue(BookingCodeGenerator::isValid($appointment->booking_code));
        $this->assertSame(2, $appointment->queue_number, 'Putaran gagal tidak menghabiskan nomor antrean.');
        $this->assertSame(['booked_count' => 2, 'last_queue_number' => 2], $this->counters($session->id));
        $this->assertSame(2, Appointment::query()->count());
        $this->assertSame(1, AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'appointment.created')->count());
        $this->assertSame(1, AppointmentStatusHistory::query()->where('appointment_id', $appointment->id)->count());
    }

    public function test_a_queue_number_collision_is_retried_and_the_round_leaves_no_trace(): void
    {
        $session = $this->makeSession();
        $this->bookAppointment($session);
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $calls = 0;
        // Nomor antrean 1 sudah dipakai: UNIQUE `(practice_session_id, queue_number)` yang sebenarnya menolak.
        Appointment::creating(function (Appointment $appointment) use (&$calls): void {
            if (++$calls === 1) {
                $appointment->queue_number = 1;
            }
        });

        $appointment = $this->bookAs($user, $session);

        $this->assertSame(2, $calls);
        $this->assertSame(2, $appointment->queue_number);
        $this->assertSame(['booked_count' => 2, 'last_queue_number' => 2], $this->counters($session->id));
        $this->assertSame(2, Appointment::query()->count());
    }

    public function test_repeated_unique_collisions_stop_after_the_rounds_and_become_system_busy_with_a_report(): void
    {
        $session = $this->makeSession();
        $existing = $this->bookAppointment($session);
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $before = $this->snapshot($session->id);
        $calls = 0;
        Appointment::creating(function (Appointment $appointment) use ($existing, &$calls): void {
            $calls++;
            $appointment->booking_code = $existing->booking_code;
        });
        Exceptions::fake();

        try {
            $this->bookAs($user, $session);
            $this->fail('Tabrakan kode terus-menerus seharusnya berakhir sebagai SYSTEM_BUSY.');
        } catch (BookingException $e) {
            $this->assertSame(BookingException::SYSTEM_BUSY, $e->errorCode);
            $this->assertSame(__('booking.errors.SYSTEM_BUSY'), $e->getMessage());
            $this->assertInstanceOf(UniqueConstraintViolationException::class, $e->getPrevious());
        }

        $this->assertSame(BookingService::UNIQUE_ROUNDS, $calls);
        $this->assertSame($before, $this->snapshot($session->id));
        Exceptions::assertReportedCount(1);
        Exceptions::assertReported(UniqueConstraintViolationException::class);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ urutan kunci (Review Focus 1)

    public function test_the_first_statements_are_the_profile_lock_then_the_session_lock_and_nothing_else_is_locked(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $session = $this->makeSession();
        // Pemanasan: pengaturan dibaca sebelum transaksi sehingga tidak ada kueri pengaturan di dalamnya.
        $this->app->make(SettingsService::class)->bookingRules();
        $queries = [];
        DB::listen(function ($query) use (&$queries): void {
            $queries[] = $query->sql;
        });

        $this->bookAs($user, $session);

        $this->assertStringContainsString('`patient_profiles`', $queries[0]);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('for update', $queries[0], 'Pernyataan pertama transaksi adalah kunci profil.');
        $this->assertStringContainsString('`practice_sessions`', $queries[1]);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('for update', $queries[1], 'Pernyataan kedua adalah kunci sesi.');

        $locking = array_values(array_filter($queries, fn (string $sql): bool => str_contains($sql, 'for update')));
        $this->assertCount(2, $locking, 'Hanya dua pembacaan terkunci (profil dan sesi); appointment tidak dikunci lewat rentang.');
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ precheck (F6-R12)

    public function test_precheck_passes_for_a_bookable_session_and_writes_and_locks_nothing(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $session = $this->makeSession();
        $this->app->make(SettingsService::class)->bookingRules();
        $before = $this->snapshot($session->id);
        $queries = [];
        DB::listen(function ($query) use (&$queries): void {
            $queries[] = strtolower($query->sql);
        });

        $this->service()->precheck($user->patientProfile, $session, $this->umum(), Actor::patient($user));

        $this->assertNotEmpty($queries, 'Precheck membaca data (SELECT biasa).');
        foreach ($queries as $sql) {
            $this->assertDoesNotMatchRegularExpression('/^\s*(insert|update|delete|replace)\b/', $sql);
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString('for update', $sql);
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString('lock in share mode', $sql);
        }
        $this->assertSame($before, $this->snapshot($session->id));
    }

    public function test_precheck_reads_the_current_session_and_throws_the_same_codes_as_book(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $session = $this->makeSession(['quota' => 1]);
        $stale = PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($session->id);
        $this->bookAppointment($session);
        $before = $this->snapshot($session->id);

        $this->assertSame(0, $stale->booked_count, 'Instansi lama masih mengira sesi kosong.');

        try {
            $this->service()->precheck($user->patientProfile, $stale, $this->umum(), Actor::patient($user));
            $this->fail('Precheck seharusnya melihat sesi yang sudah penuh.');
        } catch (BookingException $e) {
            $this->assertSame(BookingException::QUOTA_FULL, $e->errorCode);
        }

        $this->assertSame($before, $this->snapshot($session->id));
    }

    public function test_precheck_rejects_inactive_profiles_missing_sessions_and_foreign_profiles(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $stranger = $this->createPatient();
        $session = $this->makeSession();
        $ghost = new PracticeSession;
        $ghost->id = 987654;

        try {
            $this->service()->precheck($user->patientProfile, $ghost, $this->umum(), Actor::patient($user));
            $this->fail('Sesi yang tidak ada seharusnya ditolak.');
        } catch (BookingException $e) {
            $this->assertSame(BookingException::SESSION_UNAVAILABLE, $e->errorCode);
        }

        $inactive = PatientProfile::query()->findOrFail($user->patientProfile->id)->forceFill(['is_active' => false]);

        try {
            $this->service()->precheck($inactive, $session, $this->umum(), Actor::patient($user));
            $this->fail('Profil nonaktif seharusnya ditolak.');
        } catch (BookingException $e) {
            $this->assertSame('Profil pasien tidak aktif atau tidak ditemukan.', $e->getMessage());
        }

        $this->expectException(AuthorizationException::class);
        $this->service()->precheck($user->patientProfile, $session, $this->umum(), Actor::patient($stranger));
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Buat `BookingService` (tool Write) `app/Services/Booking/BookingService.php`**

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Services\Booking;

use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Enums\PaymentType;
use App\Exceptions\BookingException;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\AppointmentStatusHistory;
use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Services\Audit\AuditLogger;
use App\Services\Settings\SettingsService;
use App\Support\Actor;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Database\ConcurrencyErrorDetector;
use Illuminate\Database\DeadlockException;
use Illuminate\Database\QueryException;
use Illuminate\Database\UniqueConstraintViolationException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use LogicException;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Satu-satunya jalur pembuatan pendaftaran kunjungan (00 F.5-F.7, F6-R12, F6-R13, F6-R35).
 *
 * Konkurensi (F6-R13): `DB::transaction(..., 3)` dibungkus loop luar. Urutan kunci baku `patient_profiles` ->
 * `practice_sessions` -> INSERT `appointments`; kunci hanya lewat PK dan pernyataan PERTAMA transaksi adalah kunci
 * profil (snapshot REPEATABLE READ baru dibuat sesudah kedua kunci). Karena itu pengaturan (`booking.*`) dibaca
 * SEBELUM transaksi dan tidak ada SELECT lain sebelum kedua kunci. Closure transaksi tanpa efek samping di luar
 * DB: notifikasi dijadwalkan `DB::afterCommit` oleh AppointmentNotifier. Pelanggaran UNIQUE/CHECK (lapis DB
 * terakhir) dipetakan ke BookingException; deadlock/lock wait yang lolos dari 3 percobaan menjadi SYSTEM_BUSY.
 *
 * `Cache::lock` anti-kirim-ganda sengaja BUKAN di sini melainkan di controller (F6-R9) supaya tes konkurensi
 * tetap menguji lapis DB.
 */
final class BookingService
{
    /** Percobaan `DB::transaction` (hanya berlaku di transaksi terluar; deadlock/lock wait diulang utuh). */
    public const TRANSACTION_ATTEMPTS = 3;

    /** Putaran luar untuk tabrakan UNIQUE kode booking/nomor antrean (kode baru tiap putaran). */
    public const UNIQUE_ROUNDS = 3;

    /** Percobaan memilih kode booking yang belum ada di dalam satu putaran. */
    public const CODE_ATTEMPTS = 5;

    private const INDEX_ACTIVE_DUPLICATE = 'appointments_patient_session_active_unique';

    private const INDEX_BOOKING_CODE = 'appointments_booking_code_unique';

    private const INDEX_QUEUE_NUMBER = 'appointments_practice_session_id_queue_number_unique';

    private const CONSTRAINT_QUOTA = 'chk_sessions_quota';

    /** MariaDB 10.4 melaporkan CHECK dengan 4025, MySQL 8 dengan 3819. */
    private const CHECK_ERRORS = [4025, 3819];

    /** 1205 = lock wait timeout, 1213 = deadlock. */
    private const CONCURRENCY_ERRORS = [1205, 1213];

    public function __construct(
        private readonly AuditLogger $audit,
        private readonly SettingsService $settings,
        private readonly AppointmentNotifier $notifier,
    ) {}

    /**
     * Membuat pendaftaran. Pelaku `patient` hanya boleh untuk profilnya sendiri; pelaku `staff` untuk profil
     * mana pun (kanal loket, status awal `confirmed`); pelaku `system` ditolak.
     *
     * @throws BookingException kode F.5 (SESSION_UNAVAILABLE ... INVALID_PAYMENT) atau SYSTEM_BUSY
     * @throws AuthorizationException pasien mendaftarkan profil orang lain
     */
    public function book(PatientProfile $profile, int $practiceSessionId, BookingData $data, Actor $actor): Appointment
    {
        $this->assertActorMayBook($profile, $actor);

        // Dibaca di luar transaksi: pembacaan pertama di dalam transaksi harus kunci profil (F6-R13).
        $rules = $this->settings->bookingRules();

        $round = 0;

        while (true) {
            $round++;

            try {
                $appointment = DB::transaction(
                    fn (): Appointment => $this->createInTransaction($rules, $profile, $practiceSessionId, $data, $actor),
                    self::TRANSACTION_ATTEMPTS,
                );
            } catch (UniqueConstraintViolationException $e) {
                if ($round < self::UNIQUE_ROUNDS && $this->isRetryableUniqueViolation($e)) {
                    continue;
                }

                throw $this->translate($e, $actor);
            } catch (QueryException|DeadlockException $e) {
                throw $this->translate($e, $actor);
            }

            return Appointment::query()
                ->with(['clinic', 'doctor', 'practiceSession'])
                ->findOrFail($appointment->getKey());
        }
    }

    /**
     * Pemeriksaan awal F.5 tanpa kunci, tanpa transaksi, dan tanpa menulis apa pun (F6-R12): sesi dimuat ulang
     * dengan SELECT biasa supaya hitungan kuota tidak basi. Hasilnya tidak mengikat (book() tetap memeriksa
     * ulang di bawah kunci) dan tidak pernah SYSTEM_BUSY.
     *
     * @throws BookingException kode F.5
     */
    public function precheck(PatientProfile $profile, PracticeSession $session, BookingData $data, Actor $actor): void
    {
        $this->assertActorMayBook($profile, $actor);

        if (! $profile->is_active) {
            throw BookingException::profileInactive();
        }

        $current = PracticeSession::query()->with(['clinic', 'doctor'])->find($session->getKey());

        if ($current === null) {
            throw BookingException::make(BookingException::SESSION_UNAVAILABLE);
        }

        $this->settings->bookingRules()->assertBookable($profile, $current, $data, $actor, CarbonImmutable::now());
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ di dalam transaksi

    private function createInTransaction(BookingRules $rules, PatientProfile $profile, int $practiceSessionId, BookingData $data, Actor $actor): Appointment
    {
        // 1) Kunci profil (pernyataan pertama), lalu periksa ulang bahwa profil masih aktif.
        $locked = PatientProfile::query()->whereKey($profile->getKey())->lockForUpdate()->first();

        if ($locked === null || ! $locked->is_active) {
            throw BookingException::profileInactive();
        }

        // 2) Kunci sesi (sesudah profil; urutan baku).
        $session = PracticeSession::query()->whereKey($practiceSessionId)->lockForUpdate()->first();

        if ($session === null) {
            throw BookingException::make(BookingException::SESSION_UNAVAILABLE);
        }

        // 3) Relasi untuk aturan F.5 dimuat SESUDAH kedua kunci.
        $session->load(['clinic', 'doctor']);
        $now = CarbonImmutable::now();

        // 4) Delapan aturan F.5 (urutan 1 sampai 8) di bawah kunci.
        $rules->assertBookable($locked, $session, $data, $actor, $now);

        $status = ($actor->isStaff() || $rules->autoConfirm) ? AppointmentStatus::Confirmed : AppointmentStatus::Pending;
        $channel = $actor->channel();
        $queueNumber = (int) $session->last_queue_number + 1;
        $code = $this->uniqueCode();

        // 5) Kuota dan antrean (nomor antrean tidak pernah dipakai ulang).
        $session->forceFill([
            'booked_count' => (int) $session->booked_count + 1,
            'last_queue_number' => $queueNumber,
        ])->save();

        // 6) Pendaftaran; kolom jadwal disalin dari sesi (BR-52).
        $appointment = (new Appointment)->forceFill([
            'booking_code' => $code,
            'patient_profile_id' => $locked->getKey(),
            'practice_session_id' => $session->getKey(),
            'doctor_id' => $session->doctor_id,
            'clinic_id' => $session->clinic_id,
            'session_date' => $session->session_date->toDateString(),
            'queue_number' => $queueNumber,
            'status' => $status,
            'channel' => $channel,
            'payment_type' => $data->paymentType,
            'insurance_partner_id' => $data->insurancePartnerId,
            'payment_reference' => $data->paymentReference,
            'payment_reference_last4' => $data->paymentReferenceLast4(),
            'complaint' => $data->complaint,
            'created_by_user_id' => $actor->isStaff() ? $actor->userId : null,
            'confirmed_at' => $status === AppointmentStatus::Confirmed ? $now : null,
        ]);
        $appointment->save();

        // 7) Riwayat status pertama (from_status NULL).
        AppointmentStatusHistory::query()->create([
            'appointment_id' => $appointment->getKey(),
            'from_status' => null,
            'to_status' => $status,
            'actor_type' => $actor->type,
            'actor_user_id' => $actor->userId,
            'reason' => $actor->isPatient() && $status === AppointmentStatus::Confirmed ? 'Konfirmasi otomatis' : null,
        ]);

        // 8) Audit tanpa nama, telepon, nomor BPJS/polis, dan keluhan (F6-R35).
        $this->audit->log(
            'appointment.created',
            $appointment,
            null,
            [
                'booking_code' => $code,
                'queue_number' => $queueNumber,
                'status' => $status->value,
                'channel' => $channel->value,
                'payment_type' => $data->paymentType->value,
            ],
            "Pendaftaran {$code} dibuat ({$channel->label()}).",
            $actor,
        );

        // 9) "Simpan nomor BPJS ke profil saya" (hook `saving` model mengisi bpjs_number_last4).
        if ($data->saveBpjs && $data->paymentType === PaymentType::Bpjs && $data->paymentReference !== null) {
            $locked->bpjs_number = $data->paymentReference;
            $locked->save();

            // R-a: perubahan profil harus tercatat. AuditLogger meredaksi bpjs_number otomatis; last4 turunan dibuang.
            $diff = $this->audit->diff($locked);
            $old = array_diff_key($diff['old'], ['bpjs_number_last4' => true]);
            $new = array_diff_key($diff['new'], ['bpjs_number_last4' => true]);

            if ($new !== []) {
                $this->audit->log(
                    'patient.updated',
                    $locked,
                    $old,
                    $new,
                    'Profil pasien '.($locked->patient_number ?? '-').' diperbarui (nomor BPJS disimpan dari pendaftaran).',
                    $actor,
                );
            }
        }

        // 10) Notifikasi dijadwalkan sesudah commit (dan hanya bila profil punya akun).
        $this->notifier->statusChanged($appointment, null, $status);

        return $appointment;
    }

    /**
     * Kode booking yang belum dipakai, diperiksa di bawah kunci. Tabrakan yang lolos (balapan antar-sesi) tetap
     * ditangkap UNIQUE dan diulang oleh loop luar.
     */
    private function uniqueCode(): string
    {
        for ($attempt = 0; $attempt < self::CODE_ATTEMPTS; $attempt++) {
            $code = BookingCodeGenerator::generate();

            if (! Appointment::query()->where('booking_code', $code)->exists()) {
                return $code;
            }
        }

        throw BookingException::make(BookingException::SYSTEM_BUSY);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ pelaku

    /**
     * Pemeriksaan tanpa DB: pelaku sistem tidak membuat pendaftaran; pasien hanya untuk profilnya sendiri.
     */
    private function assertActorMayBook(PatientProfile $profile, Actor $actor): void
    {
        if ($actor->isSystem()) {
            throw new LogicException('Pendaftaran tidak dapat dibuat oleh pelaku sistem.');
        }

        if ($actor->isPatient() && ($profile->user_id === null || (int) $profile->user_id !== $actor->userId)) {
            throw new AuthorizationException('Pasien hanya dapat mendaftarkan dirinya sendiri.');
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ penerjemahan galat driver

    private function isRetryableUniqueViolation(UniqueConstraintViolationException $e): bool
    {
        return in_array($this->violatedIndex($e), [self::INDEX_BOOKING_CODE, self::INDEX_QUEUE_NUMBER], true);
    }

    /**
     * Mengubah galat DB menjadi BookingException; mengembalikan galat aslinya bila bukan kasus yang dikenal
     * (galat sistem 500 yang tercatat).
     */
    private function translate(QueryException|DeadlockException $e, Actor $actor): Throwable
    {
        if ($e instanceof UniqueConstraintViolationException) {
            $index = $this->violatedIndex($e);

            if ($index === self::INDEX_ACTIVE_DUPLICATE) {
                return BookingException::make(
                    BookingException::DUPLICATE_BOOKING,
                    ['subjek' => $actor->isStaff() ? 'pasien ini' : 'Anda'],
                    previous: $e,
                );
            }

            if ($index === self::INDEX_BOOKING_CODE || $index === self::INDEX_QUEUE_NUMBER) {
                // Tabrakan berulang tidak seharusnya terjadi: catat dan minta pengguna mencoba lagi.
                report($e);

                return BookingException::make(BookingException::SYSTEM_BUSY, previous: $e);
            }

            return $e;
        }

        if ($e instanceof QueryException && $this->isQuotaCheckViolation($e)) {
            return BookingException::make(BookingException::QUOTA_FULL, previous: $e);
        }

        if ($this->isConcurrencyFailure($e)) {
            report($e);

            return BookingException::make(BookingException::SYSTEM_BUSY, previous: $e);
        }

        return $e;
    }

    /**
     * Nama indeks dari pesan driver: MariaDB `for key 'nama'`, MySQL 8 `for key 'tabel.nama'`. Memakai
     * `errorInfo[2]` (pesan driver tanpa SQL dan bindings).
     */
    private function violatedIndex(QueryException $e): string
    {
        $message = (string) ($e->errorInfo[2] ?? $e->getMessage());

        if (preg_match("/for key '([^']+)'\s*$/", $message, $matches) !== 1) {
            return '';
        }

        $key = $matches[1];
        $dot = strrpos($key, '.');

        return $dot === false ? $key : substr($key, $dot + 1);
    }

    /**
     * CHECK `chk_sessions_quota` (bukan `chk_sessions_quota_range`): nama dengan tanda kutip penutup agar
     * awalan yang sama tidak cocok.
     */
    private function isQuotaCheckViolation(QueryException $e): bool
    {
        if (! in_array((int) ($e->errorInfo[1] ?? 0), self::CHECK_ERRORS, true)) {
            return false;
        }

        $message = (string) ($e->errorInfo[2] ?? $e->getMessage());

        return str_contains($message, '`'.self::CONSTRAINT_QUOTA.'`')
            || str_contains($message, "'".self::CONSTRAINT_QUOTA."'");
    }

    /**
     * Deadlock/lock wait yang tersisa sesudah 3 percobaan. Di dalam transaksi pembungkus (tes dengan
     * RefreshDatabase) Laravel melempar DeadlockException tanpa mengulang.
     */
    private function isConcurrencyFailure(QueryException|DeadlockException $e): bool
    {
        if ($e instanceof DeadlockException) {
            return true;
        }

        if (in_array((int) ($e->errorInfo[1] ?? 0), self::CONCURRENCY_ERRORS, true)) {
            return true;
        }

        return app(ConcurrencyErrorDetector::class)->causedByConcurrencyError($e);
    }
}
```

#### Catatan penulis (konteks untuk implementer dan reviewer)

1. **Tes yang dipindahkan ke Task 6 (konkurensi).** Tidak ada di tugas ini, karena butuh transaksi terluar nyata atau koneksi lain: (a) pengulangan `DB::transaction(..., 3)` yang sebenarnya pada deadlock/lock wait; (b) `SYSTEM_BUSY` karena lock wait (BKG-21: kunci baris sesi ditahan `RawPdoConnection` dengan `innodb_lock_wait_timeout = 1`, hasil: `BookingException` `SYSTEM_BUSY`, tanpa baris parsial, `precheck()` tetap tidak mengunci/tidak menulis, sesudah kunci dilepas booking yang sama berhasil); (c) pemetaan galat konkurensi `QueryException` errno 1205/1213 dan `DeadlockException` (di bawah `RefreshDatabase` Laravel melempar `DeadlockException` tanpa mengulang; service memetakan keduanya ke `SYSTEM_BUSY`, tetapi pemicunya hanya nyata lewat koneksi kedua); (d) KON-03: DUPLICATE_BOOKING hasil lapis DB pada balapan nyata (lihat butir 2). Yang TETAP di tugas ini walau menghasilkan `SYSTEM_BUSY`: tabrakan UNIQUE `booking_code` berulang melewati `UNIQUE_ROUNDS` (tidak melibatkan lock wait dan dapat diuji dengan savepoint).
2. **`DUPLICATE_BOOKING` dari lapis DB tidak membawa `context['appointment_code']`.** Aturan F.5 #5 (Task 2) menyertakannya pada jalur normal; bila yang menolak adalah UNIQUE `active_flag` (balapan yang lolos), baris pemenang milik transaksi lain dan tidak dicari ulang. `BookingRedirect` (Task 7) sudah memperlakukan ketiadaan kode itu seperti `QUOTA_FULL` (F6-R10).
3. **Tambahan di luar kerangka:** `assertActorMayBook()` (pelaku `system` -> `LogicException`; pasien untuk profil orang lain -> `AuthorizationException`), sebagai pertahanan berlapis di bawah Policy (11 §6.2 memuatnya sebagai langkah 0). Pemanggil sah (controller Task 8 dengan `Actor::patient($request->user())` dan profil milik akun itu) tidak pernah memicunya.
4. **Simpan nomor BPJS ke profil menulis audit `patient.updated` (R-a).** F6-R13 butir 9 meminta pembaruan `patient_profiles.bpjs_number` (hook `saving` mengisi `bpjs_number_last4`); karena perubahan profil harus tercatat, `book()` memanggil `AuditLogger::diff()` lalu `log('patient.updated', ...)` dengan `bpjs_number_last4` (turunan) dibuang dari `old`/`new` dan `bpjs_number` disamarkan otomatis oleh `AuditLogger`. Audit hanya ditulis bila `save_bpjs` aktif pada pembayaran BPJS; tes `test_save_bpjs_updates_the_profile_number_only_when_requested_for_a_bpjs_booking` mengunci tepat satu baris `patient.updated` tanpa nomor BPJS.
5. **Asumsi atas Task 2 (dikunci tes Task 4):** `context['appointment_code']` pada `DUPLICATE_BOOKING` dan placeholder `subjek` pada pesan `DUPLICATE_BOOKING` (`test_the_duplicate_message_names_the_subject_by_channel`); asumsi atas Task 1: `errors.PROFILE_INACTIVE` = "Profil pasien tidak aktif atau tidak ditemukan." dan nama argumen bernama `BookingData`.
6. **Kontrak untuk Task 5.** `AppointmentStatusService` memakai pola yang sama: kunci profil -> sesi -> appointment lewat PK, pembacaan pengaturan sebelum transaksi, satu panggilan `AppointmentNotifier::statusChanged()` di dalam closure transaksi, dan penerjemahan galat konkurensi yang sama bila diperlukan. Kode `BookingService::violatedIndex()` dan `isConcurrencyFailure()` sengaja `private` (tidak dibagikan antar-tugas); Task 5 menulis pemeriksaan sendiri bila membutuhkannya.
7. **Kontrak untuk Task 6.** Tes konkurensi memanggil `book($profile, $sessionId, $data, $actor)` tanpa `RefreshDatabase` pembungkus; pada keadaan itu `DB::transaction(..., 3)` mengulang nyata, `BookingService::TRANSACTION_ATTEMPTS` dan `UNIQUE_ROUNDS` bernilai 3. Proses anak KON-02 harus membaca `booking.*` dari DB uji (`SettingsSeeder` dijalankan tes induk sebelum proses anak dimulai).

### Task 5: `AppointmentStatusService::transition()` (tabel F.8 T4-T10, satu jalur tulis status)

**Files:**
- Create: `app/Services/Booking/AppointmentStatusService.php`
- Test (baru): `tests/Feature/Booking/AppointmentStatusServiceTest.php`
- Tidak diubah: migration, enum (`AppointmentStatus`, `ActorType` sudah memuat semua nilai), izin (19), `AuditLogger`, `SettingsService`, `Appointment`, `AppointmentStatusHistory`, `PracticeSession`, `lang/id/booking.php` (milik T1), `AppointmentNotifier` (milik T3), `BookingService` (milik T4).

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - T1: `App\Exceptions\BookingException::make(string $errorCode, array $replace = [], array $context = [], ?Throwable $previous = null): static`, konstanta `BookingException::SYSTEM_BUSY`; `App\Exceptions\InvalidTransitionException` (final, 12 kode; konstruktor publik `__construct(string $errorCode, string $message, array $context = [], ?Throwable $previous = null)`, properti `errorCode`, `context`); `lang/id/booking.php` grup `transitions` (12 kode + `CANCEL_CHECKED_IN`) dengan placeholder `:dari`, `:ke`, `:status`, `:minutes`, `:phone`, `:date`, `:time`; state factory yang ada (`AppointmentFactory::status()`).
  - T3: `App\Services\Booking\AppointmentNotifier::statusChanged(Appointment $appointment, ?AppointmentStatus $from, AppointmentStatus $to, ?string $reason = null): void` (membungkus `DB::afterCommit` + `try/catch`), `App\Notifications\AppointmentStatusChangedNotification` (properti publik `appointment`, `from`, `to`, `reason`; `via()` K-13).
  - Fase 3: `Appointment` (`$fillable` tanpa kolom status; `forceFill()`), `AppointmentStatusHistory::create()` (fillable lengkap), `PracticeSession::$starts_at`/`$ends_at` (`CarbonImmutable`), `SettingsService::bookingRules()` (`cancelCutoffMinutes`, `checkinOpenMinutes`) dan `SettingsService::string('contact.phone')`, `AuditLogger::log()`, `App\Support\Actor` (`type`, `userId`, `isPatient()/isStaff()/isSystem()`), trait tes `InteractsWithSchedules::createSession()/bookAppointment()`.
- Produces:
  - `final class App\Services\Booking\AppointmentStatusService` dengan konstruktor `(AuditLogger $audit, SettingsService $settings, AppointmentNotifier $notifier)` dan satu metode publik `transition(Appointment $appointment, AppointmentStatus $to, Actor $actor, ?string $reason = null, ?AppointmentStatus $expected = null): Appointment`.
  - Konstanta publik `TRANSITIONS` (peta dari-ke) dan `RULES` (tabel F.8 T4-T10 sebagai data: pelaku, jendela waktu, pelaku yang wajib beralasan), `REASON_MIN_LENGTH = 5`, `REASON_MAX_LENGTH = 255`. T7-T9 memakai `transition()` untuk pembatalan pasien; fase 7 memakai tabel yang sama untuk aksi staf (UI) tanpa mengubahnya.
  - Perilaku yang dijanjikan ke tugas lain (T6 mengunci sebagian lewat proses paralel): kunci `patient_profiles` → `practice_sessions` → `appointments` hanya lewat PK dan tanpa kueri lain sebelum ketiganya; galat konkurensi yang lolos `attempts: 3` diterjemahkan menjadi `BookingException` `SYSTEM_BUSY`; `InvalidTransitionException` dilempar tanpa menulis apa pun.

**Test IDs:** BKG-11 (batas pembatalan pasien), BKG-12 (matriks transisi F.8 dan ke-12 kode), BKG-13 (dampak kuota per status; pembatalan ulang), BKG-10 (pembatalan melepas kuota, antrean tidak dipakai ulang; sisi service), BKG-14/BKG-19/BKG-16 (kode `CHECKIN_*`, `CORRECTION_NOT_SAME_DAY`, `REASON_REQUIRED`, `SESSION_NOT_ENDED` terpicu di sisi service; UI dan perintah artisan = fase 7), NTF-01, NTF-03 (walk-in tanpa akun), NTF-07 (kanal K-13 per transisi), SEK-11 (tidak ada nomor BPJS/keluhan di audit), SEK-15 (keluhan `<script>` tidak masuk notifikasi dan audit), F6-R15, F6-R35, K-13, Review Focus E.2 (batal tepat `start-120` diterima, `start-119` ditolak; sesi hari ini sudah berakhir tidak dihitung aktif), E.5 (data sensitif di notifikasi/audit).

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
1. **Tabel F.8 sebagai data.** Digest-rules §5 (00 F.8, 06 §8.2) dan 11 §6.3: `TRANSITIONS` (`pending` → confirmed, checked_in, cancelled, no_show; `confirmed` → checked_in, cancelled, no_show; `checked_in` → completed, confirmed; tiga status final tanpa keluar) dan `RULES` per pasangan `"dari>ke"`: `pending>confirmed` (T4, staf, jendela `before_end`), `pending>checked_in` dan `confirmed>checked_in` (T5, staf, `checkin_window`), `checked_in>completed` (T6, staf, tanpa jendela), `checked_in>confirmed` (T7, staf, `same_day`, alasan wajib), `pending>cancelled` dan `confirmed>cancelled` (T8 pasien pemilik dengan `cancel_rule`; T9 staf/sistem kapan saja sebelum check-in; alasan wajib untuk staf dan sistem), `pending>no_show` dan `confirmed>no_show` (T10, staf atau sistem, `after_end`). T1-T3 (pembuatan) milik `BookingService`, bukan tugas ini.
2. **Urutan pemeriksaan (diputuskan di sini, dikunci tes; semuanya di bawah kunci, sebelum penulisan apa pun).** (a) pasien bukan pemilik profil → `FORBIDDEN_TRANSITION`; (b) `expected` ≠ status terkunci → `STALE_STATUS`; (c) status terkunci final → `ALREADY_FINAL`; (d) pelaku tidak boleh menuju status itu (pasien hanya `cancelled`; sistem hanya `cancelled` dan `no_show`; staf bebas) → `FORBIDDEN_TRANSITION`; (e) pasangan tidak ada di `TRANSITIONS` → `INVALID_TRANSITION` (pasien yang membatalkan `checked_in` mendapat pesan khusus BR-79, kode tetap `INVALID_TRANSITION`); (f) alasan wajib (5-255 karakter setelah `trim`) bagi staf/sistem pada pembatalan dan staf pada koreksi → `REASON_REQUIRED`; (g) jendela waktu pasangan itu. Hasilnya: pasien non-pemilik tidak pernah mendapat petunjuk status; status final selalu `ALREADY_FINAL` walau pelaku salah.
3. **Jendela waktu** (waktu = `now()` aplikasi, `Asia/Jakarta`; dibaca di dalam transaksi): `before_end` = `now < ends_at` (tepat `ends_at` ditolak `CONFIRM_AFTER_END`); `checkin_window` = `session_date` hari ini (`CHECKIN_NOT_TODAY`, pesan memuat tanggal) lalu `now >= starts_at - checkin_open_minutes` (`CHECKIN_NOT_OPEN`, pesan memuat jam buka `H.i`) lalu `now <= ends_at` (`CHECKIN_CLOSED`; tepat `ends_at` masih diterima); `same_day` = `session_date` hari ini (`CORRECTION_NOT_SAME_DAY`); `cancel_rule` hanya untuk pasien: `now <= starts_at - cancel_cutoff_minutes` (INKLUSIF; `CANCEL_CUTOFF_PASSED` dengan `:minutes` dan `:phone` = `contact.phone`); `after_end` = `now > ends_at` (tepat `ends_at` ditolak `SESSION_NOT_ENDED`, pesan memuat jam akhir). `$session->starts_at`/`ends_at` adalah accessor `CarbonImmutable` (tanpa cache objek) pada `PracticeSession`; `travelTo()` membekukan `now()` sehingga batas tepat dapat diuji.
4. **Efek** (satu jalur tulis): `forceFill()` kolom status; `Confirmed` (dari `pending`) mengisi `confirmed_at`; koreksi `checked_in → confirmed` mengosongkan `checked_in_at` dan mempertahankan `confirmed_at` (keputusan: invarian I-14 `confirmed` mensyaratkan `confirmed_at`, yang sudah terisi sejak check-in); `CheckedIn` mengisi `checked_in_at` dan `confirmed_at ??= now`; `Completed` mengisi `completed_at`; `Cancelled` mengisi `cancelled_at`, `cancelled_by_type`, `cancelled_by_user_id`, `cancel_reason` dan menurunkan `booked_count` (`max(0, n-1)`; `last_queue_number` tidak pernah turun, BR-77); `NoShow` mengisi `no_show_at`. Lalu satu baris `appointment_status_histories`, audit `appointment.status_changed` (old `status`; new `status` + `reason` bila ada; deskripsi "Status pendaftaran :code berubah dari :label ke :label."), lalu `AppointmentNotifier::statusChanged()` (afterCommit di dalam notifier). Urutan penulisan (appointment → sesi → riwayat → audit → notifikasi) dipilih agar tes atomisitas yang menggagalkan INSERT riwayat atau audit membuktikan rollback dari pembatalan yang sudah menurunkan kuota.
5. **Tidak ada pemeriksaan izin Spatie di service.** Digest data 11 §6.3 menyebut `can('appointments.manage')`, tetapi kerangka F6-R15/F6-R16 menaruh otorisasi di Policy/Form Request (`AppointmentPolicy::transition`, fase 7) dan pelaku diperiksa menurut JENIS (`ActorType`) dan kepemilikan. Service hanya menegakkan aturan domain; ini juga membuat tes tidak perlu menyemai peran (tabel `roles` tetap kosong) dan tes konkurensi T6 tidak meninggalkan baris peran di DB uji.
6. **Galat konkurensi.** `DB::transaction($callback, 3)`; bila `QueryException` yang lolos terdeteksi `Illuminate\Contracts\Database\ConcurrencyErrorDetector` (singleton framework yang sama dengan penghitung retry `DB::transaction`), diterjemahkan menjadi `BookingException::make(BookingException::SYSTEM_BUSY)` (pesan "Sistem sedang sibuk, silakan coba lagi beberapa saat."); pembuktian pengulangan dan batas 3 percobaan ada di T6 (`TransitionConcurrencyTest`) karena di dalam `RefreshDatabase` transaksi bersarang tidak mengulang (`DeadlockException` dilempar ke luar). Galat lain dilempar ulang apa adanya.
7. **Instance pemanggil.** Setelah commit, atribut instance `$appointment` yang diberikan pemanggil disinkronkan dari baris terkunci (`setRawAttributes($locked->getRawOriginal(), true)`, termasuk kolom generated `active_flag` karena baris dimuat ulang dengan `refresh()` sebelum disinkronkan) dan relasi yang sudah dimuat service (`practiceSession` dengan pencacah terbaru, `patientProfile.user`, `clinic`, `doctor`) dipasang ke instance itu; nilai kembalian = instance yang sama. Eager load wajib karena mode ketat melarang lazy loading koleksi dan notifier tidak boleh memicu kueri tambahan.
8. **Placeholder pesan** diisi dengan `label()` enum (`:dari`, `:ke`, `:status`), jumlah menit (`:minutes`), `contact.phone` (`:phone`), `translatedFormat('l, j F Y')` (`:date`), `format('H.i')` (`:time`). Tes mengunci isi pesan lewat potongan stabil (angka menit, nomor telepon seed `(021) 0000-0000`, jam `08.00`/`12.00`, tanggal yang dihitung dengan cara yang sama) kecuali BR-79 yang dikunci verbatim.
9. **Kanal notifikasi (K-13).** Tes memakai `Notification::fake()` dan memeriksa `$channels` hasil `via()`: `confirmed` dan `cancelled` = `['database', 'mail']`; `checked_in`, `completed`, `no_show` = `['database']`. Koreksi `checked_in → confirmed` dikunci persis `['database']` (tabel peristiwa 06 §18; pengecualian `$from === CheckedIn` pada `via()` ada di T3, R-b).
10. **Cakupan di luar tugas ini:** metode massal (`markNoShow*`, `cancelAllForSession`, `availableTransitions`), `STALE_STATUS` lewat form (fase 7), tes proses paralel dan `SYSTEM_BUSY` nyata (T6), pemanggilan dari controller (T9). DB pengembangan tidak disentuh.
11. Jumlah tes baru ±183 (matriks BKG-12 = 108 kasus dari provider 6 × 6 × 3).

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Booking;

use App\Enums\ActorType;
use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Enums\PaymentType;
use App\Exceptions\BookingException;
use App\Exceptions\InvalidTransitionException;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\AppointmentStatusHistory;
use App\Models\AuditLog;
use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\AppointmentStatusChangedNotification;
use App\Services\Booking\AppointmentStatusService;
use App\Services\Settings\SettingsService;
use App\Support\Actor;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Database\Seeders\SettingsSeeder;
use Illuminate\Database\QueryException;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;
use PDOException;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * F6-R15, tabel F.8 T4-T10 (BKG-10..BKG-13, NTF-01/03/07). Waktu dibekukan dengan travelTo():
 * "sekarang" awal = Senin 2026-10-05 08.00 WIB; sesi uji = Selasa 2026-10-06 09.00-12.00, kuota 20 (cukup untuk 12 appointment pada tes ke-12 kode),
 * sehingga batas pembatalan pasien (120 menit) = 07.00, jendela check-in dibuka 08.00 dan ditutup 12.00.
 * Transaksi tes membungkus service (savepoint): pembuktian pengulangan/SYSTEM_BUSY nyata ada di T6.
 */
class AppointmentStatusServiceTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    /** Ke-12 kode InvalidTransitionException (00 F.5). */
    private const ALL_CODES = [
        'INVALID_TRANSITION', 'ALREADY_FINAL', 'FORBIDDEN_TRANSITION', 'STALE_STATUS', 'CANCEL_CUTOFF_PASSED',
        'CONFIRM_AFTER_END', 'CHECKIN_NOT_TODAY', 'CHECKIN_NOT_OPEN', 'CHECKIN_CLOSED', 'CORRECTION_NOT_SAME_DAY',
        'SESSION_NOT_ENDED', 'REASON_REQUIRED',
    ];

    private const BR79 = 'Pendaftaran yang sudah check-in tidak dapat dibatalkan. Silakan hubungi petugas pendaftaran.';

    private AppointmentStatusService $service;

    private PracticeSession $session;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->travelTo(CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-05 08:00:00'));
        $this->seed(SettingsSeeder::class);

        $this->service = $this->app->make(AppointmentStatusService::class);
        $this->session = $this->createSession([
            'doctor_schedule_id' => null,
            'session_date' => '2026-10-06',
            'start_time' => '09:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'quota' => 20,
        ]);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ pembantu

    private function at(string $moment): void
    {
        $this->travelTo(CarbonImmutable::parse($moment));
    }

    /**
     * Appointment pada sesi uji (pencacah sesi ikut dijaga lewat InteractsWithSchedules::bookAppointment()).
     * Pasien berakun kecuali $withAccount = false (walk-in).
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     */
    private function appointment(
        AppointmentStatus $status = AppointmentStatus::Confirmed,
        array $overrides = [],
        bool $withAccount = true,
        ?PracticeSession $session = null,
    ): Appointment {
        $profile = $withAccount
            ? PatientProfile::factory()->withAccount()->create()
            : PatientProfile::factory()->create();

        return $this->bookAppointment($session ?? $this->session, $status, $overrides + ['patient_profile_id' => $profile->id]);
    }

    private function ownerOf(Appointment $appointment): Actor
    {
        $userId = PatientProfile::query()->whereKey($appointment->patient_profile_id)->value('user_id');

        return Actor::patient(User::query()->findOrFail($userId));
    }

    private function staff(): Actor
    {
        return Actor::staff(User::factory()->staff()->create());
    }

    private function actorFor(string $kind, Appointment $appointment): Actor
    {
        return match ($kind) {
            'patient' => $this->ownerOf($appointment),
            'staff' => $this->staff(),
            default => Actor::system(),
        };
    }

    private function booked(?PracticeSession $session = null): int
    {
        return (int) PracticeSession::query()->whereKey(($session ?? $this->session)->id)->value('booked_count');
    }

    private function lastQueue(?PracticeSession $session = null): int
    {
        return (int) PracticeSession::query()->whereKey(($session ?? $this->session)->id)->value('last_queue_number');
    }

    private function failure(callable $call): BookingException
    {
        try {
            $call();
        } catch (BookingException $e) {
            return $e;
        }

        $this->fail('BookingException tidak dilempar.');
    }

    private function assertFails(string $code, callable $call): InvalidTransitionException
    {
        $e = $this->failure($call);

        $this->assertInstanceOf(InvalidTransitionException::class, $e);
        $this->assertSame($code, $e->errorCode);

        return $e;
    }

    private function assertHistory(Appointment $appointment, ?AppointmentStatus $from, AppointmentStatus $to, ActorType $actor, ?int $userId, ?string $reason): void
    {
        $rows = AppointmentStatusHistory::query()->where('appointment_id', $appointment->id)->get();

        $this->assertCount(1, $rows);
        $this->assertSame($from, $rows[0]->from_status);
        $this->assertSame($to, $rows[0]->to_status);
        $this->assertSame($actor, $rows[0]->actor_type);
        $this->assertSame($userId, $rows[0]->actor_user_id === null ? null : (int) $rows[0]->actor_user_id);
        $this->assertSame($reason, $rows[0]->reason);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ transisi sah dan kolom waktunya (BKG-12)

    public function test_t4_staff_confirms_a_pending_appointment_before_the_session_ends(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Pending);
        $staff = User::factory()->staff()->create();
        $this->at('2026-10-05 09:30:00');

        $result = $this->service->transition($appointment, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, Actor::staff($staff));

        $fresh = $appointment->fresh();
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $fresh->status);
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-05 09:30:00', $fresh->confirmed_at->toDateTimeString());
        $this->assertNull($fresh->checked_in_at);
        $this->assertNull($fresh->completed_at);
        $this->assertNull($fresh->cancelled_at);
        $this->assertNull($fresh->no_show_at);
        $this->assertSame(1, $fresh->active_flag);
        $this->assertSame(1, $this->booked());
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $result->status);
        $this->assertHistory($appointment, AppointmentStatus::Pending, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, ActorType::Staff, $staff->id, null);
    }

    public function test_t5_staff_checks_in_a_confirmed_appointment_and_keeps_confirmed_at(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $this->at('2026-10-06 08:30:00');

        $this->service->transition($appointment, AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, $this->staff());

        $fresh = $appointment->fresh();
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, $fresh->status);
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-06 08:30:00', $fresh->checked_in_at->toDateTimeString());
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-05 08:00:00', $fresh->confirmed_at->toDateTimeString());
        $this->assertNull($fresh->completed_at);
        $this->assertSame(1, $this->booked());
    }

    public function test_t5_checking_in_a_pending_appointment_also_fills_confirmed_at(): void
    {

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ matriks lengkap (BKG-12)

    /** @return \Generator<string, array{0: string, 1: string, 2: string}> */
    public static function matrix(): \Generator
    {
        foreach (['patient', 'staff', 'system'] as $actor) {
            foreach (AppointmentStatus::cases() as $from) {
                foreach (AppointmentStatus::cases() as $to) {
                    yield "{$actor}: {$from->value} -> {$to->value}" => [$from->value, $to->value, $actor];
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /** Oracle tabel F.8 yang ditulis tangan, sengaja TIDAK memakai konstanta service. */
    private static function expectedOutcome(string $from, string $to, string $actor): string
    {
        if (in_array($from, ['completed', 'cancelled', 'no_show'], true)) {
            return 'ALREADY_FINAL';
        }

        $targets = ['patient' => ['cancelled'], 'system' => ['cancelled', 'no_show']];

        if ($actor !== 'staff' && ! in_array($to, $targets[$actor], true)) {
            return 'FORBIDDEN_TRANSITION';
        }

        $legal = [
            'pending' => ['confirmed', 'checked_in', 'cancelled', 'no_show'],
            'confirmed' => ['checked_in', 'cancelled', 'no_show'],
            'checked_in' => ['completed', 'confirmed'],
        ];

        return in_array($to, $legal[$from], true) ? 'ok' : 'INVALID_TRANSITION';
    }

    /** Saat yang memenuhi jendela waktu pasangan itu (agar yang diuji hanya struktur tabel). */
    private static function matrixMoment(string $from, string $to): string
    {
        return match (true) {
            $to === 'cancelled' => '2026-10-05 08:00:00',
            $to === 'no_show' => '2026-10-06 12:30:00',
            $to === 'confirmed' && $from === 'pending' => '2026-10-05 08:00:00',
            default => '2026-10-06 10:00:00',
        };
    }

    #[DataProvider('matrix')]
    public function test_bkg_12_every_from_to_actor_pair_follows_table_f8(string $from, string $to, string $kind): void
    {
        $fromStatus = AppointmentStatus::from($from);
        $toStatus = AppointmentStatus::from($to);
        $appointment = $this->appointment($fromStatus);
        $actor = $this->actorFor($kind, $appointment);
        $bookedBefore = $this->booked();
        $this->at(self::matrixMoment($from, $to));

        $expected = self::expectedOutcome($from, $to, $kind);

        if ($expected === 'ok') {
            $this->service->transition($appointment, $toStatus, $actor, 'Alasan uji matriks');

            $this->assertSame($toStatus, $appointment->fresh()->status);
            $this->assertSame($toStatus === AppointmentStatus::Cancelled ? $bookedBefore - 1 : $bookedBefore, $this->booked());

            return;
        }

        $this->assertFails($expected, fn () => $this->service->transition($appointment, $toStatus, $actor, 'Alasan uji matriks'));

        $this->assertSame($fromStatus, $appointment->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame($bookedBefore, $this->booked());
        $this->assertSame(0, AppointmentStatusHistory::query()->count());
    }

    public function test_t8_patient_cancel_deadline_is_inclusive_at_start_minus_120_and_exclusive_one_minute_later(): void
    {
        $onTime = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $late = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $oneSecondLate = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);

        $this->at('2026-10-06 07:00:00');
        $this->service->transition($onTime, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, $this->ownerOf($onTime), 'Berhalangan hadir');
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, $onTime->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame(2, $this->booked());

        $this->at('2026-10-06 07:00:01');
        $this->assertFails('CANCEL_CUTOFF_PASSED', fn () => $this->service->transition($oneSecondLate, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, $this->ownerOf($oneSecondLate)));

        $this->at('2026-10-06 07:01:00');
        $e = $this->assertFails('CANCEL_CUTOFF_PASSED', fn () => $this->service->transition($late, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, $this->ownerOf($late), 'Terlambat'));

        $this->assertStringContainsString('120', $e->getMessage());
        $this->assertStringContainsString('(021) 0000-0000', $e->getMessage());
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $late->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertNull($late->fresh()->cancelled_at);
        $this->assertSame(2, $this->booked());
        $this->assertSame(1, AppointmentStatusHistory::query()->count());
    }

    public function test_the_patient_cancel_deadline_follows_the_booking_setting(): void
    {
        $this->app->make(SettingsService::class)->setMany(['booking.cancel_cutoff_minutes' => 60]);
        $this->app->make(SettingsService::class)->forget();
        $service = $this->app->make(AppointmentStatusService::class);

        $ok = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Pending);
        $late = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Pending);

        $this->at('2026-10-06 07:59:00');
        $service->transition($ok, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, $this->ownerOf($ok));
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, $ok->fresh()->status);

        $this->at('2026-10-06 08:01:00');
        $e = $this->assertFails('CANCEL_CUTOFF_PASSED', fn () => $service->transition($late, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, $this->ownerOf($late)));
        $this->assertStringContainsString('60', $e->getMessage());
    }

    public function test_t5_check_in_window_opens_at_start_minus_60_and_closes_at_the_exact_end(): void
    {
        $opening = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $closing = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $tooEarly = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $tooLate = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $wrongDay = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);

        $this->at('2026-10-06 07:59:00');
        $e = $this->assertFails('CHECKIN_NOT_OPEN', fn () => $this->service->transition($tooEarly, AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, $this->staff()));
        $this->assertStringContainsString('08.00', $e->getMessage());

        $this->at('2026-10-06 08:00:00');
        $this->service->transition($opening, AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, $this->staff());
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, $opening->fresh()->status);

        $this->at('2026-10-06 12:00:00');
        $this->service->transition($closing, AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, $this->staff());
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, $closing->fresh()->status);

        $this->at('2026-10-06 12:00:01');
        $this->assertFails('CHECKIN_CLOSED', fn () => $this->service->transition($tooLate, AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, $this->staff()));

        $this->at('2026-10-05 10:00:00');
        $e = $this->assertFails('CHECKIN_NOT_TODAY', fn () => $this->service->transition($wrongDay, AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, $this->staff()));
        $this->assertStringContainsString($this->session->session_date->translatedFormat('l, j F Y'), $e->getMessage());

        $this->at('2026-10-07 10:00:00');
        $this->assertFails('CHECKIN_NOT_TODAY', fn () => $this->service->transition($wrongDay, AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, $this->staff()));

        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $tooEarly->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $tooLate->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $wrongDay->fresh()->status);
    }

    public function test_a_change_made_by_someone_else_after_the_page_was_loaded_is_stale_with_expected_and_final_without_it(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ kuota dan antrean (BKG-10, BKG-13)

    public function test_cancelling_releases_one_seat_but_never_lowers_the_last_queue_number(): void
    {
        $first = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Pending);
        $this->assertSame(2, $this->booked());
        $this->assertSame(2, $this->lastQueue());

        $this->service->transition($first, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, $this->ownerOf($first));

        $this->assertSame(1, $this->booked());
        $this->assertSame(2, $this->lastQueue());

        $third = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Pending);
        $this->assertSame(3, $third->queue_number);
        $this->assertSame(2, $this->booked());
        $this->assertSame(3, $this->lastQueue());
    }

    public function test_bkg_13_only_cancelling_changes_booked_count_and_a_second_cancel_is_rejected(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Pending);
        $this->assertSame(1, $this->booked());

        $this->at('2026-10-05 08:00:00');
        $this->service->transition($appointment, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $this->staff());
        $this->assertSame(1, $this->booked());

        $this->at('2026-10-06 09:00:00');
        $this->service->transition($appointment, AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, $this->staff());
        $this->assertSame(1, $this->booked());

        $this->service->transition($appointment, AppointmentStatus::Completed, $this->staff());
        $this->assertSame(1, $this->booked());
        $this->assertSame(1, $this->lastQueue());

        $other = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $this->service->transition($other, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, $this->staff(), 'Pasien menelepon');
        $this->assertSame(1, $this->booked());

        $this->assertFails('ALREADY_FINAL', fn () => $this->service->transition($other, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, $this->staff(), 'Pasien menelepon lagi'));
        $this->assertSame(1, $this->booked());
        $this->assertSame(2, $this->lastQueue());
    }

    public function test_the_audit_row_records_the_status_change_without_personal_data(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, [
            'payment_type' => PaymentType::Bpjs,
            'payment_reference' => '0009900000011',
            'complaint' => '<script>alert(1)</script> nyeri dada rahasia',
        ]);
        $owner = $this->ownerOf($appointment);

        $this->service->transition($appointment, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, $owner, 'Berhalangan hadir');

        $log = AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'appointment.status_changed')->sole();

        $this->assertSame($appointment->getMorphClass(), $log->auditable_type);
        $this->assertSame($appointment->id, (int) $log->auditable_id);
        $this->assertSame(ActorType::Patient, $log->actor_type);
        $this->assertSame($owner->userId, (int) $log->user_id);
        $this->assertSame(['status' => 'confirmed'], $log->old_values);
        $this->assertSame(['status' => 'cancelled', 'reason' => 'Berhalangan hadir'], $log->new_values);
        $this->assertStringContainsString($appointment->booking_code, $log->description);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Dikonfirmasi', $log->description);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Dibatalkan', $log->description);

        $stored = json_encode([$log->old_values, $log->new_values, $log->description]);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('0009900000011', $stored);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('rahasia', $stored);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('script', $stored);
    }

        $this->assertSame(['status' => 'confirmed'], $log->new_values);
    }

    /** @return array<string, array{0: AppointmentStatus, 1: AppointmentStatus, 2: string, 3: list<string>}> */
```
