```php
    /** @param list<string> $channels */
    #[DataProvider('notificationChannels')]
    public function test_ntf_07_database_for_every_transition_and_mail_only_for_confirmed_and_cancelled(AppointmentStatus $from, AppointmentStatus $to, string $kind, array $channels): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointment($from);
        $recipient = User::query()->findOrFail(PatientProfile::query()->whereKey($appointment->patient_profile_id)->value('user_id'));
        $actor = $this->actorFor($kind, $appointment);
        $this->at(self::matrixMoment($from->value, $to->value));
        Notification::fake();

        $this->service->transition($appointment, $to, $actor, 'Alasan uji notifikasi');

        Notification::assertSentToTimes($recipient, AppointmentStatusChangedNotification::class, 1);
        Notification::assertSentTo(
            $recipient,
            AppointmentStatusChangedNotification::class,
            fn (AppointmentStatusChangedNotification $notification, array $actual): bool => $actual === $channels
                && $notification->appointment->is($appointment)
                && $notification->from === $from
                && $notification->to === $to,
        );
    }

    /** @return array<string, array{0: string}> */
    public static function writeFaultPoints(): array
    {
        return [
            'insert riwayat' => ['insert into `appointment_status_histories`'],
            'insert audit' => ['insert into `audit_logs`'],
        ];

    #[DataProvider('writeFaultPoints')]
    public function test_a_failure_after_the_cancel_has_released_the_seat_rolls_back_every_effect(string $fragment): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $owner = $this->ownerOf($appointment);
        Notification::fake();

        DB::connection()->beforeExecuting(function (string $query, array $bindings) use ($fragment): void {
            if (str_contains(strtolower($query), $fragment)) {
                throw new QueryException('mariadb', $query, $bindings, new PDOException('Simulasi galat penulisan'));
            }
        });

        try {
            $this->service->transition($appointment, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, $owner, 'Berhalangan hadir');
            $this->fail('QueryException tidak dilempar.');
        } catch (QueryException $e) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString('Simulasi galat penulisan', $e->getMessage());
        }

        $fresh = Appointment::query()->findOrFail($appointment->id);
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $fresh->status);
        $this->assertNull($fresh->cancelled_at);
        $this->assertNull($fresh->cancel_reason);
        $this->assertSame(1, $fresh->active_flag);
        $this->assertSame(1, $this->booked());
        $this->assertSame(0, AppointmentStatusHistory::query()->count());
        $this->assertSame(0, AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'appointment.status_changed')->count());
        Notification::assertNothingSent();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ urutan kunci (F6-R15, 00 F.6)

    public function test_locks_are_taken_by_primary_key_in_the_order_profile_session_appointment_before_any_other_query(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointment(AppointmentStatus::Pending);
        $owner = $this->ownerOf($appointment);
        $this->at('2026-10-05 08:00:00');

        DB::flushQueryLog();
        DB::enableQueryLog();
        $this->service->transition($appointment, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, $owner, 'Berhalangan hadir');
        $queries = array_column(DB::getQueryLog(), 'query');
        DB::disableQueryLog();

        $lockPositions = array_keys(array_filter($queries, fn (string $query): bool => str_contains($query, 'for update')));

        $this->assertSame([0, 1, 2], array_slice($lockPositions, 0, 3), 'Tiga kueri pertama harus tiga kunci.');
        $this->assertStringContainsString('`patient_profiles`', $queries[0]);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('`practice_sessions`', $queries[1]);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('`appointments`', $queries[2]);

        foreach (array_slice($queries, 0, 3) as $query) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString('`id` = ?', $query, 'Kunci hanya lewat PK.');
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ ke-12 kode terpicu (BKG-12)

    public function test_bkg_12_all_twelve_error_codes_are_raised_at_least_once(): void
    {
        $cases = [
            'INVALID_TRANSITION' => [AppointmentStatus::Pending, AppointmentStatus::Completed, 'staff', '2026-10-06 10:00:00', null, null],
            'ALREADY_FINAL' => [AppointmentStatus::Completed, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, 'staff', '2026-10-06 10:00:00', null, null],
            'FORBIDDEN_TRANSITION' => [AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, 'patient', '2026-10-06 10:00:00', null, null],
            'STALE_STATUS' => [AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, 'staff', '2026-10-06 10:00:00', null, AppointmentStatus::Pending],
            'CANCEL_CUTOFF_PASSED' => [AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, 'patient', '2026-10-06 07:01:00', null, null],
            'CONFIRM_AFTER_END' => [AppointmentStatus::Pending, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, 'staff', '2026-10-06 12:00:00', null, null],
            'CHECKIN_NOT_TODAY' => [AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, 'staff', '2026-10-05 10:00:00', null, null],
            'CHECKIN_NOT_OPEN' => [AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, 'staff', '2026-10-06 07:59:00', null, null],
            'CHECKIN_CLOSED' => [AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, 'staff', '2026-10-06 12:00:01', null, null],
            'CORRECTION_NOT_SAME_DAY' => [AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, 'staff', '2026-10-05 12:00:00', 'Salah check-in', null],
            'SESSION_NOT_ENDED' => [AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, AppointmentStatus::NoShow, 'staff', '2026-10-06 12:00:00', null, null],
            'REASON_REQUIRED' => [AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, 'staff', '2026-10-06 10:00:00', null, null],
        ];

        $raised = [];

        foreach ($cases as $expectedCode => [$from, $to, $kind, $moment, $reason, $expected]) {
            $appointment = $this->appointment($from);
            $actor = $this->actorFor($kind, $appointment);
            $this->at($moment);

            $e = $this->assertFails($expectedCode, fn () => $this->service->transition($appointment, $to, $actor, $reason, $expected));

            $this->assertNotSame('', $e->getMessage());
            $raised[] = $e->errorCode;
        }

        $this->assertEqualsCanonicalizing(self::ALL_CODES, $raised);
        $this->assertSame(0, AppointmentStatusHistory::query()->count());
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Tulis service (tool Write) `app/Services/Booking/AppointmentStatusService.php`**

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Services\Booking;

use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Exceptions\BookingException;
use App\Exceptions\InvalidTransitionException;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\AppointmentStatusHistory;
use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Services\Audit\AuditLogger;
use App\Services\Settings\SettingsService;
use App\Support\Actor;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Database\ConcurrencyErrorDetector;
use Illuminate\Database\QueryException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * Satu-satunya jalur tulis status appointment setelah pembuatan (00 F.8, F6-R15). Tabel transisi T4-T10
 * ada sebagai data (TRANSITIONS dan RULES): pembuatan (T1-T3) milik BookingService. Kunci baku 00 F.6:
 * patient_profiles, practice_sessions, appointments (hanya lewat PK) sebelum kueri lain; semua pemeriksaan
 * dibaca ulang di bawah kunci. Otorisasi (izin Spatie, Policy) ada di lapisan HTTP; service menegakkan
 * aturan domain menurut JENIS pelaku dan kepemilikan.
 */
final class AppointmentStatusService
{
    public const REASON_MIN_LENGTH = 5;

    public const REASON_MAX_LENGTH = 255;

    /** Peta dari-ke yang sah (00 F.8). Status final tidak punya jalan keluar. */
    public const TRANSITIONS = [
        'pending' => ['confirmed', 'checked_in', 'cancelled', 'no_show'],
        'confirmed' => ['checked_in', 'cancelled', 'no_show'],
        'checked_in' => ['completed', 'confirmed'],
        'completed' => [],
        'cancelled' => [],
        'no_show' => [],
    ];

    /**
     * Tabel F.8 T4-T10 per pasangan "dari>ke": `actors` = jenis pelaku yang boleh; `window` = jendela waktu
     * (before_end, checkin_window, same_day, cancel_rule, after_end, atau null); `reason` = jenis pelaku yang
     * wajib mengisi alasan (5-255 karakter).
     */
    public const RULES = [
        'pending>confirmed' => ['step' => 'T4', 'actors' => ['staff'], 'window' => 'before_end', 'reason' => []],
        'pending>checked_in' => ['step' => 'T5', 'actors' => ['staff'], 'window' => 'checkin_window', 'reason' => []],
        'confirmed>checked_in' => ['step' => 'T5', 'actors' => ['staff'], 'window' => 'checkin_window', 'reason' => []],
        'checked_in>completed' => ['step' => 'T6', 'actors' => ['staff'], 'window' => null, 'reason' => []],
        'checked_in>confirmed' => ['step' => 'T7', 'actors' => ['staff'], 'window' => 'same_day', 'reason' => ['staff']],
        'pending>cancelled' => ['step' => 'T8/T9', 'actors' => ['patient', 'staff', 'system'], 'window' => 'cancel_rule', 'reason' => ['staff', 'system']],
        'confirmed>cancelled' => ['step' => 'T8/T9', 'actors' => ['patient', 'staff', 'system'], 'window' => 'cancel_rule', 'reason' => ['staff', 'system']],
        'pending>no_show' => ['step' => 'T10', 'actors' => ['staff', 'system'], 'window' => 'after_end', 'reason' => []],
        'confirmed>no_show' => ['step' => 'T10', 'actors' => ['staff', 'system'], 'window' => 'after_end', 'reason' => []],
    ];

    public function __construct(
        private readonly AuditLogger $audit,
        private readonly SettingsService $settings,
        private readonly AppointmentNotifier $notifier,
    ) {}

    /**
     * Mengubah status satu appointment. `$expected` (BR-67) = status yang dilihat pengguna saat memuat
     * halaman; berbeda dengan status di bawah kunci → STALE_STATUS. Instance `$appointment` pemanggil
     * disinkronkan dengan keadaan baru dan dikembalikan.
     *
     * @throws InvalidTransitionException aturan F.8 dilanggar (tidak ada yang ditulis)
     * @throws BookingException SYSTEM_BUSY bila galat konkurensi lolos dari 3 percobaan
     */
    public function transition(Appointment $appointment, AppointmentStatus $to, Actor $actor, ?string $reason = null, ?AppointmentStatus $expected = null): Appointment
    {
        $reason = $this->normalizeReason($reason);

        if ($actor->isPatient() && $reason !== null) {
            $reason = mb_substr($reason, 0, self::REASON_MAX_LENGTH);
        }

        $appointmentId = (int) $appointment->getKey();
        $profileId = (int) $appointment->patient_profile_id;
        $sessionId = (int) $appointment->practice_session_id;

        try {
            $locked = DB::transaction(
                fn (): Appointment => $this->applyLocked($appointmentId, $profileId, $sessionId, $to, $actor, $reason, $expected),
                3,
            );
        } catch (QueryException $e) {
            if (app(ConcurrencyErrorDetector::class)->causedByConcurrencyError($e)) {
                throw BookingException::make(BookingException::SYSTEM_BUSY, [], [], $e);
            }

            throw $e;
        }

        $appointment->setRawAttributes($locked->getRawOriginal(), true);
        $appointment->setRelations($locked->getRelations());

        return $appointment;
    }

    private function applyLocked(int $appointmentId, int $profileId, int $sessionId, AppointmentStatus $to, Actor $actor, ?string $reason, ?AppointmentStatus $expected): Appointment
    {
        // Urutan kunci baku (00 F.6): profil, sesi, appointment; hanya lewat PK dan tanpa kueri lain sebelumnya.
        $profile = PatientProfile::query()->whereKey($profileId)->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();
        $session = PracticeSession::query()->whereKey($sessionId)->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();
        $appointment = Appointment::query()->whereKey($appointmentId)->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();

        $from = $appointment->status;
        $now = CarbonImmutable::instance(now())->setTimezone((string) config('app.timezone'));

        $rule = $this->authorize($appointment, $profile, $from, $to, $actor, $reason, $expected);
        $this->assertWindow($rule['window'], $appointment, $from, $to, $actor, $session, $now);

        $appointment->forceFill($this->changes($appointment, $from, $to, $actor, $reason, $now))->save();

        if ($to === AppointmentStatus::Cancelled) {
            $session->forceFill(['booked_count' => max(0, (int) $session->booked_count - 1)])->save();
        }

        AppointmentStatusHistory::query()->create([
            'appointment_id' => $appointment->getKey(),
            'from_status' => $from,
            'to_status' => $to,
            'actor_type' => $actor->type,
            'actor_user_id' => $actor->userId,
            'reason' => $reason,
        ]);

        $this->audit->log(
            'appointment.status_changed',
            $appointment,
            ['status' => $from->value],
            ['status' => $to->value] + ($reason === null ? [] : ['reason' => $reason]),
            "Status pendaftaran {$appointment->booking_code} berubah dari {$from->label()} ke {$to->label()}.",
            $actor,
        );

        // refresh() lebih dulu (memuat kolom generated active_flag), baru relasi yang dibutuhkan notifier.
        $appointment->refresh();
        $appointment->setRelation('practiceSession', $session);
        $appointment->setRelation('patientProfile', $profile->load('user'));
        $appointment->load(['clinic', 'doctor']);

        $this->notifier->statusChanged($appointment, $from, $to, $reason);

        return $appointment;
    }

    /**
     * Urutan pemeriksaan (semuanya di bawah kunci): pemilik, expected, final, pelaku-ke-status, pasangan,
     * alasan. Mengembalikan aturan pasangan itu untuk pemeriksaan jendela.
     *
     * @return array{step: string, actors: list<string>, window: ?string, reason: list<string>}
     */
    private function authorize(Appointment $appointment, PatientProfile $profile, AppointmentStatus $from, AppointmentStatus $to, Actor $actor, ?string $reason, ?AppointmentStatus $expected): array
    {
        if ($actor->isPatient() && ($profile->user_id === null || (int) $profile->user_id !== $actor->userId)) {
            $this->reject('FORBIDDEN_TRANSITION', $appointment, $from, $to);
        }

        if ($expected !== null && $expected !== $from) {
            $this->reject('STALE_STATUS', $appointment, $from, $to);
        }

        if ($from->isFinal()) {
            $this->reject('ALREADY_FINAL', $appointment, $from, $to, ['status' => mb_strtolower($from->label())]);
        }

        if (! $this->actorMayTarget($actor, $to)) {
            $this->reject('FORBIDDEN_TRANSITION', $appointment, $from, $to);
        }

        $rule = self::RULES[$from->value.'>'.$to->value] ?? null;

        if ($rule === null) {
            if ($actor->isPatient() && $from === AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn && $to === AppointmentStatus::Cancelled) {
                throw new InvalidTransitionException('INVALID_TRANSITION', __('booking.transitions.CANCEL_CHECKED_IN'), $this->context($appointment, $from, $to));
            }

            $this->reject('INVALID_TRANSITION', $appointment, $from, $to, ['dari' => $from->label(), 'ke' => $to->label()]);
        }

        if (! in_array($actor->type->value, $rule['actors'], true)) {
            $this->reject('FORBIDDEN_TRANSITION', $appointment, $from, $to);
        }

        if (in_array($actor->type->value, $rule['reason'], true)) {
            $length = $reason === null ? 0 : mb_strlen($reason);

            if ($length < self::REASON_MIN_LENGTH || $length > self::REASON_MAX_LENGTH) {
                $this->reject('REASON_REQUIRED', $appointment, $from, $to);
            }
        }

        return $rule;
    }

    /** Staf boleh menuju status apa pun (pasangan yang tidak sah ditolak sebagai INVALID_TRANSITION). */
    private function actorMayTarget(Actor $actor, AppointmentStatus $to): bool
    {
        if ($actor->isStaff()) {
            return true;
        }

        foreach (self::RULES as $pair => $rule) {
            if (str_ends_with($pair, '>'.$to->value) && in_array($actor->type->value, $rule['actors'], true)) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    private function assertWindow(?string $window, Appointment $appointment, AppointmentStatus $from, AppointmentStatus $to, Actor $actor, PracticeSession $session, CarbonImmutable $now): void
    {
        if ($window === null) {
            return;
        }

        $rules = $this->settings->bookingRules();
        $isSessionDay = $session->session_date->toDateString() === $now->toDateString();

        if ($window === 'before_end' && ! $now->lessThan($session->ends_at)) {
            $this->reject('CONFIRM_AFTER_END', $appointment, $from, $to);
        }

        if ($window === 'checkin_window') {
            if (! $isSessionDay) {
                $this->reject('CHECKIN_NOT_TODAY', $appointment, $from, $to, ['date' => $session->session_date->translatedFormat('l, j F Y')]);
            }

            $opensAt = $session->starts_at->subMinutes($rules->checkinOpenMinutes);

            if ($now->lessThan($opensAt)) {
                $this->reject('CHECKIN_NOT_OPEN', $appointment, $from, $to, ['time' => $opensAt->format('H.i')]);
            }

            if ($now->greaterThan($session->ends_at)) {
                $this->reject('CHECKIN_CLOSED', $appointment, $from, $to);
            }
        }

        if ($window === 'same_day' && ! $isSessionDay) {
            $this->reject('CORRECTION_NOT_SAME_DAY', $appointment, $from, $to);
        }

        if ($window === 'cancel_rule' && $actor->isPatient()) {
            $deadline = $session->starts_at->subMinutes($rules->cancelCutoffMinutes);

            if ($now->greaterThan($deadline)) {
                $this->reject('CANCEL_CUTOFF_PASSED', $appointment, $from, $to, [
                    'minutes' => $rules->cancelCutoffMinutes,
                    'phone' => $this->settings->string('contact.phone'),
                ]);
            }
        }

        if ($window === 'after_end' && ! $now->greaterThan($session->ends_at)) {
            $this->reject('SESSION_NOT_ENDED', $appointment, $from, $to, ['time' => $session->ends_at->format('H.i')]);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Kolom yang berubah (I-14): status, kolom waktu, dan data pembatalan.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function changes(Appointment $appointment, AppointmentStatus $from, AppointmentStatus $to, Actor $actor, ?string $reason, CarbonImmutable $now): array
    {
        $changes = ['status' => $to];

        switch ($to) {
            case AppointmentStatus::Confirmed:
                if ($from === AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn) {
                    $changes['checked_in_at'] = null;
                } else {
                    $changes['confirmed_at'] = $now;
                }
                break;
            case AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn:
                $changes['checked_in_at'] = $now;
                $changes['confirmed_at'] = $appointment->confirmed_at ?? $now;
                break;
            case AppointmentStatus::Completed:
                $changes['completed_at'] = $now;
                break;
            case AppointmentStatus::Cancelled:
                $changes['cancelled_at'] = $now;
                $changes['cancelled_by_type'] = $actor->type;
                $changes['cancelled_by_user_id'] = $actor->userId;
                $changes['cancel_reason'] = $reason;
                break;
            case AppointmentStatus::NoShow:
                $changes['no_show_at'] = $now;
                break;
            default:
                break;
        }

        return $changes;
    }

    private function normalizeReason(?string $reason): ?string
    {
        if ($reason === null) {
            return null;
        }

        $reason = trim($reason);

        return $reason === '' ? null : $reason;
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, scalar>  $replace
     */
    private function reject(string $code, Appointment $appointment, AppointmentStatus $from, AppointmentStatus $to, array $replace = []): never
    {
        throw InvalidTransitionException::make($code, $replace, $this->context($appointment, $from, $to));
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    private function context(Appointment $appointment, AppointmentStatus $from, AppointmentStatus $to): array
    {
        return [
            'appointment_code' => (string) $appointment->booking_code,
            'from' => $from->value,
            'to' => $to->value,
        ];
    }
}
```

#### Catatan penulis (konteks untuk implementer dan reviewer)

1. **Dua tambahan terhadap kerangka (kontrak dengan T1/T3/T4).** (a) Pesan BR-79 dibangun lewat `new InvalidTransitionException('INVALID_TRANSITION', __('booking.transitions.CANCEL_CHECKED_IN'), …)` karena `make()` memilih kunci lang dari kode; T1 harus menyediakan kunci `CANCEL_CHECKED_IN` dengan teks verbatim BR-79 ("Pendaftaran yang sudah check-in tidak dapat dibatalkan. Silakan hubungi petugas pendaftaran."), dan placeholder `:dari`, `:ke`, `:status`, `:minutes`, `:phone`, `:date`, `:time` pada kunci masing-masing (tes T5 mengasersinya lewat potongan pesan). (b) `ConcurrencyErrorDetector` dipakai dari container untuk menerjemahkan galat konkurensi menjadi `SYSTEM_BUSY`; T4 sebaiknya memakai mekanisme yang sama agar perilakunya seragam.
2. **Service tidak memeriksa izin Spatie** (lihat Catatan teknis no. 5), berbeda dengan sketsa 11 §6.3. Dampak: fase 7 (`AppointmentPolicy::transition` + Form Request) wajib menjadi satu-satunya penjaga izin `appointments.manage` sebelum memanggil `transition()` dengan `Actor::staff`; tes T6 `TransitionConcurrencyTest` memakai staf tanpa peran karena itu.
3. **Keputusan perilaku yang belum ada di blueprint** dan dikunci tes: urutan pemeriksaan (Catatan teknis no. 2); koreksi T7 mempertahankan `confirmed_at`; alasan staf/sistem di luar 5-255 (termasuk > 255) memakai kode `REASON_REQUIRED`; `no_show` tepat pada `end_time` ditolak sedangkan check-in tepat pada `end_time` diterima; pasien non-pemilik selalu `FORBIDDEN_TRANSITION` di level service (di HTTP tetap 404 dari Policy, T7).
4. **Koreksi `checked_in → confirmed` dan kanal mail.** Tabel peristiwa 06 §18 menyebut koreksi = `database` saja, sedangkan K-13 (via menurut status tujuan) memberi `mail` untuk setiap `confirmed`. T3 sudah memakai pengecualian `$from === CheckedIn` (R-b), sehingga tes T5 mengunci kanal koreksi persis `['database']` (tanpa `mail`).
5. **Waktu tes.** Matriks 108 kasus membuat sesi, profil berakun, dan menyemai `SettingsSeeder` per kasus; perkiraan total berkas ini 40-80 detik. Bila gerbang T13 menilai terlalu lama, pecah provider `matrix()` per pelaku (bukan hapus kasus).

### Task 6: Tes konkurensi (KON-01..KON-05, BKG-18, BKG-21, carry fase 3)

**Files:**

- Create: `tests/Support/Concurrency/ConcurrencyTestCase.php` (kelas dasar abstrak: pola spike, pembersihan baris ter-commit, pembantu proses/PDO)

- Create: `tests/Feature/Concurrency/TransitionConcurrencyTest.php` (KON-05, `SYSTEM_BUSY` dan pengulangan pada `transition()`)
- Tidak diubah: `phpunit.xml` (kedua suite sudah mencakup `tests/Feature`, jadi tes ini ikut `php artisan test`; grup `concurrency` hanya penanda untuk `--exclude-group`/`--group`), `tests/Feature/Database/ConcurrencySpikeTest.php`, `tests/Support/RawPdoConnection.php`, `tests/Support/DatabaseGuard.php`, seluruh kode aplikasi.

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - T1: `AppointmentFactory`/`PracticeSessionFactory` yang ada, `App\Exceptions\BookingException` (`errorCode`, `getMessage()`), `InvalidTransitionException`, `lang/id/booking.php`.
  - T3: `AppointmentStatusChangedNotification` (dibuat saat pendaftaran dan setiap transisi, `database` untuk pasien berakun).
  - T4: `BookingService::book(PatientProfile $profile, int $practiceSessionId, BookingData $data, Actor $actor): Appointment` dan `precheck(PatientProfile, PracticeSession, BookingData, Actor): void`; `BookingData(PaymentType $paymentType, ...)`.
  - T5: `AppointmentStatusService::transition(Appointment, AppointmentStatus, Actor, ?string $reason, ?AppointmentStatus $expected): Appointment`.
  - Fase 3-5: `ScheduleChangeService::applyException(ScheduleException, ?array $previous, Actor)`, `DoctorService::archive(Doctor, ?string, Actor)`, `Actor`, `PatientProfileFactory::withAccount()`, `UserFactory::staff()`, `Tests\Support\RawPdoConnection::open(int $lockWaitTimeoutSeconds = 1): PDO`, `Tests\Support\DatabaseGuard::assertIsTestDatabase(string)`, trait `InteractsWithSchedules` (`bookAppointment()`).

- Produces:
  - Pembantu tes yang boleh dipakai ulang oleh fase berikutnya: `Tests\Support\Concurrency\ConcurrencyTestCase` (`makeSession()`, `makePatient()`, `makeStaff()`, `openConnection()`, `spawn()`, `gather()`, `barrier()`, `waitUntil()`, `injectFault()`, `assertSessionIsConsistent()`, `assertNoInfrastructureErrors()`) dan skrip `book-session.php` dengan operasi `--op=book` dan `--op=transition`.

**Test IDs:** KON-01a, KON-01b, KON-01c (= BKG-21), KON-01d, KON-01e (tambahan: pembaca ulang status di bawah kunci), KON-02a, KON-02b, KON-02c (opsional manual, `$env:KON_STRESS = "1"`), KON-03, KON-04, KON-05 (tiga varian), BKG-18 (pemetaan galat driver, pengulangan `attempts: 3`, rollback penuh), BKG-21 (`SYSTEM_BUSY`; `precheck()` tidak mengunci), carry fase 3 (booking versus `ScheduleChangeService::applyException` dan `DoctorService::archive` bersamaan), F6-R34, F6-R13, F6-R15, Review Focus E.1 (balapan dan kirim ganda: sisa kuota 1, N proses paralel, deadlock/lock wait menjadi `SYSTEM_BUSY` tanpa baris parsial, batal lalu daftar lagi = antrean baru), E.2 (sisi `SYSTEM_BUSY`).

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
1. **Pola spike, bukan `DatabaseTruncation`.** `ConcurrencySpikeTest` memakai `RefreshDatabase` + `protected $connectionsToTransact = [];` (tanpa transaksi pembungkus; baris factory ter-commit dan terlihat oleh koneksi/proses lain) dan membersihkan baris lewat baseline `max(id)` per tabel di `tearDown()`. Kelas dasar `ConcurrencyTestCase` menyalin pola itu dan memperluas daftar tabel menjadi `appointment_status_histories`, `appointments`, `practice_sessions`, `schedule_exceptions`, `patient_profiles`, `audit_logs`, `doctors`, `clinics`, `users` (urutan hapus aman FK; anak lebih dulu) plus `notifications` (PK uuid, jadi dihapus lewat `notifiable_id > baseline users.id`). Setelah menghapus, `tearDown()` memeriksa ulang bahwa tidak ada baris di atas baseline dan MENGGAGALKAN tes bila ada sisa (syarat "tidak meninggalkan data di DB uji"). Tes konkurensi TIDAK boleh memakai `createStaff()` (menyemai `roles`/`permissions` yang ter-commit dan mengganggu tes lain yang menghitung peran): staf dibuat `User::factory()->staff()->create()` tanpa peran, dan service T4/T5 memang tidak memeriksa izin (catatan T5 no. 5). `website_settings` TIDAK disemai (nilai cadangan `BookingRules::fromSettings`: 30, 60, 120, 60, 3, false) dan tes tidak mengubah pengaturan.
2. **Proses anak.** Dibuat dengan `Process([PHP_BINARY, base_path('tests/Support/Concurrency/book-session.php'), '--op=…', …], base_path(), $env, null, 90)` (bentuk larik: tanda kutip Windows ditangani Symfony; `base_path()` "D:\Project Web RS" berspasi aman). `PHP_BINARY` = PHP yang menjalankan tes (`C:\xampp3\php\php.exe`). Lingkungan anak EKSPLISIT (`childEnvironment()`): `APP_ENV=testing`, `APP_KEY` (dari config), `DB_CONNECTION=mariadb`, `DB_HOST/PORT/DATABASE/USERNAME/PASSWORD/TIMEZONE` dari `config('database.connections.mariadb')` milik proses tes (yang oleh `phpunit.xml` dipaksa `unpam_hospital_test`), `DB_URL=''`, `CACHE_STORE=array`, `SESSION_DRIVER=array`, `QUEUE_CONNECTION=sync`, `MAIL_MAILER=array`, `LOG_CHANNEL=null`, `BCRYPT_ROUNDS=4`. `CACHE_STORE=array` (bukan `file` seperti sketsa 15 §6.1) karena service tidak memakai `Cache::lock` (itu di controller T8) dan `SettingsService` memakai `Cache::rememberForever` yang berisiko basi bila dibagi lewat file. Tiga pagar database: (a) `childEnvironment()` memanggil `DatabaseGuard::assertIsTestDatabase()` di proses tes, (b) skrip anak memanggilnya lagi dan berhenti (kode keluar 3) bila database bukan `*_test` atau `APP_ENV` bukan `testing`, (c) `RawPdoConnection` sudah memeriksanya.
3. **Penghalang serempak.** Tiap proses menerima `--start-at=EPOCH.FRAK` (`microtime(true) + BARRIER_BASE + BARRIER_PER_PROCESS * N`, bawaan 2,5 + 0,35 N detik); skrip membuka koneksi DB, mengatur `innodb_lock_wait_timeout`, memuat service, lalu menunggu (`usleep(500)`) sampai waktu itu sebelum memanggil `book()`/`transition()`. Boot PHP di Windows ±0,3-1 detik per proses; bila sebuah proses terlambat boot, ia tetap berjalan benar tetapi tidak lagi serempak, sehingga tes yang membuktikan "menunggu kunci" menegaskan `begin < waktu lepas kunci` dengan pesan yang menyuruh menaikkan `BARRIER_BASE` (bukan lulus diam-diam). Setiap proses mencetak SATU baris JSON terakhir (`ok`, `code`/`queue`, `begin`, `end`); kode keluar 0 untuk hasil domain (sukses maupun `BookingException`).
4. **Menahan kunci dari proses tes.** Koneksi PDO A (`RawPdoConnection::open()`, sesi server terpisah) mengambil kunci dengan urutan baku (`patient_profiles` lalu `practice_sessions`) dan menahannya selama proses anak B (satu proses PHP tidak dapat sekaligus menahan dan menunggu). Penahanan dipastikan nyata dengan tiga cara: B harus `isRunning()` saat A masih menahan, `end` B ≥ saat A melepas, dan (KON-01d) koneksi C masih dapat mengunci baris sesi tanpa menunggu sementara B menunggu kunci profil, yang membuktikan kunci profil adalah pernyataan pertama transaksi `book()`.
5. **`SYSTEM_BUSY` nyata (BKG-21 = KON-01c).** Koneksi aplikasi proses tes (`DB::statement('SET SESSION innodb_lock_wait_timeout = 1')`) memanggil `book()` di luar transaksi pembungkus sementara koneksi PDO lain menahan baris sesi: Laravel mengulang transaksi terluar 3 kali (`ConcurrencyErrorDetector` mengenali "Lock wait timeout exceeded; try restarting transaction"), lalu `BookingService` menerjemahkannya menjadi `BookingException` `SYSTEM_BUSY`. Total ±3-4 detik. Di dalam `RefreshDatabase` biasa transaksi bersarang tidak mengulang (`DeadlockException` dilempar ke luar), itulah sebabnya semua tes bab ini tidak dibungkus.
6. **Simulasi galat driver (BKG-18).** `Connection::beforeExecuting(Closure)` dipanggil SEBELUM `runQueryCallback` sehingga galat harus dilempar sebagai `QueryException` (atau `UniqueConstraintViolationException` untuk errno 1062: kelas inilah yang ditangkap `BookingService`) dengan `PDOException::$errorInfo = [sqlState, errno, pesan]`; pesan memuat nama indeks/constraint karena penerjemahan memeriksa `errorInfo[1]` DAN nama indeks. Callback `beforeExecuting` tidak dapat dicabut, jadi satu penutup per tes dengan penghitung `hits` dan `remaining` (`injectFault()`); jumlah `hits` membuktikan jumlah percobaan (INSERT appointment dicoba 3 kali pada 1205/1213; 2 kali setelah satu 1062 pada `booking_code`/`queue_number`). Penyisipan galat memakai fragmen SQL huruf kecil (`insert into \`appointments\``, `update \`practice_sessions\``, `update \`appointments\``).
7. **Carry fase 3 dianalisis dari source.** (a) `ScheduleChangeService::applyException` memproses sesi berurutan `id` di savepoint dan menghitung appointment aktif dengan `FOR UPDATE` (`activeAppointmentCount()`): sesi tanpa appointment aktif menjadi `cancelled`, dengan appointment aktif menjadi `needs_review` (appointment tetap). Invarian yang diuji: tidak pernah ada sesi `cancelled` yang memuat appointment aktif; sesi `needs_review` ⇒ booking tersebut sukses; sesi `cancelled` ⇒ booking tersebut `SESSION_UNAVAILABLE`; tidak ada `SYSTEM_BUSY`/`DB_*`/pengecualian sisi jadwal. Hitungan `FOR UPDATE` pada indeks `(practice_session_id, queue_number)` memakai kunci next-key/gap yang BISA berinteraksi dengan INSERT booking di sesi lain (kunci supremum); InnoDB menyelesaikan siklus dengan membatalkan salah satu transaksi dan booking diulang otomatis (3 percobaan). Bila yang menjadi korban justru transaksi jadwal (galat 1213 di sisi admin), tes menangkap `QueryException|DeadlockException` (sama seperti tes archive), memastikan galat itu galat konkurensi, lalu hanya memeriksa invarian data (tidak ada sesi `cancelled` yang memuat appointment aktif); kejadian itu adalah temuan nyata untuk koordinator (usul perbaikan: pengulangan di `ScheduleChangeService`/controller admin atau pengurutan kunci), dicatat sebagai carry fase 7 (D-165). (b) `DoctorService::archive` mengunci baris dokter lebih dulu, lalu `futureActiveAppointmentsCount()` (baca biasa, check-then-act). INSERT appointment oleh booking mengambil kunci bersama pada baris `doctors` (pemeriksaan FK) sehingga booking yang sudah menahan kunci sesi menunggu `archive`, sementara `archive` menunggu kunci sesi: siklus yang diselesaikan InnoDB. Jadi dokter terarsip TIDAK PERNAH memiliki appointment aktif mendatang; yang diuji adalah invarian akhir, dan hasil sisi admin boleh `archived`, `rejected` (ValidationException) atau galat konkurensi (dicatat sebagai temuan; karena `archive` membuka transaksi bersarang, korban siklus muncul sebagai `DeadlockException` (`extends PDOException`, BUKAN `QueryException`) sehingga tes menangkap `QueryException|DeadlockException`; lihat Catatan penulis).
8. **Batas waktu nyata.** Proses anak memakai jam asli (tidak ada `travelTo` yang menjalar ke proses lain). Sesi uji memakai `today()+1` 08.00-12.00 (batas online 60 menit dan batas batal pasien 120 menit selalu terpenuhi kecuali tes dijalankan sekitar tengah malam), dan KON-05 memakai sesi HARI INI 00.00-23.59 (jendela check-in terbuka sepanjang hari). Jangan menjalankan tes ini pada 23.58-00.02 WIB.
9. **Anggaran waktu.** Perkiraan: KON-01a/b/d/e 4-5 dtk masing-masing, BKG-21 ±4 dtk, KON-02a ±7, KON-02b ±6, KON-03 ±6, KON-04 ±7, KON-05a/b/c ±3,5 dtk masing-masing, carry ±6 dtk ×2, `SYSTEM_BUSY` transisi ±4, tes galat driver (±12 tes) ±4 dtk total: ±85-100 detik, di bawah batas ±2 menit. Konstanta `BARRIER_BASE`/`BARRIER_PER_PROCESS` di `ConcurrencyTestCase` dapat diturunkan bila mesin cepat.
10. **Tidak ada perubahan DB pengembangan.** Seluruh tes memakai `unpam_hospital_test`; implementer tidak menjalankan `migrate*`/`db:seed` pada `unpam_hospital`.
11. Jumlah tes baru ±28 (BookingConcurrencyTest 15 termasuk kasus provider, BookingParallelProcessesTest 7 termasuk 1 yang dilewati tanpa `KON_STRESS`, TransitionConcurrencyTest 6).

- [ ] **Step 3: Tulis kelas dasar (tool Write) `tests/Support/Concurrency/ConcurrencyTestCase.php`**

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Support\Concurrency;

use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Database\QueryException;
use Illuminate\Database\UniqueConstraintViolationException;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use PDO;
use PDOException;
use stdClass;
use Symfony\Component\Process\Exception\ProcessTimedOutException;
use Symfony\Component\Process\Process;
use Tests\Support\DatabaseGuard;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\Support\RawPdoConnection;
use Tests\TestCase;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Dasar tes konkurensi fase 6 (F6-R34). Pola spike fase 3: RefreshDatabase hanya untuk memastikan skema
 * termigrasi, `$connectionsToTransact = []` mematikan transaksi pembungkus sehingga semua baris ter-COMMIT
 * (terlihat oleh koneksi PDO dan proses anak) dan wajib dibersihkan sendiri. Pembersihan memakai baseline
 * `max(id)` per tabel, lalu memeriksa ulang bahwa tidak ada sisa (tes gagal bila ada).
 *
 * Aturan: tanpa createStaff() (menyemai peran yang ter-commit), tanpa mengubah pengaturan, tanpa travelTo()
 * (proses anak memakai jam asli).
 */
abstract class ConcurrencyTestCase extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    /** Tanpa transaksi pembungkus: data harus ter-commit agar terlihat oleh koneksi/proses lain. */
    protected $connectionsToTransact = [];

    /** Detik tetap sebelum penghalang serempak (waktu boot proses PHP di Windows). */
    protected const BARRIER_BASE = 2.5;

    /** Tambahan detik per proses anak. */
    protected const BARRIER_PER_PROCESS = 0.35;

    /** Urutan hapus aman FK: anak lebih dulu (`notifications` dihapus terpisah lewat akun uji). */
    private const CLEANUP_TABLES = [
        'appointment_status_histories',
        'appointments',
        'practice_sessions',
        'schedule_exceptions',
        'patient_profiles',
        'audit_logs',
        'doctors',
        'clinics',
        'users',
    ];

    /** @var array<string, int> id tertinggi tiap tabel sebelum tes dimulai */
    private array $baselines = [];

    /** @var list<PDO> */
    private array $connections = [];

    /** @var list<Process> */
    private array $processes = [];

    private int $codeSequence = 0;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->assertSame(0, DB::transactionLevel(), 'Tes konkurensi tidak boleh berjalan di dalam transaksi.');

        foreach (self::CLEANUP_TABLES as $table) {
            $this->baselines[$table] = (int) DB::table($table)->max('id');
        }
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        foreach ($this->processes as $process) {
            try {
                if ($process->isRunning()) {
                    $process->stop(0);
                }
            } catch (Throwable) {
                // Proses sudah selesai atau tidak dapat dihentikan; koneksinya ditutup server.
            }
        }

        $this->processes = [];

        foreach ($this->connections as $pdo) {
            try {
                if ($pdo->inTransaction()) {
                    $pdo->rollBack();
                }
            } catch (Throwable) {
                // Koneksi mungkin sudah mati; kunci dilepas server saat sesi ditutup.
            }
        }

        $this->connections = [];

        $leftovers = $this->purge();

        parent::tearDown();

        if ($leftovers !== []) {
            $this->fail('Data tes konkurensi tertinggal di database uji: '.implode(', ', $leftovers).'.');
        }
    }

    /**
     * Menghapus semua baris yang dibuat tes (dan proses anaknya), lalu mengembalikan daftar tabel yang masih
     * berisi baris di atas baseline. Setiap tabel dibersihkan mandiri agar satu kegagalan tidak melewatkan yang lain.
     *
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private function purge(): array
    {
        try {
            // Proses anak yang dihentikan paksa dapat menahan kunci sesaat; jangan menunggu 50 detik.
            DB::statement('SET SESSION innodb_lock_wait_timeout = 10');
        } catch (Throwable) {
        }

        $usersBaseline = $this->baselines['users'] ?? PHP_INT_MAX;

        try {
            DB::table('notifications')->where('notifiable_id', '>', $usersBaseline)->delete();
        } catch (Throwable) {
        }

        foreach (self::CLEANUP_TABLES as $table) {
            try {
                DB::table($table)->where('id', '>', $this->baselines[$table] ?? PHP_INT_MAX)->delete();
            } catch (Throwable) {
            }
        }

        $leftovers = [];

        try {
            if (DB::table('notifications')->where('notifiable_id', '>', $usersBaseline)->exists()) {
                $leftovers[] = 'notifications';
            }
        } catch (Throwable) {
            $leftovers[] = 'notifications (tidak terbaca)';
        }

        foreach (self::CLEANUP_TABLES as $table) {
            try {
                if (DB::table($table)->where('id', '>', $this->baselines[$table] ?? PHP_INT_MAX)->exists()) {
                    $leftovers[] = $table;
                }
            } catch (Throwable) {
                $leftovers[] = $table.' (tidak terbaca)';
            }
        }

        return $leftovers;
    }

    protected function baseline(string $table): int
    {
        return $this->baselines[$table] ?? 0;
    }

    /** Jumlah baris tabel yang dibuat tes ini (id di atas baseline), opsional per nilai `action`. */
    protected function rowsSince(string $table, ?string $action = null): int
    {
        $query = DB::table($table)->where('id', '>', $this->baseline($table));

        if ($action !== null) {
            $query->where('action', $action);
        }

        return $query->count();
    }

    /** Jumlah notifikasi untuk akun yang dibuat tes ini. */
    protected function notificationsSince(): int
    {
        return DB::table('notifications')->where('notifiable_id', '>', $this->baseline('users'))->count();
    }

    // --- data (koneksi aplikasi, autocommit) ---------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * Sesi manual (tanpa templat) besok 08.00-12.00 pada dokter dan poliklinik baru, kecuali ditimpa.
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     */
    protected function makeSession(int $quota = 5, array $overrides = []): PracticeSession
    {
        return PracticeSession::factory()->manual()->create($overrides + [
            'quota' => $quota,
            'session_date' => today()->addDay()->toDateString(),
            'start_time' => '08:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
        ]);
    }

    /** Pasien berakun (kanal online): `Actor::patient()` membutuhkan `User`. */
    protected function makePatient(): PatientProfile
    {
        return PatientProfile::factory()->withAccount()->create();
    }

    /** @return list<PatientProfile> */
    protected function makePatients(int $count): array
    {
        $patients = [];

        for ($i = 0; $i < $count; $i++) {
            $patients[] = $this->makePatient();
        }

        return $patients;
    }

    /** Akun staf tanpa peran (service tidak memeriksa izin). */
    protected function makeStaff(): User
    {
        return User::factory()->staff()->create();
    }

    // --- koneksi PDO mentah --------------------------------------------------------------------

    protected function openConnection(int $lockWaitTimeoutSeconds = 1): PDO
    {
        $pdo = RawPdoConnection::open($lockWaitTimeoutSeconds);
        $this->connections[] = $pdo;

        return $pdo;
    }

    /**
     * SELECT ... FOR UPDATE: pembacaan berkunci selalu membaca nilai terbaru yang ter-commit.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    protected function lockRow(PDO $pdo, string $table, int $id): array
    {
        $statement = $pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM {$table} WHERE id = ? FOR UPDATE");
        $statement->execute([$id]);

        return (array) $statement->fetch();
    }

    /**
     * Awal transaksi booking dengan urutan kunci baku: patient_profiles lalu practice_sessions.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed> baris sesi yang terkunci
     */
    protected function beginAndLock(PDO $pdo, int $patientId, int $sessionId): array
    {
        $pdo->beginTransaction();
        $this->lockRow($pdo, 'patient_profiles', $patientId);

        return $this->lockRow($pdo, 'practice_sessions', $sessionId);
    }

    /**
     * Sisipkan appointment `pending` dan naikkan pencacah sesi (tanpa commit). Mengembalikan nomor antrean.
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $session  baris sesi yang terkunci (hasil beginAndLock)
     */
    protected function rawBook(PDO $pdo, int $patientId, array $session): int
    {
        $queue = (int) $session['last_queue_number'] + 1;
        $this->codeSequence++;
        $now = now()->toDateTimeString();

        $pdo->prepare(
            'INSERT INTO appointments (booking_code, patient_profile_id, practice_session_id, doctor_id, clinic_id, session_date, queue_number, status, channel, payment_type, created_at, updated_at)
             VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)'
        )->execute([
            sprintf('UPH-%04d-%04d', $this->codeSequence, random_int(0, 9999)),
            $patientId,
            $session['id'],
            $session['doctor_id'],
            $session['clinic_id'],
            $session['session_date'],
            $queue,
            'pending',
            'online',
            'umum',
            $now,
            $now,
        ]);

        $pdo->prepare('UPDATE practice_sessions SET booked_count = booked_count + 1, last_queue_number = ? WHERE id = ?')
            ->execute([$queue, $session['id']]);

        return $queue;
    }

    // --- proses anak ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    /** Waktu (epoch) penghalang serempak untuk $processes proses anak. */
    protected function barrier(int $processes = 1): float
    {
        return microtime(true) + static::BARRIER_BASE + static::BARRIER_PER_PROCESS * $processes;
    }

    protected function waitUntil(float $epoch): void
    {
        while (microtime(true) < $epoch) {
            usleep(2000);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Menjalankan tests/Support/Concurrency/book-session.php sebagai proses anak.
     *
     * @param  string  $operation  `book` atau `transition`
     * @param  array<string, scalar>  $arguments  opsi skrip (tanpa `--`), mis. ['patient' => 1, 'session' => 2]
     */
    protected function spawn(string $operation, array $arguments, float $startAt, int $lockTimeoutSeconds = 20): Process
    {
        $command = [
            PHP_BINARY,
            base_path('tests/Support/Concurrency/book-session.php'),
            '--op='.$operation,
            '--start-at='.sprintf('%.6F', $startAt),
            '--lock-timeout='.$lockTimeoutSeconds,
        ];

        foreach ($arguments as $name => $value) {
            $command[] = "--{$name}={$value}";
        }

        $process = new Process($command, base_path(), $this->childEnvironment(), null, 90);
        $process->start();
        $this->processes[] = $process;

        return $process;
    }

    /**
     * Menunggu proses selesai dan mengurai baris JSON terakhir keluarannya. Proses yang gagal diurai menjadi
     * `['ok' => false, 'code' => 'PROC', ...]`; yang melewati batas waktu menjadi `code => 'TIMEOUT'`.
     *
     * @param  list<Process>  $processes
     * @return list<array<string, mixed>>
     */
    protected function gather(array $processes): array
    {
        $results = [];

        foreach ($processes as $process) {
            try {
                $process->wait();
            } catch (ProcessTimedOutException) {
                $process->stop(0);
                $results[] = ['ok' => false, 'code' => 'TIMEOUT'];

                continue;
            }

            $lines = array_values(array_filter(array_map('trim', explode("\n", $process->getOutput())), fn (string $line): bool => $line !== ''));
            $decoded = $lines === [] ? null : json_decode($lines[count($lines) - 1], true);

            $results[] = is_array($decoded)
                ? $decoded
                : [
                    'ok' => false,
                    'code' => 'PROC',
                    'exit' => $process->getExitCode(),
                    'detail' => trim($process->getErrorOutput().' | '.$process->getOutput()),
                ];
        }

        return $results;
    }

    /** @return array<string, string> */
    private function childEnvironment(): array
    {
        /** @var array<string, mixed> $config */
        $config = config('database.connections.mariadb');

        $database = (string) $config['database'];
        DatabaseGuard::assertIsTestDatabase($database);

        return [
            'APP_ENV' => 'testing',
            'APP_KEY' => (string) config('app.key'),
            'DB_CONNECTION' => 'mariadb',
            'DB_HOST' => (string) $config['host'],
            'DB_PORT' => (string) $config['port'],
            'DB_DATABASE' => $database,
            'DB_USERNAME' => (string) $config['username'],
            'DB_PASSWORD' => (string) $config['password'],
            'DB_URL' => '',
            'DB_TIMEZONE' => (string) ($config['timezone'] ?? '+07:00'),
            'CACHE_STORE' => 'array',
            'SESSION_DRIVER' => 'array',
            'QUEUE_CONNECTION' => 'sync',
            'MAIL_MAILER' => 'array',
            'LOG_CHANNEL' => 'null',
            'BCRYPT_ROUNDS' => '4',
            'PULSE_ENABLED' => 'false',
            'TELESCOPE_ENABLED' => 'false',
            'NIGHTWATCH_ENABLED' => 'false',
        ];
    }

    // --- galat driver tersimulasi --------------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * Memasang penutup `beforeExecuting` pada koneksi aplikasi: setiap kueri yang mengandung `$sqlFragment`
     * (huruf kecil) melempar galat driver palsu sebanyak `$times` kali pertama. `hits` menghitung semua kueri
     * yang cocok (termasuk yang lolos), `thrown` yang dilempar. Penutup tidak dapat dicabut: satu per tes.
     */
    protected function injectFault(string $sqlFragment, int $errno, string $sqlState, string $message, int $times = PHP_INT_MAX): stdClass
    {
        $state = new stdClass;
        $state->hits = 0;
        $state->thrown = 0;

        DB::connection()->beforeExecuting(function (string $query, array $bindings) use ($sqlFragment, $errno, $sqlState, $message, $times, $state): void {
            if (! str_contains(strtolower($query), $sqlFragment)) {
                return;
            }

            $state->hits++;

            if ($state->thrown >= $times) {
                return;
            }

            $state->thrown++;

            $driver = new PDOException($message);
            $driver->errorInfo = [$sqlState, $errno, $message];

            // Laravel membungkus pelanggaran UNIQUE (1062) sebagai subkelas; BookingService menangkap subkelas itu.
            $class = $errno === 1062 ? UniqueConstraintViolationException::class : QueryException::class;

            throw new $class('mariadb', $query, $bindings, $driver);
        });

        return $state;
    }

    // --- asersi bersama ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * Invarian sesi (I1, I2, I4): `booked_count` = appointment non-batal; `booked_count <= quota`; nomor antrean
     * unik dan tidak pernah dipakai ulang (`last_queue_number` = jumlah appointment yang pernah dibuat, antrean 1..n).
     */
    protected function assertSessionIsConsistent(PracticeSession $session): void
    {
        $fresh = PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($session->getKey());
        $appointments = Appointment::query()->where('practice_session_id', $session->getKey())->get(['id', 'status', 'queue_number']);
        $consuming = $appointments->filter(fn (Appointment $appointment): bool => $appointment->status !== AppointmentStatus::Cancelled)->count();
        $queues = $appointments->pluck('queue_number')->map(fn ($queue): int => (int) $queue)->all();

        $this->assertSame($consuming, (int) $fresh->booked_count, 'I1: booked_count harus sama dengan jumlah appointment non-batal.');
        $this->assertLessThanOrEqual((int) $fresh->quota, (int) $fresh->booked_count, 'I2: booked_count tidak boleh melebihi kuota.');
        $this->assertSame(count($queues), count(array_unique($queues)), 'Nomor antrean harus unik.');
        $this->assertSame($appointments->count(), (int) $fresh->last_queue_number, 'last_queue_number harus sama dengan jumlah appointment yang pernah dibuat (antrean tidak dipakai ulang).');

        if ($queues !== []) {
            sort($queues);
            $this->assertSame(range(1, count($queues)), $queues, 'Nomor antrean harus 1..n tanpa lubang.');
        }
    }

    /**
     * Tidak ada proses anak yang gagal secara infrastruktur (proses mati, waktu habis, galat DB tak terduga,
     * pengecualian tak terduga) dan tidak ada `SYSTEM_BUSY` (jalur normal tanpa kunci yang ditahan).
     *
     * @param  list<array<string, mixed>>  $results
     */
    protected function assertNoInfrastructureErrors(array $results): void
    {
        foreach ($results as $result) {
            $code = (string) ($result['code'] ?? '');
            $unexpected = ($result['ok'] ?? false) !== true
                && (str_starts_with($code, 'DB_') || str_starts_with($code, 'EXC_') || in_array($code, ['PROC', 'TIMEOUT', 'SYSTEM_BUSY'], true));

            $this->assertFalse($unexpected, 'Hasil proses anak tidak wajar: '.json_encode($result));
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param  list<array<string, mixed>>  $results
     * @return list<array<string, mixed>>
     */
    protected function successes(array $results): array
    {
        return array_values(array_filter($results, fn (array $result): bool => ($result['ok'] ?? false) === true));
    }

    /**
     * @param  list<array<string, mixed>>  $results
     * @return list<string> kode galat proses yang gagal, terurut
     */
    protected function failureCodes(array $results): array
    {
        $codes = array_map(
            fn (array $result): string => (string) $result['code'],
            array_values(array_filter($results, fn (array $result): bool => ($result['ok'] ?? false) !== true)),
        );

        sort($codes);

        return $codes;
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Concurrency;

use App\Enums\PaymentType;
use App\Exceptions\BookingException;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\AppointmentStatusChangedNotification;
use App\Services\Booking\BookingData;
use App\Services\Booking\BookingService;
use App\Support\Actor;
use Illuminate\Database\QueryException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Group;
use Tests\Support\Concurrency\ConcurrencyTestCase;

/**
 * KON-01a-e (dua koneksi: PDO mentah A menahan kunci, proses anak B menjalankan BookingService::book()),
 * BKG-21 (= KON-01c, SYSTEM_BUSY) dan BKG-18 (galat driver tersimulasi di tengah book(), tanpa transaksi
 * pembungkus agar `attempts: 3` benar-benar mengulang). Tes ini ikut suite bawaan; `--exclude-group=concurrency`
 * melewatinya untuk putaran cepat.
 */
#[Group('concurrency')]
class BookingConcurrencyTest extends ConcurrencyTestCase
{
    private function service(): BookingService
    {
        return $this->app->make(BookingService::class);
    }

    private function actorOf(PatientProfile $profile): Actor
    {
        return Actor::patient(User::query()->findOrFail($profile->user_id));
    }

    private function attemptBooking(PatientProfile $profile, int $sessionId): Appointment
    {
        return $this->service()->book($profile, $sessionId, new BookingData(PaymentType::Umum), $this->actorOf($profile));
    }

    private function bookingFailure(PatientProfile $profile, int $sessionId): BookingException
    {
        try {
            $this->attemptBooking($profile, $sessionId);
        } catch (BookingException $e) {
            return $e;
        }

        $this->fail('BookingException tidak dilempar.');
    }

    /** Tidak ada appointment, riwayat, audit `appointment.created`, dan pencacah sesi tetap 0. */
    private function assertNoPartialWrites(PracticeSession $session): void
    {
        $fresh = PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($session->id);

        $this->assertSame(0, (int) $fresh->booked_count);
        $this->assertSame(0, (int) $fresh->last_queue_number);
        $this->assertSame(0, Appointment::query()->where('practice_session_id', $session->id)->count());
        $this->assertSame(0, $this->rowsSince('appointment_status_histories'));
        $this->assertSame(0, $this->rowsSince('audit_logs', 'appointment.created'));
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ KON-01: dua koneksi

    public function test_kon_01a_a_waiting_booking_gets_quota_full_after_the_lock_holder_takes_the_last_seat(): void
    {
        $session = $this->makeSession(1);
        $holder = $this->makePatient();
        $waiter = $this->makePatient();
        $a = $this->openConnection(1);
        $startAt = $this->barrier();

        $locked = $this->beginAndLock($a, $holder->id, $session->id);
        $process = $this->spawn('book', ['patient' => $waiter->id, 'session' => $session->id], $startAt);

        $this->waitUntil($startAt + 1.5);
        $this->assertTrue($process->isRunning(), 'Proses B harus masih menunggu kunci sesi yang ditahan A.');

        $this->rawBook($a, $holder->id, $locked);
        $releaseAt = microtime(true);
        $a->commit();

        $result = $this->gather([$process])[0];

        $this->assertFalse($result['ok'], json_encode($result));
        $this->assertSame('QUOTA_FULL', $result['code']);
        $this->assertLessThan($releaseAt, $result['begin'], 'Proses B terlambat boot: naikkan BARRIER_BASE.');
        $this->assertGreaterThanOrEqual($releaseAt - 0.05, $result['end'], 'B selesai sebelum A melepas kunci: kunci sesi tidak menyerialisasi.');

        $this->assertSame(1, Appointment::query()->where('practice_session_id', $session->id)->count());
        $this->assertSame($holder->id, (int) Appointment::query()->where('practice_session_id', $session->id)->value('patient_profile_id'));
        $this->assertSessionIsConsistent($session);
    }

    public function test_kon_01b_a_waiting_booking_succeeds_when_the_lock_holder_rolls_back(): void
    {
        $session = $this->makeSession(1);
        $holder = $this->makePatient();
        $waiter = $this->makePatient();
        $a = $this->openConnection(1);
        $startAt = $this->barrier();

        $locked = $this->beginAndLock($a, $holder->id, $session->id);
        $process = $this->spawn('book', ['patient' => $waiter->id, 'session' => $session->id], $startAt);

        $this->waitUntil($startAt + 1.5);
        $this->assertTrue($process->isRunning(), 'Proses B harus masih menunggu kunci sesi yang ditahan A.');

        $this->rawBook($a, $holder->id, $locked);
        $releaseAt = microtime(true);
        $a->rollBack();

        $result = $this->gather([$process])[0];

        $this->assertTrue($result['ok'], json_encode($result));
        $this->assertSame(1, $result['queue']);
        $this->assertLessThan($releaseAt, $result['begin'], 'Proses B terlambat boot: naikkan BARRIER_BASE.');
        $this->assertGreaterThanOrEqual($releaseAt - 0.05, $result['end'], 'B selesai sebelum A melepas kunci.');

        $this->assertSame($waiter->id, (int) Appointment::query()->where('practice_session_id', $session->id)->value('patient_profile_id'));
        $this->assertSessionIsConsistent($session);
        $this->assertSame(1, (int) PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($session->id)->booked_count);
    }

    public function test_kon_01d_the_patient_lock_is_the_first_statement_and_serialises_the_same_patient(): void
    {
        $session = $this->makeSession(3);
        $patient = $this->makePatient();
        $a = $this->openConnection(1);
        $c = $this->openConnection(1);
        $startAt = $this->barrier();

        $a->beginTransaction();
        $this->lockRow($a, 'patient_profiles', $patient->id);
        $process = $this->spawn('book', ['patient' => $patient->id, 'session' => $session->id], $startAt);

        $this->waitUntil($startAt + 1.5);
        $this->assertTrue($process->isRunning(), 'Proses B harus menunggu kunci profil pasien.');

        // B menunggu kunci PROFIL dan belum menyentuh baris sesi: koneksi lain masih dapat mengunci sesi tanpa menunggu.
        $c->beginTransaction();
        $this->lockRow($c, 'practice_sessions', $session->id);
        $c->rollBack();

        $releaseAt = microtime(true);
        $a->rollBack();

        $result = $this->gather([$process])[0];

        $this->assertTrue($result['ok'], json_encode($result));
        $this->assertSame(1, $result['queue']);
        $this->assertLessThan($releaseAt, $result['begin'], 'Proses B terlambat boot: naikkan BARRIER_BASE.');
        $this->assertGreaterThanOrEqual($releaseAt - 0.05, $result['end'], 'B selesai sebelum A melepas kunci profil.');
        $this->assertSessionIsConsistent($session);
    }

    public function test_kon_01e_a_waiting_booking_sees_the_session_status_written_by_the_lock_holder(): void
    {
        $session = $this->makeSession(3);
        $holder = $this->makePatient();
        $waiter = $this->makePatient();
        $a = $this->openConnection(1);
        $startAt = $this->barrier();

        $this->beginAndLock($a, $holder->id, $session->id);
        $process = $this->spawn('book', ['patient' => $waiter->id, 'session' => $session->id], $startAt);

        $this->waitUntil($startAt + 1.5);
        $this->assertTrue($process->isRunning(), 'Proses B harus masih menunggu kunci sesi yang ditahan A.');

        // Seperti ScheduleChangeService: sesi dibatalkan sementara A menahan kunci.
        $a->prepare("UPDATE practice_sessions SET status = 'cancelled', status_reason = 'Uji konkurensi' WHERE id = ?")->execute([$session->id]);
        $a->commit();

        $result = $this->gather([$process])[0];

        $this->assertFalse($result['ok'], json_encode($result));
        $this->assertSame('SESSION_UNAVAILABLE', $result['code']);
        $this->assertNoPartialWrites($session);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ BKG-21 = KON-01c

    public function test_kon_01c_and_bkg_21_system_busy_when_the_session_lock_outlasts_three_attempts(): void
    {
        Notification::fake();
        $session = $this->makeSession(3);
        $profile = $this->makePatient();
        $holder = $this->openConnection(1);

        $this->beginAndLock($holder, $this->makePatient()->id, $session->id);
        DB::statement('SET SESSION innodb_lock_wait_timeout = 1');

        // precheck() tidak mengunci dan tidak menulis: selesai seketika walau baris sesi sedang terkunci.
        $startedAt = microtime(true);
        $this->service()->precheck($profile, PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($session->id), new BookingData(PaymentType::Umum), $this->actorOf($profile));
        $this->assertLessThan(0.9, microtime(true) - $startedAt, 'precheck() menunggu kunci: ia tidak boleh mengunci.');

        $startedAt = microtime(true);
        $e = $this->bookingFailure($profile, $session->id);
        $elapsed = microtime(true) - $startedAt;

        $this->assertSame('SYSTEM_BUSY', $e->errorCode);
        $this->assertSame('Sistem sedang sibuk, silakan coba lagi beberapa saat.', $e->getMessage());
        $this->assertGreaterThanOrEqual(2.0, $elapsed, 'Tiga percobaan x timeout 1 detik: terlalu cepat berarti tidak diulang.');
        $this->assertLessThan(20.0, $elapsed);

        $this->assertNoPartialWrites($session);
        Notification::assertNothingSent();

        // Setelah kunci dilepas, booking yang sama berhasil.
        $holder->rollBack();
        $appointment = $this->attemptBooking($profile, $session->id);

        $this->assertSame(1, $appointment->queue_number);
        $this->assertSessionIsConsistent($session);
        Notification::assertSentToTimes(User::query()->findOrFail($profile->user_id), AppointmentStatusChangedNotification::class, 1);
    }
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Tulis tes (tool Write) `tests/Feature/Concurrency/BookingParallelProcessesTest.php`**

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Concurrency;

use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Enums\ExceptionType;
use App\Enums\SessionStatus;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Models\ScheduleException;
use App\Services\Doctors\DoctorService;
use App\Services\Scheduling\ScheduleChangeReport;
use App\Services\Scheduling\ScheduleChangeService;
use App\Support\Actor;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Database\ConcurrencyErrorDetector;
use Illuminate\Database\DeadlockException;
use Illuminate\Database\QueryException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Group;
use Tests\Support\Concurrency\ConcurrencyTestCase;

/**
 * KON-02a/b/c, KON-03, KON-04 (N proses PHP paralel memanggil BookingService/AppointmentStatusService lewat
 * tests/Support/Concurrency/book-session.php) dan carry fase 3 (booking versus ScheduleChangeService dan
 * DoctorService::archive bersamaan). Semua baris ter-commit dan dibersihkan ConcurrencyTestCase.
 */
#[Group('concurrency')]
class BookingParallelProcessesTest extends ConcurrencyTestCase
{
    /**
     * @param  list<array<string, mixed>>  $results
     */
    private function assertEverythingWrittenExactlyForTheWinners(PracticeSession $session, array $results): void
    {
        $winners = $this->successes($results);
        $count = count($winners);
        $queues = array_map(fn (array $result): int => (int) $result['queue'], $winners);
        sort($queues);

        $this->assertSame($count === 0 ? [] : range(1, $count), $queues, 'Antrean yang diberikan harus 1..sukses tanpa duplikat.');
        $this->assertSame($count, Appointment::query()->where('practice_session_id', $session->id)->count());
        $this->assertSame($count, (int) PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($session->id)->booked_count);
        $this->assertSame($count, (int) PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($session->id)->last_queue_number);
        $this->assertSame($count, $this->rowsSince('appointment_status_histories'));
        $this->assertSame($count, $this->rowsSince('audit_logs', 'appointment.created'));
        $this->assertSame($count, $this->notificationsSince());
        $this->assertSessionIsConsistent($session);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ KON-02

    public function test_kon_02a_many_patients_on_one_session_never_exceed_the_quota(): void
    {
        $quota = 3;
        $count = 8;
        $session = $this->makeSession($quota);
        $startAt = $this->barrier($count);

        $processes = [];

        foreach ($this->makePatients($count) as $patient) {
            $processes[] = $this->spawn('book', ['patient' => $patient->id, 'session' => $session->id], $startAt);
        }

        $results = $this->gather($processes);

        $this->assertNoInfrastructureErrors($results);
        $this->assertCount($quota, $this->successes($results));
        $this->assertSame(array_fill(0, $count - $quota, 'QUOTA_FULL'), $this->failureCodes($results));
        $this->assertEverythingWrittenExactlyForTheWinners($session, $results);
    }

    public function test_kon_02b_the_last_seat_goes_to_exactly_one_of_many(): void
    {
        $count = 6;
        $session = $this->makeSession(1);
        $startAt = $this->barrier($count);

        $processes = [];

        foreach ($this->makePatients($count) as $patient) {
            $processes[] = $this->spawn('book', ['patient' => $patient->id, 'session' => $session->id], $startAt);
        }

        $results = $this->gather($processes);

        $this->assertNoInfrastructureErrors($results);
        $this->assertCount(1, $this->successes($results));
        $this->assertSame(1, $this->successes($results)[0]['queue']);
        $this->assertSame(array_fill(0, $count - 1, 'QUOTA_FULL'), $this->failureCodes($results));
        $this->assertEverythingWrittenExactlyForTheWinners($session, $results);
    }

    public function test_kon_02c_stress_is_opt_in_and_still_never_exceeds_the_quota(): void
    {
        if (getenv('KON_STRESS') !== '1') {
            $this->markTestSkipped('KON-02c adalah uji beban manual: jalankan dengan $env:KON_STRESS = "1".');
        }

        $quota = 10;
        $count = 50;
        $session = $this->makeSession($quota);
        $startAt = $this->barrier($count);

        $processes = [];

        foreach ($this->makePatients($count) as $patient) {
            $processes[] = $this->spawn('book', ['patient' => $patient->id, 'session' => $session->id], $startAt);
        }

        $results = $this->gather($processes);

        $this->assertNoInfrastructureErrors($results);
        $this->assertCount($quota, $this->successes($results));
        $this->assertSame(array_fill(0, $count - $quota, 'QUOTA_FULL'), $this->failureCodes($results));
        $this->assertEverythingWrittenExactlyForTheWinners($session, $results);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ KON-03

    public function test_kon_03_the_same_patient_clicking_many_times_creates_exactly_one_active_appointment(): void
    {
        $count = 6;
        $session = $this->makeSession(10);
        $patient = $this->makePatient();
        $startAt = $this->barrier($count);

        $processes = [];

        for ($i = 0; $i < $count; $i++) {
            $processes[] = $this->spawn('book', ['patient' => $patient->id, 'session' => $session->id], $startAt);
        }

        $results = $this->gather($processes);

        $this->assertNoInfrastructureErrors($results);
        $this->assertCount(1, $this->successes($results));
        $this->assertSame(array_fill(0, $count - 1, 'DUPLICATE_BOOKING'), $this->failureCodes($results));
        $this->assertSame(1, Appointment::query()->where('patient_profile_id', $patient->id)->where('practice_session_id', $session->id)->active()->count());
        $this->assertEverythingWrittenExactlyForTheWinners($session, $results);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ KON-04

    public function test_kon_04_cancellations_racing_new_bookings_keep_the_counters_exact_and_never_reuse_a_queue_number(): void
    {
        $session = $this->makeSession(2);
        $holders = $this->makePatients(2);
        $first = $this->bookAppointment($session, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, ['patient_profile_id' => $holders[0]->id]);
        $second = $this->bookAppointment($session, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, ['patient_profile_id' => $holders[1]->id]);
        $bookers = $this->makePatients(5);
        $startAt = $this->barrier(7);

        $cancels = [];
        $books = [];

        foreach ([[$first, $holders[0]], [$second, $holders[1]]] as [$appointment, $holder]) {
            $cancels[] = $this->spawn('transition', [
                'appointment' => $appointment->id,
                'to' => 'cancelled',
                'as' => 'patient',
                'actor-user' => $holder->user_id,
            ], $startAt);
        }

        foreach ($bookers as $booker) {
            $books[] = $this->spawn('book', ['patient' => $booker->id, 'session' => $session->id], $startAt);
        }

        $cancelResults = $this->gather($cancels);
        $bookResults = $this->gather($books);

        $this->assertNoInfrastructureErrors(array_merge($cancelResults, $bookResults));
        $this->assertCount(2, $this->successes($cancelResults), 'Kedua pembatalan pemilik harus berhasil: '.json_encode($cancelResults));

        $won = $this->successes($bookResults);

        $this->assertLessThanOrEqual(2, count($won), 'Pemesan baru tidak boleh melebihi kuota 2.');
        $this->assertSame(array_fill(0, 5 - count($won), 'QUOTA_FULL'), $this->failureCodes($bookResults));

        foreach ($won as $result) {
            $this->assertGreaterThanOrEqual(3, $result['queue'], 'Nomor antrean 1 dan 2 sudah pernah dipakai dan tidak boleh dipakai ulang.');
        }

        $fresh = PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($session->id);

        $this->assertSame(count($won), (int) $fresh->booked_count);
        $this->assertSame(2 + count($won), (int) $fresh->last_queue_number);
        $this->assertSame(2, Appointment::query()->where('practice_session_id', $session->id)->where('status', AppointmentStatus::Cancelled->value)->count());
        $this->assertSessionIsConsistent($session);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ carry fase 3

    public function test_carry_f3_bookings_racing_a_leave_exception_never_leave_an_active_appointment_on_a_cancelled_session(): void
    {
        $doctor = Doctor::factory()->create();
        $staff = $this->makeStaff();
        $days = range(1, 5);
        $sessions = [];
        $processes = [];
        $startAt = $this->barrier(count($days));

        foreach ($days as $day) {
            $sessions[$day] = $this->makeSession(3, [
                'doctor_id' => $doctor->id,
                'clinic_id' => $doctor->clinic_id,
                'session_date' => today()->addDays($day)->toDateString(),
            ]);
            $processes[$day] = $this->spawn('book', ['patient' => $this->makePatient()->id, 'session' => $sessions[$day]->id], $startAt, 10);
        }

        $this->waitUntil($startAt);

        $report = null;

        try {
            // Seperti ScheduleExceptionController@store: pengecualian dibuat dan diterapkan dalam satu transaksi.
            $report = DB::transaction(function () use ($doctor, $staff): ScheduleChangeReport {
                $exception = ScheduleException::query()->create([
                    'doctor_id' => $doctor->id,
                    'type' => ExceptionType::DoctorLeave,
                    'start_date' => today()->addDay()->toDateString(),
                    'end_date' => today()->addDays(5)->toDateString(),
                    'reason' => 'Uji konkurensi',
                ]);

                return $this->app->make(ScheduleChangeService::class)->applyException($exception, null, Actor::staff($staff));
            });
        } catch (QueryException|DeadlockException $e) {
            // Korban siklus kunci (lihat Catatan teknis no. 7a): sah untuk invarian data, tetapi dicatat sebagai temuan.
            $this->assertTrue($this->app->make(ConcurrencyErrorDetector::class)->causedByConcurrencyError($e), $e->getMessage());
        }

        $results = array_combine($days, $this->gather(array_values($processes)));

        $this->assertNoInfrastructureErrors(array_values($results));

        if ($report !== null) {
            $this->assertSame(5, $report->cancelled + $report->needsReview, 'Kelima sesi tercakup pengecualian.');
        }

        foreach ($days as $day) {
            $fresh = PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($sessions[$day]->id);
            $active = Appointment::query()->where('practice_session_id', $fresh->id)->active()->count();

            if ($report === null) {
                // Transaksi jadwal dibatalkan seluruhnya: tidak boleh ada sesi cancelled yang memuat appointment aktif.
                $this->assertFalse($fresh->status === SessionStatus::Cancelled && $active > 0, "Sesi hari +{$day} cancelled tetapi memuat appointment aktif.");
            } elseif ($active > 0) {
                $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::NeedsReview, $fresh->status, "Sesi hari +{$day} punya appointment aktif sehingga harus needs_review.");
                $this->assertTrue($results[$day]['ok'], json_encode($results[$day]));
            } else {
                $this->assertSame(SessionStatus::Cancelled, $fresh->status, "Sesi hari +{$day} tanpa appointment aktif harus cancelled.");
                $this->assertSame('SESSION_UNAVAILABLE', $results[$day]['code'] ?? null, json_encode($results[$day]));
            }

            $this->assertSessionIsConsistent($fresh);
        }
    }

    public function test_carry_f3_bookings_racing_a_doctor_archive_never_leave_an_archived_doctor_with_an_active_future_appointment(): void
    {
        $doctor = Doctor::factory()->create();
        $staff = $this->makeStaff();
        $days = range(1, 4);
        $sessions = [];
        $processes = [];
        $startAt = $this->barrier(count($days));

        foreach ($days as $day) {
            $sessions[$day] = $this->makeSession(3, [
                'doctor_id' => $doctor->id,
                'clinic_id' => $doctor->clinic_id,
                'session_date' => today()->addDays($day)->toDateString(),
            ]);
            $processes[$day] = $this->spawn('book', ['patient' => $this->makePatient()->id, 'session' => $sessions[$day]->id], $startAt, 10);
        }

        $this->waitUntil($startAt);

        $outcome = 'archived';

        try {
            $this->app->make(DoctorService::class)->archive($doctor, 'Uji konkurensi', Actor::staff($staff));
        } catch (ValidationException) {
            $outcome = 'rejected';
        } catch (QueryException|DeadlockException $e) {
            // Korban siklus kunci (lihat Catatan teknis no. 7b): sah untuk invarian data, tetapi dicatat sebagai temuan.
            $this->assertTrue($this->app->make(ConcurrencyErrorDetector::class)->causedByConcurrencyError($e), $e->getMessage());
            $outcome = 'deadlock';
        }

        $results = array_combine($days, $this->gather(array_values($processes)));

        $this->assertNoInfrastructureErrors(array_values($results));

        $isArchived = $doctor->fresh()->archived_at !== null;
        $this->assertSame($outcome === 'archived', $isArchived, "Hasil arsip '{$outcome}' tidak sesuai status dokter.");

        $upcomingActive = Appointment::query()->where('doctor_id', $doctor->id)->upcomingActive()->count();

        if ($isArchived) {
            $this->assertSame(0, $upcomingActive, 'Dokter terarsip tidak boleh memiliki appointment aktif mendatang.');
            $this->assertSame([], $this->successes(array_values($results)), 'Booking yang sukses berarti arsip seharusnya ditolak.');
        } else {
            $this->assertSame(
                0,
                PracticeSession::query()->where('doctor_id', $doctor->id)->where('status', SessionStatus::Cancelled->value)->count(),
                "Arsip '{$outcome}' harus tidak meninggalkan sesi cancelled.",
            );
            $this->assertCount(4, $this->successes(array_values($results)), 'Tanpa arsip, keempat booking harus berhasil.');
        }

        foreach ($days as $day) {
            $this->assertSessionIsConsistent($sessions[$day]);
        }
    }
}
```
