- [ ] **Step 6: Tulis tes (tool Write) `tests/Feature/Concurrency/TransitionConcurrencyTest.php`**

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Concurrency;

use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Exceptions\BookingException;
use App\Exceptions\InvalidTransitionException;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\AppointmentStatusHistory;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\Booking\AppointmentStatusService;
use App\Support\Actor;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Group;
use Tests\Support\Concurrency\ConcurrencyTestCase;

/**
 * KON-05 (dua petugas mentransisi appointment yang sama; tiga varian) dan pembuktian `SYSTEM_BUSY`/pengulangan
 * pada AppointmentStatusService::transition() di luar transaksi pembungkus. Sesi KON-05 = HARI INI 00.00-23.59
 * agar jendela check-in terbuka sepanjang hari pada jam asli proses anak (jangan jalankan 23.58-00.02 WIB).
 */
#[Group('concurrency')]
class TransitionConcurrencyTest extends ConcurrencyTestCase
{
    /**
     * @return array{0: PracticeSession, 1: Appointment}
     */
    private function scenario(int $appointments = 1): array
    {
        $session = $this->makeSession(5, [
            'session_date' => today()->toDateString(),
            'start_time' => '00:00:00',
            'end_time' => '23:59:00',
        ]);

        $first = null;

        for ($i = 0; $i < $appointments; $i++) {
            $created = $this->bookAppointment($session, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, ['patient_profile_id' => $this->makePatient()->id]);
            $first ??= $created;
        }

        return [$session, $first];
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, scalar>  $arguments
     */
    private function transitionArguments(Appointment $appointment, string $to, User $staff, array $arguments = []): array
    {
        return ['appointment' => $appointment->id, 'to' => $to, 'as' => 'staff', 'actor-user' => $staff->id] + $arguments;
    }

    private function statusChangedAudits(): int
    {
        return $this->rowsSince('audit_logs', 'appointment.status_changed');
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ KON-05

    public function test_kon_05a_two_staff_racing_with_expected_status_one_wins_and_the_other_is_stale(): void
    {
        [$session, $appointment] = $this->scenario();
        $first = $this->makeStaff();
        $second = $this->makeStaff();
        $startAt = $this->barrier(2);

        $checkIn = $this->spawn('transition', $this->transitionArguments($appointment, 'checked_in', $first, ['expected' => 'confirmed']), $startAt);
        $cancel = $this->spawn('transition', $this->transitionArguments($appointment, 'cancelled', $second, ['expected' => 'confirmed', 'reason' => 'Dibatalkan petugas uji']), $startAt);

        [$checkInResult, $cancelResult] = $this->gather([$checkIn, $cancel]);

        $this->assertNoInfrastructureErrors([$checkInResult, $cancelResult]);
        $this->assertCount(1, $this->successes([$checkInResult, $cancelResult]), 'Tepat satu petugas menang: '.json_encode([$checkInResult, $cancelResult]));

        $loser = $checkInResult['ok'] ? $cancelResult : $checkInResult;
        $this->assertSame('STALE_STATUS', $loser['code']);

        $this->assertFinalStateOfTheRace($appointment, $session, $checkInResult['ok'], $first, $second);
    }

    public function test_kon_05b_two_staff_racing_without_expected_status_get_a_consistent_loser(): void
    {
        [$session, $appointment] = $this->scenario();
        $first = $this->makeStaff();
        $second = $this->makeStaff();
        $startAt = $this->barrier(2);

        $checkIn = $this->spawn('transition', $this->transitionArguments($appointment, 'checked_in', $first), $startAt);
        $cancel = $this->spawn('transition', $this->transitionArguments($appointment, 'cancelled', $second, ['reason' => 'Dibatalkan petugas uji']), $startAt);

        [$checkInResult, $cancelResult] = $this->gather([$checkIn, $cancel]);

        $this->assertNoInfrastructureErrors([$checkInResult, $cancelResult]);
        $this->assertCount(1, $this->successes([$checkInResult, $cancelResult]), 'Tepat satu petugas menang: '.json_encode([$checkInResult, $cancelResult]));

        if ($checkInResult['ok']) {
            // Check-in menang: membatalkan appointment yang sudah check-in tidak sah.
            $this->assertSame('INVALID_TRANSITION', $cancelResult['code']);
        } else {
            // Pembatalan menang: status final, jadi check-in ditolak.
            $this->assertSame('ALREADY_FINAL', $checkInResult['code']);
        }

        $this->assertFinalStateOfTheRace($appointment, $session, $checkInResult['ok'], $first, $second);
    }

    public function test_kon_05c_two_staff_cancelling_the_same_appointment_release_the_seat_only_once(): void
    {
        [$session, $appointment] = $this->scenario(2);
        $first = $this->makeStaff();
        $second = $this->makeStaff();
        $startAt = $this->barrier(2);

        $one = $this->spawn('transition', $this->transitionArguments($appointment, 'cancelled', $first, ['reason' => 'Dibatalkan petugas satu']), $startAt);
        $two = $this->spawn('transition', $this->transitionArguments($appointment, 'cancelled', $second, ['reason' => 'Dibatalkan petugas dua']), $startAt);

        $results = $this->gather([$one, $two]);

        $this->assertNoInfrastructureErrors($results);
        $this->assertCount(1, $this->successes($results));
        $this->assertSame(['ALREADY_FINAL'], $this->failureCodes($results));

        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, $appointment->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame(1, (int) PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($session->id)->booked_count, 'Kuota hanya boleh dilepas satu kali (dua appointment, satu dibatalkan).');
        $this->assertSame(2, (int) PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($session->id)->last_queue_number);
        $this->assertSame(1, AppointmentStatusHistory::query()->where('appointment_id', $appointment->id)->count());
        $this->assertSame(1, $this->statusChangedAudits());
        $this->assertSessionIsConsistent($session);
    }

    /** Keadaan akhir balapan check-in versus batal: status, kuota, satu riwayat, satu audit, pencatat benar. */
    private function assertFinalStateOfTheRace(Appointment $appointment, PracticeSession $session, bool $checkInWon, User $checkInStaff, User $cancelStaff): void
    {
        $fresh = $appointment->fresh();
        $history = AppointmentStatusHistory::query()->where('appointment_id', $appointment->id)->get();

        $this->assertCount(1, $history, 'Riwayat tidak boleh ganda.');
        $this->assertSame(1, $this->statusChangedAudits());

        if ($checkInWon) {
            $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, $fresh->status);
            $this->assertNotNull($fresh->checked_in_at);
            $this->assertNull($fresh->cancelled_at);
            $this->assertSame(1, (int) PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($session->id)->booked_count);
            $this->assertSame($checkInStaff->id, (int) $history[0]->actor_user_id);
            $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, $history[0]->to_status);
        } else {
            $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, $fresh->status);
            $this->assertNull($fresh->checked_in_at);
            $this->assertSame($cancelStaff->id, (int) $fresh->cancelled_by_user_id);
            $this->assertSame(0, (int) PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($session->id)->booked_count);
            $this->assertSame($cancelStaff->id, (int) $history[0]->actor_user_id);
            $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, $history[0]->to_status);
        }

        $this->assertSessionIsConsistent($session);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ SYSTEM_BUSY dan pengulangan pada transition()

    public function test_transition_system_busy_when_the_appointment_row_stays_locked_past_three_attempts(): void
    {
        [$session, $appointment] = $this->scenario();
        $staff = $this->makeStaff();
        $holder = $this->openConnection(1);
        $holder->beginTransaction();
        $this->lockRow($holder, 'appointments', $appointment->id);
        DB::statement('SET SESSION innodb_lock_wait_timeout = 1');
        $service = $this->app->make(AppointmentStatusService::class);

        $startedAt = microtime(true);

        try {
            $service->transition($appointment, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, Actor::staff($staff), 'Dibatalkan petugas uji');
            $this->fail('BookingException SYSTEM_BUSY tidak dilempar.');
        } catch (BookingException $e) {
            $this->assertNotInstanceOf(InvalidTransitionException::class, $e);
            $this->assertSame('SYSTEM_BUSY', $e->errorCode);
            $this->assertSame('Sistem sedang sibuk, silakan coba lagi beberapa saat.', $e->getMessage());
        }

        $this->assertGreaterThanOrEqual(2.0, microtime(true) - $startedAt, 'Tiga percobaan x timeout 1 detik.');

        $fresh = $appointment->fresh();
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $fresh->status);
        $this->assertSame(1, (int) PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($session->id)->booked_count);
        $this->assertSame(0, $this->rowsSince('appointment_status_histories'));
        $this->assertSame(0, $this->statusChangedAudits());

        $holder->rollBack();
        $service->transition($appointment, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, Actor::staff($staff), 'Dibatalkan petugas uji');

        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, $appointment->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame(0, (int) PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($session->id)->booked_count);
    }

    public function test_transition_retries_a_transient_deadlock_and_gives_up_after_three_attempts(): void
    {
        [$session, $appointment] = $this->scenario(2);
        $staff = $this->makeStaff();
        $service = $this->app->make(AppointmentStatusService::class);

        $retry = $this->injectFault(
            'update `appointments`',
            1213,
            '40001',
            'SQLSTATE[40001]: Serialization failure: 1213 Deadlock found when trying to get lock; try restarting transaction',
            2,
        );

        $service->transition($appointment, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, Actor::staff($staff), 'Dibatalkan petugas uji');

        $this->assertSame(3, $retry->hits, 'Dua kegagalan lalu sukses pada percobaan ketiga.');
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, $appointment->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame(1, (int) PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($session->id)->booked_count, 'Kuota dilepas tepat satu kali walau diulang.');
        $this->assertSame(1, AppointmentStatusHistory::query()->where('appointment_id', $appointment->id)->count());
        $this->assertSame(1, $this->statusChangedAudits());
    }

    public function test_transition_with_a_persistent_deadlock_becomes_system_busy_without_partial_writes(): void
    {
        [$session, $appointment] = $this->scenario();
        $staff = $this->makeStaff();
        $service = $this->app->make(AppointmentStatusService::class);

        $fault = $this->injectFault(
            'update `appointments`',
            1213,
            '40001',
            'SQLSTATE[40001]: Serialization failure: 1213 Deadlock found when trying to get lock; try restarting transaction',
        );

        try {
            $service->transition($appointment, AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, Actor::staff($staff), 'Dibatalkan petugas uji');
            $this->fail('BookingException SYSTEM_BUSY tidak dilempar.');
        } catch (BookingException $e) {
            $this->assertSame('SYSTEM_BUSY', $e->errorCode);
        }

        $this->assertSame(3, $fault->hits);
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $appointment->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame(1, (int) PracticeSession::query()->findOrFail($session->id)->booked_count);
        $this->assertSame(0, $this->rowsSince('appointment_status_histories'));
        $this->assertSame(0, $this->statusChangedAudits());
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

/**
 * Pembantu tes konkurensi fase 6 (F6-R34). Dijalankan SEBAGAI PROSES PHP TERPISAH oleh
 * tests/Support/Concurrency/ConcurrencyTestCase::spawn(); bukan kelas tes dan tidak dimuat aplikasi.

 *   php book-session.php --op=transition --appointment=ID --to=STATUS --as=patient|staff|system
 *                        [--actor-user=USER_ID] [--reason=TEKS] [--expected=STATUS]
 *   opsi bersama: [--start-at=EPOCH.FRAK] [--lock-timeout=DETIK]
 *
 * Keluaran: SATU baris JSON pada baris terakhir stdout, mis.
 *   {"ok":true,"queue":2,"booking_code":"UPH-...","status":"pending","begin":1.7e9,"end":1.7e9}
 *   {"ok":false,"code":"QUOTA_FULL","message":"...","begin":...,"end":...}
 * `code` = kode BookingException/InvalidTransitionException; `DB_<errno>` untuk QueryException tak terduga;
 * `EXC_<kelas>` untuk pengecualian lain. Kode keluar 0 untuk semua hasil domain; 3 bila lingkungan bukan
 * database uji (pagar keamanan: tidak pernah menulis ke database selain `*_test`).

use Illuminate\Database\QueryException;

use Tests\Support\DatabaseGuard;

require __DIR__.'/../../../vendor/autoload.php';

$app = require __DIR__.'/../../../bootstrap/app.php';
$app->make(Kernel::class)->bootstrap();

try {
    if (! $app->environment('testing')) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Skrip ini hanya boleh berjalan dengan APP_ENV=testing.');
    }

    DatabaseGuard::assertIsTestDatabase((string) DB::connection()->getDatabaseName());
} catch (Throwable $e) {

}

$options = getopt('', [
    'op:',
    'patient:',
    'session:',
    'appointment:',
    'to:',
    'as::',
    'actor-user::',
    'reason::',
    'expected::',
    'start-at::',
    'lock-timeout::',
]);

$emit = static function (array $payload): void {
    echo json_encode($payload, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES).PHP_EOL;
};

$begin = null;

try {
    if (isset($options['lock-timeout'])) {
        DB::statement('SET SESSION innodb_lock_wait_timeout = '.max(1, (int) $options['lock-timeout']));
    }

    // Koneksi dibuka dan service dimuat SEBELUM penghalang agar waktu setelahnya hanya milik operasi.
    DB::connection()->getPdo();

    $operation = (string) ($options['op'] ?? 'book');
    $as = (string) ($options['as'] ?? 'patient');

    if ($operation === 'book') {
        $service = $app->make(BookingService::class);
        $profile = PatientProfile::query()->with('user')->findOrFail((int) $options['patient']);
        $sessionId = (int) $options['session'];
        $actor = $as === 'staff'
            ? Actor::staff(User::query()->findOrFail((int) $options['actor-user']))
            : Actor::patient($profile->user);

        $action = static function () use ($service, $profile, $sessionId, $actor): array {
            $appointment = $service->book($profile, $sessionId, new BookingData(PaymentType::Umum), $actor);

            return [
                'queue' => $appointment->queue_number,
                'booking_code' => $appointment->booking_code,
                'status' => $appointment->status->value,
            ];
        };
    } elseif ($operation === 'transition') {
        $service = $app->make(AppointmentStatusService::class);
        $appointment = Appointment::query()->findOrFail((int) $options['appointment']);
        $to = AppointmentStatus::from((string) $options['to']);
        $expected = isset($options['expected']) ? AppointmentStatus::from((string) $options['expected']) : null;
        $reason = isset($options['reason']) ? (string) $options['reason'] : null;
        $actor = match ($as) {
            'staff' => Actor::staff(User::query()->findOrFail((int) $options['actor-user'])),
            'system' => Actor::system(),
            default => Actor::patient(User::query()->findOrFail((int) $options['actor-user'])),
        };

        $action = static function () use ($service, $appointment, $to, $actor, $reason, $expected): array {
            $updated = $service->transition($appointment, $to, $actor, $reason, $expected);

            return ['status' => $updated->status->value];
        };
    } else {
        throw new InvalidArgumentException("Operasi tidak dikenal: {$operation}.");
    }

    $startAt = (float) ($options['start-at'] ?? 0);

    while (microtime(true) < $startAt) {
        usleep(500);
    }

    $begin = microtime(true);
    $payload = $action();

    $emit(['ok' => true] + $payload + ['begin' => $begin, 'end' => microtime(true)]);
} catch (BookingException $e) {
    $emit(['ok' => false, 'code' => $e->errorCode, 'message' => $e->getMessage(), 'begin' => $begin, 'end' => microtime(true)]);
} catch (QueryException $e) {
    $emit(['ok' => false, 'code' => 'DB_'.($e->errorInfo[1] ?? 'ERR'), 'message' => $e->getMessage(), 'begin' => $begin, 'end' => microtime(true)]);
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    $emit(['ok' => false, 'code' => 'EXC_'.(new ReflectionClass($e))->getShortName(), 'message' => $e->getMessage(), 'begin' => $begin, 'end' => microtime(true)]);
}
```

#### Catatan penulis (konteks untuk implementer dan reviewer)

1. **Tambahan di luar daftar berkas kerangka C.2 (hanya tes/pembantu, tidak ada kode produksi):** `tests/Support/Concurrency/ConcurrencyTestCase.php` (kelas dasar agar tiga berkas tes tidak menyalin pembersihan dan pembantu proses) dan opsi `--op=transition` pada `book-session.php` (KON-04 dan KON-05 membutuhkan proses yang menjalankan `transition()`; satu skrip lebih sederhana daripada dua). Nama berkas skrip tetap `book-session.php` sesuai kerangka.
2. **Bergantung pada kontrak T4/T5 yang tidak terlihat dari sini:** (a) `BookingService` menerjemahkan `UniqueConstraintViolationException` menurut NAMA INDEKS pada pesan galat (`appointments_patient_session_active_unique`, `appointments_booking_code_unique`, `appointments_practice_session_id_queue_number_unique`) dan `QueryException` 4025/3819 + `chk_sessions_quota` menurut `errorInfo[1]` dan nama constraint; CHECK lain dilempar ulang sebagai `QueryException`; (b) `INSERT INTO appointments` dicoba tepat 3 kali pada galat 1205/1213 yang menetap dan tepat 2 kali setelah satu 1062 `booking_code`/`queue_number`; (c) `AppointmentNotifier::statusChanged` mengirim satu notifikasi `database` saat pendaftaran (KON-02a menghitung `notifications` = jumlah sukses). Bila T4 menyimpang dari salah satunya, ubah ASERSI TES hanya setelah koordinator menyetujui perubahan kontrak, karena angka-angka itu berasal dari F6-R13.
3. **Temuan yang mungkin muncul saat dieksekusi (laporkan, jangan sembunyikan):** (i) deadlock antara booking dan `ScheduleChangeService::applyException` bila yang menjadi korban justru transaksi jadwal (hitungan `FOR UPDATE` pada `appointments` mengunci gap/supremum indeks `(practice_session_id, queue_number)`; Catatan teknis no. 7a); (ii) `DoctorService::archive` sebagai korban siklus kunci dengan booking (galat 1213 tanpa pengulangan, yang di aplikasi menjadi 500 bagi admin; invarian data tetap benar karena kunci bersama FK pada baris dokter membuat salah satu pihak mengalah). Keduanya adalah kandidat tugas lanjutan (pengulangan transaksi di `DoctorService`/`ScheduleChangeService`/controller admin) untuk fase 7 atau gerbang T13; tidak diperbaiki di fase 6 karena di luar cakupan F6-R34.
4. **`KON-01a` memakai `QUOTA_FULL` bila A mengambil kursi terakhir**, sedangkan 15 §6.2 menulis "kolom dari `Appointment::factory()->forSession()->raw()`": A menyisipkan baris dengan SQL mentah (`rawBook`) agar tidak bergantung pada state factory dan agar sisipan A benar-benar berjalan di dalam transaksi PDO yang menahan kunci. `KON-01c` digabung dengan `BKG-21` (satu tes in-process, deterministik, ±4 detik) karena keduanya membuktikan hal yang sama; versi proses anak dengan `--lock-timeout=1` ditiadakan untuk menghemat waktu.
5. **`KON-02c` (50 proses, kuota 10)** ada tetapi dilewati kecuali `$env:KON_STRESS = "1"` (stres manual, tidak ikut suite bawaan); 50 proses di Windows membutuhkan `max_connections` ≥ 60 (bawaan XAMPP 151 cukup) dan ±25-30 detik.
6. **Putaran cepat tanpa konkurensi:** `& $PHP artisan test --exclude-group=concurrency` (suite sisanya) dan `& $PHP artisan test --group=concurrency` (hanya bab ini); gerbang T13 menjalankan suite penuh yang SUDAH memuat bab ini (tambahan ±1,5 menit dari total ±25-42 menit).
7. **Pembersihan data bila sebuah tes mati di tengah jalan** (mis. `Ctrl+C`): baris yang ter-commit dibersihkan oleh `migrate:fresh` pada awal proses PHPUnit berikutnya (`RefreshDatabase` pertama), jadi tidak ada intervensi manual; proses anak yang tertinggal berhenti sendiri karena `timeout` 90 detik atau saat koneksinya terputus.

**Test IDs:** AKS-01/AKS-03 (sisi #29: tamu → `/masuk`, staf → `admin.dashboard`, JSON 403), AKS-07 asli (D-151), VAL-09 (V-09 query rusak: larik, tak ada, nonaktif, di luar jendela), JDW-12/CRD-02 (wizard memakai `DoctorAvailabilityQuery` yang sama, tanpa kueri jadwal kedua), JDW-03/JDW-04 (sesi cuti/penuh/tutup tampil nonaktif dengan alasan), EMP-04 (dashboard: tombol "Daftar Kunjungan"), ERR-05 (handler `BookingException` bukan 500), SEK-11/SEK-12 (sisi flash: `bpjs_number`/`policy_number`/`payment_reference` tidak pernah di-flash), SEK-15 (nama/keluhan ter-escape di langkah 4), Review Focus 3 (tamu/staf/IDOR sisi wizard), Review Focus 4 (wizard dirusak: query larik/tak ada/nonaktif, `?sesi=` penuh/tutup/lewat), Review Focus 5 (sisi flash).

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
- **Jadwal = satu sumber.** Semua langkah memakai `DoctorAvailabilityQuery`: langkah 1 `sessions(new AvailabilityFilter)` dikelompokkan menurut `clinic_id`; langkah 2 `sessions(AvailabilityFilter(clinicId))` dikelompokkan menurut `doctor_id`; langkah 3 `sessions(AvailabilityFilter(clinicId, doctorId))` dikelompokkan menurut tanggal; `?sesi=` memakai `forSession()`. `sessions()` sudah membuang sesi `Past`, memuat `doctor.specialties`, `doctor.media`, `clinic`, `exception`, dan hanya mengambil dokter `publiclyVisible`. Kelayakan memilih = `SessionAvailability::isBookableOnline` (hasil `classify()`); aturan F.5 lengkap tetap di `precheck`/`book` (T4/T8). Tidak ada kueri `practice_sessions` kedua di controller selain `find` sesi pada `?sesi=`.
- **`session()->now('warning', …)`** dipakai untuk pesan "Sesi yang dipilih tidak dapat dipesan: {label}." (F6-R18) karena respons ini adalah 200 (bukan redirect); `x-flash-alert` di `layouts.public` membaca `session('warning')` dan `now()` terbaca di permintaan yang sama (pola `ListFilterRequest`).
- **Tanggal validasi V-09 dihitung eksplisit.** `after_or_equal:today` memakai `strtotime` waktu nyata dan mengabaikan `travelTo`; karena itu aturan memakai `CarbonImmutable::today()->toDateString()` dan `today + windowDays`. `bail` di depan tiap aturan agar nilai larik tidak sampai ke `exists`/`date_format`.
- **`failedValidation` melempar `HttpResponseException`** (redirect `create` tanpa query + flash `warning`): kegagalan V-09 tidak pernah 500 dan tidak pernah mengulang query rusak. Redirect ke `create` polos tidak bisa berulang (tanpa query tidak ada aturan yang dilanggar).
- **`Route::has('patient.appointments.review')`** di `_step-data` menjaga T7 tetap hijau sebelum T8 menambah route (pola D-21 yang sama dengan menu navigasi). Guard dibuang oleh T8 (Edit `_step-data.blade.php` menjadi `route('patient.appointments.review')` langsung, K78 #7).
- **Ringkasan galat di langkah 3.** `_step-session` memuat `<x-form.errors-summary />` tepat sesudah `@endphp` pembuka agar galat `precheck` (mis. `QUOTA_FULL`, `OUTSIDE_WINDOW`) pada `practice_session_id` terlihat (K78 #6); ringkasan hanya tampil bila ada `$errors`, `aria-current="step"` tetap satu. Tautan detail/riwayat untuk `DUPLICATE_BOOKING`/`ACTIVE_LIMIT_REACHED` pada jalur validasi ditunda (dicatat di T13).
- **Strict mode.** `$request->user()->loadMissing('patientProfile')` aman; semua relasi sesi dimuat oleh `sessions()`/`forSession()`; `Doctor` tambahan (tanpa sesi) dimuat dengan `with(['specialties', 'media'])`; spesialisasi nonaktif disaring lewat `setRelation` (E12/D-56). `Clinic::code` hanya punya mutator `set`, pembacaan atribut mentah tetap berjalan (dipakai view admin yang ada).
- **`BookingRedirect` dan route yang belum ada.** `patient.appointments.show` baru ada di T8 dan `index` di T9; `BookingRedirect` memakai `Route::has(...)` dengan cadangan `patient.dashboard` agar tidak melempar `RouteNotFoundException`. Tes unit mendaftarkan route palsu hanya bila route asli belum ada (pola `fakeRoute` yang ada); cabang cadangan sendiri tidak diuji karena begitu T9 selesai ia tidak terjangkau.
- **Handler dan urutan.** `BookingException` bukan `HttpExceptionInterface`, jadi callback `render` yang sudah ada tidak menyentuhnya; callback baru diletakkan sebelum callback HTTP. `dontReport` mencakup subkelas (`InvalidTransitionException`). `withInput($request->except(SensitiveInput::FIELDS))` dipakai eksplisit (redirect biasa tidak menyaring `dontFlash`).
- **`AppointmentPolicy`.** `Response::denyAsNotFound()` (Laravel 12, `Illuminate\Auth\Access\Response`) membuat `AuthorizationException` berstatus 404 → halaman `errors.404` yang sama dengan kode tak ada (BR-54). Policy memakai `loadMissing('patientProfile')` pada `Appointment` dan `User` (aman di mode ketat). Super Admin lolos `Gate::before`.

Write `tests/Unit/Support/BookingRedirectTest.php`:

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Unit\Support;

use App\Exceptions\BookingException;
use App\Exceptions\InvalidTransitionException;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Support\BookingRedirect;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Routing\Route as RoutingRoute;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithMasterData;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * F6-R10: tujuan pengalihan per kode `BookingException` (tidak pernah back()). Route `show` (T8) dan `index` (T9)
 * didaftarkan sebagai route palsu hanya bila route asli belum ada, sehingga tes tetap valid sesudah T8/T9.
 */
class BookingRedirectTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithMasterData;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private const CODE = 'UPH-7K3M-9QWA';

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-05 07:00:00');

        if (! Route::has('patient.appointments.show')) {
            Route::middleware('web')->get('/_uji/pasien/pendaftaran/{appointment}', fn () => 'x')->name('patient.appointments.show');
        }

        if (! Route::has('patient.appointments.index')) {
            Route::middleware('web')->get('/_uji/pasien/pendaftaran', fn () => 'x')->name('patient.appointments.index');
        }

        Route::getRoutes()->refreshNameLookups();
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $input
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $routeParameters
     */
    private function requestOn(string $routeName, array $input = [], array $routeParameters = []): Request
    {
        $uri = '/uji'.implode('', array_map(fn (string $name): string => '/{'.$name.'}', array_keys($routeParameters)));
        $path = '/uji'.str_repeat('/x', count($routeParameters));
        $route = (new RoutingRoute(['POST'], $uri, fn () => 'ok'))->name($routeName);
        $request = Request::create($path, 'POST', $input);
        $route->bind($request);

        foreach ($routeParameters as $name => $value) {
            $route->setParameter($name, $value);
        }

        $request->setRouteResolver(fn () => $route);
        $this->app->instance('request', $request);

        return $request;
    }

    /** @return array<string, array{string}> */
    public static function wizardRoutes(): array
    {
        return [
            'tinjau' => ['patient.appointments.review'],
            'simpan' => ['patient.appointments.store'],
        ];
    }

    /** @return array<string, array{string, string}> */
    public static function stepThreeCodes(): array
    {
        $cases = [];

        foreach ([BookingException::SESSION_UNAVAILABLE, BookingException::OUTSIDE_WINDOW, BookingException::CUTOFF_PASSED, BookingException::QUOTA_FULL, BookingException::OVERLAPPING_BOOKING] as $code) {
            foreach (self::wizardRoutes() as $label => [$routeName]) {
                $cases["{$code} / {$label}"] = [$code, $routeName];
            }
        }

        return $cases;
    }

    #[DataProvider('stepThreeCodes')]
    public function test_session_level_failures_return_to_step_three_of_the_same_doctor(string $code, string $routeName): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor();
        $session = $this->createSession(['doctor_id' => $doctor->id, 'clinic_id' => $doctor->clinic_id]);
        $clinic = $doctor->clinic()->firstOrFail();
        $request = $this->requestOn($routeName, ['practice_session_id' => (string) $session->id]);

        $this->assertSame(
            route('patient.appointments.create', ['poli' => $clinic->slug, 'dokter' => $doctor->slug]),
            BookingRedirect::after(BookingException::make($code), $request),
        );
    }

    #[DataProvider('wizardRoutes')]
    public function test_payment_and_busy_failures_return_to_step_four(string $routeName): void
    {
        $session = $this->createSession();
        $request = $this->requestOn($routeName, ['practice_session_id' => (string) $session->id]);

        foreach ([BookingException::INVALID_PAYMENT, BookingException::SYSTEM_BUSY] as $code) {
            $this->assertSame(
                route('patient.appointments.create', ['sesi' => (string) $session->id]),
                BookingRedirect::after(BookingException::make($code), $request),
                $code,
            );
        }
    }

    public function test_step_four_without_a_usable_session_id_falls_back_to_the_start_of_the_wizard(): void
    {
        foreach ([[], ['practice_session_id' => ['1']], ['practice_session_id' => 'abc']] as $input) {
            $request = $this->requestOn('patient.appointments.store', $input);

            $this->assertSame(
                route('patient.appointments.create'),
                BookingRedirect::after(BookingException::make(BookingException::SYSTEM_BUSY), $request),
            );
        }
    }

    #[DataProvider('wizardRoutes')]
    public function test_a_session_that_no_longer_exists_returns_to_the_start_of_the_wizard(string $routeName): void
    {
        foreach (['999999', ['1'], 'abc', ''] as $value) {
            $request = $this->requestOn($routeName, ['practice_session_id' => $value]);

            $this->assertSame(
                route('patient.appointments.create'),
                BookingRedirect::after(BookingException::make(BookingException::QUOTA_FULL), $request),
            );
        }
    }

    #[DataProvider('wizardRoutes')]
    public function test_duplicate_booking_goes_to_the_existing_appointment(string $routeName): void
    {
        $request = $this->requestOn($routeName, ['practice_session_id' => '1']);
        $exception = BookingException::make(BookingException::DUPLICATE_BOOKING, [], ['appointment_code' => self::CODE]);

        $this->assertSame(
            route('patient.appointments.show', ['appointment' => self::CODE]),
            BookingRedirect::after($exception, $request),
        );
    }

    #[DataProvider('wizardRoutes')]
    public function test_duplicate_booking_without_a_usable_code_behaves_like_a_full_session(string $routeName): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor();
        $session = $this->createSession(['doctor_id' => $doctor->id, 'clinic_id' => $doctor->clinic_id]);
        $clinic = $doctor->clinic()->firstOrFail();
        $request = $this->requestOn($routeName, ['practice_session_id' => (string) $session->id]);
        $expected = route('patient.appointments.create', ['poli' => $clinic->slug, 'dokter' => $doctor->slug]);

        foreach ([[], ['appointment_code' => '<script>'], ['appointment_code' => ['UPH-7K3M-9QWA']], ['appointment_code' => 'uph-7k3m-9qwa'], ['appointment_code' => 'UPH-7K3M-9QWI']] as $context) {
            $exception = BookingException::make(BookingException::DUPLICATE_BOOKING, [], $context);

            $this->assertSame($expected, BookingRedirect::after($exception, $request), json_encode($context));
        }
    }

    #[DataProvider('wizardRoutes')]
    public function test_active_limit_goes_to_the_history_list(string $routeName): void
    {
        $request = $this->requestOn($routeName, ['practice_session_id' => '1']);

        $this->assertSame(
            route('patient.appointments.index'),
            BookingRedirect::after(BookingException::make(BookingException::ACTIVE_LIMIT_REACHED), $request),
        );
    }

    public function test_a_failed_cancellation_returns_to_the_appointment_detail(): void
    {
        $exception = InvalidTransitionException::make('CANCEL_CUTOFF_PASSED');

        $request = $this->requestOn('patient.appointments.cancel', [], ['appointment' => self::CODE]);

        $this->assertSame(
            route('patient.appointments.show', ['appointment' => self::CODE]),
            BookingRedirect::after($exception, $request),
        );

        $appointment = new Appointment;
        $appointment->forceFill(['booking_code' => self::CODE]);
        $request = $this->requestOn('patient.appointments.cancel', [], ['appointment' => $appointment]);

        $this->assertSame(
            route('patient.appointments.show', ['appointment' => self::CODE]),
            BookingRedirect::after($exception, $request),
        );
    }

    public function test_a_cancellation_without_a_valid_code_falls_back_to_the_previous_page(): void
    {
        $request = $this->requestOn('patient.appointments.cancel', [], ['appointment' => 'bukan-kode']);
        $request->headers->set('referer', 'http://localhost/pasien');
        $this->app->instance('request', $request);

        $this->assertSame(
            'http://localhost/pasien',
            BookingRedirect::after(InvalidTransitionException::make('ALREADY_FINAL'), $request),
        );
    }

    public function test_any_other_route_goes_back_to_the_previous_page(): void
    {
        $request = $this->requestOn('patient.profile.update');
        $request->headers->set('referer', 'http://localhost/pasien/profil');
        $this->app->instance('request', $request);

        $this->assertSame(
            'http://localhost/pasien/profil',
            BookingRedirect::after(BookingException::make(BookingException::QUOTA_FULL), $request),
        );
    }
}
```

Write `tests/Feature/Errors/BookingExceptionHandlerTest.php`:

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Errors;

use App\Exceptions\BookingException;
use App\Exceptions\InvalidTransitionException;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Debug\ExceptionHandler;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use RuntimeException;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * ERR-05 dan F6-R7/F6-R10: `BookingException` (dan `InvalidTransitionException`) adalah penolakan bisnis. HTML dialihkan
 * dengan flash `error` dan input tanpa field sensitif, JSON dijawab 422 `{message, code}`, dan keduanya tidak dilaporkan.
 */
class BookingExceptionHandlerTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        Route::middleware('web')->post('/_uji/booking-penuh', fn () => throw BookingException::make(BookingException::QUOTA_FULL));
        Route::middleware('web')->post('/_uji/booking-transisi', fn () => throw InvalidTransitionException::make('STALE_STATUS'));
    }

    /** @return array<string, string> */
    private function payload(): array
    {
        return [
            'nama' => 'Budi',
            'payment_type' => 'bpjs',
            'password' => 'RahasiaUji1',
            'password_confirmation' => 'RahasiaUji1',
            'current_password' => 'LamaUji1',
            'bpjs_number' => '0001234567890',
            'policy_number' => 'POL-77-AB',
            'payment_reference' => 'PAY-12345',
        ];
    }

    public function test_html_requests_are_redirected_with_the_message_and_without_sensitive_input(): void
    {
        $this->from('/_uji/form')->post('/_uji/booking-penuh', $this->payload())
            ->assertRedirect('/_uji/form')
            ->assertSessionHas('error', __('booking.errors.QUOTA_FULL'))
            ->assertSessionHas('_old_input.nama', 'Budi')
            ->assertSessionHas('_old_input.payment_type', 'bpjs')
            ->assertSessionMissing('_old_input.password')
            ->assertSessionMissing('_old_input.password_confirmation')
            ->assertSessionMissing('_old_input.current_password')
            ->assertSessionMissing('_old_input.bpjs_number')
            ->assertSessionMissing('_old_input.policy_number')
            ->assertSessionMissing('_old_input.payment_reference');
    }

    public function test_the_response_is_never_a_server_error_or_a_405_redirect_target(): void
    {
        $response = $this->from('/_uji/form')->post('/_uji/booking-penuh', $this->payload());

        $this->assertSame(302, $response->getStatusCode());
    }

    public function test_json_requests_get_a_422_with_message_and_code(): void
    {
        $this->postJson('/_uji/booking-penuh', $this->payload())
            ->assertStatus(422)
            ->assertExactJson(['message' => __('booking.errors.QUOTA_FULL'), 'code' => 'QUOTA_FULL']);
    }

    public function test_invalid_transition_exceptions_follow_the_same_pipeline(): void
    {
        $this->from('/_uji/form')->post('/_uji/booking-transisi', $this->payload())
            ->assertRedirect('/_uji/form')
            ->assertSessionHas('error', __('booking.transitions.STALE_STATUS'));

        $this->postJson('/_uji/booking-transisi', $this->payload())
            ->assertStatus(422)
            ->assertExactJson(['message' => __('booking.transitions.STALE_STATUS'), 'code' => 'STALE_STATUS']);
    }

    public function test_booking_exceptions_are_not_reported_but_other_exceptions_are(): void
    {
        $handler = $this->app->make(ExceptionHandler::class);

        $this->assertFalse($handler->shouldReport(BookingException::make(BookingException::SYSTEM_BUSY)));
        $this->assertFalse($handler->shouldReport(InvalidTransitionException::make('ALREADY_FINAL')));
        $this->assertTrue($handler->shouldReport(new RuntimeException('galat sistem')));
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Patient;

use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithMasterData;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithPatients;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * F6-R16: `createOnline` (akun pasien aktif dengan profil aktif), `view` dan `cancel` (pemilik; pasien lain 404 lewat
 * `denyAsNotFound`; staf menurut izin `appointments.view`/`appointments.manage`). Status dan batas waktu tidak di Policy.
 */
class AppointmentPolicyTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithMasterData;
    use InteractsWithPatients;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private function appointmentOf(?PatientProfile $profile = null): Appointment
    {
        $session = $this->createSession();

        return $this->bookAppointment($session, AppointmentStatus::Pending, array_filter(['patient_profile_id' => $profile?->id]));
    }

    public function test_create_online_is_allowed_for_an_active_patient_with_an_active_profile(): void
    {
        $this->assertTrue(Gate::forUser($this->createPatient())->allows('createOnline', Appointment::class));
    }

    public function test_create_online_is_denied_for_an_inactive_profile_an_inactive_account_and_a_missing_profile(): void
    {
        $inactiveProfile = $this->createPatient([], ['is_active' => false]);
        $inactiveAccount = $this->createPatient(['is_active' => false]);
        $withoutProfile = User::factory()->patient()->create();

        $this->assertFalse(Gate::forUser($inactiveProfile)->allows('createOnline', Appointment::class));
        $this->assertFalse(Gate::forUser($inactiveAccount)->allows('createOnline', Appointment::class));
        $this->assertFalse(Gate::forUser($withoutProfile)->allows('createOnline', Appointment::class));
    }

    public function test_create_online_is_denied_for_staff_except_the_super_admin_gate_bypass(): void
    {
        $this->assertFalse(Gate::forUser($this->createStaff('registration-officer'))->allows('createOnline', Appointment::class));
        $this->assertFalse(Gate::forUser($this->createStaff('content-admin'))->allows('createOnline', Appointment::class));
        $this->assertTrue(Gate::forUser($this->createStaff('super-admin'))->allows('createOnline', Appointment::class), 'Gate::before meloloskan Super Admin.');
    }

    public function test_the_owner_may_view_and_cancel_the_appointment(): void
    {
        $owner = $this->createPatient();
        $appointment = $this->appointmentOf($owner->patientProfile);

        $this->assertTrue(Gate::forUser($owner)->allows('view', $appointment));
        $this->assertTrue(Gate::forUser($owner)->allows('cancel', $appointment));
    }

    public function test_another_patient_gets_a_404_style_denial_for_view_and_cancel(): void
    {
        $owner = $this->createPatient(['email' => 'pemilik@contoh.test']);
        $other = $this->createPatient(['email' => 'lain@contoh.test']);
        $appointment = $this->appointmentOf($owner->patientProfile);

        foreach (['view', 'cancel'] as $ability) {
            $response = Gate::forUser($other)->inspect($ability, $appointment);

            $this->assertTrue($response->denied(), $ability);
            $this->assertSame(404, $response->status(), $ability);
        }
    }

    public function test_a_walk_in_appointment_without_an_account_belongs_to_nobody_online(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointmentOf();
        $patient = $this->createPatient();

        $this->assertSame(404, Gate::forUser($patient)->inspect('view', $appointment)->status());
    }

    public function test_staff_follow_the_view_and_manage_permissions(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointmentOf();
        $officer = $this->createStaff('registration-officer');
        $contentAdmin = $this->createStaff('content-admin');

        $this->assertTrue(Gate::forUser($officer)->allows('view', $appointment));
        $this->assertTrue(Gate::forUser($officer)->allows('cancel', $appointment));
        $this->assertFalse(Gate::forUser($contentAdmin)->allows('view', $appointment));
        $this->assertFalse(Gate::forUser($contentAdmin)->allows('cancel', $appointment));
    }

    public function test_the_super_admin_passes_through_the_gate_before_hook(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->appointmentOf();
        $super = $this->createStaff('super-admin');

        $this->assertTrue(Gate::forUser($super)->allows('view', $appointment));
        $this->assertTrue(Gate::forUser($super)->allows('cancel', $appointment));
    }

    public function test_status_and_cutoff_are_not_policy_concerns(): void
    {
        $owner = $this->createPatient();
        $session = $this->createSession();
        $completed = $this->bookAppointment($session, AppointmentStatus::Completed, ['patient_profile_id' => $owner->patientProfile->id]);

        $this->assertTrue(Gate::forUser($owner)->allows('cancel', $completed), 'Status final ditolak oleh AppointmentStatusService (pesan spesifik), bukan Policy.');
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\View;

/**

 * `aria-current="step"`, langkah berikutnya bukan tautan, ringkasan "Langkah n dari 5" untuk layar kecil.
 */
class WizardStepsComponentTest extends TestCase
{
    /** @param  array<int, string>  $links */
    private function render(int $current, array $links = []): string
    {
        return Blade::render('<x-wizard-steps :current="$current" :links="$links" />', ['current' => $current, 'links' => $links]);
    }

    public function test_it_renders_the_five_fixed_labels_in_order_inside_a_labelled_nav(): void
    {
        $html = $this->render(1);

        $this->assertStringContainsString('<nav aria-label="Langkah pendaftaran"', $html);
        $this->assertSame(5, substr_count($html, '<li'));

        $positions = [];

        foreach (['Poliklinik', 'Dokter', 'Tanggal &amp; Sesi', 'Data Pendaftaran', 'Konfirmasi'] as $label) {
            $position = strpos($html, '>'.$label.'<', (int) end($positions));
            $this->assertNotFalse($position, $label);
            $positions[] = $position;
        }
    }

    public function test_the_current_step_is_marked_and_completed_steps_are_links(): void
    {
        $html = $this->render(3, [1 => '/a?x=1&y=2', 2 => '/b', 3 => '/c', 4 => '/d']);

        $this->assertSame(1, substr_count($html, 'aria-current="step"'));
        $this->assertStringContainsString('href="/a?x=1&amp;y=2"', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('href="/b"', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('href="/c"', $html, 'Langkah aktif bukan tautan.');
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('href="/d"', $html, 'Langkah berikutnya bukan tautan.');
        $this->assertSame(2, substr_count($html, 'Langkah selesai'));
    }

    public function test_a_completed_step_without_a_url_is_plain_text(): void
    {
        $html = $this->render(3, [1 => '/a']);

        $this->assertSame(1, substr_count($html, '<a '));
        $this->assertStringContainsString('>Dokter<', $html);
    }

    public function test_the_small_screen_summary_names_the_current_step(): void
    {
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Langkah 3 dari 5: Tanggal &amp; Sesi', $this->render(3));
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Langkah 1 dari 5: Poliklinik', $this->render(1));
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Langkah 5 dari 5: Konfirmasi', $this->render(5));
    }

    public function test_the_current_step_is_clamped_to_the_five_steps(): void
    {
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Langkah 5 dari 5: Konfirmasi', $this->render(9));
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Langkah 1 dari 5: Poliklinik', $this->render(0));
    }

    public function test_the_first_step_has_no_completed_steps_and_the_last_has_four(): void
    {
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Langkah selesai', $this->render(1, [1 => '/a']));
        $this->assertSame(4, substr_count($this->render(5, [1 => '/a', 2 => '/b', 3 => '/c', 4 => '/d']), 'Langkah selesai'));
    }
}
```

Write `app/Support/BookingRedirect.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Support;

use App\Exceptions\BookingException;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;

/**
 * Tujuan pengalihan setelah `BookingException` (F6-R10): tidak pernah `back()`, karena halaman tinjau adalah hasil
 * POST (bila di-GET menjadi 405). Penolakan pada `review`/`store` kembali ke langkah wizard yang dapat memperbaikinya;
 * penolakan pada `cancel` kembali ke detail pendaftaran; route lain kembali ke halaman sebelumnya.
 */
final class BookingRedirect
{
    private const CODE_PATTERN = '/^UPH-[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{4}-[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{4}$/';

    public static function after(BookingException $e, Request $request): string
    {
        $routeName = $request->route()?->getName();

        if (in_array($routeName, ['patient.appointments.review', 'patient.appointments.store'], true)) {
            return self::forWizard($e, $request);
        }

        if ($routeName === 'patient.appointments.cancel') {
            return self::appointment(self::routeCode($request)) ?? SafeRedirect::back($request);
        }

        return SafeRedirect::back($request);
    }

    private static function forWizard(BookingException $e, Request $request): string
    {
        return match ($e->errorCode) {
            BookingException::DUPLICATE_BOOKING => self::appointment($e->context['appointment_code'] ?? null) ?? self::stepSession($request),
            BookingException::ACTIVE_LIMIT_REACHED => self::history(),
            BookingException::INVALID_PAYMENT, BookingException::SYSTEM_BUSY => self::stepData($request),
            // SESSION_UNAVAILABLE, OUTSIDE_WINDOW, CUTOFF_PASSED, QUOTA_FULL, OVERLAPPING_BOOKING: pilih sesi lain.
            default => self::stepSession($request),
        };
    }

    /** Langkah 4 (data pendaftaran) untuk sesi yang sama; tanpa sesi yang bisa dipakai, awal wizard. */
    private static function stepData(Request $request): string
    {
        $id = self::sessionId($request);

        return $id === null
            ? route('patient.appointments.create')
            : route('patient.appointments.create', ['sesi' => (string) $id]);
    }

    /** Langkah 3 (tanggal dan sesi) untuk dokter pemilik sesi; sesi tak ditemukan: awal wizard. */
    private static function stepSession(Request $request): string
    {
        $id = self::sessionId($request);
        $session = $id === null ? null : PracticeSession::query()->with(['clinic', 'doctor'])->find($id);

        if ($session === null) {
            return route('patient.appointments.create');
        }

        return route('patient.appointments.create', ['poli' => $session->clinic->slug, 'dokter' => $session->doctor->slug]);
    }

    private static function history(): string
    {
        return Route::has('patient.appointments.index')
            ? route('patient.appointments.index')
            : route('patient.dashboard');
    }

    /** Detail pendaftaran berkode valid; `null` bila kode bukan string berpola UPH-XXXX-XXXX. */
    private static function appointment(mixed $code): ?string
    {
        if (! is_string($code) || preg_match(self::CODE_PATTERN, $code) !== 1) {
            return null;
        }

        return Route::has('patient.appointments.show')
            ? route('patient.appointments.show', ['appointment' => $code])
            : route('patient.dashboard');
    }

    private static function routeCode(Request $request): ?string
    {
        $parameter = $request->route('appointment');

        if ($parameter instanceof Appointment) {
            return $parameter->booking_code;
        }

        return is_string($parameter) ? $parameter : null;
    }

    /** `practice_session_id` hanya dipakai bila bilangan bulat positif yang wajar (nilai larik/teks diabaikan). */
    private static function sessionId(Request $request): ?int
    {
        $value = $request->input('practice_session_id');

        if (is_int($value)) {
            $value = (string) $value;
        }

        if (! is_string($value) || preg_match('/^[1-9][0-9]{0,17}$/', $value) !== 1) {
            return null;
        }

        return (int) $value;
    }
}
```

Write `app/Policies/AppointmentPolicy.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Policies;

use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\Response;

/**
 * F6-R16 / 11 §8. Pasien: hanya pemilik (`patientProfile.user_id`), selain itu 404 agar keberadaan kode tidak dapat
 * diuji (BR-54). Staf: `appointments.view` (lihat, bukti) dan `appointments.manage` (batal, dipakai fase 7). Status dan
 * batas waktu pembatalan TIDAK di sini: pesan spesifiknya datang dari AppointmentStatusService. Super Admin lolos
 * lewat Gate::before.
 */
final class AppointmentPolicy
{
    /** Boleh membuat pendaftaran online: akun pasien aktif dengan profil aktif. */
    public function createOnline(User $user): bool
    {
        if (! $user->isPatient() || ! $user->is_active) {
            return false;
        }

        $profile = $user->loadMissing('patientProfile')->patientProfile;

        return $profile !== null && $profile->is_active === true;
    }

    public function view(User $user, Appointment $appointment): Response|bool
    {
        if ($user->isStaff()) {
            return $user->can('appointments.view');
        }

        return $this->owns($user, $appointment) ? true : Response::denyAsNotFound();
    }

    public function cancel(User $user, Appointment $appointment): Response|bool
    {
        if ($user->isStaff()) {
            return $user->can('appointments.manage');
        }

        return $this->owns($user, $appointment) ? true : Response::denyAsNotFound();
    }

    /** Profil walk-in (`user_id` NULL) tidak dimiliki siapa pun secara online. */
    private function owns(User $user, Appointment $appointment): bool
    {
        $profile = $appointment->loadMissing('patientProfile')->patientProfile;

        return $user->isPatient()
            && $profile !== null
            && $profile->user_id !== null
            && (int) $profile->user_id === (int) $user->getKey();
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Patient;

use App\Enums\ClinicType;
use App\Enums\DoctorStatus;
use App\Enums\SessionStatus;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\InsurancePartner;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\Scheduling\PracticeSessionGenerator;
use App\Services\Settings\SettingsService;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Database\Seeders\SettingsSeeder;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithMasterData;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithPatients;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Wizard pendaftaran langkah 1 sampai 4 (#29, F6-R17/R18/R19): AKS-01/03 dan AKS-07 asli (D-151), V-09 (VAL-09),
 * JDW-12/CRD-02 (sumber jadwal tunggal), JDW-03/04, EMP-04, SEK-15, Review Focus 3 dan 4. Waktu: Senin 5 Oktober 2026
 * 07.00; jendela pendaftaran 30 hari berakhir Rabu 4 November; sesi uji 09.00 sampai 12.00.
 */
class BookingWizardTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithMasterData;
    use InteractsWithPatients;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-05 07:00:00');

        $today = CarbonImmutable::today();
        Cache::put(PracticeSessionGenerator::markerKey($today), true, $today->endOfDay());
    }

    // --- pembantu ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides */
    private function sessionOf(Doctor $doctor, string $date, array $overrides = []): PracticeSession
    {
        return $this->createSession(array_merge([
            'doctor_id' => $doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $doctor->clinic_id,
            'session_date' => $date,
            'start_time' => '09:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'quota' => 20,
        ], $overrides));
    }

    private ?User $patient = null;

    /** Pasien uji (satu per tes; email tetap `siti@contoh.test`). */
    private function patient(): User
    {
        return $this->patient ??= $this->createPatient(['name' => 'Siti Rahma', 'email' => 'siti@contoh.test'], ['full_name' => 'Siti Rahma']);
    }

    /** @param  array<string, string>  $query */
    private function wizard(array $query = []): string
    {
        return route('patient.appointments.create', $query);
    }

    private function open(string $url): string
    {
        return $this->actingAs($this->patient())->get($url)->assertOk()->getContent();
    }

    // --- akses (AKS-01, AKS-03, AKS-07) ------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_the_route_is_registered_with_the_portal_middleware(): void
    {
        $route = Route::getRoutes()->getByName('patient.appointments.create');

        $this->assertNotNull($route);
        $this->assertSame('pasien/pendaftaran/baru', $route->uri());
        $this->assertSame(['GET', 'HEAD'], $route->methods());
        $this->assertSame(['web', 'auth', 'account:patient', 'active'], array_values(array_filter($route->gatherMiddleware(), 'is_string')));
        $this->assertSame('App\\Http\\Controllers\\Patient\\AppointmentController@create', $route->getActionName());
    }

    public function test_guests_go_to_the_login_and_staff_to_the_admin_dashboard(): void
    {
        $this->get($this->wizard())->assertRedirect(route('login'));

        $staff = $this->createStaff('registration-officer');
        $this->actingAs($staff)->get($this->wizard())->assertRedirect(route('admin.dashboard'));
        $this->actingAs($staff)->getJson($this->wizard())->assertForbidden();
    }

    /** AKS-07 asli (D-151): tamu dengan `?sesi=ID` masuk lewat `/masuk` dan kembali ke URL yang sama, query utuh. */
    public function test_aks_07_a_guest_with_a_bookable_session_returns_to_the_wizard_with_the_query_intact(): void
    {
        $this->patient();
        $session = $this->sessionOf($this->createDoctor(), '2026-10-06');
        $path = '/pasien/pendaftaran/baru?sesi='.$session->id;

        $this->get($path)->assertRedirect(route('login'));

        $this->from(route('login'))
            ->post(route('login.store'), ['email' => 'siti@contoh.test', 'password' => $this->patientPassword()])
            ->assertRedirect(url($path))
            ->assertSessionMissing('url.intended');

        $this->get($path)->assertOk()->assertSee('Langkah 4 - Data pendaftaran');
    }

    public function test_a_patient_with_an_inactive_profile_or_without_a_profile_is_forbidden(): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->createPatient([], ['is_active' => false]))->get($this->wizard())->assertForbidden();
        $this->actingAs(User::factory()->patient()->create())->get($this->wizard())->assertForbidden();
    }

    public function test_the_page_is_never_cached_and_is_noindex_with_one_heading(): void
    {
        $response = $this->actingAs($this->patient())->get($this->wizard())->assertOk();
        $html = $response->getContent();

        $this->assertStringContainsString('no-store', (string) $response->headers->get('Cache-Control'));
        $this->assertStringContainsString('<title>Pendaftaran Kunjungan — '.config('app.name').'</title>', $html);

    public function test_step_one_lists_bookable_polyclinics_and_dims_those_without_a_schedule(): void
    {
        $withSchedule = $this->createClinic(['name' => 'Poliklinik Anak Uji', 'code' => 'ANK']);
        $withoutSchedule = $this->createClinic(['name' => 'Poliklinik Mata Uji', 'code' => 'MTA']);
        $onlyCancelled = $this->createClinic(['name' => 'Poliklinik Gigi Uji', 'code' => 'GGI']);
        $support = $this->createClinic(['name' => 'Laboratorium Uji', 'code' => 'LAB', 'type' => ClinicType::Penunjang, 'is_bookable' => false]);
        $inactive = $this->createClinic(['name' => 'Poliklinik Tutup Uji', 'code' => 'TTP', 'is_active' => false]);
        $notBookable = $this->createClinic(['name' => 'Poliklinik Rujukan Uji', 'code' => 'RJK', 'is_bookable' => false]);

        $this->sessionOf($this->createDoctor([], $withSchedule), '2026-10-06');
        $this->sessionOf($this->createDoctor([], $onlyCancelled), '2026-10-07', ['status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled]);
        $this->sessionOf($this->createDoctor([], $support), '2026-10-06');
        $this->sessionOf($this->createDoctor([], $notBookable), '2026-10-06');

        $html = $this->open($this->wizard());

        $this->assertStringContainsString('Langkah 1 - Pilih poliklinik', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Poliklinik Anak Uji', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('(ANK)', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('href="'.e($this->wizard(['poli' => $withSchedule->slug])).'"', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Poliklinik Mata Uji', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Poliklinik Gigi Uji', $html);
        $this->assertSame(2, substr_count($html, 'Belum ada jadwal'), 'Mata (tanpa sesi) dan Gigi (hanya sesi dibatalkan) tampil redup.');
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('poli='.$withoutSchedule->slug, $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('poli='.$onlyCancelled->slug, $html);

        foreach ([$support, $inactive, $notBookable] as $hidden) {
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString($hidden->name, $html);
        }

        $this->assertSame(1, substr_count($html, 'aria-current="step"'));
    }

    public function test_step_two_lists_the_doctors_of_the_polyclinic_with_their_nearest_session(): void
    {
        $clinic = $this->createClinic(['name' => 'Poliklinik Anak Uji']);
        $open = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Laras Wulandari'], $clinic);
        $full = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Bima Santoso'], $clinic);
        $none = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Citra Lestari'], $clinic);
        $inactive = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Dedi Nonaktif', 'status' => DoctorStatus::Inactive], $clinic);
        $elsewhere = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Eko Lain']);

        $this->sessionOf($open, '2026-10-06', ['booked_count' => 3]);
        $this->sessionOf($full, '2026-10-06', ['quota' => 2, 'booked_count' => 2]);
        $this->sessionOf($elsewhere, '2026-10-06');

        $html = $this->open($this->wizard(['poli' => $clinic->slug]));

        $this->assertStringContainsString('Langkah 2 - Pilih dokter', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Poliklinik: <strong>Poliklinik Anak Uji</strong>', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('href="'.$this->wizard().'"', $html, 'Tautan Ubah dan langkah 1 yang selesai.');

        $this->assertStringContainsString('dr. Laras Wulandari, Sp.PD', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Sel, 6 Okt 2026', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('09.00–12.00', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Sisa 17 dari 20', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('href="'.e($this->wizard(['poli' => $clinic->slug, 'dokter' => $open->slug])).'"', $html);

        $this->assertStringContainsString('dr. Bima Santoso, Sp.PD', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Penuh', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('dokter='.$full->slug, $html, 'Dokter tanpa sesi yang dapat dipesan tidak punya tombol Pilih.');
        $this->assertStringContainsString('(tidak tersedia)', $html);

        $this->assertStringContainsString('dr. Citra Lestari, Sp.PD', $html);
        $this->assertSame(1, substr_count($html, 'Belum ada jadwal dalam 30 hari ke depan'));
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('dokter='.$none->slug, $html);

        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Dedi Nonaktif', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Eko Lain', $html);
        $this->assertSame(1, substr_count($html, 'aria-current="step"'));
    }

    public function test_the_wizard_triggers_the_daily_session_generation_and_uses_the_generated_sessions(): void
    {
        Cache::forget(PracticeSessionGenerator::markerKey(CarbonImmutable::today()));

        $clinic = $this->createClinic(['name' => 'Poliklinik Anak Uji']);
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Laras Wulandari'], $clinic);
        $this->createSchedule(['doctor_id' => $doctor->id]); // templat Senin 08.00-12.00 berlaku mulai hari ini

        $this->assertSame(0, PracticeSession::query()->count());

        $html = $this->open($this->wizard(['poli' => $clinic->slug]));

        $this->assertGreaterThan(0, PracticeSession::query()->count());
        $this->assertTrue(Cache::has(PracticeSessionGenerator::markerKey(CarbonImmutable::today())));
        // Senin 5 Oktober 07.00: sesi 08.00 sudah ditutup (batas 60 menit), sesi terdekat yang dapat dipesan Senin 12 Oktober.
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Sen, 12 Okt 2026', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Sisa 20 dari 20', $html);
    }

    // --- langkah 3: tanggal dan sesi ---------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_step_three_shows_date_chips_with_reasons_and_the_sessions_of_the_selected_date(): void
    {
        $clinic = $this->createClinic(['name' => 'Poliklinik Anak Uji']);
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Laras Wulandari'], $clinic);
        $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-06', ['quota' => 5, 'booked_count' => 5]);
        $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-07', ['status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled]);
        $morning = $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-08', ['booked_count' => 4]);
        $afternoon = $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-08', ['start_time' => '13:00:00', 'end_time' => '15:00:00', 'status' => SessionStatus::Closed, 'quota' => 10]);
        $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-09');

        $html = $this->open($this->wizard(['poli' => $clinic->slug, 'dokter' => $doctor->slug]));

        $this->assertStringContainsString('Langkah 3 - Pilih tanggal dan sesi', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Poliklinik: <strong>Poliklinik Anak Uji</strong>', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Dokter: <strong>dr. Laras Wulandari, Sp.PD</strong>', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('href="'.$this->wizard().'" aria-label="Ubah poliklinik"', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('href="'.e($this->wizard(['poli' => $clinic->slug])).'" aria-label="Ubah dokter"', $html);

        // Tanggal tanpa sesi yang dapat dipesan nonaktif dengan alasan; sisanya tautan GET yang membawa poli, dokter, tanggal.
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Sel 6 Okt - Penuh', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Rab 7 Okt - Dibatalkan', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('tanggal=2026-10-06', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('tanggal=2026-10-07', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('href="'.e($this->wizard(['poli' => $clinic->slug, 'dokter' => $doctor->slug, 'tanggal' => '2026-10-09'])).'"', $html);

        // Tanpa `tanggal`, tanggal pertama yang dapat dipesan dipilih (Kamis 8 Oktober).
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Sesi pada Kamis, 8 Oktober 2026', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('value="'.$morning->id.'"', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Sisa 16 dari 20', $html);
        $this->assertMatchesRegularExpression('#<input[^>]*type="radio"[^>]*name="sesi"[^>]*value="'.$morning->id.'"[^>]*checked#', $html);
        $this->assertMatchesRegularExpression('#<input[^>]*name="sesi"[^>]*value="'.$afternoon->id.'"[^>]*disabled#', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Sesi ditutup oleh petugas.', $html);

        // Form tanpa JavaScript: GET ke `create` dengan field tersembunyi poli, dokter, tanggal.
        $this->assertStringContainsString('<form method="GET" action="'.$this->wizard().'"', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('<input type="hidden" name="poli" value="'.$clinic->slug.'">', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('<input type="hidden" name="dokter" value="'.$doctor->slug.'">', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('<input type="hidden" name="tanggal" value="2026-10-08">', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Lanjut: Data Pendaftaran', $html);
        $this->assertSame(1, substr_count($html, 'aria-current="step"'));
    }

    public function test_step_three_explains_a_session_closed_by_the_online_cutoff(): void
    {
        $this->travelTo('2026-10-06 08:30:00'); // 30 menit sebelum sesi 09.00: batas 60 menit sudah lewat

        $clinic = $this->createClinic();
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor([], $clinic);
        $closed = $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-06');
        $later = $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-06', ['start_time' => '13:00:00', 'end_time' => '16:00:00']);
        Cache::put(PracticeSessionGenerator::markerKey(CarbonImmutable::today()), true, CarbonImmutable::today()->endOfDay());

        $html = $this->open($this->wizard(['poli' => $clinic->slug, 'dokter' => $doctor->slug]));

        $this->assertMatchesRegularExpression('#<input[^>]*name="sesi"[^>]*value="'.$closed->id.'"[^>]*disabled#', $html);
        $this->assertMatchesRegularExpression('#<input[^>]*name="sesi"[^>]*value="'.$later->id.'"[^>]*checked#', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Pendaftaran online ditutup', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Alasan: batas pendaftaran online 60 menit sebelum sesi dimulai.', $html);
    }

    // --- tanpa JavaScript ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    /** Wizard berfungsi penuh tanpa JavaScript: tautan GET dan formulir biasa, tanpa skrip atau atribut event inline. */
    public function test_every_step_works_without_javascript(): void
    {
        $clinic = $this->createClinic();
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor([], $clinic);
        $session = $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-06');
        $urls = [
            $this->wizard(),
            $this->wizard(['poli' => $clinic->slug]),
            $this->wizard(['poli' => $clinic->slug, 'dokter' => $doctor->slug]),
            $this->wizard(['sesi' => $session->id]),
        ];
        $pages = [];

        foreach ($urls as $url) {
            $pages[$url] = $this->open($url);

            $this->assertDoesNotMatchRegularExpression('#<script(?![^>]*\bsrc=)#i', $pages[$url], $url);
            $this->assertDoesNotMatchRegularExpression('#\son[a-z]+\s*=#i', $pages[$url], $url);
        }

        $stepThree = $pages[$urls[2]];
        $this->assertStringContainsString('<form method="GET" action="'.$this->wizard().'"', $stepThree);
        $this->assertMatchesRegularExpression('#<input[^>]*type="radio"[^>]*name="sesi"[^>]*required#', $stepThree, 'Browser menegakkan pilihan sesi tanpa JavaScript.');

        $stepFour = $pages[$urls[3]];
        $this->assertDoesNotMatchRegularExpression('#data-payment-block="[a-z]+"[^>]*\shidden#', $stepFour, 'Semua blok pembayaran tampil; hanya JavaScript yang menyembunyikannya.');
        $this->assertDoesNotMatchRegularExpression('#name="(bpjs_number|policy_number|insurance_partner_id|save_bpjs)"[^>]*\sdisabled#', $stepFour);
        $this->assertSame(3, substr_count($stepFour, 'Isi hanya bila memilih'), 'Teks bantuan BPJS, mitra asuransi, dan nomor polis selalu terlihat.');
        $this->assertStringContainsString('name="_token"', $stepFour);
    }

    /** SEK-15: nama pasien, nama dokter, dan nama poliklinik berisi tag tampil sebagai teks. */
    public function test_step_four_escapes_names(): void
    {

    public static function unbookableSessions(): array
    {

            'penuh' => [['quota' => 2, 'booked_count' => 2], 'Penuh'],

        ];

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides */
    #[DataProvider('unbookableSessions')]
    public function test_a_direct_session_that_cannot_be_booked_falls_back_to_step_three_with_the_reason(array $overrides, string $label): void
    {
        $clinic = $this->createClinic();
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Laras Wulandari'], $clinic);
        $session = $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-06', $overrides);
        $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-08');
```

Write `app/Http/Requests/Patient/BookingWizardQueryRequest.php`:

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Patient;

use App\Enums\ClinicType;
use App\Enums\DoctorStatus;
use App\Services\Settings\SettingsService;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Validation\Validator;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
use Illuminate\Http\Exceptions\HttpResponseException;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;

/**
 * V-09 (F6-R19): query `poli`, `dokter`, `sesi`, `tanggal` pada GET `patient.appointments.create`. BUKAN turunan
 * ListFilterRequest: kegagalan apa pun (nilai larik, tidak ada, nonaktif, di luar jendela) mengalihkan ke langkah 1
 * (tanpa query) dengan flash `warning`, tidak pernah 500 dan tidak pernah mengulang query yang rusak. `dokter` tanpa
 * `poli` dan tanpa `sesi` menghasilkan pesan khusus.
 */
class BookingWizardQueryRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public const MESSAGE_INVALID = 'Poliklinik, dokter, atau sesi yang dipilih tidak tersedia. Silakan pilih kembali.';

    public const MESSAGE_CLINIC_FIRST = 'Pilih poliklinik terlebih dahulu.';

    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Tanggal batas dihitung eksplisit dari `now()` aplikasi (kata kunci `today` pada aturan tanggal memakai waktu nyata).
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        $today = CarbonImmutable::today();
        $last = $today->addDays(max(1, app(SettingsService::class)->bookingRules()->windowDays));

        return [
            'poli' => [
                'bail', 'nullable', 'string', 'max:100',
                Rule::exists('clinics', 'slug')
                    ->where('is_active', true)
                    ->where('is_bookable', true)
                    ->where('type', ClinicType::Poliklinik->value),
            ],
            'dokter' => [
                'bail', 'nullable', 'string', 'max:150',
                Rule::exists('doctors', 'slug')->where('status', DoctorStatus::Active->value),
            ],
            'sesi' => ['bail', 'nullable', 'integer', 'min:1', Rule::exists('practice_sessions', 'id')],
            'tanggal' => [
                'bail', 'nullable', 'date_format:Y-m-d',
                'after_or_equal:'.$today->toDateString(),
                'before_or_equal:'.$last->toDateString(),
            ],
        ];
    }

    public function withValidator(Validator $validator): void
    {
        $validator->after(function (Validator $validator): void {
            $dokter = $this->input('dokter');

            if (
                $validator->errors()->isEmpty()
                && is_string($dokter) && $dokter !== ''
                && ! $this->filled('poli') && ! $this->filled('sesi')
            ) {
                $validator->errors()->add('dokter', self::MESSAGE_CLINIC_FIRST);
            }
        });
    }

    protected function failedValidation(Validator $validator): void
    {
        $message = $validator->errors()->all() === [self::MESSAGE_CLINIC_FIRST]
            ? self::MESSAGE_CLINIC_FIRST
            : self::MESSAGE_INVALID;

        throw new HttpResponseException(
            redirect()->route('patient.appointments.create')->with('warning', $message),
        );
    }

    /**
     * Nilai yang lolos validasi; yang tidak diisi atau kosong menjadi null.
     *
     * @return array{poli: ?string, dokter: ?string, sesi: ?int, tanggal: ?string}
     */
    public function filters(): array
    {
        $validated = $this->validated();

        return [
            'poli' => ($validated['poli'] ?? null) ?: null,
            'dokter' => ($validated['dokter'] ?? null) ?: null,
            'sesi' => isset($validated['sesi']) && $validated['sesi'] !== '' ? (int) $validated['sesi'] : null,
            'tanggal' => ($validated['tanggal'] ?? null) ?: null,
        ];
    }
}
```
