Write `app/Http/Controllers/Patient/AppointmentController.php`:

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Patient;

use App\Enums\Availability;
use App\Enums\ClinicType;
use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\Patient\BookingWizardQueryRequest;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\Clinic;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\InsurancePartner;
use App\Models\PatientProfile;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Services\Scheduling\AvailabilityFilter;
use App\Services\Scheduling\DoctorAvailabilityQuery;
use App\Services\Scheduling\PracticeSessionGenerator;
use App\Services\Scheduling\SessionAvailability;
use App\Services\Settings\SettingsService;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use Illuminate\View\View;

/**
 * Pendaftaran kunjungan pasien (#29, F6-R17): langkah 1 sampai 4 adalah satu GET `create` (query `poli`, `dokter`,
 * `tanggal`, `sesi`); langkah 5 (tinjau) dan simpan menyusul di T8. Sumber jadwal SATU-SATUNYA adalah
 * DoctorAvailabilityQuery (JDW-12); aturan F.5 lengkap tetap di precheck/book.
 */
class AppointmentController extends Controller
{
    /** Sesi yang dibatalkan alasan operasional tidak layak menjadi "praktik terdekat". */
    private const CANCELLATIONS = [Availability::Leave, Availability::Holiday, Availability::Cancelled];

    public function create(
        BookingWizardQueryRequest $request,
        PracticeSessionGenerator $generator,
        DoctorAvailabilityQuery $availability,
        SettingsService $settings,
    ): View {
        $this->authorize('createOnline', Appointment::class);

        $generator->ensureDailyHorizon();

        $profile = $request->user()->loadMissing('patientProfile')->patientProfile;
        $filters = $request->filters();
        $rules = $settings->bookingRules();

        $data = match (true) {
            $filters['sesi'] !== null => $this->stepFromSession($availability, $profile, (int) $filters['sesi']),
            $filters['poli'] !== null && $filters['dokter'] !== null => $this->stepSessions(
                $availability,
                $this->clinicBySlug($filters['poli']),
                $this->doctorBySlug($filters['dokter']),
                $filters['tanggal'],
            ),
            $filters['poli'] !== null => $this->stepDoctors($availability, $this->clinicBySlug($filters['poli'])),
            default => $this->stepClinics($availability),
        };

        return view('patient.appointments.create', $data + [
            'windowDays' => max(1, $rules->windowDays),
            'cutoffMinutes' => $rules->onlineCutoffMinutes,
        ]);
    }

    // [[METODE-PUBLIK-BERIKUT]] (T8 sampai T10 menambah method publik di atas baris ini: review, store, show, index, cancel, proof, proofPdf)

    // --- langkah wizard ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    /** Langkah 1: poliklinik poliklinik yang aktif dan dapat didaftar online; redup bila tanpa sesi di jendela. */
    private function stepClinics(DoctorAvailabilityQuery $availability): array
    {
        $clinics = Clinic::query()
            ->bookable()
            ->where('type', ClinicType::Poliklinik->value)
            ->ordered()
            ->get(['id', 'name', 'slug', 'code', 'location', 'sort_order']);

        $withSessions = $availability->sessions(new AvailabilityFilter)
            ->reject(fn (SessionAvailability $item): bool => in_array($item->availability, self::CANCELLATIONS, true))
            ->map(fn (SessionAvailability $item): int => (int) $item->session->clinic_id)
            ->unique()
            ->all();

        return [
            'step' => 1,
            'links' => [],
            'clinicRows' => $clinics->map(fn (Clinic $clinic): array => [
                'clinic' => $clinic,
                'hasSessions' => in_array((int) $clinic->id, $withSessions, true),
            ]),
        ];
    }

    /** Langkah 2: dokter aktif poliklinik itu (sesi di poliklinik itu, ditambah dokter poliklinik tanpa sesi). */
    private function stepDoctors(DoctorAvailabilityQuery $availability, Clinic $clinic): array
    {
        $items = $availability->sessions(new AvailabilityFilter(clinicId: $clinic->id));
        $grouped = $items->groupBy(fn (SessionAvailability $item): int => (int) $item->session->doctor_id);

        $doctors = $items
            ->map(fn (SessionAvailability $item): Doctor => $item->session->doctor)
            ->unique('id')
            ->keyBy('id');

        Doctor::query()->publiclyVisible()->inClinic($clinic->id)->with(['specialties', 'media'])->get()
            ->each(function (Doctor $doctor) use ($doctors): void {
                if (! $doctors->has($doctor->id)) {
                    $doctors->put($doctor->id, $doctor);
                }
            });

        $rows = $doctors
            ->map(function (Doctor $doctor) use ($grouped): array {
                // Hanya spesialisasi aktif yang tampil di publik (E12, D-56).
                $doctor->setRelation('specialties', $doctor->specialties->filter(fn ($specialty): bool => (bool) $specialty->is_active)->values());
                $own = $grouped->get($doctor->id, new Collection);

                return [
                    'doctor' => $doctor,
                    'bookable' => $own->first(fn (SessionAvailability $item): bool => $item->isBookableOnline),
                    'next' => $own->first(fn (SessionAvailability $item): bool => ! in_array($item->availability, self::CANCELLATIONS, true)),
                ];
            })
            ->sort(fn (array $a, array $b): int => [$a['doctor']->sort_order, $a['doctor']->name] <=> [$b['doctor']->sort_order, $b['doctor']->name])
            ->values();

        return [
            'step' => 2,
            'links' => $this->stepLinks(),
            'clinic' => $clinic,
            'doctorRows' => $rows,
        ];
    }

    /** Langkah 3: chip tanggal (jendela pendaftaran) dan sesi pada tanggal terpilih. */
    private function stepSessions(DoctorAvailabilityQuery $availability, Clinic $clinic, Doctor $doctor, ?string $date): array
    {
        $items = $availability->sessions(new AvailabilityFilter(clinicId: $clinic->id, doctorId: $doctor->id));

        $entries = $items
            ->groupBy(fn (SessionAvailability $item): string => $item->session->session_date->toDateString())
            ->map(function (Collection $group, string $key): array {
                $selectable = $group->contains(fn (SessionAvailability $item): bool => $item->isBookableOnline);

                return [
                    'key' => $key,
                    'date' => CarbonImmutable::createFromFormat('!Y-m-d', $key),
                    'items' => $group->values(),
                    'selectable' => $selectable,
                    'reason' => $selectable ? null : $group->first()->availability,
                ];
            });

        $selected = $date !== null && ($entries->get($date)['selectable'] ?? false)
            ? $entries->get($date)
            : $entries->firstWhere('selectable', true);

        return [
            'step' => 3,
            'links' => $this->stepLinks($clinic),
            'clinic' => $clinic,
            'doctor' => $doctor,
            'dateEntries' => $entries->values(),
            'selected' => $selected,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * `?sesi=` langsung (alur 3.C, F6-R18): sesi yang dapat dipesan online langsung ke langkah 4; selain itu langkah 3
     * untuk dokter itu dengan peringatan berisi label ketersediaan.
     */
    private function stepFromSession(DoctorAvailabilityQuery $availability, PatientProfile $profile, int $sessionId): array
    {
        $session = PracticeSession::query()->with(['clinic', 'doctor', 'exception'])->findOrFail($sessionId);
        $item = $availability->forSession($session);

        if (! $item->isBookableOnline) {
            session()->now('warning', 'Sesi yang dipilih tidak dapat dipesan: '.$item->availability->label().'.');

            return $this->stepSessions($availability, $session->clinic, $session->doctor, $session->session_date->toDateString());
        }

        return [
            'step' => 4,
            'links' => $this->stepLinks($session->clinic, $session->doctor, $session->session_date->toDateString()),
            'session' => $session,
            'item' => $item,
            'clinic' => $session->clinic,
            'doctor' => $session->doctor,
            'profile' => $profile,
            'partners' => InsurancePartner::query()->active()->ordered()->get(['id', 'name']),
            'storedBpjs' => $profile->masked_bpjs,
        ];
    }

    private function clinicBySlug(string $slug): Clinic
    {
        return Clinic::query()->bookable()->where('type', ClinicType::Poliklinik->value)->where('slug', $slug)->firstOrFail();
    }

    private function doctorBySlug(string $slug): Doctor
    {
        return Doctor::query()->active()->where('slug', $slug)->firstOrFail();
    }

    /**
     * Tautan langkah yang sudah dilewati untuk x-wizard-steps (hanya yang kurang dari langkah aktif yang dirender).
     *
     * @return array<int, string>
     */
    private function stepLinks(?Clinic $clinic = null, ?Doctor $doctor = null, ?string $date = null, ?int $sessionId = null): array
    {
        $links = [1 => route('patient.appointments.create')];

        if ($clinic !== null) {
            $links[2] = route('patient.appointments.create', ['poli' => $clinic->slug]);
        }

        if ($clinic !== null && $doctor !== null) {
            $links[3] = route('patient.appointments.create', array_filter(['poli' => $clinic->slug, 'dokter' => $doctor->slug, 'tanggal' => $date]));
        }

        if ($sessionId !== null) {
            $links[4] = route('patient.appointments.create', ['sesi' => $sessionId]);
        }

        return $links;
    }
}
```

#### Catatan penulis (konteks untuk implementer dan reviewer) (konteks untuk implementer, reviewer, dan penulis tugas lain)
1. **Penanda di controller untuk T8 sampai T10.** `AppointmentController` berakhir dengan baris `// [[METODE-PUBLIK-BERIKUT]] (…)` sebelum pembantu privat; method publik baru (T8: `review`, `store`, `show`; T9: `index`, `cancel`; T10: `proof`, `proofPdf`) dipasang dengan mengganti baris itu menjadi method baru DITAMBAH baris penanda yang sama (supaya tugas berikutnya punya jangkar). Impor tambahan (`Cache`, `Actor`, dst.) ditambahkan dengan jangkar `use Illuminate\View\View;`. Pembantu privat `stepLinks(?Clinic, ?Doctor, ?string $date, ?int $sessionId)` dipakai ulang oleh T8 (`review`).
2. **Jangkar route.** `routes/patient.php` berisi grup `Route::prefix('pendaftaran')->name('appointments.')->controller(AppointmentController::class)->group(...)` dengan satu baris `Route::get('/baru', 'create')->name('create');`. T8 menambah `/tinjau`, `POST /`, dan grup `{appointment:booking_code}` (dengan jangkar `Route::get('/', 'show')->name('show');` untuk T9/T10) di grup yang sama; `index` (T9) berupa `Route::get('/', 'index')`.
3. **Kontrak markup langkah 4** (dipakai JS T8): pembungkus `data-payment-toggle`, radio `payment_type`, blok `data-payment-block="bpjs"` (berisi `bpjs_number` dan `save_bpjs`) dan `data-payment-block="asuransi"` (berisi `insurance_partner_id` dan `policy_number`). Tanpa JS semua blok tampil dengan teks bantuan "Isi hanya bila memilih …". Judul langkah memakai `data-wizard-heading` (JS T8 memindahkan fokus bila tidak ada ringkasan galat).
4. **`BookingRedirect` bergantung pada route yang dibuat T8/T9** lewat `Route::has` dengan cadangan `patient.dashboard`; tes unit mendaftarkan route palsu hanya bila belum ada, jadi tidak perlu diubah oleh T8/T9. Cabang `DUPLICATE_BOOKING` tanpa `context['appointment_code']` yang valid sengaja diperlakukan seperti `QUOTA_FULL` (langkah 3).
5. **`ACTIVE_LIMIT_REACHED`/`DUPLICATE_BOOKING` yang terdeteksi `precheck` saat validasi** (T8) tidak memakai `BookingRedirect`: sesuai F6-R10 itu adalah kegagalan validasi yang mengalihkan ke `create?sesi=` dengan galat pada `practice_session_id`. Hanya penolakan dari `book()` (balapan) yang melewati handler ini. T8 menguji kedua jalur.
6. **`BookingWizardQueryRequest` tidak mendefinisikan `messages()`**: pesan V-09 per field ("Dokter yang dipilih tidak tersedia." dst.) tidak pernah tampil karena kegagalan selalu mengalihkan ke langkah 1 dengan dua pesan F6-R19. Aturan V-09 dipertajam dengan `type = poliklinik` pada `poli` agar sama dengan daftar langkah 1.
7. **Keputusan UI di luar teks yang dikunci:** dokter yang hanya punya sesi penuh/ditutup tampil dengan "(tidak tersedia)" tanpa tombol Pilih (langkah 3 tidak punya tanggal yang dapat dipilih untuk dokter itu); dokter poliklinik tanpa sesi tetap dicantumkan ("Belum ada jadwal dalam N hari ke depan") sesuai 07 W-11. "Sisa N dari M" ditulis terpisah dari lencana ketersediaan (lencana langkah 3 tidak membawa angka sisa agar tidak dobel).
8. **Dropdown "Akun Saya"** (F6-R30) dan banner dashboard bukan bagian T7 (T11). Tombol "Daftar Kunjungan" pada dashboard kosong sudah memakai route asli tanpa mengubah `dashboard.blade.php` (guard `Route::has` yang ada).
9. **405 sementara.** Antara T8 dan T9, `GET /pasien/pendaftaran` (route `index`) menjawab 405 karena hanya `POST /pasien/pendaftaran` (`store`) yang ada; tidak ada tes yang mengunci GET itu (T7 membuangnya dari tes wildcard).
10. **Jumlah route:** 142 sesudah T7 (T8 menambah 3 → 145 dengan `show`; kerangka C.1 menetapkan 150 setelah T11). `Phase6RoutePermissionTest` (T13) mengunci 150/106/13.

### Task 8: Tinjau, simpan, dan detail pendaftaran (`review`, `store`, `show`, form request, QR, JS blok pembayaran)

**Files:**
- Create: `app/Http/Requests/Patient/Concerns/HasBookingRules.php`
- Create: `app/Http/Requests/Patient/ReviewAppointmentRequest.php`
- Create: `app/Http/Requests/Patient/StoreAppointmentRequest.php`
- Create: `app/Services/Booking/AppointmentProofService.php` (hanya `qrPayload` dan `qrSvgDataUri`; T10 menambah `qrPngDataUri` dan `pdf`)
- Create: `resources/views/patient/appointments/review.blade.php`
- Create: `resources/views/patient/appointments/show.blade.php`
- Modify: `app/Http/Controllers/Patient/AppointmentController.php` (`review`, `store`, `show` di atas penanda T7)
- Modify: `routes/patient.php` (`review`, `store` + `throttle:booking`, grup `{appointment:booking_code}` dengan `show`)
- Modify: `resources/views/patient/appointments/_step-data.blade.php` (`$reviewUrl = route('patient.appointments.review')`, guard `Route::has` dibuang)
- Modify: `resources/js/app.js` (`initPaymentToggles`, `focusWizardHeading`)
- Create (tes): `tests/Feature/Patient/BookingSubmissionTest.php`, `tests/Feature/Patient/AppointmentShowTest.php`, `tests/Unit/Requests/ReviewAppointmentRequestTest.php`, `tests/Unit/Services/AppointmentProofServiceTest.php`
- Modify (tes): `tests/Unit/FrontendManifestTest.php` (satu tes JS baru)
- Tidak diubah: `bootstrap/app.php` (handler `BookingException` dan `SensitiveInput` dari T7), `app/Support/SafeRedirect.php` (sudah memetakan `review`/`store` ke `create?sesi=`), `app/Support/BookingRedirect.php`, `AppointmentPolicy`, `config/navigation.php` (F6-R39 sudah di T7), `resources/scss/*`, view `create`/`_step-*` (T7; hanya guard `Route::has('patient.appointments.review')` yang kini selalu benar).

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - T1: `App\Services\Booking\BookingData` (`paymentType`, `paymentReference`, `insurancePartnerId`, `complaint`, `saveBpjs`, `fromValidated(array)`, `paymentReferenceLast4()`), `BookingCodeGenerator::PATTERN`, `BookingException`/`lang/id/booking.php` (`errors.*`, `submit_in_progress`), `Appointment` (`queue_label`, `masked_payment_reference`, `insurancePartner`, `statusHistories`, `schedule_changed_at`).
  - T4: `BookingService::precheck(PatientProfile, PracticeSession, BookingData, Actor): void` dan `::book(PatientProfile, int $practiceSessionId, BookingData, Actor): Appointment`.
  - T7: `SensitiveInput::FIELDS`, `BookingRedirect`, handler `BookingException`, `AppointmentPolicy` (`createOnline`, `view`), `x-wizard-steps`, `AppointmentController` (penanda `// [[METODE-PUBLIK-BERIKUT]]`, `stepLinks()`), view langkah 4 (kontrak `[data-payment-toggle]`/`[data-payment-block]`/`[data-wizard-heading]`), route `patient.appointments.create`.
  - Kode yang sudah ada: `DoctorAvailabilityQuery::forSession()`, `SettingsService::bookingRules()` (`cancelCutoffMinutes`, `checkinOpenMinutes`), `PatientProfile::bpjs_number` (terenkripsi), `Actor::patient()`, `throttle:booking` (`AppServiceProvider`, 10/menit per pengguna), `chillerlan/php-qrcode` 6.0.1.
- Produces:
  - Route: `patient.appointments.review` (POST `/pasien/pendaftaran/tinjau`), `patient.appointments.store` (POST `/pasien/pendaftaran`, `throttle:booking`), `patient.appointments.show` (GET `/pasien/pendaftaran/{appointment:booking_code}`).
  - `ReviewAppointmentRequest`, `StoreAppointmentRequest` (V-10/V-11), trait `HasBookingRules` (`bookingRules`, `bookingMessages`, `prepareBookingInput`, `toBookingData`; tambahan publik `bpjsTyped(): bool`).
  - `AppointmentController@review|store|show`; view `patient.appointments.review|show`.
  - `AppointmentProofService::qrPayload(Appointment): string` dan `::qrSvgDataUri(Appointment): string` (SVG, `data:image/svg+xml;base64,…`).
  - JS: `[data-payment-toggle]` (menampilkan hanya blok pembayaran yang dipilih dan menonaktifkan isian blok tersembunyi) dan fokus judul langkah.
  - Kontrak untuk T9/T10: view `show` memuat blok aksi `<div class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-2 mt-4" data-appointment-actions>` dengan komentar Blade `{{-- [[AKSI-DETAIL-BERIKUT]] --}}` sebagai jangkar tombol "Cetak Bukti"/"Unduh PDF" (T10) dan "Batalkan Pendaftaran" + modal (T9); jangkar route `Route::get('/', 'show')->name('show');` di dalam grup `{appointment:booking_code}`.

**Test IDs:** VAL-03, VAL-08 (302 ke `create?sesi=`, tidak pernah 405, BPJS tidak di-flash; 419 termasuk), BKG-20 (pesan galat tampil sebagai flash, bukan 500; sisi HTTP), BKG-02/BKG-04 (sisi HTTP: duplikat dan kuota penuh), SEK-05 (throttle booking ke-11), SEK-06 (CSRF `review`/`store` → 419 dialihkan), SEK-11 (sisi HTTP: BPJS tidak di-flash), SEK-12 (BPJS terenkripsi di DB, tersamar di halaman), SEK-13 (QR hanya kode booking, didekode dari SVG), SEK-15 (escape di tinjau dan detail), PAS-02 (detail milik orang lain 404), AKS (sisi mutasi `review`/`store`/`show`: tamu, staf), Review Focus 1 (kirim ganda: lock → pesan BR-48 tanpa appointment; lapis DB tetap di T4/T6), Review Focus 3 (IDOR detail), Review Focus 4 (field tersembunyi dipalsukan, BPJS 12 digit/berspasi/bertanda hubung/larik, `payment_type`, mitra nonaktif), Review Focus 5 (sisi halaman: nomor lengkap tidak dirender selain isian ketik sendiri di tinjau).

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
- **Alur dan pengalihan.** Kegagalan VALIDASI (termasuk galat `precheck` pada `practice_session_id`) = `ValidationException` dengan `redirectTo` = `create?sesi={id}` (`getRedirectUrl()` di trait; id hanya dipakai bila `^[1-9][0-9]{0,17}$`). Handler validasi Laravel memakai `withInput(Arr::except($request->input(), $dontFlash))` sehingga `bpjs_number` dan `policy_number` tidak pernah masuk `old()` (daftar `SensitiveInput::FIELDS` di `dontFlash`, T7). Kegagalan dari `book()` (balapan) ditangani handler `BookingException` + `BookingRedirect` (T7). `create?sesi=` sendiri menurunkan ke langkah 3 bila sesi tak lagi dapat dipesan (F6-R18), sehingga pasien tidak pernah mendarat di halaman POST-only (405).
- **`prepareForValidation` dan `ValidatesWhenResolved`.** `validateResolved()` memanggil `prepareForValidation()` SEBELUM `authorize()`; `prepareBookingInput()` tidak boleh mengandalkan otorisasi (ia hanya membaca profil milik `$this->user()`). Normalisasi (F6-R21, carry fase 5): BPJS buang spasi dan `-`, polis buang spasi saja (regex V-10 mengizinkan `-` dan `/`), keluhan `trim`, string kosong → null. Bila `payment_type = bpjs` dan nomor kosong dan profil menyimpan nomor → `bpjs_number` diisi dari profil di server (dekripsi hanya di server), `save_bpjs` dipaksa false, dan `bpjsTyped()` = false. `merge()` memasukkan nomor itu ke `input()`, tetapi `bpjs_number` ada di `dontFlash`.
- **Aturan larik tidak 500.** Aturan `digits` memanggil `preg_match` pada nilai dan melempar `TypeError` untuk larik; karena itu urutan aturan diawali `bail` dan `string` mendahului `digits`/`regex`/`max` (nilai larik → pesan Indonesia). `Rule::in(PaymentType::values())` dipakai (bukan `Rule::enum`) karena pesan kustom aturan objek `Enum` tidak dapat ditimpa per kunci (`lang/id/validation.php` tidak dipakai di sini).
- **UTF-8 rusak pada `complaint` tidak 500.** Byte tidak valid (mis. `"a\xC3\x28"`) lolos `string`/`max` lalu menjadi `QueryException` 1366 di `book()`. Aturan `regex:/\A[\s\S]*\z/u` gagal (tanpa melempar) pada byte rusak, pesan `complaint.regex` = "Keluhan tidak valid."; kasus provider `keluhan UTF-8 rusak` mengunci galat pada `complaint` dengan pengalihan ke `create?sesi=` (K78 #8).
- **Nama helper tes.** Helper privat `ReviewAppointmentRequestTest::openSession()` (bukan `session()`, yang menabrak `InteractsWithSession::session()` publik milik TestCase); `beforeBooking()` dipasang SESUDAH `payload()` (pembuatan sesi memakai transaksi, sehingga pengait `DB::beforeStartingTransaction` tidak boleh menembak di kode tes); loop tamu dan staf dipisah karena `actingAs($staff)` menetap antar iterasi (integrasi B-2, B-3, B-4).
- **`withValidator` + `precheck`.** Hook `after` hanya berjalan bila belum ada galat; data dibangun dari `$this->only([...])` (bukan `validated()`, yang belum dapat dipanggil di dalam hook). `BookingService::precheck()` tidak mengunci dan tidak menulis; `BookingException` → galat pada `practice_session_id` dengan pesan F6-R8. Kegagalan `precheck` yang terdeteksi saat validasi (mis. duplikat, batas aktif) tampil sebagai galat lapangan di `create?sesi=`; hanya yang terjadi di dalam `book()` (balapan) memakai pengalihan per kode F6-R10 (ke `show`, riwayat, langkah 3 atau 4).
- **`Cache::lock` (F6-R9).** Di controller, bukan service: `Cache::lock("booking-submit:{$userId}", 10)->get()` non-blocking, dilepas di `finally`. Gagal = redirect `create?sesi=` + flash `error` (`__('booking.submit_in_progress')`, BR-48) tanpa memanggil `book()`. Lock diambil SESUDAH validasi (agar permintaan tak valid tidak menahan lock) dan sebelum transaksi. Driver `array` pada tes cukup untuk membuktikan perilaku dalam satu proses (lintas proses = T6). Karena kunci per pengguna, dua pengguna berbeda tidak saling menahan.
- **Simulasi balapan di tes tanpa mock.** `BookingService` `final` (tidak dapat di-mock). `DB::beforeStartingTransaction(Closure)` (`Illuminate\Database\Connection`, dipanggil pada setiap `beginTransaction`, termasuk savepoint) dipakai untuk mengubah keadaan DB atau melempar `BookingException` tepat sesudah validasi/`precheck` dan sebelum transaksi `book()`: perubahan di callback tetap berada di transaksi pembungkus tes sehingga terlihat oleh `book()`, dan pengecualian dari callback keluar dari `DB::transaction()` tanpa diulang (`beginTransaction()` di luar blok `try` pengulangan). Callback dipasang sekali (`$armed`), karena `bookAppointment()` di dalam callback juga membuka transaksi. Asumsi: transaksi pertama pada siklus `store` adalah transaksi `book()` (tidak ada penulisan DB lain sebelum itu: sesi/cache memakai driver `array`).
- **QR.** `chillerlan\QRCode\QRCode` (6.0.1) dengan `QROptions`: `outputInterface = QRMarkupSVG::class`, `outputBase64 = true` (hasil `render()` = `data:image/svg+xml;base64,…`), `eccLevel = EccLevel::M` (`chillerlan\QRCode\Common\EccLevel`). Diverifikasi menjalankan kode: keluaran ±15–20 KB; SVG tidak memuat teks payload, jadi SEK-13 mendekode SVG-nya: dark module (`fill="#000"`, perintah `M{x} {y} h1 v1 h-1Z`) digambar ke GD lalu `QRCode::readFromBlob()` (opsi `readerUseImagickIfAvailable = false`) membaca `UPH-XXXX-XXXX`. SVG disajikan `<img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64,…" alt="…">` (CSP `img-src 'self' data:` sudah ada; tanpa `{!! !!}`, `RawOutputScanTest` tetap hijau).
- **Detail (`show`).** `{appointment:booking_code}` dengan `->where` pola Crockford; kode berpola salah/huruf kecil → 404 (rute tidak cocok). `authorize('view')` dijalankan SESUDAH binding: pasien lain mendapat `Response::denyAsNotFound()` (404 yang sama dengan kode tak ada). Urutan middleware: `auth` mendahului `SubstituteBindings` sehingga tamu dialihkan ke `/masuk` (bukan 404). Relasi dimuat eksplisit (`patientProfile`, `clinic`, `doctor`, `practiceSession`, `insurancePartner`, `statusHistories`; mode ketat). `route('patient.appointments.show', ['appointment' => $code])` selalu memakai kode eksplisit (model tidak menimpa `getRouteKeyName()`).
- **JS.** Hanya `resources/js/app.js` (tanpa entri Vite baru, tanpa listener `error` kedua, tanpa kata `onerror`): `FrontendManifestTest` mengunci satu listener `error` terdelegasi dan melarang `onerror` di JS/view. Isian pada blok yang disembunyikan di-`disabled` agar tidak terkirim (server menolak nomor BPJS pada pembayaran selain BPJS). `npm run build` wajib sebelum tes.
- **`Phase5RoutePermissionTest`/`Phase6RoutePermissionTest`.** T8 tidak mengubah tes kunci route (T7 sudah membuang angka global; T13 mengunci 150/106/13). Total route sesudah T8: 145.
- **Jumlah tes baru** ±116 (`BookingSubmissionTest` ±71 termasuk provider 28 dan 9, `AppointmentShowTest` 13, `ReviewAppointmentRequestTest` ±28 termasuk provider, `AppointmentProofServiceTest` 5, `FrontendManifestTest` +1).

- [ ] **Step 2: Tulis tes `AppointmentProofService`, jalankan, pastikan GAGAL (RED)**

Write `tests/Unit/Services/AppointmentProofServiceTest.php`:

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Unit\Services;

use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Services\Booking\AppointmentProofService;
use chillerlan\QRCode\QRCode;
use chillerlan\QRCode\QROptions;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * SEK-13 (F6-R27): isi QR hanya `booking_code`. Tes mendekode SVG (bukan hanya membandingkan string): dark module
 * digambar ke GD lalu dibaca `QRCode::readFromBlob()`.
 */
class AppointmentProofServiceTest extends TestCase
{
    private const PREFIX = 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,';

    private function appointment(string $code): Appointment
    {
        $appointment = new Appointment;
        $appointment->forceFill(['booking_code' => $code, 'patient_profile_id' => 7, 'queue_number' => 3]);

        return $appointment;
    }

    /** Mendekode SVG QR keluaran chillerlan (path `M{x} {y} h1 v1 h-1Z` ber-fill hitam) menjadi teks payload. */
    public static function decodeSvg(string $svg): string
    {
        preg_match('/viewBox="0 0 (\d+) (\d+)"/', $svg, $box);
        $size = (int) $box[1];
        $scale = 8;

        $image = imagecreatetruecolor($size * $scale, $size * $scale);
        $white = (int) imagecolorallocate($image, 255, 255, 255);
        $black = (int) imagecolorallocate($image, 0, 0, 0);
        imagefill($image, 0, 0, $white);

        preg_match_all('/<path[^>]*fill="#000"[^>]*d="([^"]+)"/', $svg, $paths);

        foreach ($paths[1] as $d) {
            preg_match_all('/M(\d+) (\d+) h1 v1 h-1Z/', $d, $cells, PREG_SET_ORDER);

            foreach ($cells as $cell) {
                imagefilledrectangle($image, (int) $cell[1] * $scale, (int) $cell[2] * $scale, ((int) $cell[1] + 1) * $scale - 1, ((int) $cell[2] + 1) * $scale - 1, $black);
            }
        }

        ob_start();
        imagepng($image);
        $png = (string) ob_get_clean();

        return (string) (new QRCode(new QROptions(['readerUseImagickIfAvailable' => false])))->readFromBlob($png);
    }

    public function test_the_payload_is_the_booking_code_only(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame('UPH-7K3M-9QWA', (new AppointmentProofService)->qrPayload($this->appointment('UPH-7K3M-9QWA')));
    }

    public function test_the_svg_data_uri_is_valid_base64_svg_without_scripts(): void
    {
        $uri = (new AppointmentProofService)->qrSvgDataUri($this->appointment('UPH-7K3M-9QWA'));

        $this->assertStringStartsWith(self::PREFIX, $uri);

        $svg = base64_decode(substr($uri, strlen(self::PREFIX)), true);

        $this->assertIsString($svg);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('<svg', $svg);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('viewBox="0 0 ', $svg);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('<script', $svg);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('onload', $svg);
    }

    public function test_decoding_the_svg_returns_exactly_the_booking_code(): void
    {
        foreach (['UPH-7K3M-9QWA', 'UPH-0000-ZZZZ', 'UPH-ABCD-2345'] as $code) {
            $uri = (new AppointmentProofService)->qrSvgDataUri($this->appointment($code));

            $this->assertSame($code, self::decodeSvg((string) base64_decode(substr($uri, strlen(self::PREFIX)), true)), $code);
        }
    }

    public function test_the_output_is_deterministic_and_differs_between_codes(): void
    {
        $service = new AppointmentProofService;

        $this->assertSame($service->qrSvgDataUri($this->appointment('UPH-7K3M-9QWA')), $service->qrSvgDataUri($this->appointment('UPH-7K3M-9QWA')));
        $this->assertNotSame($service->qrSvgDataUri($this->appointment('UPH-7K3M-9QWA')), $service->qrSvgDataUri($this->appointment('UPH-7K3M-9QWB')));
    }

    public function test_other_attributes_of_the_appointment_never_influence_the_qr(): void
    {
        $service = new AppointmentProofService;
        $plain = $this->appointment('UPH-7K3M-9QWA');
        $other = $this->appointment('UPH-7K3M-9QWA');
        $other->forceFill(['patient_profile_id' => 99, 'queue_number' => 42, 'complaint' => 'Nama Pasien 0009900000011']);

        $this->assertSame($service->qrSvgDataUri($plain), $service->qrSvgDataUri($other));
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implementasi `AppointmentProofService` (QR)**

Write `app/Services/Booking/AppointmentProofService.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Services\Booking;

use App\Models\Appointment;
use chillerlan\QRCode\Common\EccLevel;
use chillerlan\QRCode\Output\QRMarkupSVG;
use chillerlan\QRCode\QRCode;
use chillerlan\QRCode\QROptions;
use RuntimeException;

/**
 * Bukti pendaftaran (00 F.10, F6-R26/F6-R27). T8: isi QR dan QR SVG untuk halaman; T10 menambah QR PNG dan PDF.
 * Otorisasi (AppointmentPolicy::view) dijalankan pemanggil SEBELUM service ini dipanggil.
 */
final class AppointmentProofService
{
    private const SVG_PREFIX = 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,';

    /** Isi QR hanya kode booking (00 F.7, SEK-13): tanpa nama, tanggal lahir, BPJS, atau id numerik. */
    public function qrPayload(Appointment $appointment): string
    {
        return $appointment->booking_code;
    }

    /**
     * QR sebagai data URI SVG base64 untuk `<img src>` (CSP `img-src 'self' data:`); tidak pernah dirender dengan
     * `{!! !!}`.
     */
    public function qrSvgDataUri(Appointment $appointment): string
    {
        $options = new QROptions([
            'outputInterface' => QRMarkupSVG::class,
            'outputBase64' => true,
            'eccLevel' => EccLevel::M,
        ]);

        $uri = (new QRCode($options))->render($this->qrPayload($appointment));

        if (! is_string($uri) || ! str_starts_with($uri, self::SVG_PREFIX)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('QR SVG tidak dapat dibuat.');
        }

        return $uri;
    }
}
```

Write `tests/Unit/Requests/ReviewAppointmentRequestTest.php`:

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Unit\Requests;

use App\Enums\PaymentType;
use App\Http\Requests\Patient\ReviewAppointmentRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\Patient\StoreAppointmentRequest;
use App\Models\InsurancePartner;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\Scheduling\PracticeSessionGenerator;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithFormRequests;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithMasterData;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithPatients;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * V-10/V-11 (F6-R21): normalisasi BPJS/polis/keluhan, isian BPJS dari profil, `save_bpjs`, bentuk `BookingData`, URL
 * pengalihan, dan otorisasi. Aturan per field diuji lewat HTTP di BookingSubmissionTest (VAL-03).
 */
class ReviewAppointmentRequestTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithFormRequests;
    use InteractsWithMasterData;
    use InteractsWithPatients;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private const BPJS = '0009900000011';

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-05 07:00:00');
        Cache::put(PracticeSessionGenerator::markerKey(CarbonImmutable::today()), true, CarbonImmutable::today()->endOfDay());
    }

    private function openSession(): PracticeSession
    {
        return $this->createSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-06', 'start_time' => '09:00:00', 'end_time' => '12:00:00']);
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function data(PracticeSession $session, array $overrides = []): array
    {
        return $overrides + ['practice_session_id' => (string) $session->id, 'payment_type' => 'umum'];
    }

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $data */
    private function validated(array $data, User $user, string $class = ReviewAppointmentRequest::class): ReviewAppointmentRequest
    {
        $request = $this->makeFormRequest($class, $data, $user);
        $request->validateResolved();

        return $request;
    }

    // --- normalisasi -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    /** @return array<string, array{string, string}> */
    public static function bpjsInputs(): array
    {
        return [
            'tanpa spasi' => ['0009900000011', '0009900000011'],
            'spasi' => ['000 9900 000 011', '0009900000011'],
            'tanda hubung' => ['0009-9000-00011', '0009900000011'],
            'spasi dan hubung' => [' 000-99 00000-011 ', '0009900000011'],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('bpjsInputs')]
    public function test_bpjs_numbers_lose_spaces_and_hyphens_before_validation(string $input, string $expected): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $request = $this->validated($this->data($this->openSession(), ['payment_type' => 'bpjs', 'bpjs_number' => $input]), $user);

        $this->assertSame($expected, $request->validated('bpjs_number'));
        $this->assertTrue($request->bpjsTyped());
        $this->assertSame($expected, $request->toBookingData()->paymentReference);
    }

    public function test_policy_numbers_lose_spaces_but_keep_hyphens_and_slashes(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $partner = InsurancePartner::factory()->create();
        $request = $this->validated($this->data($this->openSession(), ['payment_type' => 'asuransi', 'insurance_partner_id' => (string) $partner->id, 'policy_number' => ' AB 12/3-4 ']), $user);

        $this->assertSame('AB12/3-4', $request->validated('policy_number'));
        $this->assertSame('AB12/3-4', $request->toBookingData()->paymentReference);
        $this->assertSame($partner->id, $request->toBookingData()->insurancePartnerId);
    }

    public function test_the_complaint_is_trimmed_and_blank_becomes_null(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $session = $this->openSession();

        $this->assertSame('Pusing sejak pagi.', $this->validated($this->data($session, ['complaint' => "  Pusing sejak pagi.\n"]), $user)->toBookingData()->complaint);
        $this->assertNull($this->validated($this->data($session, ['complaint' => '   ']), $user)->toBookingData()->complaint);
        $this->assertNull($this->validated($this->data($session), $user)->toBookingData()->complaint);
    }

    public function test_a_general_payment_carries_no_reference_and_no_partner(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $data = $this->validated($this->data($this->openSession()), $user)->toBookingData();

        $this->assertSame(PaymentType::Umum, $data->paymentType);
        $this->assertNull($data->paymentReference);
        $this->assertNull($data->insurancePartnerId);
        $this->assertFalse($data->saveBpjs);
    }

    // --- BPJS dari profil dan save_bpjs (F6-R21) -----------------------------------------------

    public function test_an_empty_bpjs_field_is_filled_from_the_stored_profile_number(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient([], ['bpjs_number' => self::BPJS]);
        $request = $this->validated($this->data($this->openSession(), ['payment_type' => 'bpjs', 'save_bpjs' => '1']), $user);

        $this->assertSame(self::BPJS, $request->validated('bpjs_number'));
        $this->assertFalse($request->bpjsTyped(), 'Nomor berasal dari profil, bukan diketik pasien.');
        $this->assertSame(self::BPJS, $request->toBookingData()->paymentReference);
        $this->assertFalse($request->toBookingData()->saveBpjs, 'Tidak ada yang perlu disimpan: nomor sudah tersimpan.');
    }

    public function test_a_typed_bpjs_number_wins_over_the_stored_one(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient([], ['bpjs_number' => self::BPJS]);
        $request = $this->validated($this->data($this->openSession(), ['payment_type' => 'bpjs', 'bpjs_number' => '0001234567890']), $user);

        $this->assertSame('0001234567890', $request->toBookingData()->paymentReference);
        $this->assertTrue($request->bpjsTyped());
    }

    public function test_without_a_stored_number_an_empty_bpjs_field_is_a_validation_error(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();

        try {
            $this->validated($this->data($this->openSession(), ['payment_type' => 'bpjs']), $user);
            $this->fail('Nomor BPJS kosong tanpa nomor tersimpan harus ditolak.');
        } catch (ValidationException $exception) {
            $this->assertSame(['Nomor BPJS wajib diisi untuk pembayaran BPJS.'], $exception->errors()['bpjs_number']);
        }
    }

    public function test_the_stored_number_is_never_used_for_other_payment_types(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient([], ['bpjs_number' => self::BPJS]);
        $request = $this->validated($this->data($this->openSession()), $user);

        $this->assertNull($request->validated('bpjs_number') ?? null);
        $this->assertNull($request->toBookingData()->paymentReference);
    }

    /** @return array<string, array{array<string, mixed>, bool}> */
    public static function saveBpjsCases(): array
    {
        return [
            'diketik dan dicentang' => [['bpjs_number' => '0009900000011', 'save_bpjs' => '1'], true],
            'diketik dan benar' => [['bpjs_number' => '0009900000011', 'save_bpjs' => true], true],
            'diketik tanpa centang' => [['bpjs_number' => '0009900000011'], false],
            'diketik dengan nol' => [['bpjs_number' => '0009900000011', 'save_bpjs' => '0'], false],
        ];
    }

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $extra */
    #[DataProvider('saveBpjsCases')]
    public function test_save_bpjs_only_applies_to_a_typed_bpjs_number(array $extra, bool $expected): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();

        $this->assertSame($expected, $this->validated($this->data($this->openSession(), ['payment_type' => 'bpjs'] + $extra), $user)->toBookingData()->saveBpjs);
    }

    public function test_save_bpjs_is_ignored_for_other_payment_types(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();

        $this->assertFalse($this->validated($this->data($this->openSession(), ['save_bpjs' => '1']), $user)->toBookingData()->saveBpjs);
    }

    // --- Store = Review ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_the_store_request_has_the_same_rules_normalisation_and_precheck(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $session = $this->openSession();

        $this->assertInstanceOf(ReviewAppointmentRequest::class, new StoreAppointmentRequest);
        $this->assertSame(
            '0009900000011',
            $this->validated($this->data($session, ['payment_type' => 'bpjs', 'bpjs_number' => '000 9900-000011']), $user, StoreAppointmentRequest::class)->validated('bpjs_number'),
        );

        $this->expectException(ValidationException::class);
        $this->validated($this->data($session, ['payment_type' => 'bpjs', 'bpjs_number' => '12']), $user, StoreAppointmentRequest::class);
    }

    // --- pengalihan dan precheck ---------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_a_validation_failure_redirects_to_the_wizard_with_the_session_id(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $session = $this->openSession();

        foreach ([ReviewAppointmentRequest::class, StoreAppointmentRequest::class] as $class) {
            try {
                $this->validated($this->data($session, ['payment_type' => 'bpjs', 'bpjs_number' => '123']), $user, $class);
                $this->fail('Harus ditolak.');
            } catch (ValidationException $exception) {
                $this->assertSame(route('patient.appointments.create', ['sesi' => (string) $session->id]), $exception->redirectTo, $class);
            }
        }
    }

    /** @return array<string, array{mixed}> */
    public static function unusableSessionIds(): array
    {
        return [
            'kosong' => [null],
            'teks' => ['abc'],
            'larik' => [['1']],
            'nol' => ['0'],
            'negatif' => ['-5'],
            'terlalu panjang' => ['1234567890123456789'],
            'desimal' => ['1.5'],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('unusableSessionIds')]
    public function test_an_unusable_session_id_redirects_to_the_start_of_the_wizard(mixed $id): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();

        try {
            $this->validated(['practice_session_id' => $id, 'payment_type' => 'umum'], $user);
            $this->fail('Harus ditolak.');
        } catch (ValidationException $exception) {
            $this->assertSame(route('patient.appointments.create'), $exception->redirectTo);
            $this->assertArrayHasKey('practice_session_id', $exception->errors());
        }
    }

    public function test_the_precheck_failure_is_an_error_on_the_session_field_with_the_booking_message(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $full = $this->createSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-06', 'quota' => 1, 'booked_count' => 1]);

        try {
            $this->validated($this->data($full), $user);
            $this->fail('Sesi penuh harus ditolak oleh precheck.');
        } catch (ValidationException $exception) {
            $this->assertSame([__('booking.errors.QUOTA_FULL')], $exception->errors()['practice_session_id']);
            $this->assertSame(route('patient.appointments.create', ['sesi' => (string) $full->id]), $exception->redirectTo);
        }
    }

    public function test_the_precheck_is_skipped_while_other_fields_are_invalid(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $full = $this->createSession(['session_date' => '2026-10-06', 'quota' => 1, 'booked_count' => 1]);

        try {
            $this->validated($this->data($full, ['payment_type' => 'bpjs', 'bpjs_number' => '1']), $user);
            $this->fail('Harus ditolak.');
        } catch (ValidationException $exception) {
            $this->assertArrayHasKey('bpjs_number', $exception->errors());
            $this->assertArrayNotHasKey('practice_session_id', $exception->errors(), 'Galat per field didahulukan; precheck baru berjalan bila field lain valid.');
        }
    }

    // --- otorisasi -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_authorization_requires_an_active_patient_with_an_active_profile(): void
    {
        $session = $this->openSession();

        foreach ([$this->createPatient([], ['is_active' => false]), $this->createStaff('registration-officer')] as $user) {
            try {
                $this->validated($this->data($session), $user);
                $this->fail('Harus ditolak oleh otorisasi.');
            } catch (AuthorizationException) {
                $this->addToAssertionCount(1);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Patient\Concerns;

use App\Enums\PaymentType;
use App\Exceptions\BookingException;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\Booking\BookingData;
use App\Services\Booking\BookingService;
use App\Support\Actor;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Validation\Validator;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;

/**
 * Aturan bersama `review` dan `store` (V-10/V-11, F6-R21). Profil yang dipesan SELALU milik `$this->user()`; tidak ada
 * id profil di input. Data tinjauan dibawa sebagai field tersembunyi dan divalidasi ulang sepenuhnya di `store`.
 * Normalisasi (carry fase 5): BPJS tanpa spasi dan `-`; polis tanpa spasi (regex V-10 mengizinkan `-` dan `/`).
 */
trait HasBookingRules
{
    /** Nomor BPJS diisi server dari profil (pasien mengosongkan isian). */
    protected bool $bpjsFromProfile = false;

    /** @return array<string, list<mixed>> */
    protected function bookingRules(): array
    {
        return [
            'practice_session_id' => ['bail', 'required', 'integer', 'min:1', Rule::exists('practice_sessions', 'id')],
            'payment_type' => ['bail', 'required', 'string', Rule::in(PaymentType::values())],
            'bpjs_number' => ['bail', 'nullable', 'required_if:payment_type,bpjs', 'prohibited_unless:payment_type,bpjs', 'string', 'digits:13'],
            'insurance_partner_id' => [
                'bail', 'nullable', 'required_if:payment_type,asuransi', 'prohibited_unless:payment_type,asuransi', 'integer',
                Rule::exists('insurance_partners', 'id')->where('is_active', true),
            ],
            'policy_number' => ['bail', 'nullable', 'prohibited_unless:payment_type,asuransi', 'string', 'max:30', 'regex:/^[A-Za-z0-9\/-]+$/'],
            'complaint' => ['bail', 'nullable', 'string', 'max:500', 'regex:/\A[\s\S]*\z/u'],
            'save_bpjs' => ['nullable', 'boolean'],
        ];
    }

    /** @return array<string, string> */
    protected function bookingMessages(): array
    {
        return [
            'practice_session_id.required' => 'Sesi praktik wajib dipilih.',
            'practice_session_id.integer' => 'Sesi praktik tidak ditemukan.',
            'practice_session_id.min' => 'Sesi praktik tidak ditemukan.',
            'practice_session_id.exists' => 'Sesi praktik tidak ditemukan.',
            'payment_type.required' => 'Jenis pembayaran wajib dipilih.',
            'payment_type.string' => 'Jenis pembayaran tidak valid.',
            'payment_type.in' => 'Jenis pembayaran tidak valid.',
            'bpjs_number.required_if' => 'Nomor BPJS wajib diisi untuk pembayaran BPJS.',
            'bpjs_number.prohibited_unless' => 'Nomor BPJS hanya boleh diisi bila jenis pembayaran adalah BPJS.',
            'bpjs_number.string' => 'Nomor BPJS harus terdiri dari 13 digit angka.',
            'bpjs_number.digits' => 'Nomor BPJS harus terdiri dari 13 digit angka.',
            'insurance_partner_id.required_if' => 'Mitra asuransi wajib dipilih untuk pembayaran asuransi.',
            'insurance_partner_id.prohibited_unless' => 'Mitra asuransi hanya boleh dipilih bila jenis pembayaran adalah asuransi.',
            'insurance_partner_id.integer' => 'Mitra asuransi yang dipilih tidak tersedia.',
            'insurance_partner_id.exists' => 'Mitra asuransi yang dipilih tidak tersedia.',
            'policy_number.prohibited_unless' => 'Nomor polis hanya boleh diisi bila jenis pembayaran adalah asuransi.',
            'policy_number.string' => 'Nomor polis tidak valid.',
            'policy_number.max' => 'Nomor polis maksimal 30 karakter.',
            'policy_number.regex' => 'Nomor polis hanya boleh berisi huruf, angka, garis miring, dan tanda hubung.',
            'complaint.string' => 'Keluhan tidak valid.',
            'complaint.max' => 'Keluhan maksimal 500 karakter.',
            'complaint.regex' => 'Keluhan tidak valid.',
            'save_bpjs.boolean' => 'Pilihan simpan nomor BPJS tidak valid.',
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Normalisasi sebelum validasi. Dipanggil dari `prepareForValidation()` (yang berjalan SEBELUM `authorize()`).
     */
    protected function prepareBookingInput(): void
    {
        $merge = [];

        $bpjs = $this->input('bpjs_number');

        if (is_string($bpjs)) {
            $bpjs = preg_replace('/[\s-]+/u', '', $bpjs) ?? '';
            $merge['bpjs_number'] = $bpjs === '' ? null : $bpjs;
        }

        $policy = $this->input('policy_number');

        if (is_string($policy)) {
            $policy = preg_replace('/\s+/u', '', $policy) ?? '';
            $merge['policy_number'] = $policy === '' ? null : $policy;
        }

        $complaint = $this->input('complaint');

        if (is_string($complaint)) {
            $complaint = trim($complaint);
            $merge['complaint'] = $complaint === '' ? null : $complaint;
        }

        $typed = array_key_exists('bpjs_number', $merge) ? $merge['bpjs_number'] : $bpjs;

        // Pasien mengosongkan isian BPJS dan profil menyimpan nomor: pakai nomor tersimpan (dekripsi hanya di server).
        if ($this->input('payment_type') === PaymentType::Bpjs->value && ($typed === null || $typed === '')) {
            $user = $this->user();
            $stored = $user instanceof User ? $user->loadMissing('patientProfile')->patientProfile?->bpjs_number : null;

            if (is_string($stored) && $stored !== '') {
                $merge['bpjs_number'] = $stored;
                $merge['save_bpjs'] = false;
                $this->bpjsFromProfile = true;
            }
        }

        $this->merge($merge);
    }

    /** Nomor BPJS diketik pasien sendiri (bukan diisi dari profil). */
    public function bpjsTyped(): bool
    {
        return $this->input('payment_type') === PaymentType::Bpjs->value
            && ! $this->bpjsFromProfile
            && is_string($this->input('bpjs_number'))
            && $this->input('bpjs_number') !== '';
    }

    /** `BookingData` dari input yang lolos validasi. */
    public function toBookingData(): BookingData
    {
        return BookingData::fromValidated($this->bookingInput($this->validated()));
    }

    /**
     * Pengalihan untuk kegagalan validasi: langkah 4 untuk sesi yang sama (tidak pernah back(); halaman tinjau adalah
     * hasil POST). Id sesi hanya dipakai bila bilangan bulat positif yang wajar.
     */
    protected function getRedirectUrl(): string
    {
        $id = $this->input('practice_session_id');

        if ((is_string($id) || is_int($id)) && preg_match('/^[1-9][0-9]{0,17}$/', (string) $id) === 1) {
            return route('patient.appointments.create', ['sesi' => (string) $id]);
        }

        return route('patient.appointments.create');
    }

    /**
     * `BookingService::precheck()` (tanpa kunci, tanpa tulis) setelah semua field lolos; kegagalan = galat pada
     * `practice_session_id` dengan pesan `BookingException`. Dibangun dari `only()` karena `validated()` belum dapat
     * dipanggil di dalam hook ini.
     */
    public function withValidator(Validator $validator): void
    {
        $validator->after(function (Validator $validator): void {
            if ($validator->errors()->isNotEmpty()) {
                return;
            }

            $user = $this->user();
            $profile = $user instanceof User ? $user->loadMissing('patientProfile')->patientProfile : null;
            $session = PracticeSession::query()->with(['clinic', 'doctor', 'exception'])->find((int) $this->input('practice_session_id'));

            if ($profile === null || $session === null) {
                $validator->errors()->add('practice_session_id', 'Sesi praktik tidak ditemukan.');

                return;
            }

            $input = $this->only(['payment_type', 'bpjs_number', 'policy_number', 'insurance_partner_id', 'complaint', 'save_bpjs']);

            try {
                app(BookingService::class)->precheck($profile, $session, BookingData::fromValidated($this->bookingInput($input)), Actor::patient($user));
            } catch (BookingException $e) {
                $validator->errors()->add('practice_session_id', $e->getMessage());
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * Bentuk masukan `BookingData::fromValidated()`: referensi hanya sesuai jenis pembayaran, `save_bpjs` hanya untuk
     * nomor BPJS yang diketik pasien sendiri.
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $source
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function bookingInput(array $source): array
    {
        $type = (string) ($source['payment_type'] ?? '');
        $isBpjs = $type === PaymentType::Bpjs->value;
        $isInsurance = $type === PaymentType::Asuransi->value;
        $partner = $source['insurance_partner_id'] ?? null;

        return [
            'payment_type' => $type,
            'bpjs_number' => $isBpjs ? ($source['bpjs_number'] ?? null) : null,
            'policy_number' => $isInsurance ? ($source['policy_number'] ?? null) : null,
            'insurance_partner_id' => $isInsurance && $partner !== null && $partner !== '' ? (int) $partner : null,
            'complaint' => $source['complaint'] ?? null,
            'save_bpjs' => $isBpjs && ! $this->bpjsFromProfile && filter_var($source['save_bpjs'] ?? false, FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOLEAN),
        ];
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Patient;

use App\Http\Requests\Patient\Concerns\HasBookingRules;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;

/**
 * V-10: POST `patient.appointments.review` (langkah 5, tidak menyimpan apa pun). Hanya akun pasien aktif dengan profil
 * aktif (AppointmentPolicy::createOnline); kegagalan validasi dan galat `precheck` dialihkan ke `create?sesi=`.
 */
class ReviewAppointmentRequest extends FormRequest
{
    use HasBookingRules;

    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        $user = $this->user();

        return $user instanceof User && $user->can('createOnline', Appointment::class);
    }

    protected function prepareForValidation(): void
    {
        $this->prepareBookingInput();
    }

    /** @return array<string, mixed> */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        return $this->bookingRules();
    }

    /** @return array<string, string> */
    public function messages(): array
    {
        return $this->bookingMessages();
    }
}
```

```php
<?php
```

```php
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use Illuminate\Testing\TestResponse;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithMasterData;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithPatients;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Langkah 5 (tinjau) dan simpan (F6-R9/R10/R20/R21/R37): VAL-03, VAL-08, BKG-20 (sisi HTTP), SEK-05/06/11/12/15,
 * Review Focus 1 (kirim ganda), 3 dan 4 (field tersembunyi dipalsukan), 5. Waktu: Senin 5 Oktober 2026 07.00; sesi uji
 * Selasa 6 Oktober 09.00 sampai 12.00, kuota 20.
 */
class BookingSubmissionTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithMasterData;
    use InteractsWithPatients;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private const BPJS = '0009900000011';

    private ?User $patient = null;

    private ?PracticeSession $bookable = null;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-05 07:00:00');

        $today = CarbonImmutable::today();
        Cache::put(PracticeSessionGenerator::markerKey($today), true, $today->endOfDay());
    }

    // --- pembantu ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    /** Pasien uji (satu per tes). Panggilan PERTAMA menentukan isi profil (mis. `bpjs_number` tersimpan). */
    private function patient(array $profile = []): User
    {
        return $this->patient ??= $this->createPatient(['name' => 'Siti Rahma', 'email' => 'siti@contoh.test'], $profile + ['full_name' => 'Siti Rahma']);
    }

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides */
    private function sessionFor(Doctor $doctor, string $date, array $overrides = []): PracticeSession
    {
        return $this->createSession(array_merge([
            'doctor_id' => $doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $doctor->clinic_id,
            'session_date' => $date,
            'start_time' => '09:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'quota' => 20,
        ], $overrides));
    }

    private function bookableSession(): PracticeSession
    {
        return $this->bookable ??= $this->sessionFor(
            $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Laras Wulandari'], $this->createClinic(['name' => 'Poliklinik Anak Uji', 'code' => 'ANK'])),
            '2026-10-06',
        );
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function payload(array $overrides = []): array
    {
        return $overrides + [
            'practice_session_id' => (string) $this->bookableSession()->id,
            'payment_type' => 'umum',
            'complaint' => 'Batuk berdahak sejak tiga hari.',
        ];
    }

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $data */
    private function submit(string $routeName, array $data, ?User $user = null): TestResponse
    {
        $id = $data['practice_session_id'] ?? null;
        $query = is_string($id) || is_int($id) ? ['sesi' => $id] : [];

        return $this->actingAs($user ?? $this->patient())
            ->from(route('patient.appointments.create', $query))
            ->post(route($routeName), $data);

    private function wizardStepThree(PracticeSession $session): string
    {
        return route('patient.appointments.create', [
            'poli' => Clinic::query()->findOrFail($session->clinic_id)->slug,
            'dokter' => Doctor::query()->findOrFail($session->doctor_id)->slug,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Field tersembunyi form `store` pada halaman tinjau (tanpa `_token`), nilai sudah di-decode.
     *
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    private function hiddenFields(string $html): array
    {
        preg_match_all('#<input type="hidden" name="([^"]+)" value="([^"]*)">#', $html, $matches, PREG_SET_ORDER);
        $fields = [];

        foreach ($matches as [, $name, $value]) {
            if ($name !== '_token') {
                $fields[$name] = html_entity_decode($value, ENT_QUOTES);
            }
        }

        ksort($fields);

        return $fields;
    }

    /** Memasang penghenti satu kali tepat sebelum transaksi `book()` dimulai (lihat Catatan teknis). */
    private function beforeBooking(callable $callback): void
    {
        $armed = true;

        DB::beforeStartingTransaction(function () use (&$armed, $callback): void {
            if ($armed) {
                $armed = false;
                $callback();
            }
        });
    }

    /** @return array<string, array{string}> */
    public static function submitRoutes(): array
    {
        return [
            'tinjau' => ['patient.appointments.review'],
            'simpan' => ['patient.appointments.store'],
        ];
    }

    // --- route -------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_the_routes_are_registered_with_the_documented_middleware(): void
    {
        $expected = [
            'patient.appointments.review' => ['pasien/pendaftaran/tinjau', ['POST'], ['web', 'auth', 'account:patient', 'active'], 'review'],
            'patient.appointments.store' => ['pasien/pendaftaran', ['POST'], ['web', 'auth', 'account:patient', 'active', 'throttle:booking'], 'store'],
            'patient.appointments.show' => ['pasien/pendaftaran/{appointment}', ['GET', 'HEAD'], ['web', 'auth', 'account:patient', 'active'], 'show'],
        ];

        foreach ($expected as $name => [$uri, $methods, $middleware, $method]) {
            $route = Route::getRoutes()->getByName($name);

            $this->assertNotNull($route, $name);
            $this->assertSame($uri, $route->uri(), $name);
            $this->assertSame($methods, $route->methods(), $name);
            $this->assertSame($middleware, array_values(array_filter($route->gatherMiddleware(), 'is_string')), $name);
            $this->assertSame('App\\Http\\Controllers\\Patient\\AppointmentController@'.$method, $route->getActionName(), $name);
        }
    }

    public function test_guests_and_staff_cannot_use_review_and_store(): void
    {
        $data = $this->payload();
        $staff = $this->createStaff('registration-officer');

        foreach (['patient.appointments.review', 'patient.appointments.store'] as $name) {
            $this->post(route($name), $data)->assertRedirect(route('login'));
        }

        foreach (['patient.appointments.review', 'patient.appointments.store'] as $name) {
            $this->actingAs($staff)->post(route($name), $data)->assertRedirect(route('admin.dashboard'));
        }

        $this->assertSame(0, Appointment::query()->count());
    }

    public function test_review_renders_the_summary_without_saving_anything_or_assigning_a_queue_number(): void
    {
        $session = $this->bookableSession();

        $response = $this->submit('patient.appointments.review', $this->payload())->assertOk();
        $html = $response->getContent();

        foreach ([
            'Langkah 5 - Periksa dan kirim',
            'Poliklinik Anak Uji',
            'dr. Laras Wulandari, Sp.PD',
            'Selasa, 6 Oktober 2026',
            '09.00–12.00 (sisa kuota saat ini: 20 dari 20)',
            'Siti Rahma',
            'Umum/Pribadi',
            'Batuk berdahak sejak tiga hari.',
            'Nomor antrean diberikan setelah pendaftaran berhasil dikirim.',
            'Pembatalan oleh pasien dapat dilakukan hingga 120 menit sebelum sesi.',
            'Ubah data',
            'Kirim Pendaftaran',
        ] as $text) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString($text, $html, $text);
        }

        $this->assertStringContainsString('<form method="POST" action="'.route('patient.appointments.store').'" novalidate>', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('href="'.route('patient.appointments.create', ['sesi' => $session->id]).'"', $html, 'Ubah data = GET ke langkah 4.');
        $this->assertSame(
            ['complaint' => 'Batuk berdahak sejak tiga hari.', 'payment_type' => 'umum', 'practice_session_id' => (string) $session->id],
            $this->hiddenFields($html),
        );
        $this->assertSame(1, substr_count($html, 'aria-current="step"'));
        $this->assertSame(1, substr_count($html, '<h1'));
        $this->assertStringContainsString('no-store', (string) $response->headers->get('Cache-Control'));

        $this->assertSame(0, Appointment::query()->count());
        $this->assertSame(0, $session->fresh()->booked_count);
        $this->assertSame(0, $session->fresh()->last_queue_number);
    }

    /**
     * Kolom: [override payload, field galat, pesan, sesi pada URL pengalihan (`__SESI__` | '' | id literal)].
     *
     * @return array<string, array{array<string, mixed>, string, string, string}>
     */
    public static function invalidSubmissions(): array
    {
        $bpjs = 'Nomor BPJS harus terdiri dari 13 digit angka.';
        $partner = 'Mitra asuransi yang dipilih tidak tersedia.';
        $session = 'Sesi praktik tidak ditemukan.';
        $payment = 'Jenis pembayaran tidak valid.';

        return [
            'bpjs 12 digit' => [['payment_type' => 'bpjs', 'bpjs_number' => '000990000001'], 'bpjs_number', $bpjs, '__SESI__'],
            'bpjs 14 digit' => [['payment_type' => 'bpjs', 'bpjs_number' => '00099000000112'], 'bpjs_number', $bpjs, '__SESI__'],
            'bpjs berisi huruf' => [['payment_type' => 'bpjs', 'bpjs_number' => '00099000000AB'], 'bpjs_number', $bpjs, '__SESI__'],
            'bpjs larik' => [['payment_type' => 'bpjs', 'bpjs_number' => ['0009900000011']], 'bpjs_number', $bpjs, '__SESI__'],
            'bpjs kosong tanpa nomor tersimpan' => [['payment_type' => 'bpjs'], 'bpjs_number', 'Nomor BPJS wajib diisi untuk pembayaran BPJS.', '__SESI__'],
            'bpjs untuk umum' => [['payment_type' => 'umum', 'bpjs_number' => '0009900000011'], 'bpjs_number', 'Nomor BPJS hanya boleh diisi bila jenis pembayaran adalah BPJS.', '__SESI__'],
            'bpjs untuk asuransi' => [['payment_type' => 'asuransi', 'bpjs_number' => '0009900000011', 'insurance_partner_id' => '__MITRA__'], 'bpjs_number', 'Nomor BPJS hanya boleh diisi bila jenis pembayaran adalah BPJS.', '__SESI__'],
            'asuransi tanpa mitra' => [['payment_type' => 'asuransi'], 'insurance_partner_id', 'Mitra asuransi wajib dipilih untuk pembayaran asuransi.', '__SESI__'],
            'mitra untuk umum' => [['payment_type' => 'umum', 'insurance_partner_id' => '__MITRA__'], 'insurance_partner_id', 'Mitra asuransi hanya boleh dipilih bila jenis pembayaran adalah asuransi.', '__SESI__'],
            'mitra tidak ada' => [['payment_type' => 'asuransi', 'insurance_partner_id' => '999999'], 'insurance_partner_id', $partner, '__SESI__'],
            'mitra nonaktif' => [['payment_type' => 'asuransi', 'insurance_partner_id' => '__MITRA_NONAKTIF__'], 'insurance_partner_id', $partner, '__SESI__'],
            'mitra larik' => [['payment_type' => 'asuransi', 'insurance_partner_id' => ['1']], 'insurance_partner_id', $partner, '__SESI__'],
            'polis untuk umum' => [['payment_type' => 'umum', 'policy_number' => 'POL-1'], 'policy_number', 'Nomor polis hanya boleh diisi bila jenis pembayaran adalah asuransi.', '__SESI__'],
            'polis berisi karakter terlarang' => [['payment_type' => 'asuransi', 'insurance_partner_id' => '__MITRA__', 'policy_number' => 'AB#12'], 'policy_number', 'Nomor polis hanya boleh berisi huruf, angka, garis miring, dan tanda hubung.', '__SESI__'],
            'polis 31 karakter' => [['payment_type' => 'asuransi', 'insurance_partner_id' => '__MITRA__', 'policy_number' => str_repeat('A', 31)], 'policy_number', 'Nomor polis maksimal 30 karakter.', '__SESI__'],
            'polis larik' => [['payment_type' => 'asuransi', 'insurance_partner_id' => '__MITRA__', 'policy_number' => ['AB1']], 'policy_number', 'Nomor polis tidak valid.', '__SESI__'],
            'pembayaran kosong' => [['payment_type' => null], 'payment_type', 'Jenis pembayaran wajib dipilih.', '__SESI__'],
            'pembayaran tidak dikenal' => [['payment_type' => 'tunai'], 'payment_type', $payment, '__SESI__'],
            'pembayaran larik' => [['payment_type' => ['umum']], 'payment_type', $payment, '__SESI__'],
            'keluhan 501 karakter' => [['complaint' => str_repeat('a', 501)], 'complaint', 'Keluhan maksimal 500 karakter.', '__SESI__'],
            'keluhan larik' => [['complaint' => ['a']], 'complaint', 'Keluhan tidak valid.', '__SESI__'],
            'sesi kosong' => [['practice_session_id' => null], 'practice_session_id', 'Sesi praktik wajib dipilih.', ''],
            'sesi tidak ada' => [['practice_session_id' => '999999'], 'practice_session_id', $session, '999999'],
            'sesi berupa teks' => [['practice_session_id' => 'abc'], 'practice_session_id', $session, ''],
            'sesi larik' => [['practice_session_id' => ['1']], 'practice_session_id', $session, ''],
            'save_bpjs tidak valid' => [['payment_type' => 'bpjs', 'bpjs_number' => '0009900000011', 'save_bpjs' => 'abc'], 'save_bpjs', 'Pilihan simpan nomor BPJS tidak valid.', '__SESI__'],
            'keluhan UTF-8 rusak' => [['complaint' => "a\xC3\x28"], 'complaint', 'Keluhan tidak valid.', '__SESI__'],
        ];
    }

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides */
    #[DataProvider('invalidSubmissions')]
    public function test_an_invalid_submission_returns_to_the_wizard_with_the_field_message(array $overrides, string $field, string $message, string $sesi): void
    {
        $partner = InsurancePartner::factory()->create();
        $inactivePartner = InsurancePartner::factory()->inactive()->create();
        $session = $this->bookableSession();
        $replacements = ['__MITRA__' => (string) $partner->id, '__MITRA_NONAKTIF__' => (string) $inactivePartner->id];
        $overrides = array_map(fn (mixed $value): mixed => is_string($value) ? strtr($value, $replacements) : $value, $overrides);
        $expected = match ($sesi) {
            '__SESI__' => route('patient.appointments.create', ['sesi' => $session->id]),
            '' => route('patient.appointments.create'),
            default => route('patient.appointments.create', ['sesi' => $sesi]),
        };

        foreach (['patient.appointments.review', 'patient.appointments.store'] as $routeName) {
            $this->submit($routeName, $this->payload($overrides))
                ->assertRedirect($expected)
                ->assertSessionHasErrors([$field => $message])
                ->assertSessionMissing('_old_input.bpjs_number')
                ->assertSessionMissing('_old_input.policy_number');
        }

        $this->assertSame(0, Appointment::query()->count());
    }

    /** VAL-08: BPJS 12 digit pada `review` dan `store`: 302 ke langkah 4, input dipertahankan kecuali nomor, tidak 405. */

            ->assertSee('value="bpjs" checked', false);
    }

    // --- simpan (sukses) -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_store_books_the_session_and_redirects_to_the_detail_with_the_success_flash(): void
    {
        $session = $this->bookableSession();
        $user = $this->patient();

        $response = $this->submit('patient.appointments.store', $this->payload());

        $appointment = Appointment::query()->firstOrFail();
        $detail = route('patient.appointments.show', ['appointment' => $appointment->booking_code]);

        $response->assertRedirect($detail)
            ->assertSessionHas('success', 'Pendaftaran berhasil. Simpan kode booking Anda: '.$appointment->booking_code.'.');
        $this->assertMatchesRegularExpression(BookingCodeGenerator::PATTERN, $appointment->booking_code);
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Pending, $appointment->status);
        $this->assertSame(1, $appointment->queue_number);
        $this->assertSame(BookingChannel::Online, $appointment->channel);
        $this->assertSame(PaymentType::Umum, $appointment->payment_type);
        $this->assertSame('Batuk berdahak sejak tiga hari.', $appointment->complaint);
        $this->assertSame($user->patientProfile->id, $appointment->patient_profile_id);
        $this->assertSame($session->id, $appointment->practice_session_id);
        $this->assertSame(1, $session->fresh()->booked_count);
        $this->assertSame(1, $session->fresh()->last_queue_number);

        $this->get($detail)->assertOk()->assertSee('Pendaftaran berhasil. Simpan kode booking Anda: '.$appointment->booking_code.'.');
    }

    public function test_a_typed_bpjs_number_is_stored_encrypted_and_saved_to_the_profile_when_asked(): void
    {
        $user = $this->patient();

        $this->submit('patient.appointments.store', $this->payload(['payment_type' => 'bpjs', 'bpjs_number' => '000 9900-000011', 'save_bpjs' => '1']));

        $appointment = Appointment::query()->firstOrFail();
        $row = DB::table('appointments')->where('id', $appointment->id)->first();

        $this->assertSame(PaymentType::Bpjs, $appointment->payment_type);
        $this->assertSame(self::BPJS, $appointment->payment_reference);
        $this->assertSame('0011', $row->payment_reference_last4);
        $this->assertNotSame(self::BPJS, $row->payment_reference);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString(self::BPJS, (string) $row->payment_reference);
        $this->assertSame(self::BPJS, $user->patientProfile->fresh()->bpjs_number);
        $this->assertSame('0011', $user->patientProfile->fresh()->bpjs_number_last4);
    }
```
