```php
    public function test_tampered_system_fields_are_never_read_from_the_input(): void
    {
        $user = $this->patient();
        $other = $this->createPatient(['email' => 'lain@contoh.test']);

        $this->submit('patient.appointments.store', $this->payload([
            'patient_profile_id' => (string) $other->patientProfile->id,
            'user_id' => (string) $other->id,
            'status' => 'confirmed',
            'booking_code' => 'UPH-AAAA-AAAA',
            'queue_number' => '99',
            'channel' => 'loket',
            'created_by_user_id' => (string) $other->id,
            'cancelled_by_type' => 'patient',
            'payment_reference' => '0001234567890',
            'doctor_id' => '1',
            'clinic_id' => '1',
            'session_date' => '2030-01-01',
        ]));

        $appointment = Appointment::query()->firstOrFail();

        $this->assertSame($user->patientProfile->id, $appointment->patient_profile_id);
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Pending, $appointment->status);
        $this->assertNotSame('UPH-AAAA-AAAA', $appointment->booking_code);
        $this->assertSame(1, $appointment->queue_number);
        $this->assertSame(BookingChannel::Online, $appointment->channel);
        $this->assertNull($appointment->created_by_user_id, 'Pendaftaran online tidak mencatat petugas pembuat.');
        $this->assertNull($appointment->cancelled_by_type);
        $this->assertNull($appointment->payment_reference, 'Pembayaran umum tidak menyimpan referensi.');
        $this->assertSame($this->bookableSession()->doctor_id, $appointment->doctor_id);
        $this->assertSame($this->bookableSession()->session_date->toDateString(), $appointment->session_date->toDateString());
        $this->assertSame(0, Appointment::query()->where('patient_profile_id', $other->patientProfile->id)->count());
    }

    public function test_a_tampered_session_id_books_that_session_only_if_the_rules_allow_it(): void
    {
        $this->patient();
        $other = $this->sessionFor($this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Bima Santoso']), '2026-10-07');
        $closed = $this->sessionFor($this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Citra Lestari']), '2026-10-07', ['status' => SessionStatus::Closed]);

        $this->submit('patient.appointments.store', $this->payload(['practice_session_id' => (string) $closed->id]))
            ->assertRedirect(route('patient.appointments.create', ['sesi' => $closed->id]))
            ->assertSessionHasErrors(['practice_session_id' => __('booking.errors.SESSION_UNAVAILABLE')]);
        $this->assertSame(0, Appointment::query()->count());

        $this->submit('patient.appointments.store', $this->payload(['practice_session_id' => (string) $other->id]));
        $this->assertSame($other->id, Appointment::query()->firstOrFail()->practice_session_id, 'Data divalidasi ulang; sesi lain yang sah dipesan apa adanya.');
    }

    // --- kirim ganda (F6-R9, Review Focus 1) ----------------------------------------------------

    public function test_a_held_submit_lock_answers_with_the_processing_message_and_books_nothing(): void
    {
        $user = $this->patient();
        $session = $this->bookableSession();
        $lock = Cache::lock('booking-submit:'.$user->id, 10);
        $this->assertTrue($lock->get());

        $this->submit('patient.appointments.store', $this->payload(['payment_type' => 'bpjs', 'bpjs_number' => self::BPJS]))
            ->assertRedirect(route('patient.appointments.create', ['sesi' => $session->id]))
            ->assertSessionHas('error', 'Permintaan Anda sedang diproses. Mohon tunggu sebentar dan jangan menekan tombol berulang kali.')
            ->assertSessionHas('_old_input.payment_type', 'bpjs')
            ->assertSessionMissing('_old_input.bpjs_number');

        $this->assertSame(0, Appointment::query()->count());
        $this->assertSame(0, $session->fresh()->booked_count);
        $this->assertSame(0, $session->fresh()->last_queue_number);

        $lock->release();

        $this->submit('patient.appointments.store', $this->payload());
        $this->assertSame(1, Appointment::query()->count(), 'Sesudah lock dilepas, pengiriman berikutnya berhasil.');
    }

    public function test_the_lock_is_per_patient_and_released_after_a_successful_booking(): void
    {
        $user = $this->patient();
        $other = $this->createPatient(['email' => 'lain@contoh.test']);
        $this->assertTrue(Cache::lock('booking-submit:'.$user->id, 10)->get());

        $this->submit('patient.appointments.store', $this->payload(), $other)->assertSessionHas('success');
        $this->assertSame(1, Appointment::query()->count(), 'Pasien lain tidak ditahan oleh lock pasien ini.');

        Cache::lock('booking-submit:'.$user->id)->forceRelease();
        $this->submit('patient.appointments.store', $this->payload(), $user)->assertSessionHas('success');

        $lock = Cache::lock('booking-submit:'.$user->id, 10);
        $this->assertTrue($lock->get(), 'Lock dilepas di finally setelah booking selesai.');
        $lock->release();
    }

    public function test_the_lock_is_released_even_when_booking_fails(): void
    {
        $user = $this->patient();
        $data = $this->payload();
        $this->beforeBooking(function (): void {
            throw BookingException::make(BookingException::SYSTEM_BUSY);
        });

        $this->submit('patient.appointments.store', $data)->assertSessionHas('error');

        $lock = Cache::lock('booking-submit:'.$user->id, 10);
        $this->assertTrue($lock->get());
        $lock->release();
    }

    public function test_a_second_submission_of_the_same_payload_is_a_duplicate_with_only_one_appointment(): void
    {
        $session = $this->bookableSession();

        $this->submit('patient.appointments.store', $this->payload())->assertSessionHas('success');
        $this->submit('patient.appointments.store', $this->payload())
            ->assertRedirect(route('patient.appointments.create', ['sesi' => $session->id]))
            ->assertSessionHasErrors(['practice_session_id' => 'Anda sudah memiliki pendaftaran aktif pada sesi dokter ini.']);

        $this->assertSame(1, Appointment::query()->count());
        $this->assertSame(1, $session->fresh()->booked_count);
    }

    // --- throttle (SEK-05, F6-R37) --------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_the_eleventh_store_in_a_minute_is_throttled_with_a_redirect_and_retry_after(): void
    {
        $user = $this->patient();
        $session = $this->bookableSession();
        $data = ['practice_session_id' => (string) $session->id];

        for ($attempt = 1; $attempt <= 10; $attempt++) {
            $this->submit('patient.appointments.store', $data, $user)->assertStatus(302)->assertSessionHasErrors('payment_type');
        }

        $this->submit('patient.appointments.store', $data, $user)
            ->assertStatus(302)
            ->assertRedirect(route('patient.appointments.create', ['sesi' => $session->id]))
            ->assertHeader('Retry-After')
            ->assertSessionHas('error', fn (string $message): bool => preg_match('/^Terlalu banyak percobaan\. Silakan coba lagi dalam \d+ detik\.$/', $message) === 1);

        $this->assertSame(0, Appointment::query()->count());
    }

    // --- pengalihan per kode (F6-R10, BKG-20) -----------------------------------------------------

    /** @return array<string, array{string, string}> */
    public static function bookingFailures(): array
    {
        return [
            'SESSION_UNAVAILABLE' => [BookingException::SESSION_UNAVAILABLE, 'langkah3'],
            'OUTSIDE_WINDOW' => [BookingException::OUTSIDE_WINDOW, 'langkah3'],
            'CUTOFF_PASSED' => [BookingException::CUTOFF_PASSED, 'langkah3'],
            'QUOTA_FULL' => [BookingException::QUOTA_FULL, 'langkah3'],
            'OVERLAPPING_BOOKING' => [BookingException::OVERLAPPING_BOOKING, 'langkah3'],
            'INVALID_PAYMENT' => [BookingException::INVALID_PAYMENT, 'langkah4'],
            'SYSTEM_BUSY' => [BookingException::SYSTEM_BUSY, 'langkah4'],
            'DUPLICATE_BOOKING' => [BookingException::DUPLICATE_BOOKING, 'detail'],
            'ACTIVE_LIMIT_REACHED' => [BookingException::ACTIVE_LIMIT_REACHED, 'riwayat'],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('bookingFailures')]
    public function test_a_booking_exception_from_book_is_redirected_per_code_with_its_message_as_a_flash(string $code, string $kind): void
    {
        $user = $this->patient();
        $session = $this->bookableSession();
        $existing = $this->bookAppointment(
            $this->sessionFor($this->createDoctor(), '2026-10-12'),
            AppointmentStatus::Pending,
            ['patient_profile_id' => $user->patientProfile->id],
        );
        $exception = BookingException::make($code, [], $code === BookingException::DUPLICATE_BOOKING ? ['appointment_code' => $existing->booking_code] : []);
        $expected = match ($kind) {
            'langkah3' => $this->wizardStepThree($session),
            'langkah4' => route('patient.appointments.create', ['sesi' => $session->id]),
            'detail' => route('patient.appointments.show', ['appointment' => $existing->booking_code]),
            'riwayat' => Route::has('patient.appointments.index') ? route('patient.appointments.index') : route('patient.dashboard'),
        };
        $before = Appointment::query()->count();

        $this->beforeBooking(function () use ($exception): void {
            throw $exception;
        });

        $this->submit('patient.appointments.store', $this->payload(['payment_type' => 'bpjs', 'bpjs_number' => self::BPJS, 'complaint' => 'Pusing sejak pagi.']))
            ->assertStatus(302)
            ->assertRedirect($expected)
            ->assertSessionHas('error', $exception->getMessage())
            ->assertSessionHas('_old_input.payment_type', 'bpjs')
            ->assertSessionHas('_old_input.complaint', 'Pusing sejak pagi.')
            ->assertSessionMissing('_old_input.bpjs_number');

        $this->assertSame($before, Appointment::query()->count());
    }

    public function test_a_quota_race_between_validation_and_booking_returns_to_step_three_with_the_real_message(): void
    {
        $session = $this->bookableSession();
        $this->patient();

        $this->beforeBooking(function () use ($session): void {
            DB::table('practice_sessions')->where('id', $session->id)->update(['booked_count' => 20, 'last_queue_number' => 20]);
        });

        $this->submit('patient.appointments.store', $this->payload())
            ->assertRedirect($this->wizardStepThree($session))
            ->assertSessionHas('error', __('booking.errors.QUOTA_FULL'));

        $this->assertSame(0, Appointment::query()->count());
        $this->assertSame(20, $session->fresh()->booked_count, 'Hanya perubahan simulasi; book() tidak menulis apa pun.');
    }

    public function test_a_duplicate_created_between_validation_and_booking_redirects_to_that_appointment(): void
    {
        $user = $this->patient();
        $session = $this->bookableSession();

        $this->beforeBooking(function () use ($session, $user): void {
            $this->bookAppointment($session, AppointmentStatus::Pending, ['patient_profile_id' => $user->patientProfile->id]);
        });

        $response = $this->submit('patient.appointments.store', $this->payload());
        $existing = Appointment::query()->firstOrFail();

        $response->assertRedirect(route('patient.appointments.show', ['appointment' => $existing->booking_code]))
            ->assertSessionHas('error', 'Anda sudah memiliki pendaftaran aktif pada sesi dokter ini.');
        $this->assertSame(1, Appointment::query()->count());
    }
```

```php
    /**
     * Langkah 5 (F6-R17): halaman tinjau hasil POST. Tidak menyimpan apa pun dan tidak memberi nomor antrean. Validasi
     * V-10 dan `BookingService::precheck()` sudah dijalankan Form Request (kegagalan dialihkan ke `create?sesi=`).
     */
    public function review(ReviewAppointmentRequest $request, DoctorAvailabilityQuery $availability, SettingsService $settings): View
    {
        $profile = $request->user()->loadMissing('patientProfile')->patientProfile;
        $session = PracticeSession::query()
            ->with(['clinic', 'doctor', 'exception'])
            ->findOrFail((int) $request->validated('practice_session_id'));
        $data = $request->toBookingData();
        $last4 = $data->paymentReferenceLast4();

        return view('patient.appointments.review', [
            'session' => $session,
            'item' => $availability->forSession($session),
            'clinic' => $session->clinic,
            'doctor' => $session->doctor,
            'profile' => $profile,
            'data' => $data,
            'partner' => $data->insurancePartnerId === null ? null : InsurancePartner::query()->find($data->insurancePartnerId),
            'maskedReference' => $last4 === null ? null : self::MASK.$last4,
            'hidden' => $this->hiddenFields($session, $data, $request->bpjsTyped()),
            'cancelMinutes' => $settings->bookingRules()->cancelCutoffMinutes,
            'links' => $this->stepLinks($session->clinic, $session->doctor, $session->session_date->toDateString(), $session->id),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Simpan (F6-R9, F6-R20): kunci kirim-ganda per pasien di controller (bukan service), lalu `BookingService::book()`.
     * Kegagalan `BookingException` ditangani handler global (redirect per kode, F6-R10).
     */
    public function store(StoreAppointmentRequest $request, BookingService $booking): RedirectResponse
    {
        $user = $request->user();
        $profile = $user->loadMissing('patientProfile')->patientProfile;
        $sessionId = (int) $request->validated('practice_session_id');

        $lock = Cache::lock('booking-submit:'.$user->getKey(), 10);

        if (! $lock->get()) {
            return redirect()->route('patient.appointments.create', ['sesi' => $sessionId])
                ->withInput($request->except(SensitiveInput::FIELDS))
                ->with('error', __('booking.submit_in_progress'));
        }

        try {
            $appointment = $booking->book($profile, $sessionId, $request->toBookingData(), Actor::patient($user));
        } finally {
            $lock->release();
        }

        return redirect()->route('patient.appointments.show', ['appointment' => $appointment->booking_code])
            ->with('success', 'Pendaftaran berhasil. Simpan kode booking Anda: '.$appointment->booking_code.'.');
    }

    /** Detail pendaftaran (F6-R24): hanya pemilik (kode pasien lain = 404 lewat AppointmentPolicy::view). */
    public function show(Appointment $appointment, AppointmentProofService $proof, SettingsService $settings): View
    {
        $this->authorize('view', $appointment);

        $appointment->load(['patientProfile', 'clinic', 'doctor', 'practiceSession', 'insurancePartner', 'statusHistories']);

        return view('patient.appointments.show', [
            'appointment' => $appointment,
            'qrDataUri' => $proof->qrSvgDataUri($appointment),
            'checkinMinutes' => $settings->bookingRules()->checkinOpenMinutes,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Field tersembunyi form `store` pada halaman tinjau. Nomor BPJS dan polis lengkap hanya ada di sini bila diketik
     * pasien sendiri (F6-R21); nomor dari profil tidak pernah dirender (server mengisinya ulang di `store`).
     *
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    private function hiddenFields(PracticeSession $session, BookingData $data, bool $bpjsTyped): array
    {
        $fields = [
            'practice_session_id' => (string) $session->id,
            'payment_type' => $data->paymentType->value,
            'complaint' => $data->complaint,
        ];

        if ($data->paymentType === PaymentType::Asuransi) {
            $fields['insurance_partner_id'] = $data->insurancePartnerId === null ? null : (string) $data->insurancePartnerId;
            $fields['policy_number'] = $data->paymentReference;
        }

        if ($data->paymentType === PaymentType::Bpjs && $bpjsTyped) {
            $fields['bpjs_number'] = $data->paymentReference;
            $fields['save_bpjs'] = $data->saveBpjs ? '1' : null;
        }

        return array_filter($fields, fn (?string $value): bool => $value !== null && $value !== '');
    }

    // [[METODE-PUBLIK-BERIKUT]] (T8 sampai T10 menambah method publik di atas baris ini: review, store, show, index, cancel, proof, proofPdf)
```

```blade
                        <x-status-badge :status="$history->to_status" class="ms-1" />
                        <span class="text-body-secondary">(oleh {{ $history->actor_type->label() }})</span>
                        @if (filled($history->reason))
                            <span class="d-block small text-body-secondary">{{ $history->reason }}</span>
                        @endif
                    </li>
                @endforeach
            </ol>

            <div class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-2 mt-4" data-appointment-actions>
                {{-- [[AKSI-DETAIL-BERIKUT]] --}}
                <a class="btn btn-outline-secondary" href="{{ route('patient.dashboard') }}">Ke Dashboard</a>
            </div>
        </div>

</x-layouts.patient>
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Patient;

use App\Enums\ActorType;

    private const BPJS = '0009900000011';

    private ?PracticeSession $bookable = null;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-05 07:00:00');

        $today = CarbonImmutable::today();
        Cache::put(PracticeSessionGenerator::markerKey($today), true, $today->endOfDay());
    }

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $profile */
    private function patient(array $profile = []): User
    {
        return $this->patient ??= $this->createPatient(['name' => 'Siti Rahma', 'email' => 'siti@contoh.test'], $profile + ['full_name' => 'Siti Rahma']);
    }

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $doctor */
    private function bookableSession(array $doctor = ['name' => 'Laras Wulandari'], array $clinic = ['name' => 'Poliklinik Anak Uji', 'code' => 'ANK']): PracticeSession
    {
        if ($this->bookable !== null) {
            return $this->bookable;
        }

        $created = $this->createDoctor($doctor, $this->createClinic($clinic));

        return $this->bookable = $this->createSession([
            'doctor_id' => $created->id,
            'clinic_id' => $created->clinic_id,
            'session_date' => '2026-10-06',
            'start_time' => '09:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'quota' => 20,
        ]);
    }

    private function book(User $user, ?BookingData $data = null, ?PracticeSession $session = null): Appointment
    {
        return app(BookingService::class)->book(
            $user->patientProfile,
            ($session ?? $this->bookableSession())->id,
            $data ?? new BookingData(PaymentType::Umum, complaint: 'Batuk berdahak sejak tiga hari.'),
            Actor::patient($user),
        );
    }

    private function detailUrl(Appointment $appointment): string
    {
        return route('patient.appointments.show', ['appointment' => $appointment->booking_code]);
    }

    private function open(Appointment $appointment, ?User $user = null): string
    {
        return $this->actingAs($user ?? $this->patient())->get($this->detailUrl($appointment))->assertOk()->getContent();
    }

    // --- isi -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_the_detail_shows_the_booking_data_the_code_box_and_the_status_history(): void
    {
        $user = $this->patient();

        $this->assertStringContainsString('•••••••••3-45', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('AB123-45', $html);
    }

    // --- SEK-12 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_the_bpjs_number_is_masked_on_the_page_and_encrypted_in_the_database(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->book($this->patient(), new BookingData(PaymentType::Bpjs, self::BPJS));

        $html = $this->open($appointment);
        $row = DB::table('appointments')->where('id', $appointment->id)->first();

        $this->assertStringContainsString('BPJS Kesehatan', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('•••••••••0011', $html);

    // --- SEK-13 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_the_qr_on_the_page_decodes_to_the_booking_code_only(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->book($this->patient(), new BookingData(PaymentType::Bpjs, self::BPJS));

        $html = $this->open($appointment);

        $this->assertSame(1, preg_match('#<img src="(data:image/svg\+xml;base64,[^"]+)" alt="Kode QR booking#', $html, $matches));
        $this->assertSame($matches[1], app(AppointmentProofService::class)->qrSvgDataUri($appointment));

        $svg = (string) base64_decode(substr($matches[1], strlen('data:image/svg+xml;base64,')), true);

        $this->assertSame($appointment->booking_code, AppointmentProofServiceTest::decodeSvg($svg));
        $this->assertSame($appointment->booking_code, app(AppointmentProofService::class)->qrPayload($appointment));

        $this->assertStringNotContainsString(self::BPJS, $svg);

    public function test_names_complaint_and_history_reasons_are_escaped(): void
    {
        $script = '<script>alert(1)</script>';
        $user = $this->createPatient(['email' => 'siti@contoh.test'], ['full_name' => $script]);
        $this->patient = $user;
        $session = $this->bookableSession(['name' => $script], ['name' => '<b>Poli</b> Uji', 'code' => 'XSS']);

            'from_status' => AppointmentStatus::Pending,

            'actor_type' => ActorType::Staff,

            'created_at' => '2026-10-05 08:45:00',
        ])->save();

        $html = $this->open($appointment, $user);

        $this->assertStringNotContainsString($script, $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('<b>Poli</b>', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('<img src=x', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('&lt;script&gt;alert(1)&lt;/script&gt;', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('&lt;b&gt;Poli&lt;/b&gt; Uji', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('&lt;img src=x onerror=alert(1)&gt;', $html);
    }

    public function test_another_patient_gets_the_same_404_as_for_a_code_that_does_not_exist(): void
    {
        $owner = $this->patient();
        $appointment = $this->book($owner);
        $other = $this->createPatient(['email' => 'lain@contoh.test'], ['full_name' => 'Pasien Lain']);

        $foreign = $this->actingAs($other)->get($this->detailUrl($appointment))->assertNotFound();
        $missing = $this->actingAs($other)->get(route('patient.appointments.show', ['appointment' => 'UPH-ZZZZ-ZZZZ']))->assertNotFound();

        $normalise = fn (string $html): string => (string) preg_replace('/\b[A-Za-z0-9]{40}\b/', 'TOKEN', $html);

        $this->assertSame($normalise($missing->getContent()), $normalise($foreign->getContent()));
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString($appointment->booking_code, $foreign->getContent());
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Siti Rahma', $foreign->getContent());
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Laras', $foreign->getContent());
    }

    public function test_malformed_codes_are_404_because_the_route_does_not_match(): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->book($this->patient());
        $code = $appointment->booking_code;

        foreach ([strtolower($code), 'ABC', str_replace('-', '', $code), $code.'X', 'UPH-7K3M-9QWI', 'UPH-7K3M-9QWO', $code.'/bukti-palsu'] as $malformed) {
            $this->actingAs($this->patient())->get('/pasien/pendaftaran/'.rawurlencode($malformed))->assertNotFound();
        }

    {
```

Implementasi JS:

**Edit `resources/js/app.js`**
**old:**
```js
function init() {
    recheckBrokenImages();

```
**new:**
```js
// ---------------------------------------------------------------- Wizard pendaftaran (F6-R17, F6-R21)
// Judul langkah ([data-wizard-heading], tabindex="-1") menerima fokus saat langkah berganti, kecuali bila ringkasan
// galat ([data-errors-summary]) sudah memintanya. Wizard berfungsi penuh tanpa berkas ini.
function focusWizardHeading() {
    if (document.querySelector('[data-errors-summary]')) {
        return;
    }

    const heading = document.querySelector('[data-wizard-heading]');

    if (heading) {
        heading.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    }
}

// Markup: [data-payment-toggle] membungkus radio name="payment_type" dan blok [data-payment-block="bpjs|asuransi"].
// Tanpa JavaScript semua blok tampil dengan teks bantuan; dengan JavaScript hanya blok yang sesuai pilihan yang tampil
// dan isian pada blok yang disembunyikan dinonaktifkan agar tidak terkirim (server menolak BPJS pada pembayaran selain BPJS).
function initPaymentToggles() {
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-payment-toggle]').forEach((root) => {
        const radios = root.querySelectorAll('input[type="radio"][name="payment_type"]');
        const blocks = root.querySelectorAll('[data-payment-block]');

        if (radios.length === 0 || blocks.length === 0) {
            return;
        }

        const sync = () => {
            const chosen = Array.from(radios).find((radio) => radio.checked);
            const value = chosen ? chosen.value : '';

            blocks.forEach((block) => {
                const visible = block.dataset.paymentBlock === value;

                block.hidden = !visible;
                block.querySelectorAll('input, select, textarea').forEach((field) => {
                    field.disabled = !visible;
                });
            });
        };

        radios.forEach((radio) => radio.addEventListener('change', sync));
        sync();
    });
}

function init() {
    recheckBrokenImages();
    focusErrorsSummary();
    focusWizardHeading();
    initPaymentToggles();
    initCharCounters();
```

#### Catatan penulis (konteks untuk implementer dan reviewer) (konteks untuk implementer, reviewer, dan penulis tugas lain)
1. **Asumsi terhadap T1/T4 yang perlu dicek implementer.** (a) `BookingData::fromValidated(array)` menerima kunci `payment_type` (string nilai enum), `bpjs_number`, `policy_number`, `insurance_partner_id` (int), `complaint`, `save_bpjs` (bool) dan memetakan `bpjs_number|policy_number` ke `paymentReference`; semua penyesuaian bentuk cukup di `HasBookingRules::bookingInput()`. (b) `BookingService::book()` menyimpan `payment_reference_last4` dan, bila `saveBpjs` dan pembayaran BPJS, memperbarui `patient_profiles.bpjs_number`. Kontrak untuk T11: `index?jadwal_berubah=1` bekerja (tautan banner dashboard). Kontrak untuk T13: halaman #30 dan mutasi `POST cancel` masuk `PatientPageMatrixTest`.

**Test IDs:** PAS-01 (riwayat hanya milik sendiri), PAS-03 (batal booking orang lain, 404), PAS-10 (filter `jadwal_berubah`: `1`, `0`, `abc`, larik), VAL (V-12, alasan 255 karakter, larik), BKG-11/BKG-13 (sisi HTTP: kuota dilepas, `last_queue_number` tetap), BKG-12 (sebagian: `CANCEL_CUTOFF_PASSED`, `INVALID_TRANSITION` check-in, `ALREADY_FINAL`), NTF-01/NTF-02/NTF-07 (sisi pembatalan: `database` + `mail`), SEK-15 (sebagian: nama dokter ter-escape di riwayat), EMP (riwayat kosong dan terfilter kosong), AKS (tamu, staf), Review Focus E.2 (batas tepat 120/119 dan satu detik, sesi `closed`/`cancelled`/`needs_review` tetap dapat dibatalkan), E.3 (kepemilikan: 404 identik, tanpa efek samping), E.4 (input larik/liar pada filter dan alasan tidak pernah 500).

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
- **`ListFilterRequest`** (`app/Http/Requests/ListFilterRequest.php`): `failedValidation()` TIDAK melempar; hanya `session()->now('warning', 'Filter tidak valid dan diabaikan.')`. `filters()` mengiris `$validator->valid()` ke kunci yang punya aturan dan membuang nilai larik. `rules()` induk memuat `q`, `kategori`, `per_page` (`Rule::in([10, 25, 50])`), `page`, `kembali`, dan `status` (hanya bila `statusValues()` tidak kosong). Pola turunan = `Admin\PracticeSessionIndexRequest` (`array_merge(parent::rules(), …)`, `messages()`, `applyTo(Builder)`). `jadwal_berubah` memakai aturan `['nullable', 'string', 'max:10']` dan baru berlaku bila nilainya persis `'1'`: `0`/`abc` diabaikan tanpa peringatan (PAS-10 "nilai lain diabaikan"), larik gagal `string` lalu diabaikan dengan peringatan.
- **`x-data-table`** (`resources/views/components/data-table.blade.php`): props `rows`, `searchable`, `preserve`, `caption`, `emptyTitle`, `emptyMessage`; slot `filters`, `head`, `empty`, `actions`. Ringkasan `Menampilkan {first}–{last} dari {total} data` (tanda en dash), halaman di luar rentang → `x-empty-state` "Halaman yang diminta tidak berisi data." Bila slot `empty` diberikan, ia menggantikan pesan bawaan "Tidak ada data yang cocok dengan pencarian atau filter Anda." + "Hapus filter" (termasuk untuk kasus filter kosong). Karena itu slot `empty` dibungkus `@unless ($hasFilter)` supaya kasus filter kosong memakai pesan bawaan (F6-R23). Judul bawaan komponen tetap dicetak (`empty-title`), maka diisi "Pendaftaran tidak ditemukan" supaya kasus filter kosong tidak berjudul "Belum ada pendaftaran" (judul itu hanya untuk slot `empty` tanpa filter). Tombol "Reset" bawaan muncul bila ada query. Form pencarian memakai `GET` ke `url()->current()`; `preserve` dikosongkan (`[]`) karena riwayat tidak punya `urut`.
- **`$site` tidak tersedia di view halaman.** `AppServiceProvider` hanya menyuntik `$site` ke `components.layouts.*`. View `show`/`index` memakai `app(SettingsService::class)` di blok `@php` (telepon, WhatsApp, batas pembatalan). `SettingsService::whatsappUrl()` mengembalikan `https://wa.me/{angka}` atau `null` bila `contact.whatsapp` kosong; `bookingRules()->cancelCutoffMinutes` jatuh ke 120 bila tabel pengaturan kosong. Tes memanggil `SettingsSeeder` (telepon `(021) 0000-0000`, WhatsApp `6280000000000`, batas 120).
- **Urutan riwayat.** `session_date` menurun, lalu jam mulai menurun lewat subkueri `orderByDesc(PracticeSession::query()->select('start_time')->whereColumn(...))` (tanpa join sehingga eager load tetap sederhana; `Builder::orderBy` menerima Eloquent Builder lewat `isQueryable`), lalu `appointments.id` menurun. Eager load `clinic`, `doctor`, `practiceSession` WAJIB (mode ketat melarang lazy loading pada koleksi hasil `paginate()`; tes dengan 12 baris membuktikannya).
- **Otorisasi di Form Request.** `CancelAppointmentRequest::authorize()` memanggil `Gate::forUser($user)->authorize('cancel', $appointment)`; `Response::denyAsNotFound()` membuat `AuthorizationException` ber-status 404 yang dirender sebagai 404, dan terjadi SEBELUM validasi sehingga pemilik lain tidak pernah melihat galat validasi (404 identik dengan kode tak ada). Format kode salah/tak ada → 404 dari batasan route `where` dan binding.
- **Kegagalan validasi alasan.** `failedValidation()` dibuat melempar `HttpResponseException` berisi redirect ke `patient.appointments.show` + flash `error` (kalimat pesan pertama) karena halaman detail (layout) menampilkan flash `error`, bukan galat per-field; `withInput` hanya `cancel_reason` bila berupa string. Pesan: `cancel_reason.max` = "Alasan maksimal 255 karakter." (BR-76), `cancel_reason.string` = "Alasan tidak valid." (tambahan penulis untuk larik). `bail` dipakai agar larik tidak menghasilkan pesan `max`.
- **`InvalidTransitionException`** dari `transition()` ditangkap handler T7: HTML → redirect ke `show` kode route + flash `error` berisi `$e->getMessage()` (pesan BR-73/BR-79/BR-58 dari `lang/id/booking.php`). Tes memeriksa potongan kalimat kunci, bukan seluruh kalimat, agar perubahan redaksi kecil di T1 tidak mematahkan tes ini; kalimat penuh dikunci di tes T1/T5.
- **Teks UI (F6-R20)**: tombol "Batalkan Pendaftaran"; modal judul "Batalkan pendaftaran :code?", isi "Kuota akan dilepas dan nomor antrean Anda tidak dapat dipakai kembali.", label "Alasan (opsional)", tombol "Tidak, kembali" / "Ya, batalkan"; flash sukses "Pendaftaran berhasil dibatalkan. Kuota telah dilepas."; lewat batas "Batas pembatalan online telah lewat. Untuk membatalkan atau mengubah pendaftaran, hubungi rumah sakit di :phone atau melalui WhatsApp." (kata "WhatsApp" menjadi tautan `wa.me` bila nomor ada).
- **Modal tanpa `x-confirm-modal`** (F6-R25): penghubung JS-nya ada di `admin.js`, yang tidak dimuat portal. Modal Bootstrap langsung (`data-bs-toggle="modal"` bekerja karena `bootstrap` diimpor `app.js`). `x-form.textarea` dipakai untuk alasan (menyertakan penghitung karakter yang sudah ada di `app.js`, `maxlength="255"`); id berbeda (`modal-batal-alasan`, `noscript-batal-alasan`) agar tidak ada id ganda bila JS nonaktif. Tanpa JS tombol modal tidak berfungsi, jadi `<noscript>` berisi formulir yang sama; dengan JS isi `<noscript>` tidak dirender. Fokus awal pada "Tidak, kembali" (07) TIDAK diimplementasikan: Bootstrap mengembalikan fokus ke pemicu dan Esc menutup modal; ini dicatat di Catatan penulis.
- **Kapan tombol tampil.** `$canCancel = status ∈ {pending, confirmed} && isCancellableByPatient(now(), cutoff)`. Teks "hubungi RS" tampil bila status AKTIF (`pending`, `confirmed`, `checked_in`) tetapi tidak dapat dibatalkan; status final (`completed`, `cancelled`, `no_show`) tidak menampilkan tombol maupun teks (menyimpang tipis dari digest-http §5.3 yang menyebut "final" ikut diganti keterangan; penulis menilai teks "hubungi RS untuk membatalkan" tidak bermakna untuk pendaftaran yang sudah selesai atau batal).
- **Tes memakai `bookAppointment()`** (`InteractsWithSchedules`) agar `booked_count`/`last_queue_number` konsisten (CHECK `chk_sessions_quota`), sesi tambahan manual (`doctor_schedule_id => null`), kode booking eksplisit `UPH-ABCD-0001` dst. (alfabet Crockford valid, sehingga lolos batasan route `where`), dan `travelTo('2026-10-12 08:00:00')` (Senin) di `setUp`. Tes batas memajukan jam ke hari yang sama dengan sesi 09.00.
- **Notifikasi.** `Notification::fake()` hanya untuk memeriksa saluran (`mail` + `database`) karena `Mail::fake()` tidak mencatat surat notifikasi bertemplat; baris `database` nyata diperiksa pada tes terpisah tanpa fake (pengiriman lewat `DB::afterCommit`; di `RefreshDatabase` callback `afterCommit` dijalankan pada commit transaksi bersarang pertama setelah transaksi uji).
- **Jumlah tes baru** ±84: `AppointmentHistoryTest` 42 (21 metode, termasuk kasus provider), `AppointmentCancelTest` 41 (28 metode, termasuk kasus provider), `LayoutsTest` 1 baru (1 dihapus).

- [ ] **Step 2: Tulis tes riwayat yang gagal `tests/Feature/Patient/AppointmentHistoryTest.php` (tool Write)**

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Patient;

use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\Clinic;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Models\User;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Database\Seeders\SettingsSeeder;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Testing\TestResponse;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithMasterData;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithPatients;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Riwayat pendaftaran pasien (#30, F6-R23): PAS-01 (hanya milik sendiri), PAS-10 (`jadwal_berubah`), urutan dan
 * paginasi, filter status/tanggal, input larik/liar tanpa 500, empty state, SEK-15 (escape). Waktu dibekukan pada
 * Senin 2026-10-12 08.00.
 */
class AppointmentHistoryTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithMasterData;
    use InteractsWithPatients;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private const WARNING = 'Filter tidak valid dan diabaikan.';

    private Clinic $clinic;

    private Doctor $doctor;

    private int $sequence = 0;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->seed(SettingsSeeder::class);
        $this->travelTo(CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-12 08:00:00'));

        $this->clinic = $this->createClinic(['name' => 'Poli Anak', 'code' => 'ANK']);
        $this->doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Sinta Maharani', 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => 'Sp.A'], $this->clinic);
    }

    // --- pembantu ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    /** Kode booking valid (alfabet Crockford) dan berurutan: UPH-ABCD-0001, UPH-ABCD-0002, … */
    private function code(): string
    {
        return sprintf('UPH-ABCD-%04d', ++$this->sequence);
    }

    private function sessionOn(string $date, string $start = '09:00:00', string $end = '12:00:00', ?Doctor $doctor = null): PracticeSession
    {
        $doctor ??= $this->doctor;

        return $this->createSession([
            'doctor_id' => $doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $doctor->clinic_id,
            'session_date' => $date,
            'start_time' => $start,
            'end_time' => $end,
            'doctor_schedule_id' => null,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     */
    private function book(User $user, PracticeSession $session, AppointmentStatus $status = AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, array $overrides = []): Appointment
    {
        return $this->bookAppointment($session, $status, array_merge([
            'booking_code' => $this->code(),
            'patient_profile_id' => $user->patientProfile->id,
        ], $overrides));
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $query
     */
    private function history(User $user, array $query = []): TestResponse
    {
        return $this->actingAs($user)->get(route('patient.appointments.index', $query));
    }

    // --- akses -------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_guests_are_sent_to_the_login_page(): void
    {
        $this->get(route('patient.appointments.index'))->assertRedirect(route('login'));
    }

    public function test_staff_are_sent_to_the_admin_dashboard(): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'))
            ->get(route('patient.appointments.index'))
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.dashboard'));
    }

    // --- PAS-01: hanya milik sendiri ----------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_the_history_lists_only_the_own_appointments(): void
    {
        $owner = $this->createPatient(['email' => 'a@contoh.test'], ['full_name' => 'Pasien Pemilik']);
        $other = $this->createPatient(['email' => 'b@contoh.test'], ['full_name' => 'Pasien Lain']);

        $own = [
            $this->book($owner, $this->sessionOn('2026-10-13')),
            $this->book($owner, $this->sessionOn('2026-10-14')),
            $this->book($owner, $this->sessionOn('2026-10-15')),
        ];
        $foreign = [
            $this->book($other, $this->sessionOn('2026-10-16')),
            $this->book($other, $this->sessionOn('2026-10-17')),
        ];

        $response = $this->history($owner)->assertOk();

        foreach ($own as $appointment) {
            $response->assertSee($appointment->booking_code);
        }
        foreach ($foreign as $appointment) {
            $response->assertDontSee($appointment->booking_code);
        }
        $response->assertSee('Menampilkan 1–3 dari 3 data');
    }

    public function test_the_page_renders_title_breadcrumb_columns_and_row_details(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $appointment = $this->book($user, $this->sessionOn('2026-10-13'), AppointmentStatus::Pending, ['queue_number' => 7]);
        $code = $appointment->booking_code;

        $response->assertSee('<title>Riwayat Pendaftaran — '.config('app.name').'</title>', false)
            ->assertSee('<li class="breadcrumb-item"><a href="'.route('patient.dashboard').'">Portal Pasien</a></li>', false)
            ->assertSee('<li class="breadcrumb-item active" aria-current="page">Riwayat Pendaftaran</li>', false)

            ->assertSee('href="'.route('patient.appointments.show', $code).'"', false)

        $this->assertSame(1, substr_count($response->getContent(), '<h1'));

    public function test_the_menu_marks_the_history_item_as_current(): void
    {

    }

    public function test_the_changed_schedule_marker_is_shown_on_the_row(): void
    {

        $this->book($user, $this->sessionOn('2026-10-13'), AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, ['schedule_changed_at' => now()]);

        $this->history($user)->assertOk()->assertSee('Jadwal berubah');
    }

    // --- urutan dan paginasi -----------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_rows_are_ordered_by_date_then_start_time_descending(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $morning = $this->book($user, $this->sessionOn('2026-10-20', '09:00:00', '12:00:00'));
        $afternoon = $this->book($user, $this->sessionOn('2026-10-20', '13:00:00', '15:00:00'));
        $earlier = $this->book($user, $this->sessionOn('2026-10-15'));
        $past = $this->book($user, $this->sessionOn('2026-10-05'), AppointmentStatus::Completed);

        $this->history($user)
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSeeInOrder([
                $afternoon->booking_code,
                $morning->booking_code,
                $earlier->booking_code,
                $past->booking_code,
            ]);
    }

    public function test_the_history_is_paginated_by_ten_and_eager_loads_its_relations(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $codes = [];

        for ($day = 1; $day <= 12; $day++) {
            $codes[$day] = $this->book($user, $this->sessionOn(CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-11-01')->addDays($day)->toDateString()))->booking_code;
        }

        $first = $this->history($user)->assertOk();
        // Terbaru dulu: kode 12 sampai 3 di halaman 1, kode 2 dan 1 di halaman 2.
        for ($day = 12; $day >= 3; $day--) {
            $first->assertSee($codes[$day]);
        }
        $first->assertDontSee($codes[2])
            ->assertDontSee($codes[1])
            ->assertSee('Menampilkan 1–10 dari 12 data')
            ->assertSee('page=2', false);

        $second = $this->history($user, ['page' => 2])->assertOk();
        $second->assertSee($codes[2])
            ->assertSee($codes[1])
            ->assertDontSee($codes[3])
            ->assertSee('Menampilkan 11–12 dari 12 data');
    }

    public function test_per_page_can_be_raised_and_the_page_links_keep_the_filters(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();

        for ($day = 1; $day <= 12; $day++) {
            $this->book($user, $this->sessionOn(CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-11-01')->addDays($day)->toDateString()));
        }

        $this->history($user, ['per_page' => 25])->assertOk()->assertSee('Menampilkan 1–12 dari 12 data');

        $this->history($user, ['status' => 'confirmed'])
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('status=confirmed', false)
            ->assertSee('page=2', false);
    }

    public function test_a_page_beyond_the_last_shows_the_out_of_range_notice(): void

        $this->book($user, $this->sessionOn('2026-10-13'));

            ->assertOk()

            ->assertSee('Kembali ke halaman 1');
    }

    public function test_a_patient_without_appointments_sees_the_empty_state_with_the_register_button(): void

    public function test_a_filter_without_results_uses_the_default_message_and_offers_reset(): void
    {

            ->assertSee('Pendaftaran tidak ditemukan')

            ->assertSee('Hapus filter')
            ->assertDontSee('Belum ada pendaftaran');

    // --- filter status dan tanggal -----------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_each_status_filter_keeps_only_that_status(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $byStatus = [];

        foreach (AppointmentStatus::cases() as $index => $status) {
            $date = CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-13')->addDays($index)->toDateString();
            $byStatus[$status->value] = $this->book($user, $this->sessionOn($date), $status)->booking_code;
        }

        foreach ($byStatus as $value => $code) {
            $response = $this->history($user, ['status' => $value])->assertOk();
            $response->assertSee($code);

            foreach ($byStatus as $otherValue => $otherCode) {
                if ($otherValue !== $value) {
                    $response->assertDontSee($otherCode);
                }
            }
            $this->assertMatchesRegularExpression('#<option value="'.$value.'"\s+selected\s*>#', $response->getContent());
        }
    }

    public function test_the_date_range_is_inclusive_on_both_ends(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $a = $this->book($user, $this->sessionOn('2026-10-13'))->booking_code;
        $b = $this->book($user, $this->sessionOn('2026-10-15'))->booking_code;
        $c = $this->book($user, $this->sessionOn('2026-10-20'))->booking_code;

        $this->history($user, ['dari' => '2026-10-15', 'sampai' => '2026-10-15'])
            ->assertOk()->assertSee($b)->assertDontSee($a)->assertDontSee($c);
        $this->history($user, ['dari' => '2026-10-15'])
            ->assertOk()->assertSee($b)->assertSee($c)->assertDontSee($a);
        $this->history($user, ['sampai' => '2026-10-15'])
            ->assertOk()->assertSee($a)->assertSee($b)->assertDontSee($c);
    }

    public function test_an_until_date_before_the_from_date_is_ignored_with_a_warning(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $a = $this->book($user, $this->sessionOn('2026-10-13'))->booking_code;
        $c = $this->book($user, $this->sessionOn('2026-10-20'))->booking_code;

        $this->history($user, ['dari' => '2026-10-20', 'sampai' => '2026-10-13'])
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee(self::WARNING)
            ->assertSee($c)
            ->assertDontSee($a);

    public function test_the_filter_form_does_not_reflect_invalid_values(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $this->book($user, $this->sessionOn('2026-10-13'));

        $response = $this->history($user, ['status' => '"><script>alert(1)</script>', 'dari' => '"><script>alert(2)</script>'])->assertOk();

        $response->assertSee(self::WARNING)
            ->assertDontSee('<script>alert(1)</script>', false)
            ->assertDontSee('<script>alert(2)</script>', false);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{0: array<string, mixed>}>
     */
    public static function invalidFilters(): array
    {
        return [
            'status liar' => [['status' => 'foo']],
            'status huruf besar' => [['status' => 'CONFIRMED']],
            'status larik' => [['status' => ['confirmed']]],
            'status larik asosiatif' => [['status' => ['a' => 'b']]],
            'dari bukan tanggal' => [['dari' => 'besok']],
            'dari format lain' => [['dari' => '15/10/2026']],
            'dari tanggal mustahil' => [['dari' => '2026-02-30']],
            'dari larik' => [['dari' => ['2026-10-15']]],
            'sampai bukan tanggal' => [['sampai' => 'lusa']],
            'sampai larik' => [['sampai' => ['2026-10-15']]],
            'jadwal_berubah larik' => [['jadwal_berubah' => ['1']]],
            'per_page liar' => [['per_page' => '7']],
            'per_page larik' => [['per_page' => ['10']]],
            'page bukan angka' => [['page' => 'abc']],
            'page nol' => [['page' => '0']],
            'page negatif' => [['page' => '-1']],
            'page larik' => [['page' => ['2']]],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $query
     */
    #[DataProvider('invalidFilters')]
    public function test_invalid_or_array_filters_are_ignored_with_a_warning_and_never_fail(array $query): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $first = $this->book($user, $this->sessionOn('2026-10-13'))->booking_code;
        $second = $this->book($user, $this->sessionOn('2026-10-14'), AppointmentStatus::Pending)->booking_code;

        $this->history($user, $query)
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee(self::WARNING)
            ->assertSee($first)
            ->assertSee($second);
    }

    // --- PAS-10: jadwal_berubah --------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_the_schedule_changed_filter_keeps_only_own_changed_appointments(): void
    {
        $owner = $this->createPatient(['email' => 'a@contoh.test']);
        $other = $this->createPatient(['email' => 'b@contoh.test']);

        $changed = $this->book($owner, $this->sessionOn('2026-10-13'), AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, ['schedule_changed_at' => now()->subDay()])->booking_code;
        $plainOne = $this->book($owner, $this->sessionOn('2026-10-14'))->booking_code;
        $plainTwo = $this->book($owner, $this->sessionOn('2026-10-15'))->booking_code;
        $foreignChanged = $this->book($other, $this->sessionOn('2026-10-16'), AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, ['schedule_changed_at' => now()->subDay()])->booking_code;

        $this->history($owner, ['jadwal_berubah' => '1'])

            ->assertDontSee($foreignChanged)
            ->assertDontSee(self::WARNING)

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{0: string}>
     */
    public static function ignoredScheduleChangedValues(): array
    {
        return [

            'teks' => ['abc'],
            'spasi' => [' '],
            'dua' => ['2'],
            'benar teks' => ['true'],

    }

    #[DataProvider('ignoredScheduleChangedValues')]

    {

    public function test_the_schedule_changed_filter_combines_with_status_and_is_kept_in_the_form(): void
    {
        $owner = $this->createPatient();
        $changedConfirmed = $this->book($owner, $this->sessionOn('2026-10-13'), AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, ['schedule_changed_at' => now()->subDay()])->booking_code;
        $changedPending = $this->book($owner, $this->sessionOn('2026-10-14'), AppointmentStatus::Pending, ['schedule_changed_at' => now()->subDay()])->booking_code;

        $response->assertSee($changedPending)->assertDontSee($changedConfirmed);

    // --- SEK-15 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_the_doctor_name_is_escaped_in_the_history(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $evil = $this->createDoctor(['name' => '<script>alert(1)</script>', 'title_prefix' => '', 'title_suffix' => ''], $this->clinic);
        $this->book($user, $this->sessionOn('2026-10-13', '09:00:00', '12:00:00', $evil));

        $this->history($user)
            ->assertOk()

            ->assertSee('&lt;script&gt;alert(1)&lt;/script&gt;', false);
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Patient;

use App\Enums\ActorType;
use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Enums\PaymentType;
use App\Enums\SessionStatus;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\AppointmentStatusHistory;
use App\Models\AuditLog;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\AppointmentStatusChangedNotification;
use App\Services\Settings\SettingsService;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Database\Seeders\SettingsSeeder;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;
use Illuminate\Testing\TestResponse;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithMasterData;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithPatients;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithStaff;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Pembatalan oleh pasien (V-12, F6-R25, BR-73..BR-81) dan tampilannya di halaman detail: PAS-03, BKG-11/13 (sisi
 * HTTP), NTF-01/02/07 (sisi batal), batas tepat 120/119 menit, status check-in/final, alasan 255 karakter, 404
 * pemilik lain, modal dan teks "hubungi RS". Waktu dibekukan pada Senin 2026-10-12 08.00; sesi bawaan besok 09.00.
 */
class AppointmentCancelTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithMasterData;
    use InteractsWithPatients;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use InteractsWithStaff;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private const SUCCESS = 'Pendaftaran berhasil dibatalkan. Kuota telah dilepas.';

    private const BPJS = '0009900000011';

    private Doctor $doctor;

    private int $sequence = 0;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->seed(SettingsSeeder::class);
        $this->travelTo(CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-12 08:00:00'));

        $clinic = $this->createClinic(['name' => 'Poli Anak', 'code' => 'ANK']);
        $this->doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Sinta Maharani', 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => 'Sp.A'], $clinic);
    }

    // --- pembantu ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    private function code(): string
    {
        return sprintf('UPH-ABCD-%04d', ++$this->sequence);
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     */
    private function sessionOn(string $date, string $start = '09:00:00', string $end = '12:00:00', array $overrides = []): PracticeSession
    {
        return $this->createSession($overrides + [
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $this->doctor->clinic_id,
            'session_date' => $date,
            'start_time' => $start,
            'end_time' => $end,
            'doctor_schedule_id' => null,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     */
    private function book(User $user, PracticeSession $session, AppointmentStatus $status = AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, array $overrides = []): Appointment
    {
        return $this->bookAppointment($session, $status, array_merge([
            'booking_code' => $this->code(),
            'patient_profile_id' => $user->patientProfile->id,
        ], $overrides));
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $data
     */
    private function cancel(Appointment|string $target, array $data = []): TestResponse
    {
        $code = $target instanceof Appointment ? $target->booking_code : $target;

        return $this->post(route('patient.appointments.cancel', $code), $data);
    }

    private function showUrl(Appointment $appointment): string
    {
        return route('patient.appointments.show', $appointment->booking_code);
    }

    private function currentStatus(Appointment $appointment): AppointmentStatus
    {
        return Appointment::query()->findOrFail($appointment->id)->status;
    }

    private function historyCount(Appointment $appointment): int
    {
        return AppointmentStatusHistory::query()->where('appointment_id', $appointment->id)->count();
    }

    // --- akses -------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_guests_are_sent_to_the_login_page_and_nothing_changes(): void
    {
        $owner = $this->createPatient();
        $appointment = $this->book($owner, $this->sessionOn('2026-10-13'));

        $this->cancel($appointment)->assertRedirect(route('login'));

        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $this->currentStatus($appointment));
    }

    public function test_staff_are_sent_to_the_admin_dashboard_and_nothing_changes(): void
    {
        $owner = $this->createPatient();
        $appointment = $this->book($owner, $this->sessionOn('2026-10-13'));

        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'));
        $this->cancel($appointment)->assertRedirect(route('admin.dashboard'));

        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $this->currentStatus($appointment));
    }

    // --- PAS-03 dan Review Focus E.3 ---------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_cancelling_another_patients_appointment_gives_404_without_side_effects(): void
    {
        Notification::fake();
        $owner = $this->createPatient(['email' => 'pemilik@contoh.test']);
        $intruder = $this->createPatient(['email' => 'penyusup@contoh.test']);
        $session = $this->sessionOn('2026-10-13');
        $appointment = $this->book($owner, $session);

        $this->actingAs($intruder);
        $this->cancel($appointment, ['cancel_reason' => 'Bukan milik saya'])->assertNotFound();
        // Alasan terlalu panjang: tetap 404 (otorisasi mendahului validasi), bukan galat validasi.
        $this->cancel($appointment, ['cancel_reason' => str_repeat('a', 300)])->assertNotFound();

        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $this->currentStatus($appointment));
        $this->assertSame(1, $session->fresh()->booked_count);
        $this->assertSame(0, $this->historyCount($appointment));
        $this->assertSame(0, AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'appointment.status_changed')->count());
        Notification::assertNothingSent();
    }

    public function test_malformed_and_unknown_codes_give_404(): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->createPatient());

        $this->cancel('XYZ')->assertNotFound();
        $this->cancel('UPH-ILLE-OOOO')->assertNotFound();
        $this->cancel('UPH-ABCD-9999')->assertNotFound();
    }

    // --- pembatalan sukses -------------------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_a_successful_cancellation_flashes_releases_quota_and_records_the_trail(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $session = $this->sessionOn('2026-10-13');
        $appointment = $this->book($user, $session);
        $this->assertSame(1, $session->booked_count);
        $this->assertSame(1, $session->last_queue_number);

        $this->actingAs($user);
        $this->cancel($appointment, ['cancel_reason' => 'Berhalangan hadir'])
            ->assertRedirect($this->showUrl($appointment))
            ->assertSessionHas('success', self::SUCCESS)
            ->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $fresh = Appointment::query()->findOrFail($appointment->id);
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, $fresh->status);
        $this->assertNotNull($fresh->cancelled_at);
        $this->assertSame(ActorType::Patient, $fresh->cancelled_by_type);
        $this->assertSame($user->id, (int) $fresh->cancelled_by_user_id);
        $this->assertSame('Berhalangan hadir', $fresh->cancel_reason);
        $this->assertNull($fresh->active_flag);

        // BKG-11/BKG-13: kuota dilepas, penghitung antrean tidak turun (nomor tidak dipakai ulang).
        $sessionNow = $session->fresh();
        $this->assertSame(0, $sessionNow->booked_count);
        $this->assertSame(1, $sessionNow->last_queue_number);

        $history = AppointmentStatusHistory::query()->where('appointment_id', $appointment->id)->get();
        $this->assertCount(1, $history);
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $history[0]->from_status);
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, $history[0]->to_status);
        $this->assertSame(ActorType::Patient, $history[0]->actor_type);
        $this->assertSame($user->id, (int) $history[0]->actor_user_id);
        $this->assertSame(1, AuditLog::query()->where('action', 'appointment.status_changed')->count());

        // Flash tampil di halaman detail berikutnya dan status berubah.
        $this->get($this->showUrl($appointment))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee(self::SUCCESS)
            ->assertSee('Dibatalkan');
    }

    public function test_a_pending_appointment_can_be_cancelled_too(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $session = $this->sessionOn('2026-10-13');
        $appointment = $this->book($user, $session, AppointmentStatus::Pending);

        $this->actingAs($user);
        $this->cancel($appointment)->assertRedirect($this->showUrl($appointment))->assertSessionHas('success', self::SUCCESS);

        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, $this->currentStatus($appointment));
        $this->assertSame(0, $session->fresh()->booked_count);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{0: array<string, mixed>}>
     */
    public static function emptyReasons(): array
    {
        return [
            'tanpa field' => [[]],

        ];

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $payload
     */
    #[DataProvider('emptyReasons')]
    public function test_the_reason_is_optional_and_stored_as_null_when_empty(array $payload): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $appointment = $this->book($user, $this->sessionOn('2026-10-13'));

    public function test_extra_fields_cannot_change_anything_except_the_cancellation(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();

        $this->actingAs($user);
        $this->cancel($appointment, [
            'cancel_reason' => 'Batal',

            'patient_profile_id' => 999999,
            'queue_number' => 99,
            'cancelled_by_type' => 'staff',

        $this->assertSame($user->id, (int) $fresh->cancelled_by_user_id);

    // --- alasan: batas 255 dan input liar (V-12) ----------------------------------------------

    public function test_a_reason_of_exactly_255_characters_is_accepted_counted_in_characters_not_bytes(): void
    {

        $this->assertSame($reason, Appointment::query()->findOrFail($appointment->id)->cancel_reason);

    public function test_a_reason_of_256_characters_is_rejected_with_the_indonesian_message(): void
    {

        $this->assertSame(0, $this->historyCount($appointment));

    // --- notifikasi (NTF-01, NTF-02, NTF-07) -------------------------------------------------

    public function test_cancellation_notifies_the_patient_by_mail_and_database(): void
    {
        Notification::fake();
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $appointment = $this->book($user, $this->sessionOn('2026-10-13'));

        $this->actingAs($user);
        $this->cancel($appointment)->assertSessionHas('success');

        Notification::assertSentToTimes($user, AppointmentStatusChangedNotification::class, 1);
        Notification::assertSentTo(
            $user,
            AppointmentStatusChangedNotification::class,
            fn (AppointmentStatusChangedNotification $notification, array $channels): bool => $notification->to === AppointmentStatus::Cancelled
                && $notification->appointment->is($appointment)
                && in_array('mail', $channels, true)
                && in_array('database', $channels, true),
        );
    }

    public function test_the_database_notification_carries_no_sensitive_data(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $appointment = $this->book($user, $this->sessionOn('2026-10-13'), AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, [
            'payment_type' => PaymentType::Bpjs,
            'payment_reference' => self::BPJS,
            'payment_reference_last4' => '0011',
            'complaint' => 'Nyeri dada kiri sejak semalam',
        ]);

        $this->actingAs($user);
        $this->cancel($appointment, ['cancel_reason' => 'Berhalangan'])->assertSessionHas('success');

        $rows = DB::table('notifications')->where('notifiable_id', $user->id)->get();
        $this->assertCount(1, $rows);
        $data = json_decode((string) $rows[0]->data, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);

        $this->assertSame($appointment->booking_code, $data['booking_code']);
        $this->assertSame('cancelled', $data['status']);
        $this->assertArrayNotHasKey('complaint', $data);
        $this->assertArrayNotHasKey('payment_reference', $data);
        $encoded = (string) $rows[0]->data;
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString(self::BPJS, $encoded);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Nyeri dada', $encoded);
    }

    // --- batas waktu tepat (Review Focus E.2) ------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{0: string, 1: bool}>
     */
    public static function cutoffMoments(): array
    {
        return [
            '121 menit sebelum sesi' => ['06:59:00', true],
            '120 menit tepat (inklusif)' => ['07:00:00', true],
            '119 menit 59 detik' => ['07:00:01', false],
            '119 menit' => ['07:01:00', false],
            '1 menit sebelum sesi' => ['08:59:00', false],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('cutoffMoments')]
    public function test_the_patient_cancellation_cutoff_is_inclusive_at_exactly_120_minutes(string $time, bool $allowed): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $session = $this->sessionOn('2026-10-12');
        $appointment = $this->book($user, $session);

        $this->travelTo(CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-12 '.$time));
        $this->actingAs($user);
        $response = $this->cancel($appointment)->assertRedirect($this->showUrl($appointment));

        if ($allowed) {
            $response->assertSessionHas('success', self::SUCCESS);
            $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, $this->currentStatus($appointment));
            $this->assertSame(0, $session->fresh()->booked_count);

            return;
        }

        $response->assertSessionMissing('success');
        $message = (string) session('error');
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Batas pembatalan online telah lewat', $message);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('120 menit', $message);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('(021) 0000-0000', $message);
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $this->currentStatus($appointment));
        $this->assertSame(1, $session->fresh()->booked_count);
        $this->assertSame(0, $this->historyCount($appointment));
    }

    public function test_the_cutoff_follows_the_booking_setting(): void
    {
        app(SettingsService::class)->set('booking.cancel_cutoff_minutes', 60);
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $first = $this->book($user, $this->sessionOn('2026-10-12'));

        $this->actingAs($user);
        $this->travelTo(CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-12 08:00:00'));
        $this->cancel($first)->assertSessionHas('success', self::SUCCESS);

        $second = $this->book($user, $this->sessionOn('2026-10-12', '14:00:00', '16:00:00'));
        $this->travelTo(CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-12 13:00:01'));
        $this->cancel($second)->assertSessionMissing('success');
        $this->assertStringContainsString('60 menit', (string) session('error'));
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $this->currentStatus($second));
    }

    // --- status yang tidak dapat dibatalkan --------------------------------------------------

    public function test_a_checked_in_appointment_cannot_be_cancelled_by_the_patient(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $session = $this->sessionOn('2026-10-13');
        $appointment = $this->book($user, $session, AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn);

        $this->actingAs($user);
        $this->cancel($appointment)
            ->assertRedirect($this->showUrl($appointment))
            ->assertSessionHas('error', fn (string $message): bool => str_contains($message, 'sudah check-in tidak dapat dibatalkan'))
            ->assertSessionMissing('success');

        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn, $this->currentStatus($appointment));
        $this->assertSame(1, $session->fresh()->booked_count);
        $this->assertSame(0, $this->historyCount($appointment));
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array{0: AppointmentStatus}>
     */
    public static function finalStatuses(): array
    {
        return [
            'selesai' => [AppointmentStatus::Completed],
            'dibatalkan' => [AppointmentStatus::Cancelled],
            'tidak hadir' => [AppointmentStatus::NoShow],
        ];
    }

    #[DataProvider('finalStatuses')]
    public function test_a_final_appointment_cannot_be_cancelled_and_keeps_the_quota_untouched(AppointmentStatus $status): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $session = $this->sessionOn('2026-10-13');
        $appointment = $this->book($user, $session, $status);
        $bookedBefore = $session->fresh()->booked_count;

        $this->actingAs($user);
        $this->cancel($appointment)
            ->assertRedirect($this->showUrl($appointment))
            ->assertSessionHas('error', fn (string $message): bool => str_contains($message, 'Pendaftaran ini sudah berstatus'))
            ->assertSessionMissing('success');

        $this->assertSame($status, $this->currentStatus($appointment));
        $this->assertSame($bookedBefore, $session->fresh()->booked_count);
        $this->assertSame(0, $this->historyCount($appointment));

    public function test_a_second_submission_after_success_fails_without_releasing_the_quota_twice(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $session = $this->sessionOn('2026-10-13');
        $appointment = $this->book($user, $session);
        $other = $this->book($this->createPatient(['email' => 'lain@contoh.test']), $session, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, ['queue_number' => 2]);
        $this->assertSame(2, $session->fresh()->booked_count);

        $this->actingAs($user);
        $this->cancel($appointment)->assertSessionHas('success');
        $this->cancel($appointment)->assertSessionHas('error')->assertSessionMissing('success');

        $this->assertSame(1, $session->fresh()->booked_count, 'Kuota hanya dilepas satu kali; pendaftaran pasien lain tetap menghitung.');
        $this->assertSame(1, $this->historyCount($appointment));
        $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, $this->currentStatus($other));
    }

    public function test_appointments_of_closed_cancelled_and_needs_review_sessions_can_still_be_cancelled(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $this->actingAs($user);

        $closed = $this->sessionOn('2026-10-13', '09:00:00', '12:00:00', ['status' => SessionStatus::Closed, 'status_reason' => 'Ditutup sementara']);
        $cancelledSession = $this->sessionOn('2026-10-14', '09:00:00', '12:00:00', ['status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled, 'status_reason' => 'Dokter cuti']);
        $review = PracticeSession::factory()->needsReview(['source' => 'exception', 'exception_id' => 1])->create([
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $this->doctor->clinic_id,
            'session_date' => '2026-10-15',
            'start_time' => '09:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'doctor_schedule_id' => null,
        ]);

        foreach ([$closed, $cancelledSession, $review] as $session) {
            $appointment = $this->book($user, $session);
            $this->cancel($appointment)->assertSessionHas('success', self::SUCCESS);

            $this->assertSame(AppointmentStatus::Cancelled, $this->currentStatus($appointment));
            $this->assertSame(0, $session->fresh()->booked_count);
        }
    }

    // --- tampilan di halaman detail (F6-R25) -------------------------------------------------

    public function test_the_detail_page_offers_the_button_modal_and_noscript_form_before_the_cutoff(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $appointment = $this->book($user, $this->sessionOn('2026-10-13'));
        $code = $appointment->booking_code;
        $action = route('patient.appointments.cancel', $code);

        $response = $this->actingAs($user)->get($this->showUrl($appointment))->assertOk();
        $html = $response->getContent();

        $response->assertSee('Batalkan Pendaftaran')
            ->assertSee('data-bs-toggle="modal" data-bs-target="#modal-batal"', false)
            ->assertSee('id="modal-batal"', false)
            ->assertSee('Batalkan pendaftaran '.$code.'?')
            ->assertSee('Kuota akan dilepas dan nomor antrean Anda tidak dapat dipakai kembali.')
            ->assertSee('Alasan (opsional)')
            ->assertSee('Tidak, kembali')
            ->assertSee('Ya, batalkan')
            ->assertSee('maxlength="255"', false)
            ->assertDontSee('Batas pembatalan online telah lewat');

        // Dua formulir (modal dan noscript), masing-masing dengan token dan field alasan.
        $this->assertSame(2, substr_count($html, 'action="'.$action.'"'));
        $this->assertSame(2, substr_count($html, 'name="cancel_reason"'));
        $this->assertGreaterThanOrEqual(2, substr_count($html, 'name="_token"'));
        $this->assertSame(1, substr_count($html, 'id="modal-batal-alasan"'));
        $this->assertSame(1, substr_count($html, 'id="noscript-batal-alasan"'));
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('<x-confirm-modal', $html);
    }

    public function test_the_noscript_block_holds_a_working_cancel_form_without_the_modal_trigger(): void
    {
        $user = $this->createPatient();
        $appointment = $this->book($user, $this->sessionOn('2026-10-13'));
        $action = route('patient.appointments.cancel', $appointment->booking_code);

        $html = $this->actingAs($user)->get($this->showUrl($appointment))->assertOk()->getContent();

        preg_match_all('#<noscript>(.*?)</noscript>#s', $html, $matches);
        $block = collect($matches[1])->first(fn (string $content): bool => str_contains($content, 'name="cancel_reason"'));

        $this->assertNotNull($block, 'Tidak ada <noscript> berisi formulir batal.');
        $this->assertStringContainsString('action="'.$action.'"', $block);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('name="_token"', $block);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('type="submit"', $block);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('data-bs-toggle', $block);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('data-bs-target', $block);
    }
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Buat `AppointmentIndexRequest` (tool Write `app/Http/Requests/Patient/AppointmentIndexRequest.php`)**

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Patient;

use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Http\Requests\ListFilterRequest;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;

/**
 * Filter riwayat pendaftaran pasien (F6-R23, 07 W-12): `status` (AppointmentStatus), `dari`/`sampai` (`Y-m-d`,
 * inklusif pada `session_date`), `jadwal_berubah` (hanya nilai `1` yang berlaku; nilai lain diabaikan tanpa
 * peringatan, PAS-10). Nilai tidak valid atau larik diabaikan dengan flash `warning` (pola ListFilterRequest).
 */
class AppointmentIndexRequest extends ListFilterRequest
{
    /** Kunci filter yang ditampilkan kembali di formulir. */
    public const FILTER_KEYS = ['status', 'dari', 'sampai', 'jadwal_berubah'];

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        return array_merge(parent::rules(), [
            'dari' => ['nullable', 'date_format:Y-m-d'],
            'sampai' => ['nullable', 'date_format:Y-m-d', 'after_or_equal:dari'],
            'jadwal_berubah' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:10'],
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function messages(): array
    {
        return array_merge(parent::messages(), [
            'dari.date_format' => 'Format tanggal tidak valid.',
            'sampai.date_format' => 'Format tanggal tidak valid.',
            'sampai.after_or_equal' => 'Tanggal sampai tidak boleh sebelum tanggal dari.',
            'jadwal_berubah.string' => 'Pilihan filter tidak valid.',
            'jadwal_berubah.max' => 'Pilihan filter tidak valid.',
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    protected function statusValues(): array
    {
        return AppointmentStatus::values();
    }

    /**
     * Filter yang benar-benar berlaku (untuk mengisi ulang formulir): hanya yang lolos validasi, dan
     * `jadwal_berubah` hanya bila bernilai `1`.
     *
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function activeFilters(): array
    {
        $filters = array_intersect_key($this->filters(), array_flip(self::FILTER_KEYS));

        if (($filters['jadwal_berubah'] ?? null) !== '1') {
            unset($filters['jadwal_berubah']);
        }

        return $filters;
    }

    /**
     * Terapkan filter dan urutan: tanggal sesi menurun, lalu jam mulai menurun, lalu id menurun.
     *
     * @param  Builder<Appointment>  $query
     * @return Builder<Appointment>
     */
    public function applyTo(Builder $query): Builder
    {
        $filters = $this->activeFilters();

        if (isset($filters['status'])) {
            $query->where('appointments.status', $filters['status']);
        }

        if (isset($filters['dari'])) {
            $query->where('appointments.session_date', '>=', $filters['dari']);
        }

        if (isset($filters['sampai'])) {
            $query->where('appointments.session_date', '<=', $filters['sampai']);
        }

        if (isset($filters['jadwal_berubah'])) {
            $query->scheduleChanged();
        }

        return $query
            ->orderByDesc('appointments.session_date')
            ->orderByDesc(
```

- [ ] **Step 6: Buat `CancelAppointmentRequest` (tool Write `app/Http/Requests/Patient/CancelAppointmentRequest.php`)**

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Patient;

use App\Models\Appointment;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Validation\Validator;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
use Illuminate\Http\Exceptions\HttpResponseException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;

/**
 * Pembatalan pendaftaran oleh pasien (V-12, BR-73..BR-81). Otorisasi = `AppointmentPolicy::cancel` (pemilik; selain
 * itu 404 `denyAsNotFound`) dan dijalankan SEBELUM validasi, sehingga pasien lain tidak pernah melihat galat
 * validasi. Status dan batas waktu dijaga `AppointmentStatusService`, bukan di sini. Gagal validasi = redirect ke
 * halaman detail dengan flash `error` (halaman detail menampilkan flash, bukan galat per-field).
 */
class CancelAppointmentRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        $appointment = $this->route('appointment');

        if (! $appointment instanceof Appointment) {
            return false;
        }

        Gate::forUser($this->user())->authorize('cancel', $appointment);

        return true;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        return [
            'cancel_reason' => ['bail', 'nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function messages(): array
    {
        return [
            'cancel_reason.string' => 'Alasan tidak valid.',
            'cancel_reason.max' => 'Alasan maksimal 255 karakter.',
        ];
    }

    protected function failedValidation(Validator $validator): void
    {
        $appointment = $this->route('appointment');
        $reason = $this->input('cancel_reason');

        throw new HttpResponseException(
            redirect()
                ->route('patient.appointments.show', $appointment->booking_code)
                ->with('error', (string) $validator->errors()->first())
                ->withInput(is_string($reason) ? ['cancel_reason' => $reason] : []),
        );
    }
}
```

4. Method. `old_string` (tepat satu kali; sertakan indentasi 4 spasi; hanya awal baris penanda, sisa teks `(T8 sampai T10 ...)` tidak disentuh):
