`new_string`: kedua method di bawah, diikuti satu baris kosong, lalu penanda dikembalikan persis (`    // [[METODE-PUBLIK-BERIKUT]]`).

```php
    /**
     * Riwayat pendaftaran milik pasien (#30, F6-R23): satu daftar, filter status/tanggal/jadwal berubah,
     * paginasi 10, terbaru dulu. Hanya `Appointment::forPatient()`; relasi tampilan dimuat sekaligus.
     */
    public function index(AppointmentIndexRequest $request): View
    {
        $profile = $request->user()->loadMissing('patientProfile')->patientProfile;

        abort_if($profile === null, 404);

        $appointments = $request
            ->applyTo(Appointment::query()->forPatient($profile)->with(['clinic', 'doctor', 'practiceSession']))
            ->paginate($request->perPage(10));

        return view('patient.appointments.index', [
            'appointments' => $appointments,
            'filters' => $request->activeFilters(),
            'statusOptions' => AppointmentStatus::options(),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Batalkan pendaftaran (V-12, BR-73..BR-81). Otorisasi (pemilik, 404 bila bukan) ada di
     * `CancelAppointmentRequest`; status, batas waktu, kuota, riwayat, audit, dan notifikasi di
     * `AppointmentStatusService::transition()`. Galat bisnis (`InvalidTransitionException`) ditangani handler
     * `BookingException` (redirect ke detail + flash `error`).
     */
    public function cancel(CancelAppointmentRequest $request, Appointment $appointment, AppointmentStatusService $statuses): RedirectResponse
    {
        $statuses->transition(
            $appointment,
            AppointmentStatus::Cancelled,
            Actor::patient($request->user()),
            $request->validated('cancel_reason'),
        );

        return redirect()
            ->route('patient.appointments.show', $appointment->booking_code)
            ->with('success', 'Pendaftaran berhasil dibatalkan. Kuota telah dilepas.');
    }

    // [[METODE-PUBLIK-BERIKUT]]
```

**Test IDs:** PAS-04 (sisi pasien: pemilik 200, pasien lain 404, Admin Konten/staf dialihkan, tamu ke `login` dengan intended; sisi Petugas = fase 7), SEK-13 (QR hanya `UPH-XXXX-XXXX`; payload, SVG, dan PNG yang didekode), SEK-12 (nomor BPJS tersamar di halaman dan PDF, terenkripsi di DB), SEK-15 (nama pasien `<script>` ter-escape di halaman bukti dan HTML PDF; keluhan tidak ada di bukti), F-SYS-05/F-PAS-08 (cetak dan PDF), EMP (bukti pendaftaran berstatus `cancelled`), Review Focus E.3 (kepemilikan: 404 identik, kode berformat salah 404, tamu dengan intended utuh, staf), E.5 (tanpa nomor lengkap, keluhan, telepon, alamat, tanggal lahir di bukti/PDF; QR hanya kode booking).

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source dan dijalankan terhadap vendor):**
- **Verifikasi vendor (dijalankan penulis di PHP 8.2.12, dompdf 3.1.2, chillerlan 6.0.1, GD aktif).** (1) `QRGdImagePNG` + `outputBase64 = true` menghasilkan `data:image/png;base64,…` (≈1 KB untuk `UPH-ABCD-EFGH`, `scale` 6); `QRCode::readFromBlob()` (dekoder bawaan chillerlan) mendekode PNG itu menjadi persis `UPH-ABCD-EFGH`. (2) dompdf merender `<img src="data:image/png;base64,…">` dengan `enable_remote = false` (hasil PDF memuat `/Subtype /Image`); data URI SVG (logo) juga tidak galat: dirender sebagai vektor lewat `php-svg-lib`. (3) Font: `default_font = 'DejaVu Sans'` ditemukan dari `vendor/dompdf/dompdf/lib/fonts/DejaVuSans.ttf` tanpa menyalin font ke `storage/fonts` (dompdf hanya menulis cache metrik `DejaVuSans.ufm.json` dan `DejaVuSans-Bold.ufm.json`, masing-masing ±270 KB, ke `font_cache`); PDF memuat `BaseFont /…+DejaVuSans` (subset tertanam). (4) Glyph `•` (U+2022) dan `–` (U+2013) ada di `DejaVuSans.ttf` (pemeriksaan `FontLib\Font` cmap: indeks 2821 dan 2806), jadi `•••••••••1234` dan "09.00–12.00" tercetak tanpa kotak "tofu". Ketiganya diulang oleh skrip Step 1 dan dikunci tes.
- **Ekstraksi teks PDF (cara yang dipilih dan alasannya).** PDF hasil dompdf memampatkan content stream (Flate) dan memetakan teks ke subset font. Hasil uji: setelah `gzuncompress`, karakter ASCII tetap utuh di operator `TJ` dengan byte NUL di antara huruf (`[( K o d e   U P H - A B C D … )] TJ`), sedangkan karakter non-ASCII dipetakan ke kode rendah (`•` menjadi `"`, `–` menjadi karakter kontrol). Karena itu tes memakai DUA lapis: (a) ekstraksi teks dari byte PDF (pembantu `pdfText()`: dekompresi tiap stream, ambil string di operator `TJ`, buang NUL) HANYA untuk bukti ASCII: kode booking, judul, nama RS, TIDAK ada nomor BPJS lengkap, keluhan, telepon, alamat, tahun lahir; (b) untuk karakter non-ASCII dan escape HTML, tes menangkap data view (`View::composer('pdf.appointment-proof', …)` merekam `$view->getData()` dari permintaan nyata ke endpoint PDF), merender ulang view itu menjadi HTML dan memeriksanya (jalur yang sama dengan yang diumpankan ke dompdf, jadi andal dan tidak bergantung pada pemetaan font). Tes juga menolak hasil ekstraksi kosong (agar tidak lulus hampa bila format PDF berubah).
- **PDF memuat QR sebagai PNG** (`qrPngDataUri`), bukan SVG (F6-R27); halaman HTML memakai SVG dari T8. Keduanya `qrPayload()` = `booking_code` saja (SEK-13). Tidak ada dekoder SVG di vendor, jadi isi QR dibuktikan lewat `qrPayload()` + dekode PNG; SVG diperiksa strukturnya (`<svg`, tanpa teks) dan dibandingkan dengan `src` gambar di halaman.
- **`config/dompdf.php`**: `mergeConfigFrom` paket menggabungkan dangkal (kunci teratas), sehingga blok `options` di aplikasi menggantikan seluruh `options` vendor; karena itu semua kunci `options` vendor disalin. Nilai khusus (F6-R26): `default_font = 'DejaVu Sans'`, `enable_remote = false`, `enable_php = false`, `enable_javascript = false` (vendor: true; JavaScript di PDF tidak diperlukan), `allowed_protocols` hanya `data://` dan `file://` (vendor menyertakan `http://`, `https://`), `font_dir` = `font_cache` = `storage_path('fonts')`, `chroot` = `realpath(base_path())`, `default_paper_size = 'a5'`, `enable_font_subsetting = true` (vendor: false, yang menanamkan DejaVu Sans utuh: PDF ±880 KB; dengan subset PDF ±22 KB dan ekstraksi teks seperti di atas). `PDF::loadView()` melalui facade `Barryvdh\DomPDF\Facade\Pdf` meresolusi instance baru tiap panggilan (tidak ada keadaan bersama), `->setPaper('a5', 'portrait')` diteruskan `__call` ke dompdf dan mengembalikan wrapper, `->download($name)` mengembalikan `Illuminate\Http\Response` dengan `Content-Type: application/pdf`, `Content-Disposition: attachment; filename=…` (`HeaderUtils::makeDisposition`, nama ASCII sehingga tanpa tanda kutip), dan `Content-Length`.
- **Selektor cetak yang keliru diperbaiki.** `layouts.public` tidak memakai `.site-header`/`.site-footer`/`.site-topbar`: header adalah `<header>` dan footer `<footer>` langsung di bawah `<body>`, menu portal adalah `<aside>`, flash `[data-flash]`. `_print.scss` kini menyembunyikan `body > header`, `body > footer`, `aside`, `[data-flash]` (selektor lama dipertahankan untuk panel admin). Ukuran A5 memakai halaman bernama (`@page proof` + `.proof-sheet { page: proof; }`) dan bukan `@page` global: `admin.scss` juga mengimpor `print`, sehingga `@page` global akan memaksa semua cetak (laporan admin fase berikutnya) berukuran A5. Peramban tanpa halaman bernama (Safari lama) mencetak A4; bukti tetap terbaca (07 W-12: "dapat dicetak ke A4"). Kompilasi Sass diperiksa penulis (`sass` mengeluarkan `@page proof` dan `page: proof` apa adanya).
- **Atribut dan kelas Bootstrap.** Tombol/tautan di halaman bukti memakai `d-print-none`; `x-breadcrumb` meneruskan atribut `class` ke `<nav>` (komponen `{{ $attributes }}`). Elemen `<header>` TIDAK dipakai di dalam `.proof-sheet` (selektor cetak `body > header` hanya menyasar header situs, tetapi menghindari tag itu mencegah salah sasaran).
- **CSP.** Tombol cetak = `<button type="button" data-print>` tanpa atribut event; satu delegasi `click` di `app.js` memanggil `window.print()`. Tidak ada listener `error` baru (`FrontendManifestTest` menghitung satu). `RawOutputScanTest`: tidak ada `{!!`, `HtmlString`, atau atribut `on…=` di view baru.
- **Mode ketat.** Controller memuat `clinic`, `doctor`, `practiceSession`, `patientProfile`, `insurancePartner` lewat `loadMissing` pada satu model (bukan koleksi, jadi tidak melanggar larangan lazy loading, tetapi eksplisit agar `queue_label` dan nama dokter aman). `SettingsService` di-resolve lewat `app()` di dalam service karena konstruktor `AppointmentProofService` milik T8 tidak diubah.
- **Pembayaran di bukti.** `payment_type->label()`; bila ada mitra asuransi, ` - {nama mitra}`; bila ada `masked_payment_reference`, ` ({•••••••••1234})`. Tanpa keluhan, alamat, telepon, tanggal lahir, email, atau nomor lengkap. Pendaftaran berstatus `cancelled` tetap dapat dilihat dan menampilkan catatan "Pendaftaran ini telah dibatalkan. Bukti ini tidak berlaku untuk check-in." (tambahan penulis; status lain tanpa catatan).
- **Logo di PDF** memakai `public/images/placeholders/logo.svg` (data URI SVG, vektor); logo kustom dari media tidak dipakai di PDF (butuh akses berkas privat; dicatat di Catatan penulis). Halaman HTML memakai `SettingsService::logoUrl()` (+ `data-fallback` untuk penghubung gambar rusak yang sudah ada).
- **Jumlah tes baru** 42 (`AppointmentProofTest`: 31 metode termasuk kasus provider). Waktu dibekukan `2026-10-12 08:00:00`; PDF pertama dalam proses menulis cache font ke `storage/fonts` (≈0,5 detik).

```powershell
$root = getenv('APP_ROOT');

use chillerlan\QRCode\Output\QRGdImagePNG;
use chillerlan\QRCode\QRCode;
use chillerlan\QRCode\QROptions;
use Dompdf\Dompdf;
use Dompdf\Options;

$qr = new QROptions(['outputInterface' => QRGdImagePNG::class, 'outputBase64' => true, 'scale' => 6, 'imageTransparent' => false]);
$uri = (new QRCode($qr))->render('UPH-ABCD-EFGH');
$bin = base64_decode(substr($uri, strlen('data:image/png;base64,')), true);
echo 'qr prefix=', substr($uri, 0, 21), ' decoded=', (new QRCode())->readFromBlob($bin), PHP_EOL;

$font = \FontLib\Font::load($root.'/vendor/dompdf/dompdf/lib/fonts/DejaVuSans.ttf');
$font->parse();
foreach ($font->getData('cmap', 'subtables') as $sub) {

        echo 'glyph U+2022=', $sub['glyphIndexArray'][0x2022] ?? 'TIDAK ADA', ' U+2013=', $sub['glyphIndexArray'][0x2013] ?? 'TIDAK ADA', PHP_EOL;
        break;
    }
}

$logo = 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,'.base64_encode((string) file_get_contents($root.'/public/images/placeholders/logo.svg'));
$options = new Options();
$options->set('font_dir', $dir);
$options->set('font_cache', $dir);
$options->set('chroot', $root);
$options->set('default_font', 'DejaVu Sans');
$options->set('enable_remote', false);

$dompdf->setPaper('a5', 'portrait');
$dompdf->render();
$pdf = $dompdf->output();

$text = '';
preg_match_all('~stream\r?\n(.*?)\r?\nendstream~s', $pdf, $streams);
foreach ($streams[1] as $raw) {
    $data = @gzuncompress($raw);
    if ($data === false || ! str_contains($data, ' TJ')) {
        continue;
    }
    preg_match_all('~\[(.*?)\]\s*TJ~s', $data, $ops);
    foreach ($ops[1] as $chunk) {
        preg_match_all('~\(((?:[^()\\\\]|\\\\.)*)\)~s', $chunk, $parts);
        $text .= str_replace("\0", '', preg_replace('~\\\\(.)~s', '$1', implode('', $parts[1])))."\n";
    }
}
echo 'pdf head=', substr($pdf, 0, 5), ' image=', preg_match('~/Subtype /Image~', $pdf), ' dejavu=', preg_match('~BaseFont /\S*DejaVuSans~', $pdf), PHP_EOL;
preg_match('~/MediaBox \[([^\]]+)\]~', $pdf, $box);
echo 'mediabox=', $box[1] ?? '-', PHP_EOL;
echo 'text has code=', str_contains($text, 'UPH-ABCD-EFGH') ? '1' : '0', ' has 1234=', str_contains($text, '1234') ? '1' : '0', PHP_EOL;
```

```php
        parent::setUp();

        $this->seed(SettingsSeeder::class);
        $this->travelTo(CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-12 08:00:00'));

        $this->clinic = $this->createClinic(['name' => 'Poli Anak', 'code' => 'ANK']);
        $this->doctor = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Sinta Maharani', 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => 'Sp.A'], $this->clinic);
        $this->owner = $this->createPatient(
            ['name' => 'Siti Rahma', 'email' => 'siti@contoh.test'],
            [
                'full_name' => 'Siti Rahma',
                'phone' => self::PHONE,
                'address' => self::ADDRESS,
                'birth_date' => '1985-07-23',
                'bpjs_number' => self::BPJS,
            ],
        );
        $this->appointment = $this->bookFor($this->owner, '2026-10-13', AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, [
            'queue_number' => 5,
            'payment_type' => PaymentType::Bpjs,
            'payment_reference' => self::BPJS,
            'payment_reference_last4' => '0011',
            'complaint' => self::COMPLAINT,
        ]);
    }

    // --- pembantu ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    private function code(): string
    {
        return sprintf('UPH-ABCD-%04d', ++$this->sequence);
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     */
    private function bookFor(User $user, string $date, AppointmentStatus $status = AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, array $overrides = []): Appointment
    {
        $session = $this->createSession([
            'doctor_id' => $this->doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $this->clinic->id,
            'session_date' => $date,
            'start_time' => '09:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'doctor_schedule_id' => null,
        ]);

        return $this->bookAppointment($session, $status, array_merge([
            'booking_code' => $this->code(),
            'patient_profile_id' => $user->patientProfile->id,
        ], $overrides));
    }

    private function proofUrl(Appointment $appointment): string
    {
        return route('patient.appointments.proof', $appointment->booking_code);
    }

    private function pdfUrl(Appointment $appointment): string
    {
        return route('patient.appointments.proof-pdf', $appointment->booking_code);
    }

    private function proofPage(?User $user = null, ?Appointment $appointment = null): TestResponse
    {
        return $this->actingAs($user ?? $this->owner)->get($this->proofUrl($appointment ?? $this->appointment));
    }

    private function pdfResponse(?User $user = null, ?Appointment $appointment = null): TestResponse
    {
        return $this->actingAs($user ?? $this->owner)->get($this->pdfUrl($appointment ?? $this->appointment));
    }

    /**
     * Teks ASCII dari byte PDF dompdf: dekompresi tiap stream Flate, ambil string di operator `TJ`, buang byte NUL
     * di antara huruf (PDF berfont subset dua-byte). Karakter non-ASCII dipetakan ke kode rendah oleh subset font,
     * karena itu hanya dipakai untuk asersi ASCII.
     */
    private static function pdfText(string $pdf): string
    {
        $text = '';
        preg_match_all('~stream\r?\n(.*?)\r?\nendstream~s', $pdf, $streams);

        foreach ($streams[1] as $raw) {
            $data = @gzuncompress($raw);

            if ($data === false || ! str_contains($data, ' TJ')) {
                continue;
            }

            preg_match_all('~\[(.*?)\]\s*TJ~s', $data, $operations);

            foreach ($operations[1] as $chunk) {
                preg_match_all('~\(((?:[^()\\\\]|\\\\.)*)\)~s', $chunk, $parts);
                $line = (string) preg_replace('~\\\\(.)~s', '$1', implode('', $parts[1]));
                $text .= str_replace("\0", '', $line)."\n";
            }
        }

        return $text;
    }

    /**
     * Merekam data view PDF dari permintaan nyata ke endpoint PDF, lalu merender ulang view itu menjadi HTML
     * (persis yang diumpankan ke dompdf).
     */
    private function capturedPdfHtml(?User $user = null, ?Appointment $appointment = null): string
    {
        $captured = null;
        View::composer('pdf.appointment-proof', function ($view) use (&$captured): void {
            $captured = $view->getData();
        });

        $this->pdfResponse($user, $appointment)->assertOk();

        $this->assertIsArray($captured, 'View pdf.appointment-proof tidak dirender oleh endpoint PDF.');

        return view('pdf.appointment-proof', $captured)->render();
    }

    private function service(): AppointmentProofService
    {
        return app(AppointmentProofService::class);
    }

        $session = $this->appointment->practiceSession;

        $response = $this->proofPage()->assertOk();

        $response->assertSee('<title>Bukti Pendaftaran '.$code.' — '.config('app.name').'</title>', false)
            ->assertSee('<meta name="robots" content="noindex,nofollow">', false)
            ->assertSee('Bukti Pendaftaran Kunjungan')

            ->assertSee('Dikonfirmasi')

            ->assertSee('09.00–12.00')

    public function test_the_pdf_is_an_a5_attachment_with_the_expected_name_and_headers(): void
    {
        $response = $this->pdfResponse()->assertOk();
        $body = $response->getContent();
        $code = $this->appointment->booking_code;

        $this->assertSame('application/pdf', $response->headers->get('Content-Type'));
        $this->assertMatchesRegularExpression('~^attachment;\s*filename="?bukti-'.preg_quote($code, '~').'\.pdf"?$~', (string) $response->headers->get('Content-Disposition'));
        $this->assertSame((string) strlen($body), $response->headers->get('Content-Length'));
        $this->assertTrue($response->headers->hasCacheControlDirective('no-store'));
        $this->assertTrue($response->headers->hasCacheControlDirective('private'));
        $this->assertStringStartsWith('%PDF-', $body);
        $this->assertSame(1, preg_match('~/MediaBox \[0\.000 0\.000 419\.530 595\.280\]~', $body), 'Ukuran halaman harus A5 potret.');
        $this->assertGreaterThanOrEqual(1, preg_match_all('~/Subtype /Image~', $body), 'Gambar QR (PNG) harus tertanam.');
        $this->assertStringContainsString('DejaVuSans', $body, 'Font DejaVu Sans harus tertanam.');
    }

        }
    }

    public function test_the_pdf_html_has_no_sensitive_data_and_escapes_names(): void

        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('<script>alert(1)</script>', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('&lt;script&gt;alert(1)&lt;/script&gt;', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('alert(2)', $html);
    }

    public function test_dejavu_sans_has_the_glyphs_used_by_the_proof(): void
    {
        $font = \FontLib\Font::load(base_path('vendor/dompdf/dompdf/lib/fonts/DejaVuSans.ttf'));
        $font->parse();

        $map = null;
        foreach ($font->getData('cmap', 'subtables') as $subtable) {
            if (isset($subtable['glyphIndexArray'])) {
                $map = $subtable['glyphIndexArray'];
                break;
            }
        }

        $this->assertIsArray($map);
        foreach ([0x2022 => 'bullet', 0x2013 => 'en dash', 0x00C5 => 'A ring', 0x00D1 => 'N tilde'] as $codePoint => $name) {
            $this->assertArrayHasKey($codePoint, $map, "DejaVu Sans tidak memiliki glyph {$name}.");
        }

        $font->close();
    }

    #[DataProvider('proofRoutes')]
    public function test_the_owner_gets_200(string $route): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->owner)->get(route($route, $this->appointment->booking_code))->assertOk();
    }

    #[DataProvider('proofRoutes')]
    public function test_another_patient_gets_the_same_404_as_for_an_unknown_code_and_sees_nothing(string $route): void
    {
        $intruder = $this->createPatient(['email' => 'penyusup@contoh.test'], ['full_name' => 'Penyusup']);
        $this->actingAs($intruder);

        $foreign = $this->get(route($route, $this->appointment->booking_code));
        $unknown = $this->get(route($route, 'UPH-ABCD-9999'));

        $foreign->assertNotFound();
        $unknown->assertNotFound();
        $this->assertSame($unknown->getStatusCode(), $foreign->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString($this->appointment->booking_code, $foreign->getContent());
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Siti Rahma', $foreign->getContent());
        $this->assertNotSame('application/pdf', $foreign->headers->get('Content-Type'));
    }

    #[DataProvider('proofRoutes')]
    public function test_malformed_codes_give_404(string $route): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->owner);

        foreach (['XYZ', 'UPH-ILLE-OOOO', 'uph-abcd-0001', 'UPH-ABCD-00011'] as $code) {
            $this->get(route($route, $code))->assertNotFound();
        }
    }

    #[DataProvider('proofRoutes')]
    public function test_staff_are_sent_to_the_admin_dashboard(string $route): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->createStaff('content-admin'))
            ->get(route($route, $this->appointment->booking_code))
            ->assertRedirect(route('admin.dashboard'));
    }

    #[DataProvider('proofRoutes')]
    public function test_guests_are_sent_to_login_with_the_full_intended_url(string $route): void
    {
        $url = route($route, $this->appointment->booking_code);

        $this->get($url)->assertRedirect(route('login'));

        $this->assertSame($url, session('url.intended'));
    }

    public function test_the_routes_have_the_expected_uris_and_patient_guards(): void
    {
        $code = $this->appointment->booking_code;

        $this->assertSame('/pasien/pendaftaran/'.$code.'/bukti', route('patient.appointments.proof', $code, false));
        $this->assertSame('/pasien/pendaftaran/'.$code.'/bukti.pdf', route('patient.appointments.proof-pdf', $code, false));

        foreach (['patient.appointments.proof', 'patient.appointments.proof-pdf'] as $name) {
            $route = Route::getRoutes()->getByName($name);
            $this->assertNotNull($route);
            $this->assertSame(['GET', 'HEAD'], $route->methods());
            $middleware = $route->gatherMiddleware();
            $this->assertContains('auth', $middleware);
            $this->assertContains('account:patient', $middleware);
            $this->assertContains('active', $middleware);
            $this->assertNotContains('throttle:booking', $middleware);
        }
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

/*
|--------------------------------------------------------------------------
| Konfigurasi dompdf (barryvdh/laravel-dompdf ^3.1) — bukti pendaftaran PDF
|--------------------------------------------------------------------------
|
| Struktur disalin dari `vendor/barryvdh/laravel-dompdf/config/dompdf.php`. Paket menggabungkan berkas ini
| DANGKAL (`mergeConfigFrom`): blok `options` di sini menggantikan seluruh `options` vendor, jadi semua kunci
| harus ada. Nilai khusus fase 6 (F6-R26): font bawaan DejaVu Sans (mendukung "•" dan "–"), tanpa akses jarak
| jauh, tanpa PHP/JavaScript di dokumen, protokol hanya `data://` dan `file://`, kertas A5 potret.
|
*/

return [

    // Lempar pengecualian pada peringatan dompdf (mati: peringatan tidak menggagalkan unduhan).
    'show_warnings' => false,

    // Menimpa path `public` bila perlu (NULL = `base_path('public')`).
    'public_path' => null,

    // Mengubah "€" dan "£" menjadi entitas HTML sebelum dirender.
    'convert_entities' => true,

    'options' => [
        // Folder font dan cache metrik font. WAJIB ada dan dapat ditulis web server: `storage/fonts`
        // (isinya di-gitignore; DejaVu Sans dibaca dari `vendor/dompdf/dompdf/lib/fonts`).
        'font_dir' => storage_path('fonts'),

        'font_cache' => storage_path('fonts'),

        // Folder sementara untuk dompdf.
        'temp_dir' => sys_get_temp_dir(),

        // Berkas lokal yang dibuka dompdf harus berada di dalam folder ini. Jangan diubah ke "/".
        'chroot' => realpath(base_path()),

        // Protokol yang diizinkan: hanya data URI (QR PNG, logo) dan berkas lokal. Tanpa http/https.
        'allowed_protocols' => [
            'data://' => ['rules' => []],
            'file://' => ['rules' => []],
        ],

        'artifactPathValidation' => null,

        'log_output_file' => null,

        // Subset font: hanya glyph yang dipakai tertanam (PDF ±22 KB, bukan ±880 KB dengan DejaVu Sans utuh).
        'enable_font_subsetting' => true,

        'pdf_backend' => 'CPDF',

        'default_media_type' => 'screen',

        // Bukti pendaftaran dicetak A5 potret (07 W-12).
        'default_paper_size' => 'a5',

        'default_paper_orientation' => 'portrait',

        // DejaVu Sans: font bawaan dompdf yang memuat "•" (U+2022) dan "–" (U+2013) (K-17 pilihan a).
        'default_font' => 'DejaVu Sans',

        'dpi' => 96,

        // Tidak pernah mengeksekusi PHP atau JavaScript tertanam di dokumen.
        'enable_php' => false,

        'enable_javascript' => false,

        // Tidak pernah mengambil sumber jarak jauh (SSRF); semua gambar berupa data URI.
        'enable_remote' => false,

        'allowed_remote_hosts' => null,

        'font_height_ratio' => 1.1,

        'enable_html5_parser' => true,
    ],

];
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Tambahkan `qrPngDataUri()` dan `pdf()` ke `AppointmentProofService` (tool Read lalu Edit pada `app/Services/Booking/AppointmentProofService.php`)**

Baca berkas dulu (T8 menulis `final class AppointmentProofService { private const SVG_PREFIX = …; qrPayload(); qrSvgDataUri(); }`). Semua nama kelas memakai nama lengkap di dalam kode agar tidak bentrok dengan `use` T8 (hindari `use` ganda). Ketiga method dipasang di AKHIR kelas (urutan T8 tidak berubah). `old_string` (akhir `qrSvgDataUri()` sampai penutup kelas; tepat satu kali):

```php
        return $uri;
    }
}
```

`new_string`: `        return $uri;`, `    }`, satu baris kosong, ketiga method di bawah (`qrPngDataUri`, `pdf`, lalu `pdfLogoDataUri` privat paling bawah), lalu `}` penutup kelas:

```php
        return $uri;
    }

    /**
     * QR untuk PDF (F6-R27): PNG (chillerlan GD) sebagai data URI base64. Isi QR = `qrPayload()` (kode booking
     * saja). dompdf merender gambar raster dari data URI tanpa akses jarak jauh; PNG dipakai alih-alih SVG di PDF.
     */
    public function qrPngDataUri(Appointment $appointment): string
    {
        $options = new \chillerlan\QRCode\QROptions([
            'outputInterface' => \chillerlan\QRCode\Output\QRGdImagePNG::class,
            'outputBase64' => true,
            'eccLevel' => \chillerlan\QRCode\Common\EccLevel::M,
            'scale' => 6,
            'imageTransparent' => false,
        ]);

        return (string) (new \chillerlan\QRCode\QRCode($options))->render($this->qrPayload($appointment));
    }

    /**
     * Bukti PDF A5 potret (F6-R26): unduhan `bukti-{booking_code}.pdf`, tanpa cache. Otorisasi (pemilik) dilakukan
     * pemanggil sebelum method ini. Tanpa keluhan, alamat, telepon, tanggal lahir, atau nomor lengkap.
     */
    public function pdf(Appointment $appointment): \Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response
    {
        $appointment->loadMissing(['clinic', 'doctor', 'practiceSession', 'patientProfile', 'insurancePartner']);

        // SettingsService di-resolve di sini agar konstruktor kelas ini (milik Task 8) tidak berubah.
        $settings = app(\App\Services\Settings\SettingsService::class);

        $pdf = \Barryvdh\DomPDF\Facade\Pdf::loadView('pdf.appointment-proof', [
            'appointment' => $appointment,
            'siteName' => $settings->string('site.name', (string) config('app.name')),
            'logoDataUri' => $this->pdfLogoDataUri(),
            'qrPngDataUri' => $this->qrPngDataUri($appointment),
            'checkinMinutes' => $settings->bookingRules()->checkinOpenMinutes,
            'printedAt' => \Carbon\CarbonImmutable::now(),
        ])->setPaper('a5', 'portrait');

        $response = $pdf->download('bukti-'.$appointment->booking_code.'.pdf');
        $response->headers->set('Cache-Control', 'no-store, private');

        return $response;
    }

    /** Logo lokal untuk PDF sebagai data URI SVG (vektor); NULL bila berkas tidak ada. */
    private function pdfLogoDataUri(): ?string
    {
        $path = public_path('images/placeholders/logo.svg');

        if (! is_file($path)) {
            return null;
        }

        $contents = file_get_contents($path);

        return $contents === false ? null : 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,'.base64_encode($contents);
    }
}
```

`eccLevel` M disamakan dengan QR SVG T8 (hasil pindai sama). Jangan mengubah method T8; bila nama privat `pdfLogoDataUri` bentrok dengan method T8, ganti namanya. Pint (Step 14) dapat mengubah nama kelas lengkap menjadi `use`; itu tidak mengubah perilaku.

Baca berkas dulu. Dua pengeditan dengan jangkar kanonik (`Appointment`, `AppointmentProofService`, `SettingsService`, `CarbonImmutable`, `View` sudah diimpor T7/T8/T9; hanya `SymfonyResponse` yang baru).

1. `old_string` (tepat satu kali): `use Illuminate\View\View;` lalu `new_string`:

```php
use Illuminate\View\View;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response as SymfonyResponse;
```

2. Method. `old_string` (tepat satu kali; 4 spasi di depan):

```php
    // [[METODE-PUBLIK-BERIKUT]]
```

`new_string`: kedua method di bawah, diikuti satu baris kosong, lalu penanda dikembalikan persis (`    // [[METODE-PUBLIK-BERIKUT]]`):

```php
    /**
     * Halaman bukti untuk dicetak (F6-R26). Hanya pemilik (`AppointmentPolicy::view`, selain itu 404); isi tanpa
     * keluhan, alamat, telepon, tanggal lahir, atau nomor lengkap. QR = kode booking saja (SVG data URI).
     */
    public function proof(Appointment $appointment, AppointmentProofService $proof, SettingsService $settings): View
    {
        $this->authorize('view', $appointment);

        $appointment->loadMissing(['clinic', 'doctor', 'practiceSession', 'patientProfile', 'insurancePartner']);

        return view('patient.appointments.proof', [
            'appointment' => $appointment,
            'qrDataUri' => $proof->qrSvgDataUri($appointment),
            'siteName' => $settings->string('site.name', (string) config('app.name')),
            'logoUrl' => $settings->logoUrl(),
            'checkinMinutes' => $settings->bookingRules()->checkinOpenMinutes,
            'printedAt' => CarbonImmutable::now(),
        ]);
    }

    /** Unduhan PDF bukti (A5 potret, `bukti-{kode}.pdf`); otorisasi sama dengan halaman cetak. */
    public function proofPdf(Appointment $appointment, AppointmentProofService $proof): SymfonyResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('view', $appointment);

        return $proof->pdf($appointment);
    }

    // [[METODE-PUBLIK-BERIKUT]]
```

Bila `use Illuminate\View\View;` atau penanda `// [[METODE-PUBLIK-BERIKUT]]` tidak ada tepat satu kali, T7 sampai T9 belum selesai: hentikan. Jangan mengubah method lain.

Method privat/publik baru di `AppointmentProofService` memakai nama kelas lengkap agar tidak bentrok dengan `use` T8; hanya `qrPngDataUri()` dan `pdf()` publik (sesuai kerangka D), selebihnya privat (`pdfLogoDataUri`).
- **Penyimpangan dari F6-R26 (tercatat untuk T13/dokumen D-xxx).** `@page { size: A5 portrait; margin: 10mm; }` ditulis sebagai halaman BERNAMA (`@page proof` + `.proof-sheet { page: proof; }`), bukan `@page` global, karena `admin.scss` mengimpor `print` yang sama dan cetak laporan admin fase 7+ tidak boleh terpaksa A5; konsekuensinya Safari lama mencetak bukti pada A4 (tetap terbaca). Tes mengunci `@page proof`, `size: A5 portrait`, dan `margin: 10mm`. Juga: `enable_javascript` = `false` (vendor `true`) dan `allowed_protocols` tanpa `http/https` (selaras 10 §7.5). **Test IDs:** PAS-08 (notifikasi milik sendiri vs milik orang lain), NTF-01 (banner/pemberitahuan belum dibaca di dashboard, isi tanpa BPJS), PAS-10 (sisi dashboard: banner menaut ke `index?jadwal_berubah=1`), EMP-04 (kartu kosong dengan tombol "Daftar Kunjungan"), F-PAS-01 (kunjungan mendatang), SEK-15 (judul/isi notifikasi dan nama pasien di dropdown ter-escape), SEK-12 (nomor BPJS tidak pernah muncul di dashboard), VAL (nilai liar `tujuan`, id non-UUID tanpa 500), Review Focus E.3 (notifikasi milik orang lain 404; kode booking asing di `data` tidak menjadi tautan) dan E.5 (data sensitif).

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
- **Dashboard fase 5.** `DashboardController::index` hanya `view('patient.dashboard', ['user' => $user, 'profile' => $profile])` dan `abort_if($profile === null, 404)` (F5-R13); view memuat `<h1>` "Halo, …", seksi `aria-labelledby="kunjungan-judul"` (empty state "Belum ada pendaftaran" + tombol bersyarat `Route::has`) dan seksi `profil-judul`. `PatientDashboardTest::section()` memotong dengan regex `<section[^>]*aria-labelledby="{id}"[^>]*>(.*?)</section>`, sehingga `<section>` TIDAK boleh bersarang di dalam kartu kunjungan (kartu memakai `<ul>/<li>`). Teks yang dikunci tes: "Kunjungan Mendatang", "Belum ada pendaftaran", "Pendaftaran kunjungan Anda akan tampil di sini.", `<a class="btn btn-primary" href="{{ route('patient.appointments.create') }}">Daftar Kunjungan</a>`, "Profil Anda", tepat satu `<h1`. Semuanya dipertahankan; cabang `Route::has` + "Lihat Jadwal Dokter" dihapus karena route sudah ada (tes empty state dibalik oleh T7).
- **Definisi "mendatang".** Satu-satunya implementasi adalah `Appointment::scopeUpcomingActive($now)` (F3-R15): status aktif (`pending`, `confirmed`, `checked_in`) pada sesi yang belum berakhir (`session_date` > hari ini, atau hari ini dengan `end_time` > jam sekarang). Urutan kartu: `appointments.session_date`, lalu jam mulai sesi (subkueri `orderBy(PracticeSession::query()->select('start_time')->whereColumn(...))`; `Query\Builder::orderBy` menerima builder lewat `isQueryable()` + `createSub()`, diverifikasi di vendor), lalu `appointments.id`. Batas 5 lewat `limit()`; banner menghitung SEMUA aktif mendatang yang berubah jadwal (bukan hanya lima).
- **Mode ketat.** `Model::shouldBeStrict()` melarang lazy loading pada hasil `get()`: `clinic` (untuk `queue_label`), `doctor` (`display_name`), dan `practiceSession` (`time_range`) wajib di-eager-load; tes `…does_not_grow_the_query_count…` membuktikan jumlah kueri sama untuk 1 dan 5 kunjungan.
- **Notifikasi.** `User` memakai trait `Notifiable`; `unreadNotifications()` = `notifications()->unread()` (relasi morph, sudah `latest()`), `DatabaseNotification::$guarded = []` (tes boleh `create([...])` lewat relasi), `markAsRead()` hanya mengisi `read_at` bila masih NULL (idempoten). Kolom `type` menyimpan nama kelas; dashboard membedakan jenis dengan `=== AppointmentScheduleChangedNotification::class` (banner `alert-warning`; jenis lain `alert-info`).
- **`notifications.read`.** `$request->user()->notifications()->whereKey($id)->firstOrFail()`: baris milik pengguna lain tidak ditemukan → 404 (PAS-08); `->whereUuid('id')` membuat id non-UUID tidak pernah cocok route (404 dari router). `tujuan` dibaca dengan `$request->input('tujuan') === 'dashboard'`: nilai larik/liar tidak pernah sama dengan string itu sehingga jatuh ke tujuan bawaan (detail) tanpa 500. Tujuan detail hanya ke `show` bila `data.booking_code` bertipe string dan benar-benar milik profil pasien itu (kode asing atau basi di `data` → `index`, tidak pernah bocor ke 404 yang membingungkan).
- **Dropdown (F6-R30).** Header `layouts.public` menghitung `$accountLinks` (Dashboard, Riwayat Pendaftaran, Profil dan Akun; tautan ke route yang tidak ada disaring) dan `$hasAccountMenu = $accountLinks !== [] && $logoutUrl !== null`. Aksi "Akun Saya" lama diberi `'account' => true`: tetap tampil di bilah ringkas mobile (`header => true`), tetapi dilewati (`@continue`) di baris atas desktop dan offcanvas ketika dropdown aktif. Label tombol = `Str::limit($account->name, 24)` di dalam `{{ }}` (ter-escape) dengan teks tersembunyi `Akun Saya: ` untuk pembaca layar. Tombol "Keluar" terpisah hanya dirender bila dropdown tidak aktif (staf, atau pasien tanpa route). Tidak ada JS/SCSS baru: `import * as bootstrap from 'bootstrap'` di `app.js` sudah memuat Dropdown (menu "Informasi" memakainya).
- **Tes lama yang tersentuh.** `git grep "Akun Saya"` hanya menemukan `PatientDashboardTest::test_portal_menu_and_logout_form_are_rendered_for_the_patient` (`->assertSee('Akun Saya')`, tetap lulus karena teks tersembunyi dipertahankan; ditambah asersi dropdown). `LayoutsTest` tidak memiliki asersi yang gagal oleh dropdown (diverifikasi di Step 13); bagian baru ditambahkan lewat anchor komentar `// --- layout pasien ---`. Tes empty state `PatientDashboardTest` diubah T7 dan tidak disentuh di sini.
- Jumlah tes baru: `PatientNotificationsTest` ±27 (termasuk 3 kasus provider), `LayoutsTest` +5.

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Patient;

use App\Enums\AppointmentStatus;
use App\Enums\PaymentType;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\AppointmentScheduleChangedNotification;
use App\Notifications\AppointmentStatusChangedNotification;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Notifications\DatabaseNotification;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Mail;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithPatients;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Dashboard pasien fase 6 (#27, F6-R28) dan `patient.notifications.read` (F6-R29): F-PAS-01 (kunjungan mendatang),
 * EMP-04, NTF-01 (pemberitahuan belum dibaca), PAS-08 (notifikasi milik sendiri), PAS-10 (banner jadwal berubah
 * menaut ke filter riwayat), SEK-12 dan SEK-15 (tanpa BPJS; teks ter-escape). Sekarang = Senin 2026-10-05 07.00.
 */
class PatientNotificationsTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithPatients;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-05 07:00:00'); // Senin
    }

    // --- pembantu ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    /** Isi `<section aria-labelledby="{id}">` (header dan sidebar juga memuat teks "Daftar Kunjungan"). */
    private function section(string $html, string $id): string
    {
        $this->assertSame(
            1,
            preg_match('#<section[^>]*aria-labelledby="'.preg_quote($id, '#').'"[^>]*>(.*?)</section>#s', $html, $matches),
            "Bagian {$id} tidak ditemukan.",
        );

        return $matches[1];
    }

    /** @param  list<string>  $needles */
    private function assertInOrder(array $needles, string $haystack): void
    {
        $offset = -1;

        foreach ($needles as $needle) {
            $position = strpos($haystack, $needle);

            $this->assertNotFalse($position, "{$needle} tidak ditemukan.");
            $this->assertGreaterThan($offset, $position, "{$needle} berada di urutan yang salah.");
            $offset = $position;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Pendaftaran milik `$patient` pada sesi baru; kuota sesi dijaga konsisten oleh `bookAppointment()`.
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $session
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $appointment
     */
    private function book(User $patient, array $session = [], AppointmentStatus $status = AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, array $appointment = []): Appointment
    {
        $created = $this->bookAppointment(
            $this->createSession($session),
            $status,
            ['patient_profile_id' => $patient->patientProfile->id] + $appointment,
        );

        return $created->load(['clinic', 'doctor', 'practiceSession']);
    }

    /**
     * Notifikasi database langsung ke tabel (bentuk `data` = 11 §10.1).
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $data
     */
    private function notice(User $user, array $data = [], string $type = AppointmentStatusChangedNotification::class, ?string $readAt = null): DatabaseNotification
    {
        return $user->notifications()->create([
            'id' => (string) Str::uuid(),
            'type' => $type,
            'data' => $data + [
                'appointment_id' => 1,
                'booking_code' => 'UPH-AAAA-BBBB',
                'title' => 'Status pendaftaran berubah',
                'body' => 'Status pendaftaran Anda kini Dikonfirmasi.',
            ],
            'read_at' => $readAt,
        ]);
    }

    private function readUrl(DatabaseNotification|string $notification): string
    {
        return route('patient.notifications.read', ['id' => $notification instanceof DatabaseNotification ? $notification->id : $notification]);
    }

    private function showUrl(string $bookingCode): string
    {
        return route('patient.appointments.show', ['appointment' => $bookingCode]);
    }

    private function queryCountFor(User $user): int
    {
        DB::flushQueryLog();
        DB::enableQueryLog();
        $this->actingAs($user)->get(route('patient.dashboard'))->assertOk();
        $count = count(DB::getQueryLog());
        DB::disableQueryLog();

        return $count;
    }

    // --- kunjungan mendatang (F-PAS-01) ---------------------------------------------------------

    public function test_the_upcoming_card_lists_only_own_active_appointments_on_sessions_that_have_not_ended(): void
    {
        $me = $this->createPatient();
        $other = $this->createPatient();

        $today = $this->book($me, ['session_date' => '2026-10-05', 'start_time' => '09:00:00', 'end_time' => '12:00:00'], AppointmentStatus::CheckedIn);
        $pending = $this->book($me, ['session_date' => '2026-10-06'], AppointmentStatus::Pending);
        $confirmed = $this->book($me, ['session_date' => '2026-10-08'], AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $cancelled = $this->book($me, ['session_date' => '2026-10-07'], AppointmentStatus::Cancelled);
        $completed = $this->book($me, ['session_date' => '2026-10-09'], AppointmentStatus::Completed);
        $noShow = $this->book($me, ['session_date' => '2026-10-10'], AppointmentStatus::NoShow);
        $past = $this->book($me, ['session_date' => '2026-10-04'], AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);
        $others = $this->book($other, ['session_date' => '2026-10-06'], AppointmentStatus::Confirmed);

        $html = $this->actingAs($me)->get(route('patient.dashboard'))->assertOk()->getContent();
        $visits = $this->section($html, 'kunjungan-judul');

        $this->assertInOrder([$today->booking_code, $pending->booking_code, $confirmed->booking_code], $visits);

        foreach ([$cancelled, $completed, $noShow, $past, $others] as $hidden) {
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString($hidden->booking_code, $html, "{$hidden->booking_code} tidak boleh tampil di dashboard.");
        }

        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Belum ada pendaftaran', $visits);
    }

    public function test_the_upcoming_card_shows_at_most_five_appointments_earliest_first(): void
    {
        $me = $this->createPatient();
        $codes = [];

        foreach ([12, 6, 10, 7, 9, 8, 11] as $day) {
            $codes[$day] = $this->book($me, ['session_date' => sprintf('2026-10-%02d', $day)])->booking_code;
        }

        $visits = $this->section($this->actingAs($me)->get(route('patient.dashboard'))->assertOk()->getContent(), 'kunjungan-judul');

        $this->assertInOrder([$codes[6], $codes[7], $codes[8], $codes[9], $codes[10]], $visits);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString($codes[11], $visits);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString($codes[12], $visits);
        $this->assertSame(5, substr_count($visits, 'class="card"'));
    }

    public function test_appointments_on_the_same_day_are_ordered_by_session_start_time(): void
    {
        $me = $this->createPatient();

        $afternoon = $this->book($me, ['session_date' => '2026-10-06', 'start_time' => '13:00:00', 'end_time' => '15:00:00']);
        $morning = $this->book($me, ['session_date' => '2026-10-06', 'start_time' => '08:00:00', 'end_time' => '10:00:00']);

        $visits = $this->section($this->actingAs($me)->get(route('patient.dashboard'))->assertOk()->getContent(), 'kunjungan-judul');

        $this->assertInOrder([$morning->booking_code, $afternoon->booking_code], $visits);

    public function test_a_session_that_ended_earlier_today_is_not_an_upcoming_visit(): void
    {
        $me = $this->createPatient();
        $ended = $this->book($me, ['session_date' => '2026-10-05', 'start_time' => '08:00:00', 'end_time' => '12:00:00']);
        $later = $this->book($me, ['session_date' => '2026-10-05', 'start_time' => '14:00:00', 'end_time' => '16:00:00']);

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-05 13:00:00');

        $html = $this->actingAs($me)->get(route('patient.dashboard'))->assertOk()->getContent();

        $this->assertStringNotContainsString($ended->booking_code, $html);

    public function test_each_visit_card_shows_code_queue_doctor_clinic_schedule_status_and_a_detail_link(): void
    {
        $me = $this->createPatient();
        $visit = $this->book($me, ['session_date' => '2026-10-06', 'start_time' => '09:00:00', 'end_time' => '12:00:00'], AppointmentStatus::Pending);

        $visits = $this->section($this->actingAs($me)->get(route('patient.dashboard'))->assertOk()->getContent(), 'kunjungan-judul');

        $this->assertStringContainsString('09.00–12.00', $visits);

        $this->assertStringContainsString('href="'.route('patient.appointments.index').'"', $visits);

    /** Eager load: mode ketat melarang lazy loading; jumlah kueri tidak bertambah menurut jumlah kunjungan. */
    public function test_the_dashboard_does_not_grow_its_query_count_with_more_appointments(): void

    // --- banner jadwal berubah (PAS-10, sisi dashboard) -----------------------------------------

    public function test_the_schedule_banner_counts_only_own_active_upcoming_changes_and_links_to_the_history_filter(): void
    {
        $me = $this->createPatient();

    }

    // --- pemberitahuan belum dibaca (NTF-01) ---------------------------------------------------

    public function test_unread_notifications_are_listed_with_detail_and_mark_read_buttons(): void
    {
        $me = $this->createPatient();
        $other = $this->createPatient();

        $status = $this->notice($me, ['title' => 'Pendaftaran dikonfirmasi', 'body' => 'Status pendaftaran UPH-AAAA-BBBB kini Dikonfirmasi.']);
        $schedule = $this->notice($me, [
            'title' => 'Jadwal kunjungan berubah',
            'body' => 'Jam praktik kini 10.00–14.00 (sebelumnya 09.00–13.00).',
            'old_range' => '09.00–13.00',
            'new_range' => '10.00–14.00',
        ], AppointmentScheduleChangedNotification::class);
        $this->notice($me, ['title' => 'Sudah dibaca dulu'], AppointmentStatusChangedNotification::class, '2026-10-04 08:00:00');
        $this->notice($other, ['title' => 'Milik pasien lain']);

        $response = $this->actingAs($me)->get(route('patient.dashboard'))->assertOk();
        $notices = $this->section($response->getContent(), 'pemberitahuan-judul');

        $this->assertStringContainsString('Pemberitahuan', $notices);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Pendaftaran dikonfirmasi', $notices);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Status pendaftaran UPH-AAAA-BBBB kini Dikonfirmasi.', $notices);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Jadwal kunjungan berubah', $notices);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Jam praktik kini 10.00–14.00 (sebelumnya 09.00–13.00).', $notices);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Sudah dibaca dulu', $response->getContent());
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Milik pasien lain', $response->getContent());

        // Jenis menentukan warna: jadwal berubah = peringatan, status = informasi.
        $this->assertSame(1, substr_count($notices, 'alert-warning'));
        $this->assertSame(1, substr_count($notices, 'alert-info'));

        foreach ([$status, $schedule] as $notification) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString('action="'.$this->readUrl($notification).'"', $notices);
        }

        $this->assertSame(2, substr_count($notices, 'name="tujuan" value="detail"'));
        $this->assertSame(2, substr_count($notices, 'name="tujuan" value="dashboard"'));
        $this->assertSame(2, substr_count($notices, '>Lihat detail<'));
        $this->assertSame(2, substr_count($notices, '>Tandai sudah dibaca<'));
        $this->assertSame(4, substr_count($notices, 'name="_token"'));
    }

    {

    /** SEK-15: judul dan isi notifikasi tampil sebagai teks. */
    public function test_notification_text_is_escaped(): void
    {
        $me = $this->createPatient();
        $this->notice($me, ['title' => '<script>alert(1)</script>', 'body' => '<img src=x onerror=alert(2)>']);

        $this->actingAs($me)->get(route('patient.dashboard'))->assertOk()
            ->assertDontSee('<script>alert(1)</script>', false)

    /** NTF-01 dan SEK-12: notifikasi nyata muncul di dashboard tanpa nomor BPJS, polis, atau keluhan. */
    public function test_a_real_status_notification_appears_on_the_dashboard_without_sensitive_data(): void
    {
        Mail::fake();

        $me = $this->createPatient();
        $appointment = $this->book($me, ['session_date' => '2026-10-06'], AppointmentStatus::Confirmed, [
            'payment_type' => PaymentType::Bpjs,
            'payment_reference' => '0009900000011',
            'payment_reference_last4' => '0011',
            'complaint' => 'Keluhan sangat rahasia',
        ]);

        $me->notify(new AppointmentStatusChangedNotification($appointment, AppointmentStatus::Pending, AppointmentStatus::Confirmed));

        $this->assertSame(1, $me->unreadNotifications()->count());

        $response = $this->actingAs($me)->get(route('patient.dashboard'))->assertOk();
        $html = $response->getContent();

        $notices = $this->section($html, 'pemberitahuan-judul');
        $notification = $me->unreadNotifications()->firstOrFail();

        $this->assertStringContainsString('Pemberitahuan', $notices);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('action="'.$this->readUrl($notification).'"', $notices);
        $this->assertSame($appointment->booking_code, $notification->data['booking_code']);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('0009900000011', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Keluhan sangat rahasia', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('0009900000011', json_encode($me->notifications()->first()->data, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR));
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Keluhan sangat rahasia', json_encode($me->notifications()->first()->data, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR));
    }

    // --- patient.notifications.read (F6-R29, PAS-08) ----------------------------------------------

    public function test_reading_an_own_notification_marks_it_read_and_goes_to_the_appointment_detail(): void
    {
        $me = $this->createPatient();
        $appointment = $this->book($me, ['session_date' => '2026-10-06']);
        $notification = $this->notice($me, ['booking_code' => $appointment->booking_code]);

        $this->actingAs($me)->post($this->readUrl($notification), ['tujuan' => 'detail'])
            ->assertRedirect($this->showUrl($appointment->booking_code));

        $this->assertNotNull($notification->fresh()->read_at);
        $this->assertSame(0, $me->unreadNotifications()->count());
    }

    public function test_the_dashboard_destination_returns_to_the_dashboard(): void
    {
        $me = $this->createPatient();
        $appointment = $this->book($me, ['session_date' => '2026-10-06']);
        $notification = $this->notice($me, ['booking_code' => $appointment->booking_code]);

        $this->actingAs($me)->post($this->readUrl($notification), ['tujuan' => 'dashboard'])
            ->assertRedirect(route('patient.dashboard'));

        $this->assertNotNull($notification->fresh()->read_at);
    }

    public function test_without_a_destination_the_default_is_the_appointment_detail(): void
    {
        $me = $this->createPatient();
        $appointment = $this->book($me, ['session_date' => '2026-10-06']);
        $notification = $this->notice($me, ['booking_code' => $appointment->booking_code]);

        $this->actingAs($me)->post($this->readUrl($notification))
            ->assertRedirect($this->showUrl($appointment->booking_code));
    }

    /** VAL: `tujuan` berupa larik atau nilai liar tidak pernah 500; jatuh ke tujuan bawaan. */
    public function test_a_wild_destination_value_falls_back_to_the_default_without_an_error(): void
    {
        $me = $this->createPatient();
        $appointment = $this->book($me, ['session_date' => '2026-10-06']);

        foreach ([['dashboard'], 'http://jahat.example', str_repeat('x', 5000), ''] as $wild) {
            $notification = $this->notice($me, ['booking_code' => $appointment->booking_code]);

            $this->actingAs($me)->post($this->readUrl($notification), ['tujuan' => $wild])
                ->assertRedirect($this->showUrl($appointment->booking_code));
        }
    }

    /** Review Focus E.3: kode booking milik pasien lain di `data` tidak pernah menjadi tautan detail. */
    public function test_a_booking_code_of_someone_else_in_the_data_leads_to_the_history_not_the_detail(): void
    {

    {

    /** PAS-08: notifikasi milik pasien lain 404 dan `read_at`-nya tidak berubah. */
    public function test_someone_elses_notification_answers_404_and_stays_unread(): void
    {
        $me = $this->createPatient();
        $other = $this->createPatient();
        $theirs = $this->notice($other);
        $mine = $this->notice($me);

        $this->actingAs($me)->post($this->readUrl($theirs), ['tujuan' => 'detail'])->assertNotFound();

    public function test_reading_twice_keeps_the_first_read_time_and_other_notifications_stay_unread(): void
    {
        $me = $this->createPatient();
        $first = $this->notice($me);
        $second = $this->notice($me);

        $this->actingAs($me)->post($this->readUrl($first), ['tujuan' => 'dashboard']);
        $firstReadAt = $first->fresh()->read_at->toDateTimeString();

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-05 09:00:00');
        $this->actingAs($me)->post($this->readUrl($first), ['tujuan' => 'dashboard'])->assertRedirect(route('patient.dashboard'));

        $this->assertSame('2026-10-05 07:00:00', $firstReadAt);
        $this->assertSame($firstReadAt, $first->fresh()->read_at->toDateTimeString());
        $this->assertNull($second->fresh()->read_at);
    }
}
```

Tulis `app/Http/Controllers/Patient/NotificationController.php` (tool Write):

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Patient;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

/**
 * Menandai notifikasi pasien sebagai dibaca (F6-R29, PAS-08). Hanya notifikasi milik akun yang login: baris milik
 * pengguna lain tidak ditemukan sehingga menjawab 404. Tujuan: `tujuan=dashboard` kembali ke dashboard; selain itu
 * (termasuk nilai larik atau liar) ke detail pendaftaran bila `data.booking_code` milik profil pasien ini, dan ke
 * riwayat bila tidak.
 */
class NotificationController extends Controller
{
    public function read(Request $request, string $id): RedirectResponse
    {
        $user = $request->user();
        $notification = $user->notifications()->whereKey($id)->firstOrFail();

        $notification->markAsRead();

        if ($request->input('tujuan') === 'dashboard') {
            return redirect()->route('patient.dashboard');
        }

        $profile = $user->loadMissing('patientProfile')->patientProfile;
        $code = is_array($notification->data) ? ($notification->data['booking_code'] ?? null) : null;

        if ($profile !== null && is_string($code) && $code !== '') {
            $owned = Appointment::query()->forPatient($profile)->where('booking_code', $code)->exists();

            if ($owned) {
                return redirect()->route('patient.appointments.show', ['appointment' => $code]);
            }
        }

        return redirect()->route('patient.appointments.index');
    }
}
```

new_string:

```php
use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Appointment;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Notifications\AppointmentScheduleChangedNotification;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Notifications\DatabaseNotification;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class DashboardController extends Controller
{
    /** Kunjungan mendatang pada kartu dashboard (F6-R28). */
    public const UPCOMING_LIMIT = 5;

    /** Pemberitahuan belum dibaca pada dashboard (F6-R28). */
    public const NOTICE_LIMIT = 5;

    /**
     * Dashboard pasien (F5-R22, F6-R28): kunjungan mendatang milik sendiri (aktif pada sesi yang belum berakhir, urut
     * tanggal lalu jam mulai, maksimal lima, relasi di-eager-load), banner jadwal berubah, dan pemberitahuan belum
     * dibaca. Akun pasien tanpa profil (data rusak) menjawab 404 (F5-R13).
     */
    public function index(Request $request): View
    {
        $user = $request->user();
        $profile = $user->loadMissing('patientProfile')->patientProfile;

        abort_if($profile === null, 404);

        $now = CarbonImmutable::now();

        $upcoming = Appointment::query()
            ->forPatient($profile)
            ->upcomingActive($now)
            ->with(['clinic', 'doctor', 'practiceSession'])
            ->orderBy('appointments.session_date')
            ->orderBy(PracticeSession::query()->select('start_time')->whereColumn('practice_sessions.id', 'appointments.practice_session_id'))
            ->orderBy('appointments.id')
            ->limit(self::UPCOMING_LIMIT)
            ->get();

        $changedCount = Appointment::query()
            ->forPatient($profile)
            ->upcomingActive($now)
            ->scheduleChanged()
            ->count();

        $notices = $user->unreadNotifications()
            ->limit(self::NOTICE_LIMIT)
            ->get()
            ->map(fn (DatabaseNotification $notification): array => [
                'id' => $notification->id,
                'title' => $this->text($notification->data, 'title', 'Pemberitahuan'),
                'body' => $this->text($notification->data, 'body', ''),
                'is_schedule_change' => $notification->type === AppointmentScheduleChangedNotification::class,
            ])
            ->all();

        return view('patient.dashboard', [
            'user' => $user,
            'profile' => $profile,
            'upcoming' => $upcoming,
            'changedCount' => $changedCount,
            'notices' => $notices,
        ]);
    }

    /** Nilai teks `data[$key]` notifikasi, atau `$fallback` bila bukan string atau kosong. */
    private function text(mixed $data, string $key, string $fallback): string
    {
        $value = is_array($data) ? ($data[$key] ?? null) : null;

        return is_string($value) && $value !== '' ? $value : $fallback;
    }
}
```

**Files:**

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `DoctorAvailabilityQuery::doctors(AvailabilityFilter, int): LengthAwarePaginator` (relasi `specialties` + `availabilities` per dokter), `SessionAvailability` (`session`, `remaining`, `availability`, `isBookableOnline`, `isBookableCounter`), `Availability::{Leave, Holiday, Cancelled}`, `Doctor::primary_specialty`, `InteractsWithMasterData::createDoctor()`, `InteractsWithSchedules::createSession()`.
- Produces: `DoctorAvailabilityQuery::prepareCards(iterable $doctors, bool $forDate = false): array` (kunci id dokter, nilai `?SessionAvailability`). Efek samping terdokumentasi: relasi `specialties` tiap dokter diganti spesialisasi aktif saja (D-56; `pivot->is_primary` tetap). Tanpa kueri. Dikonsumsi oleh `HomeController`, `DoctorController`, dan `AppointmentController::stepDoctors` (T7, lewat Edit di tugas ini; lihat Catatan penulis).

**Test IDs:** JDW-12 (satu sumber jadwal: definisi "jadwal terdekat" tunggal), CRD-01/CRD-03 bagian #1 dan #6 (kartu dokter tidak berubah), carry E12 fase 4a (F6-R32). Tidak ada ID kasus 15 baru; tes ini mengunci kesetaraan keluaran.

**Catatan teknis (diverifikasi dari source):**
- **Duplikasi yang disatukan (tepat dua tempat, byte-identik kecuali parameter).** `HomeController::index` (baris yang memfilter `specialties` lalu memanggil `$this->nextSession($doctor->availabilities)`) dan `DoctorController::index` (blok yang sama, memanggil `$this->nextSession($doctor->availabilities, $date !== null)`). Dua `nextSession()` privat: beranda = "sesi pertama yang BUKAN `Leave`/`Holiday`/`Cancelled`"; #6 = sama, kecuali bila filter `tanggal` aktif: `->first()` (sesi pertama hari itu, termasuk Cuti/Libur agar pengunjung tahu alasannya, F3-R25). Keduanya dipertahankan sebagai satu method dengan parameter `$forDate`.
- **Mengapa di `DoctorAvailabilityQuery`.** Kelas itu sudah "satu-satunya sumber jadwal untuk halaman publik, wizard pasien, dan form walk-in" (BR-16) dan sudah mengimpor `Availability`, `Collection`, dan `Doctor`; `doctors()` adalah penghasil relasi `availabilities` yang dikonsumsi `nextSession`. `SessionAvailability` adalah `final readonly` DTO tanpa logika koleksi, sehingga bukan tempat yang cocok. `doctors()` TIDAK diubah: tes `DoctorAvailabilityQueryTest` mengunci keluarannya dan pemanggil lain (wizard T7, form walk-in fase 7) mungkin memerlukan spesialisasi nonaktif.
- **Nama.** `prepareCards` (bukan `nextSessionsFor`) karena method juga mengganti relasi `specialties`; tipe `iterable` menerima `Collection` (beranda: `getCollection()`) maupun `LengthAwarePaginator` (#6; paginator mengimplementasikan `IteratorAggregate`, jadi `foreach` identik dengan kode lama). Hasil berkunci `$doctor->id` seperti array `$nextSessions` lama, sehingga view tetap membaca `$nextSessions[$doctor->id] ?? null`.
- **Impor yang jadi tak terpakai (pint `no_unused_imports`).** `HomeController`: `Availability`, `SessionAvailability`, `Collection` hanya dipakai `nextSession()`; `Specialty` TETAP dipakai (`Specialty::query()->active()`). `DoctorController`: `Availability`, `SessionAvailability`, `Collection` dihapus; `Specialty` TETAP dipakai. Diverifikasi dengan `git grep` (Step 6).
- **Mode ketat.** `prepareCards()` tidak boleh memicu lazy loading: `specialties` dan `availabilities` sudah di-eager-load `doctors()`; tes `…makes_no_queries` membuktikannya.
- **Tes kesetaraan (`DoctorCardParityTest`) adalah tes karakterisasi:** lulus SEBELUM refactor (Step 3) dan HARUS tetap lulus sesudahnya. Ia mengekstrak fakta kartu (badge spesialisasi, paragraf "Jadwal terdekat", `data-availability`, tautan Daftar) dari `GET /` dan `GET /dokter` untuk dokter yang sama dan membandingkannya; bila salah satu halaman menyimpang kelak, tes gagal.
- **Penanda pembangkitan sesi.** Seperti `PublicHomeTest`/`PublicDoctorIndexTest`, tes mengisi `PracticeSessionGenerator::markerKey(today)` agar templat bawaan pabrik tidak membangkitkan sesi tambahan saat controller memanggil `ensureDailyHorizon()`.

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Public;

use App\Enums\ExceptionType;
use App\Enums\SessionStatus;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Services\Scheduling\PracticeSessionGenerator;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithMasterData;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Carry E12 (F6-R32): beranda (`/`) dan direktori dokter (`/dokter`) memakai definisi "jadwal terdekat" dan saringan
 * spesialisasi aktif yang sama. Tes karakterisasi: lulus sebelum dan sesudah penyatuan ke
 * `DoctorAvailabilityQuery::prepareCards()`. Sekarang = Senin 2026-10-05 07.00.
 */
class DoctorCardParityTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithMasterData;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        Storage::fake('public');
        $this->travelTo('2026-10-05 07:00:00'); // Senin

        $today = CarbonImmutable::today();
        Cache::put(PracticeSessionGenerator::markerKey($today), true, $today->endOfDay());
    }

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides */
    private function sessionOf(Doctor $doctor, string $date, array $overrides = []): PracticeSession
    {
        return $this->createSession(array_merge([
            'doctor_id' => $doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $doctor->clinic_id,
            'session_date' => $date,
            'start_time' => '09:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'quota' => 20,
        ], $overrides));
    }

    private function leaveSession(Doctor $doctor, string $date): PracticeSession
    {
        $exception = $this->createException(['doctor_id' => $doctor->id, 'type' => ExceptionType::DoctorLeave, 'start_date' => $date, 'end_date' => $date]);

        return $this->sessionOf($doctor, $date, ['status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled, 'schedule_exception_id' => $exception->id]);
    }

    /**
     * Fakta kartu satu dokter dari HTML halaman: badge spesialisasi, "Jadwal terdekat", `data-availability`, dan tautan
     * Daftar. Kartu = `<article class="… doctor-card">` yang memuat nama dokter.
     *
     * @return array{specialties: list<string>, next: list<string>, availability: ?string, register: ?string}
     */
    private function cardFacts(string $html, string $doctorName): array
    {
        preg_match_all('#<article[^>]*doctor-card[^>]*>.*?</article>#s', $html, $cards);
        $card = collect($cards[0])->first(fn (string $item): bool => str_contains($item, $doctorName));

        $this->assertNotNull($card, "Kartu {$doctorName} tidak ditemukan.");

        preg_match_all('#<span class="badge text-bg-light border">([^<]*)</span>#', $card, $specialties);
        preg_match('#Jadwal terdekat: <time datetime="([^"]*)">([^<]*)</time> · ([^<]*)</p>#u', $card, $next);
        preg_match('#data-availability="([^"]*)"#', $card, $availability);
        preg_match('#<a class="btn btn-primary btn-sm[^"]*" href="([^"]*)"#', $card, $register);

        return [
            'specialties' => $specialties[1],
            'next' => array_slice($next, 1),
            'availability' => $availability[1] ?? null,
            'register' => $register[1] ?? null,
        ];
    }

    public function test_home_and_directory_show_the_same_nearest_session_and_active_specialty_for_a_doctor(): void
    {
        $hidden = $this->createSpecialty(['name' => 'Spesialis Nonaktif Utama', 'is_active' => false]);
        $shown = $this->createSpecialty(['name' => 'Spesialis Aktif Tambahan']);
        $rani = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Rani Oktaviani', 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => null], null, [$hidden, $shown]);
        $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Teguh Wicaksono', 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => null]);
        $this->leaveSession($rani, '2026-10-06');
        $this->sessionOf($rani, '2026-10-08', ['start_time' => '13:00:00', 'end_time' => '15:00:00']);

        $home = $this->cardFacts($this->get('/')->assertOk()->getContent(), 'dr. Rani Oktaviani');
        $directory = $this->cardFacts($this->get('/dokter')->assertOk()->getContent(), 'dr. Rani Oktaviani');

        $this->assertSame($home, $directory);
        $this->assertSame(['Spesialis Aktif Tambahan'], $home['specialties']);
        $this->assertSame(['2026-10-08', 'Kamis, 8 Oktober 2026', '13.00–15.00'], $home['next']);
        $this->assertSame('available', $home['availability']);
    }

    public function test_a_doctor_with_only_a_leave_session_has_no_nearest_session_on_either_page(): void
    {
        $teguh = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Teguh Wicaksono', 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => null]);
        $this->leaveSession($teguh, '2026-10-06');

        $home = $this->cardFacts($this->get('/')->assertOk()->getContent(), 'dr. Teguh Wicaksono');
        $directory = $this->cardFacts($this->get('/dokter')->assertOk()->getContent(), 'dr. Teguh Wicaksono');

        $this->assertSame($home, $directory);
        $this->assertSame([], $home['next']);
        $this->assertNull($home['availability']);
        $this->assertNull($home['register']);
    }

    /** Hanya #6 dengan filter `tanggal` menampilkan Cuti sebagai sesi yang diwakili kartu (F3-R25); beranda tidak punya filter. */
    public function test_the_date_filter_alone_lets_a_leave_session_represent_the_card(): void
    {
        $teguh = $this->createDoctor(['name' => 'Teguh Wicaksono', 'title_prefix' => 'dr.', 'title_suffix' => null]);
        $this->leaveSession($teguh, '2026-10-06');
        $this->sessionOf($teguh, '2026-10-08');

        $filtered = $this->cardFacts($this->get('/dokter?tanggal=2026-10-06')->assertOk()->getContent(), 'dr. Teguh Wicaksono');
        $unfiltered = $this->cardFacts($this->get('/dokter')->assertOk()->getContent(), 'dr. Teguh Wicaksono');
        $home = $this->cardFacts($this->get('/')->assertOk()->getContent(), 'dr. Teguh Wicaksono');

        $this->assertSame('leave', $filtered['availability']);
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-06', $filtered['next'][0]);
        $this->assertNull($filtered['register']);
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-08', $unfiltered['next'][0]);
        $this->assertSame($unfiltered, $home);
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Scheduling;

use App\Enums\Availability;
use App\Enums\ExceptionType;
use App\Enums\SessionStatus;
use App\Models\Doctor;
use App\Models\PracticeSession;
use App\Services\Scheduling\AvailabilityFilter;
use App\Services\Scheduling\DoctorAvailabilityQuery;
use App\Services\Scheduling\SessionAvailability;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Pagination\LengthAwarePaginator;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithMasterData;
use Tests\Support\InteractsWithSchedules;
use Tests\TestCase;

/**
 * Carry E12 (F6-R32): `DoctorAvailabilityQuery::prepareCards()` = satu definisi sesi yang diwakili kartu dokter publik
 * dan satu saringan spesialisasi aktif. Sekarang = Senin 2026-10-05 07.00.
 */
class DoctorCardPreparationTest extends TestCase
{
    use InteractsWithMasterData;
    use InteractsWithSchedules;
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->travelTo('2026-10-05 07:00:00'); // Senin
    }

    private function query(): DoctorAvailabilityQuery
    {
        return $this->app->make(DoctorAvailabilityQuery::class);
    }

    /** Direktori dokter halaman pertama, seperti yang dipakai controller publik. */
    private function directory(?CarbonImmutable $date = null): LengthAwarePaginator
    {
        request()->query->remove('page');

        return $this->query()->doctors(new AvailabilityFilter(date: $date), 12);
    }

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides */
    private function sessionOf(Doctor $doctor, string $date, array $overrides = []): PracticeSession
    {
        return $this->createSession(array_merge([
            'doctor_id' => $doctor->id,
            'clinic_id' => $doctor->clinic_id,
            'session_date' => $date,
            'start_time' => '09:00:00',
            'end_time' => '12:00:00',
            'quota' => 20,
        ], $overrides));
    }

    private function leaveSession(Doctor $doctor, string $date): PracticeSession
    {
        $exception = $this->createException(['doctor_id' => $doctor->id, 'type' => ExceptionType::DoctorLeave, 'start_date' => $date, 'end_date' => $date]);

        return $this->sessionOf($doctor, $date, ['status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled, 'schedule_exception_id' => $exception->id]);
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<int, SessionAvailability|null>  $cards
     * @return array<int, int|null>
     */
    private function sessionIds(array $cards): array
    {
        return array_map(fn (?SessionAvailability $card): ?int => $card?->session->id, $cards);
    }

    public function test_it_returns_the_nearest_session_that_is_not_a_cancellation_keyed_by_doctor_id(): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor();
        $withoutSessions = $this->createDoctor();
        $this->leaveSession($doctor, '2026-10-06');
        $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-07', ['status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled]);
        $nearest = $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-08');
        $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-09');

        $cards = $this->query()->prepareCards($this->directory());

        $this->assertEqualsCanonicalizing([$doctor->id, $withoutSessions->id], array_keys($cards));
        $this->assertSame($nearest->id, $cards[$doctor->id]->session->id);
        $this->assertSame(Availability::Available, $cards[$doctor->id]->availability);
        $this->assertNull($cards[$withoutSessions->id]);
    }

    public function test_a_holiday_or_a_plain_cancellation_never_stands_in_for_the_nearest_session(): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor();
        $holiday = $this->createException(['doctor_id' => null, 'type' => ExceptionType::NationalHoliday, 'start_date' => '2026-10-06', 'end_date' => '2026-10-06']);
        $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-06', ['status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled, 'schedule_exception_id' => $holiday->id]);
        $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-07', ['status' => SessionStatus::Cancelled]);

        $cards = $this->query()->prepareCards($this->directory());

        $this->assertNull($cards[$doctor->id]);
    }

    public function test_a_full_session_still_counts_as_the_nearest_session(): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor();
        $full = $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-06', ['quota' => 1, 'booked_count' => 1, 'last_queue_number' => 1]);

        $cards = $this->query()->prepareCards($this->directory());

        $this->assertSame($full->id, $cards[$doctor->id]->session->id);
        $this->assertSame(Availability::Full, $cards[$doctor->id]->availability);
    }

    public function test_with_a_date_it_returns_the_first_session_of_the_day_even_when_it_is_a_leave(): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor();
        $leave = $this->leaveSession($doctor, '2026-10-06');
        $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-06', ['start_time' => '13:00:00', 'end_time' => '15:00:00']);

        $cards = $this->query()->prepareCards($this->directory(CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-06')), true);

        $this->assertSame($leave->id, $cards[$doctor->id]->session->id);
        $this->assertSame(Availability::Leave, $cards[$doctor->id]->availability);
    }

    public function test_it_keeps_only_active_specialties_and_preserves_the_pivot(): void
    {
        $hidden = $this->createSpecialty(['name' => 'Spesialis Nonaktif Utama', 'is_active' => false]);
        $shown = $this->createSpecialty(['name' => 'Spesialis Aktif Tambahan']);
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor([], null, [$hidden, $shown]);

        $directory = $this->directory();
        $this->query()->prepareCards($directory);

        $prepared = collect($directory->items())->firstWhere('id', $doctor->id);

        $this->assertSame(['Spesialis Aktif Tambahan'], $prepared->specialties->pluck('name')->all());
        $this->assertFalse((bool) $prepared->specialties->first()->pivot->is_primary, 'Pivot asli (bukan primer) tetap terbawa.');
        $this->assertSame('Spesialis Aktif Tambahan', $prepared->primary_specialty->name);
    }

    public function test_it_accepts_a_paginator_and_a_plain_collection_with_the_same_result(): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor();
        $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-08');
        $this->createDoctor();

        $fromPaginator = $this->query()->prepareCards($this->directory());
        $fromCollection = $this->query()->prepareCards($this->directory()->getCollection());

        $this->assertSame($this->sessionIds($fromPaginator), $this->sessionIds($fromCollection));
        $this->assertCount(2, $fromPaginator);
    }

    public function test_an_empty_list_gives_an_empty_map(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame([], $this->query()->prepareCards([]));
        $this->assertSame([], $this->query()->prepareCards($this->directory()));
    }

    /** Mode ketat: `specialties` dan `availabilities` sudah dimuat `doctors()`; menyiapkan kartu tidak boleh mengueri. */
    public function test_preparing_cards_makes_no_queries(): void
    {
        $doctor = $this->createDoctor();
        $this->sessionOf($doctor, '2026-10-08');
        $directory = $this->directory();

        DB::flushQueryLog();
        DB::enableQueryLog();
        $this->query()->prepareCards($directory);
        $queries = DB::getQueryLog();
        DB::disableQueryLog();

        $this->assertSame([], $queries);
    }
}
```

```php
     * sesi yang diwakili kartu tiap dokter, berkunci id dokter (`null` bila tidak ada). Dengan `$forDate` (filter
     * tanggal #6) sesi yang diwakili ialah sesi pertama pada tanggal itu, termasuk Cuti/Libur agar pengunjung tahu
     * alasannya; tanpa itu, sesi terdekat yang bukan pembatalan (F3-R25). Relasi `specialties` dan `availabilities`
     * wajib sudah dimuat; tidak ada kueri.
     *
     * @param  iterable<int, Doctor>  $doctors
     * @return array<int, SessionAvailability|null>
     */
    public function prepareCards(iterable $doctors, bool $forDate = false): array
    {
        $sessions = [];

        foreach ($doctors as $doctor) {
            // Data publik hanya memuat spesialisasi aktif (D-56); pivot `is_primary` tetap terbawa.
            $doctor->setRelation('specialties', $doctor->specialties->filter(fn (Specialty $item): bool => $item->is_active)->values());
            $sessions[$doctor->id] = $this->representativeSession($doctor->availabilities, $forDate);
        }

        return $sessions;
    }

    /**
     * @param  Collection<int, SessionAvailability>  $availabilities
     */
    private function representativeSession(Collection $availabilities, bool $forDate): ?SessionAvailability
    {
        if ($forDate) {
            return $availabilities->first();
        }

        $cancellations = [Availability::Leave, Availability::Holiday, Availability::Cancelled];

        return $availabilities->first(
            fn (SessionAvailability $item): bool => ! in_array($item->availability, $cancellations, true),
        );
    }

     * Klasifikasi murni (tanpa kueri) menurut F3-R12; yang pertama cocok dipakai. Relasi `doctor`, `clinic`,
```
